; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Screen MODE dimensions
;
; The maximum text row and column number in each MODE.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.textWindowBottomRowTable                               ; Maximum text row number
    !byte 31                                            ; MODE 0 (32 rows)
    !byte 31                                            ; MODE 1 (32 rows)
    !byte 31                                            ; MODE 2 (32 rows)
    !byte 24                                            ; MODE 3 (25 rows)
    !byte 31                                            ; MODE 4 (32 rows)
    !byte 31                                            ; MODE 5 (32 rows)
    !byte 24                                            ; MODE 6 (25 rows)
    !byte 24                                            ; MODE 7 (25 rows)

.textWindowRightColumnTable                             ; Maximum text column number
    !byte 79                                            ; MODE 0 (80 columns)
    !byte 39                                            ; MODE 1 (40 columns)
    !byte 19                                            ; MODE 2 (20 columns)
    !byte 79                                            ; MODE 3 (80 columns)
    !byte 39                                            ; MODE 4 (40 columns)
    !byte 19                                            ; MODE 5 (20 columns)
    !byte 39                                            ; MODE 6 (40 columns)
    !byte 39                                            ; MODE 7 (40 columns)

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Video Control Register of the VideoULA
;
; bit
;   0 - Flash colour select (which of the flashing colours is displayed)
;   1 - Teletext select
;   2 - } These two bits determine the number of characters per row
;   3 - } from this table:
;       %00 = 10 characters per row
;       %01 = 20 characters per row
;       %10 = 40 characters per row
;       %11 = 80 characters per row
;   4 - CRTC clock rate select:
;        %0 = low frequency clock for MODEs 4-7
;        %1 = high frequency clock for MODEs 0-3
;   5 - } These two bits determine the width of cursor in bytes
;   6 - } from this table:
;       %00 = 1 (MODEs 0,3,4,6)
;       %01 = - undefined
;       %10 = 2 (MODEs 1,5,7)
;       %11 = 4 (MODE 2)

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Converting characters in Teletext
;
; See teletext.png
;
; Writing printable characters (32-126) directly to the display memory in MODE 7
; gives different results in three cases to printing via OSWRCH. In particular:
;
; Value     Write to Screen     Write to screen
;           Memory Directly       via OSWRCH
; ----------------------------------------------
;   $23           £                   #
;   $5F           #                   long dash
;   $60           long dash           £
; ----------------------------------------------
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.teletextCharacterConversionTable
    !byte $23                                           ; when writing a character in MODE 7,
                                                        ; replace each byte here with the next
                                                        ; in the table
    !byte $5F                                           ; when reading the character from the
                                                        ; screen, replace each byte with the
                                                        ; previous in the table
    !byte $60                                           ;
    !byte $23                                           ;

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Soft character table offsets
;
; Converts the OSBYTE 20 parameter 1-6 (how much of the character set to 'explode', i.e.
; which range of character definitions can be redefined) into the offset into the
; .vduFontZoneAddressesHigh1 table, which stores the page addresses used to define characters
; in an 'exploded' soft character set.
; See .osbyte20EntryPoint
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.softCharacterRamAllocationTable
    !byte $04                                           ; 1 -> 4 = range of characters 128-159
    !byte $05                                           ; 2 -> 5 = range of characters 160-191
    !byte $06                                           ; 3 -> 6 = range of characters 192-223
    !byte $00                                           ; 4 -> 0 = range of characters  32-63
    !byte $01                                           ; 5 -> 1 = range of characters  64-95
    !byte $02                                           ; 6 -> 2 = range of characters  96-127

; ***************************************************************************************
; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Chapter 5: VDU and OSWORD routines
;
; ***************************************************************************************
; ***************************************************************************************

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Note about the BBC Micro Character Set (it's almost, but not quite 7-bit ASCII)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
; One of the main tasks for OSWRCH is to draw characters to the screen. The VDUCHR routine
; performs this job. In particular, with A in the range 32-126 these are the 'printable'
; characters. They result in a visual character appearing on screen. They almost match the
; standard 7-bit ASCII character set. The exception being ASCII CODE 96 '`' (GRAVE ACCENT)
; which is not available. When this code is used with OSWRCH, a pound sign '£' is displayed
; instead. For character definitions, see Chapter 4.
;
; Additionally, MODE 7 (the TELETEXT mode) has a different character set from ASCII, which
; means 10 of the ASCII printable characters can't be displayed. Substitutions are made
; as follows:
;
;     ASCII CODE 91  '[' is displayed as an arrow pointing left
;     ASCII CODE 92  '\' is displayed as the fraction 1/2
;     ASCII CODE 93  ']' is displayed as an arrow pointing right
;     ASCII CODE 94  '^' is displayed as an arrow pointing up
;     ASCII CODE 95  '_' is displayed as a dash
;     ASCII CODE 96  '`' is displayed as a pound sign
;     ASCII CODE 123 '{' is displayed as the fraction 1/4
;     ASCII CODE 124 '|' is displayed as a double vertical bar
;     ASCII CODE 125 '}' is displayed as the fraction 3/4
;     ASCII CODE 126 '~' is displayed as the divide symbol
;
; Note that when writing directly to the display memory in MODE 7 this gives different
; results in three cases to printing via OSWRCH. See .teletextCharacterConversionTable
;
; The character being output is interpreted as below:
;
; Character Range   Description
;   0-31            Control characters, which are interpreted as a whole range of special
;                   commands. Multiple bytes may need to be output to complete the
;                   command. Each VDU command is described at it's own entry point
;                   which are listed in a table (See .vduEntryPointTableLow).
;   32-126          Printable ASCII(-ish) characters as described above.
;   127             Delete character. Attempts to remove the previous printed character
;                   from the screen at the text or graphics cursor (whichever is active).
;   128-255         Available for users programs as soft characters (see .osbyte20EntryPoint).
;                   In MODE 7 these control the appearance of Teletext characters.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
;
; VDUCHR entry point
;
; This is a limited version of OSWRCH that assumes output is to the display only, not to
; Econet, the printer, RS-423, nor SPOOLed to a file. It assumes the VDU drivers are enabled.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vduChrEntryPoint
    LDX .twosComplimentOfNumberOfBytesInVDUQueue        ; get the number of items in the VDU queue  $^$ 0xc4c0
    BNE .vduParametersAreOutstanding                    ; if (parameters are still needed) then branch  $^$ 0xc4c3
    BIT .vduStatusByte                                  ; test VDU status byte  $^$ 0xc4c5
    BVC +                                               ; if (cursor editing mode is NOT active) then branch forward  $^$ 0xc4c7

    ; handle cursor editing mode...
    JSR .exchangeTextCursorAndInputCursorValues         ; temporarily swap the text cursor and input cursor coordinates  $^$ 0xc4c9
    JSR .setUpWriteCursor                               ; set up write cursor  $^$ 0xc4cc
    BMI +                                               ; if (display is disabled) then branch forward  $^$ 0xc4cf
    CMP #.charRETURN                                    ;  $^$ 0xc4d1
    BNE +                                               ; if (character is not RETURN) then branch forward  $^$ 0xc4d3
    JSR .terminateEdit                                  ; terminate editing  $^$ 0xc4d5

+
    CMP #.charDELETE                                    ;  $^$ 0xc4d8
    BEQ .handleDeleteCharacter                          ; if (character is DELETE) then branch  $^$ 0xc4da
    CMP #.charSPACE                                     ;  $^$ 0xc4dc
    BCC .readVDUEntryPointAddressAndParameters          ; if (character less than space, i.e. a VDU control code) then branch  $^$ 0xc4de
    BIT .vduStatusByte                                  ; test VDU status byte again  $^$ 0xc4e0
    BMI +                                               ; if (screen disabled) then branch forward  $^$ 0xc4e2
    JSR .displayACharacter                              ; display a character  $^$ 0xc4e4
    JSR .vdu9EntryPoint                                 ; and cursor right  $^$ 0xc4e7
+
    JMP .exitVDUCHR                                     ;  $^$ 0xc4ea

; ***************************************************************************************
.handleDeleteCharacter
    LDA #.vduEntryPointTableDelete - .vduEntryPointTableLow ; index to read the vdu entry  $^$ 0xc4ed
                                                            ; point table for DELETE

.readVDUEntryPointAddressAndParameters
    TAY                                                 ; store the VDU number in Y  $^$ 0xc4ef
    LDA .vduEntryPointTableLow,Y                        ; get low byte of entry point address  $^$ 0xc4f0
    STA .vduJumpVectorLow                               ; store it in jump vector  $^$ 0xc4f3
    LDA .vduEntryPointTableHigh,Y                       ; get high byte of entry point address  $^$ 0xc4f6
    BMI .explicitAddressNoParameters                    ; if (a direct access with no parameters) then branch  $^$ 0xc4f9
    TAX                                                 ; X=A  $^$ 0xc4fb
    ORA #%11110000                                      ; set up negated parameter count (set bits in top nybble)  $^$ 0xc4fc
    STA .twosComplimentOfNumberOfBytesInVDUQueue        ; store it back as number of items in VDU queue  $^$ 0xc4fe
    TXA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xc501
    LSR                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xc502
    LSR                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xc503
    LSR                                                 ; } get high nybble into low nybble  $^$ 0xc504
    LSR                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xc505
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xc506
    ADC #>.vduBaseAddress                               ; add base address (high byte) to get high byte of VDU entry point address  $^$ 0xc507
    STA .vduJumpVectorHigh                              ;  $^$ 0xc509
    BIT .vduStatusByte                                  ; check for cursor editing mode enabled  $^$ 0xc50c
    BVS .reexchangeCursorsAndExit                       ; if (cursor editing mode enabled) then branch (re-exchange cursors)  $^$ 0xc50e
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xc510
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 0 / 6 / 27      Empty handlers
;
;   VDU 0  - Does nothing
;   VDU 6  - Enable VDU drivers (re-enabling is handled prior to here, see .checkForVDUReenable)
;   VDU 27 - ESCAPE code, does nothing
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu0EntryPoint
.vdu6EntryPoint
.vdu27EntryPoint
.exit
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc511

; ***************************************************************************************
.vduParametersAreOutstanding
    STA .vduQueueEndByte-$FF,X                          ; store parameter in vdu queue  $^$ 0xc512
                                                        ; (X = 256 - number of parameters
                                                        ; i.e. X=$FF for 1, $FE for 2 etc.)
    INX                                                 ; increment X  $^$ 0xc515
    STX .twosComplimentOfNumberOfBytesInVDUQueue        ; store it as number of bytes in VDU queue (2's complement)  $^$ 0xc516
    BNE .clearCarryAndExit                              ; if (more parameters are needed) then branch  $^$ 0xc519
    BIT .vduStatusByte                                  ; test VDU status byte  $^$ 0xc51b
    BMI .preVDU1                                        ; if (VDU disabled) then branch to VDU 1 code  $^$ 0xc51d
    BVS .handleCursorEditing                            ; if (cursor editing mode) then branch  $^$ 0xc51f
    JSR .executeRequiredVDUFunction                     ; execute required function for VDU command  $^$ 0xc521
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xc524
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc525

.handleCursorEditing
    JSR .exchangeTextCursorAndInputCursorValues         ; swap values of cursors  $^$ 0xc526
    JSR .setUpWriteCursor                               ; set up write cursor  $^$ 0xc529
    JSR .executeRequiredVDUFunction                     ; execute required function for VDU command  $^$ 0xc52c
.reexchangeCursorsAndExit
    JSR .reswapCursorsBack                              ; re-exchange cursors  $^$ 0xc52f
.clearCarryAndExit
    CLC                                                 ; carry clear  $^$ 0xc532
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc533

.preVDU1
    LDY .vduJumpVectorHigh                              ; check the upper byte of entry point address  $^$ 0xc534
    CPY #>.vdu1EntryPoint                               ; check for the default handler  $^$ 0xc537
    BNE .clearCarryAndExit                              ; if (not the default handler) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xc539
    ; fall through...


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 1       Send next byte to printer only
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu1EntryPoint
    TAX                                                 ; remember A  $^$ 0xc53b
    LDA .vduStatusByte                                  ; get VDU status byte  $^$ 0xc53c
    LSR                                                 ; get bit 0 into carry (printer enabled bit)  $^$ 0xc53e
    BCC .exit                                           ; if (printer not enabled) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xc53f
    TXA                                                 ; restore A  $^$ 0xc541
    JMP .sendValidByteToPrinter                         ; send byte in A (next byte) to printer  $^$ 0xc542

; ***************************************************************************************
.explicitAddressNoParameters
    STA .vduJumpVectorHigh                              ; upper byte of link address  $^$ 0xc545
    TYA                                                 ; restore A (the VDU number)  $^$ 0xc548

    ; set carry if VDU number is within range 8-13 (cursor movement)
    CMP #8                                              ;  $^$ 0xc549
    BCC +                                               ; if (VDU number < 8) then branch (carry clear)  $^$ 0xc54b
    EOR #$FF                                            ; invert value  $^$ 0xc54d
    CMP #$F2                                            ; if (VDU number > 13) then clear carry  $^$ 0xc54f
    EOR #$FF                                            ; re-invert value back again  $^$ 0xc551

+
    BIT .vduStatusByte                                  ; test VDU status byte  $^$ 0xc553
    BMI .checkForVDUReenable                            ; if (VDU disabled) then branch  $^$ 0xc555
    PHP                                                 ; push flags  $^$ 0xc557
    JSR .executeRequiredVDUFunction                     ; execute required function  $^$ 0xc558
    PLP                                                 ; pull flags back  $^$ 0xc55b
    BCC +                                               ; if (not VDU 8-13 cursor movement) then branch (skip 'printer enabled' check)  $^$ 0xc55c
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.exitVDUCHR
    LDA .vduStatusByte                                  ; read VDU status byte  $^$ 0xc55e
    LSR                                                 ; carry is set if printer is enabled  $^$ 0xc560
+
    BIT .vduStatusByte                                  ; test VDU status byte  $^$ 0xc561
    BVC .exit                                           ; if (no cursor editing mode) then branch  $^$ 0xc563
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.reswapCursorsBack
    JSR .restoreWriteCursor                             ; restore normal write cursor  $^$ 0xc565

.exchangeTextCursorAndInputCursorValues
    PHP                                                 ; save flags  $^$ 0xc568
    PHA                                                 ; save A  $^$ 0xc569
    LDX #.vduTextCursorXPosition        - .vduVariablesStart    ; offset within VDU variables for text cursor position  $^$ 0xc56a
    LDY #.vduTextInputCursorXCoordinate - .vduVariablesStart    ; offset within VDU variables for text input cursor position  $^$ 0xc56c
    JSR .exchangeTwoVDUBytes                            ; exchange current text cursor coordinates with text input cursor coordinates  $^$ 0xc56e
    JSR .setTextCursorScreenAddresses                   ; set cursor screen addresses  $^$ 0xc571
    JSR .setHardwareCursorAddress                       ; set cursor position  $^$ 0xc574
    LDA .vduStatusByte                                  ; get VDU status byte  $^$ 0xc577
    EOR #%00000010                                      ; invert bit 1 to allow or inhibit scrolling  $^$ 0xc579
    STA .vduStatusByte                                  ; store VDU status byte  $^$ 0xc57b
    PLA                                                 ; restore flags  $^$ 0xc57d
    PLP                                                 ; restore A  $^$ 0xc57e
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc57f

; ***************************************************************************************
.checkForVDUReenable
    EOR #6                                              ; check for VDU 6 (to reenable output to the display)  $^$ 0xc580
    BNE .exit1                                          ; if (not VDU 6) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xc582
    LDA #%01111111                                      ; set A to clear the top bit of the VDU status byte  $^$ 0xc584
    BCC .clearVDUStatusByteFlags                        ; ALWAYS branch, clearing the top bit (enabling output to the display again)  $^$ 0xc586

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Check whether the text or graphics cursor is active
;
; On Exit:
;    A = 0   if text cursor is active           (Z flag set)
;    A = $20 otherwise (graphics cursor active) (Z flag clear)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.isTextCursorActive
    LDA .vduStatusByte                                  ; VDU status byte  $^$ 0xc588
    AND #%00100000                                      ; test bit 5 of status byte  $^$ 0xc58a
.exit1
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc58c


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 14    Set paged mode
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu14EntryPoint
    LDY #0                                              ; Y = 0  $^$ 0xc58d
    STY .pagedModeCounter                               ; paged mode counter  $^$ 0xc58f
    LDA #4                                              ; A = 4  $^$ 0xc592
    BNE .setVDUStatusByteFlags                          ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xc594


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 2     Printer On
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu2EntryPoint
    JSR .printerServiceCall                             ; select printer buffer  $^$ 0xc596
    LDA #$94                                            ; A=$94 when inverted at next statement this = 1  $^$ 0xc599
                                                        ; thereby setting bit 0 of the VDU status byte (printer output enable)
    ; fall through...


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 21    Disable VDU drivers
;
; Output to the VDU is disabled (until a VDU 6 is used to re-enable output).
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu21EntryPoint
    EOR #$95                                            ; if A=21  (entry from VDU 21) then A = $80  $^$ 0xc59b
                                                        ; if A=$94 (entry from VDU 2)  then A = 1
.setVDUStatusByteFlags
    ORA .vduStatusByte                                  ; VDU status byte set bit 0 or bit 7  $^$ 0xc59d
    BNE .storeVDUStatusByteAndReturn                    ; ALWAYS branch (since A != 0)  $^$ 0xc59f


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 3     Printer off
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu3EntryPoint
    JSR .printerServiceCall                             ; select printer buffer  $^$ 0xc5a1
    LDA #10                                             ;  $^$ 0xc5a4
    ; fall through...


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 15    Paged mode off
;
; On Entry:
;       A = 15  paged mode off
;       A = 10  printer off
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu15EntryPoint
    EOR #$F4                                            ; convert to $FB or $FE to clear  $^$ 0xc5a6
                                                        ; bit 2 or 1 respectively
.clearVDUStatusByteFlags
    AND .vduStatusByte                                  ; AND with VDU status byte  $^$ 0xc5a8
.storeVDUStatusByteAndReturn
    STA .vduStatusByte                                  ; store VDU status byte  $^$ 0xc5aa
-
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc5ac


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 4       Select text cursor
;
; At all times either the text cursor is active or the graphics cursor is active
; Characters are either drawn normally in text cells (at the text cursor) or at any pixel
; position (the graphics cursor)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu4EntryPoint
    LDA .vduPixelsPerByteMinusOne                       ; pixels per byte  $^$ 0xc5ad
    BEQ -                                               ; if (not in graphics MODE) then branch (return)  $^$ 0xc5b0
    JSR .setTextCursor                                  ; set text cursor (CRTC hardware)  $^$ 0xc5b2
    LDA #%11011111                                      ; clear bit 5 (graphics cursor bit)  $^$ 0xc5b5
    BNE .clearVDUStatusByteFlags                        ; ALWAYS branch - clear bit 5 and exit  $^$ 0xc5b7


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 5       Select graphics cursor
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu5EntryPoint
    LDA .vduPixelsPerByteMinusOne                       ; pixels per byte minus one  $^$ 0xc5b9
    BEQ -                                               ; if (not in graphics MODE) then branch (return)  $^$ 0xc5bc
    LDA #32                                             ; cursor setting  $^$ 0xc5be
    JSR .setCursorOnOrOff                               ; turn off cursor  $^$ 0xc5c0
    BNE .setVDUStatusByteFlags                          ; ALWAYS branch - set bit 5 of VDU status byte and exit  $^$ 0xc5c3


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 8       Cursor left (.charBACKSPACE)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu8EntryPoint
    JSR .isTextCursorActive                             ; set A=0 if text cursor is active  $^$ 0xc5c5
                                                        ;  or A=$20 if graphics cursor
    BNE .moveGraphicsCursorLeftEightPixels              ; if (currently in graphics cursor  $^$ 0xc5c8
                                                        ; mode) then branch (to move cursor
                                                        ; left 8 pixels)
    DEC .vduTextCursorXPosition                         ; decrement text column  $^$ 0xc5ca
    LDX .vduTextCursorXPosition                         ; get new text column  $^$ 0xc5cd
    CPX .vduTextWindowLeft                              ; check against left of text window  $^$ 0xc5d0
    BMI .wrapFromLeftEdgeToRightEdgeOfTextWindow        ; if (less than left edge of text  $^$ 0xc5d3
                                                        ; window) then branch (wrap to right
                                                        ; edge and one line up)
    LDA .vduTextCursorCRTCAddressLow                    ; get text cursor CRTC address (low)  $^$ 0xc5d5
    SEC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc5d8
    SBC .vduBytesPerCharacter                           ; subtract bytes per character  $^$ 0xc5d9
    TAX                                                 ; put in X  $^$ 0xc5dc
    LDA .vduTextCursorCRTCAddressHigh                   ; get text cursor CRTC address (high)  $^$ 0xc5dd
    SBC #0                                              ; subtract 0 + carry  $^$ 0xc5e0
    CMP .vduStartScreenAddressHighByte                  ; compare with high byte of screen  $^$ 0xc5e2
                                                        ; RAM address
    BCS +                                               ; if (text cursor is not below the  $^$ 0xc5e5
                                                        ; start of the screen address) then
                                                        ; branch forward
    ADC .vduScreenSizeHighByte                          ; add screen RAM size high byte to  $^$ 0xc5e7
                                                        ; wrap back onto screen
+
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A  $^$ 0xc5ea
    JMP .setTextCursorCRTCAddress                       ; A high and X low byte of cursor  $^$ 0xc5eb
                                                        ; address

; ***************************************************************************************
.wrapFromLeftEdgeToRightEdgeOfTextWindow
    LDA .vduTextWindowRight                             ; load text window right edge  $^$ 0xc5ee
    STA .vduTextCursorXPosition                         ; set current text column  $^$ 0xc5f1

.cursorUp
    DEC .pagedModeCounter                               ; paged mode counter  $^$ 0xc5f4
    BPL +                                               ; if (not less than zero) then branch (skip next instruction)  $^$ 0xc5f7
    INC .pagedModeCounter                               ; paged mode counter to restore X=0  $^$ 0xc5f9
+
    LDX .vduTextCursorYPosition                         ; current text line  $^$ 0xc5fc
    CPX .vduTextWindowTop                               ; top of text window  $^$ 0xc5ff
    BEQ .cursorAtTopOfTextWindow                        ; if (it's at the top of the text window) then branch  $^$ 0xc602
    DEC .vduTextCursorYPosition                         ; decrement current text line  $^$ 0xc604
    JMP .setCursorSoftwareAndHardwarePosition           ; set cursor position  $^$ 0xc607

; ***************************************************************************************
.cursorAtTopOfTextWindow
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xc60a
    JSR .moveTextCursorToNextLine                       ; move cursor  $^$ 0xc60b
    LDA #%00001000                                      ; A=8 to check for software scrolling  $^$ 0xc60e
    BIT .vduStatusByte                                  ; test VDU status byte  $^$ 0xc610
    BNE +                                               ; if (software scrolling enabled) then branch forward  $^$ 0xc612
    JSR .hardwareScrollDown                             ; scroll down  $^$ 0xc614
    BNE .skipScrolling                                  ; branch  $^$ 0xc617
+
    JSR .scrollTextWindowDownwards                      ; soft scroll 1 line  $^$ 0xc619
.skipScrolling
    JMP .clearOneLineAndPositionCursor                  ; clear one line and exit  $^$ 0xc61c

; ***************************************************************************************
.moveGraphicsCursorLeftEightPixels
    LDX #0                                              ; X = 0 to select horizontal movement (move left)  $^$ 0xc61f
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Move graphics cursor (left or down)
;
; On Entry:
;       X = 0 to move left or
;       X = 2 to move down
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.moveGraphicsCursorLeftOrDownEightPixels
    STX .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; store X  $^$ 0xc621
    JSR .checkGraphicsCursorIsWithinGraphicsWindow      ; check window bounds  $^$ 0xc623
    LDX .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; restore X  $^$ 0xc626
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xc628
    LDA .vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXLow,X                  ; current graphics cursor (X=2 for vertical movement)  $^$ 0xc629
    SBC #8                                              ; subtract 8 to move back/down 1 character  $^$ 0xc62c
    STA .vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXLow,X                  ; store in current graphics cursor (X=2 for vertical movement)  $^$ 0xc62e
    BCS +                                               ; if (carry set, no need to adjust high byte) then branch forward  $^$ 0xc631
    DEC .vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXHigh,X                 ; decrement high byte of graphics cursor  $^$ 0xc633
+
    LDA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; check the old graphics cursor position  $^$ 0xc636
    BNE .setUpExternalGraphicsCoordinates               ; if (old graphics position out of the graphics window bounds) then branch  $^$ 0xc638
    JSR .checkGraphicsCursorIsWithinGraphicsWindow      ; check the new graphics cursor position  $^$ 0xc63a
    BEQ .setUpExternalGraphicsCoordinates               ; if (not out of bounds now) then branch  $^$ 0xc63d

    ; this is the case where the old coordinates were within the window, but now are not.
    ; when moving left, then move up and clamp to the right edge.
    ; when moving down, clamp to the top edge.
    LDX .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; get back X  $^$ 0xc63f
    LDA .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsRightLow,X              ; get graphics window right (X=0) or top (X=2)  $^$ 0xc641
    CPX #1                                              ;  $^$ 0xc644
    BCS +                                               ; if (moving down) then branch forward  $^$ 0xc646
    SBC #6                                              ; moving left. A = A - 7 (note carry is clear)  $^$ 0xc648
+
    STA .vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXLow,X                  ; current graphics cursor position (X=2 means vertical)  $^$ 0xc64a
    LDA .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsRightHigh,X             ; graphics window right (X=0) or top (X=2) high byte  $^$ 0xc64d
    SBC #0                                              ; subtract carry  $^$ 0xc650
    STA .vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXHigh,X                 ; current graphics cursor position (X=2 means vertical)  $^$ 0xc652
    TXA                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc655
    BEQ .graphicsCursorUpEightPixels                    ; if (moving left) then branch  $^$ 0xc656
                                                        ; (because we've hit the left edge,
                                                        ; move graphics cursor up)

.setUpExternalGraphicsCoordinates
    JMP .convertPixelGraphicsCoordinatesToExternal      ; set up external coordinates for graphics  $^$ 0xc658


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 11       Cursor up
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu11EntryPoint
    JSR .isTextCursorActive                             ; set A=0 if text cursor is active; A=$20 if graphics cursor  $^$ 0xc65b
    BEQ .cursorUp                                       ; if (text cursor is active) then branch  $^$ 0xc65e
.graphicsCursorUpEightPixels
    LDX #2                                              ; set X = 2 for moving graphics cursor UP  $^$ 0xc660
    BNE .moveGraphicsCursorUpOrRightEightPixels         ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xc662


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 9        Cursor right
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu9EntryPoint
    LDA .vduStatusByte                                  ; get VDU status byte  $^$ 0xc664
    AND #%00100000                                      ; check bit 5 (graphics cursor)  $^$ 0xc666
    BNE .moveGraphicsCursorRightEightPixels             ; if (graphics cursor in use) then branch  $^$ 0xc668
    LDX .vduTextCursorXPosition                         ; text column  $^$ 0xc66a
    CPX .vduTextWindowRight                             ; text window right  $^$ 0xc66d
    BCS .moveTextCursorToLeftEdgeAndDown                ; if (X exceeds window right) then branch  $^$ 0xc670
    INC .vduTextCursorXPosition                         ; text column  $^$ 0xc672
    LDA .vduTextCursorCRTCAddressLow                    ; text cursor CRTC address low  $^$ 0xc675
    ADC .vduBytesPerCharacter                           ; add bytes per character  $^$ 0xc678
    TAX                                                 ; X = new low byte of CRTC address  $^$ 0xc67b
    LDA .vduTextCursorCRTCAddressHigh                   ; text cursor CRTC address high  $^$ 0xc67c
    ADC #0                                              ; add carry. A = new high byte of CRTC address  $^$ 0xc67f
    JMP .setTextCursorCRTCAddress                       ; use X and A to set new text cursor CRTC address  $^$ 0xc681

; ***************************************************************************************
.moveTextCursorToLeftEdgeAndDown
    LDA .vduTextWindowLeft                              ; text window left  $^$ 0xc684
    STA .vduTextCursorXPosition                         ; text column  $^$ 0xc687
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.moveTextCursorDown
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xc68a
    JSR .handleScrollingInPagedModeInternal             ; check text window bottom edge, X=line count  $^$ 0xc68b
    LDX .vduTextCursorYPosition                         ; current text line  $^$ 0xc68e
    CPX .vduTextWindowBottom                            ; bottom edge  $^$ 0xc691
    BCS +                                               ; if (current text Y position => bottom edge) then branch  $^$ 0xc694
    INC .vduTextCursorYPosition                         ; increment current text line  $^$ 0xc696
    BCC .setCursorSoftwareAndHardwarePosition           ; ALWAYS branch (set cursor position)  $^$ 0xc699
+
    JSR .moveTextCursorToNextLine                       ; move cursor to next line  $^$ 0xc69b
    LDA #%00001000                                      ; check bit 3 (software scrolling)  $^$ 0xc69e
    BIT .vduStatusByte                                  ; test VDU status byte  $^$ 0xc6a0
    BNE +                                               ; if (software scrolling enabled) then branch  $^$ 0xc6a2
    JSR .hardwareScrollUp                               ; perform hardware scroll  $^$ 0xc6a4
    BNE .clearOneLineAndPositionCursor                  ;  $^$ 0xc6a7
+
    JSR .scrollTextWindowUpwards                        ; execute upward software scroll  $^$ 0xc6a9
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.clearOneLineAndPositionCursor
    JSR .clearOneLine                                   ; clear a line  $^$ 0xc6ac
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Set cursor address
;
; Calculates cursor screen addresses and sets the hardware
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.setCursorSoftwareAndHardwarePosition
    JSR .setTextCursorScreenAddresses                   ; set cursor screen addresses  $^$ 0xc6af
    BCC .setHardwareCursorAddressLocal                  ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xc6b2

; ***************************************************************************************
.moveGraphicsCursorRightEightPixels
    LDX #0                                              ; X=0 for move cursor right  $^$ 0xc6b4
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Move graphics cursor (up or right)
;
; On Entry:
;       X = 0 means move graphics cursor right
;       X = 2 means move graphics cursor up
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.moveGraphicsCursorUpOrRightEightPixels
    STX .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; store X  $^$ 0xc6b6
    JSR .checkGraphicsCursorIsWithinGraphicsWindow      ; check window bounds  $^$ 0xc6b8
    LDX .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; recall X  $^$ 0xc6bb
    CLC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc6bd
    LDA .vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXLow,X                  ; get current graphics cursor (low)  $^$ 0xc6be
    ADC #8                                              ; add 8 pixels  $^$ 0xc6c1
    STA .vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXLow,X                  ; set current graphics cursor (low)  $^$ 0xc6c3
    BCC +                                               ;  $^$ 0xc6c6
    INC .vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXHigh,X                 ; set current graphics cursor (high)  $^$ 0xc6c8
+
    LDA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; A=0 no window violations, 1 or 2 indicates violation  $^$ 0xc6cb
    BNE .setUpExternalGraphicsCoordinates               ; if (outside graphics window) then branch  $^$ 0xc6cd
    JSR .checkGraphicsCursorIsWithinGraphicsWindow      ; check window bounds  $^$ 0xc6cf
    BEQ .setUpExternalGraphicsCoordinates               ; if (within graphics window) then branch  $^$ 0xc6d2

    LDX .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; get back X  $^$ 0xc6d4
    LDA .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsLeftLow,X               ; get left/bottom edge of graphics  $^$ 0xc6d6
                                                        ; window (low) (X=0 means left,
                                                        ; else X=2 means bottom)
    CPX #1                                              ;  $^$ 0xc6d9
    BCC +                                               ; if (X is 0; hit left edge) then branch  $^$ 0xc6db
    ADC #6                                              ; A = A + 7 (including carry)  $^$ 0xc6dd
+
    STA .vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXLow,X                  ; set current graphics cursor position (low)  $^$ 0xc6df
    LDA .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsLeftHigh,X              ; get left edge (high)  $^$ 0xc6e2
    ADC #0                                              ; add carry  $^$ 0xc6e5
    STA .vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXHigh,X                 ; set current graphics cursor position (high)  $^$ 0xc6e7
    TXA                                                 ; A=X  $^$ 0xc6ea
    BEQ .graphicsCursorDown                             ; if (X = 0) then branch (move graphics cursor down)  $^$ 0xc6eb
    JMP .convertPixelGraphicsCoordinatesToExternal      ; set up external coordinates for graphics  $^$ 0xc6ed


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 10       Cursor down
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu10EntryPoint
    JSR .isTextCursorActive                             ; set A=0 if text cursor is active; A=$20 if graphics cursor  $^$ 0xc6f0
    BEQ .moveTextCursorDown                             ; if (text cursor active) then branch  $^$ 0xc6f3
.graphicsCursorDown
    LDX #2                                              ; X = 2 to indicate movement down  $^$ 0xc6f5
    JMP .moveGraphicsCursorLeftOrDownEightPixels        ; move graphics cursor down  $^$ 0xc6f7


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 28       Define Text Window
;
; A sub-rectangle on screen can be defined that limits where text can be drawn.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu28ParamLeftEdge   = .vduQueueEndByte - 3
.vdu28ParamBottomEdge = .vduQueueEndByte - 2
.vdu28ParamRightEdge  = .vduQueueEndByte - 1
.vdu28ParamTopEdge    = .vduQueueEndByte
; Note that last parameter is always in 0323

.vdu28EntryPoint
    LDX .vduCurrentScreenMODE                           ; get current screen MODE  $^$ 0xc6fa
    LDA .vdu28ParamBottomEdge                           ; get bottom edge  $^$ 0xc6fd
    CMP .vdu28ParamTopEdge                              ; compare with top edge  $^$ 0xc700
    BCC .exit2                                          ; if (bottom edge exceeds top edge) then branch (return)  $^$ 0xc703
    CMP .textWindowBottomRowTable,X                     ; check against text window bottom edge maximum  $^$ 0xc705
    BEQ +                                               ; if (on the edge) then branch (it's OK)  $^$ 0xc708
    BCS .exit2                                          ; if (outside bounds) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xc70a
+
    LDA .vdu28ParamRightEdge                            ; get right edge  $^$ 0xc70c
    TAY                                                 ; put it in Y  $^$ 0xc70f
    CMP .textWindowRightColumnTable,X                   ; text window right hand edge maximum  $^$ 0xc710
    BEQ +                                               ; if (on the edge) then branch (it's OK)  $^$ 0xc713
    BCS .exit2                                          ; if (outside bounds) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xc715
+
    SEC                                                 ; set carry to subtract  $^$ 0xc717
    SBC .vdu28ParamLeftEdge                             ; left edge  $^$ 0xc718
    BMI .exit2                                          ; if (left edge greater than right) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xc71b
    TAY                                                 ; A=Y (window width)  $^$ 0xc71d
    JSR .calculateBytesPerTextWindowRow                 ; calculate number of bytes in a text window row  $^$ 0xc71e
    LDA #%00001000                                      ; set bit 3 of .vduStatusByte  $^$ 0xc721
    JSR .setVDUStatusByteFlags                          ; indicating that text window is defined  $^$ 0xc723
    LDX #.vdu28ParamLeftEdge - .vduVariablesStart       ; point to parameters  $^$ 0xc726
    LDY #.vduTextWindowLeft  - .vduVariablesStart       ; point to text window edges  $^$ 0xc728
    JSR .copyFourBytesWithinVDUVariables                ; copy 4 parameters into the text window edges  $^$ 0xc72a
    JSR .validatePositionAndSetupScreenAddress          ; check ok and set up screen address  $^$ 0xc72d
    BCS .vdu30EntryPoint                                ; home cursor within window  $^$ 0xc730
.setHardwareCursorAddressLocal
    JMP .setHardwareCursorAddress                       ; set cursor position  $^$ 0xc732


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   OSWORD 9 - Read a pixel
;
; On Entry:
;       .oswordA = 9
;       .oswordX = low byte of parameter block address
;       .oswordY = high byte of parameter block address
;
;   .oswordX/Y is the address of the four bytes of parameters:
;       byte 0-1: X coordinate
;       byte 2-3: Y coordinate
;
; On Exit:
;       Result stored in byte 4 of parameter block:
;           $FF if point was off screen, or logical colour of point if on screen
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osword9EntryPoint
    LDY #3                                              ; Y is loop counter  $^$ 0xc735
-
    LDA (.oswordX),Y                                    ; get it  $^$ 0xc737
    STA .vduWorkspaceA,Y                                ; store it  $^$ 0xc739
    DEY                                                 ; decrement counter  $^$ 0xc73c
    BPL -                                               ; loop back until done  $^$ 0xc73d
    LDA #.vduWorkspaceA - .vduVariablesStart            ;  $^$ 0xc73f
    JSR .readPixel                                      ;  $^$ 0xc741
    LDY #4                                              ; Y=4  $^$ 0xc744
    BNE .storeAInParameterBlock                         ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xc746


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   OSWORD 11 - Read palette
;
; On Entry:
;       Y = 0
;       .oswordA = 11
;       .osWordX = low byte of parameter block address
;       .osWordY = high byte of parameter block address
;
;   .oswordX/Y is the address of the four byte parameter block:
;       byte 0: logical colour to read
;
; On Exit:
;       byte 0: logical colour
;       byte 1: physical colour
;       byte 2: zero
;       byte 3: zero
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osword11EntryPoint
    AND .vduNumberOfLogicalColoursMinusOne              ; number of logical colours less 1  $^$ 0xc748
    TAX                                                 ; put it in X  $^$ 0xc74b
    LDA .vduColourPaletteStart,X                        ; get value from colour palette  $^$ 0xc74c
-
    INY                                                 ; increment Y to point to byte 1  $^$ 0xc74f
.storeAInParameterBlock
    STA (.oswordX),Y                                    ; store data  $^$ 0xc750
    LDA #0                                              ; issue 0s  $^$ 0xc752
    CPY #4                                              ; to next bytes until Y=4  $^$ 0xc754
    BNE -                                               ;  $^$ 0xc756
.exit2
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc758


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 12      Clear text or graphics window
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu12EntryPoint
    JSR .isTextCursorActive                             ; set A=0 if text cursor is active; A=$20 if graphics cursor  $^$ 0xc759
    BNE .clearGraphicsWindowAndHomeGraphicsCursor       ; if (graphics cursor active) then branch (clear graphics area)  $^$ 0xc75c
    LDA .vduStatusByte                                  ; VDU status byte  $^$ 0xc75e
    AND #%00001000                                      ; check if software scrolling (text window set)  $^$ 0xc760
    BNE +                                               ; if (software scrolling) then branch  $^$ 0xc762
    JMP .initializeDisplayAndHomeCursor                 ; initialise screen display and home cursor  $^$ 0xc764
+
    LDX .vduTextWindowTop                               ; top of text window  $^$ 0xc767
-
    STX .vduTextCursorYPosition                         ; current text line  $^$ 0xc76a
    JSR .clearOneLine                                   ; clear a line  $^$ 0xc76d

    LDX .vduTextCursorYPosition                         ; current text line  $^$ 0xc770
    CPX .vduTextWindowBottom                            ; bottom edge  $^$ 0xc773
    INX                                                 ; X=X+1  $^$ 0xc776
    BCC -                                               ; if (not reached bottom edge yet)  $^$ 0xc777
                                                        ; then branch (loop back and clear the next row)
    ; fall through...


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 30      Home Cursor
;
; Moves the current cursor (text or graphics) to the top left of the defined text or
; graphics window.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu30EntryPoint
    JSR .isTextCursorActive                             ; set A=0 if text cursor is active; A=$20 if graphics cursor  $^$ 0xc779
    BEQ .homeTextCursor                                 ; if (text cursor active) then branch  $^$ 0xc77c
    JMP .graphicsCursorHome                             ; home graphic cursor  $^$ 0xc77e

.homeTextCursor
    STA .vdu31ParamYCoordinate                          ; store 0 in last two parameters  $^$ 0xc781
    STA .vdu31ParamXCoordinate                          ;  $^$ 0xc784
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 31      Position text cursor
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu31ParamXCoordinate = .vduQueueEndByte - 1
.vdu31ParamYCoordinate = .vduQueueEndByte
.vdu31EntryPoint
    JSR .isTextCursorActive                             ; set A=0 if text cursor is active; A=$20 if graphics cursor  $^$ 0xc787
    BNE .exit2                                          ; if (graphics cursor active) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xc78a
    JSR +                                               ; exchange text column/line with workspace .vduWorkspaceA/B  $^$ 0xc78c
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xc78f
    LDA .vdu31ParamXCoordinate                          ; get X coordinate  $^$ 0xc790
    ADC .vduTextWindowLeft                              ; add to text window left  $^$ 0xc793
    STA .vduTextCursorXPosition                         ; store as text column  $^$ 0xc796
    LDA .vdu31ParamYCoordinate                          ; get Y coordinate  $^$ 0xc799
    CLC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc79c
    ADC .vduTextWindowTop                               ; add top of text window  $^$ 0xc79d
    STA .vduTextCursorYPosition                         ; current text line  $^$ 0xc7a0
    JSR .validatePositionAndSetupScreenAddress          ; set up screen address  $^$ 0xc7a3
    BCC .setHardwareCursorAddressLocal                  ; if (carry clear, ie. on screen) then branch (set cursor position)  $^$ 0xc7a6
+
    LDX #.vduTextCursorXPosition  - .vduVariablesStart  ; point to text cursor position (low byte)  $^$ 0xc7a8
    LDY #.vduWorkspaceA - .vduVariablesStart            ; point to vdu workspace (low byte)  $^$ 0xc7aa
    JMP .exchangeTwoVDUBytes                            ; exchange text cursor position with workspace .vduWorkspaceA/B  $^$ 0xc7ac


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 13      Carriage Return (.charRETURN)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu13EntryPoint
    JSR .isTextCursorActive                             ; set A=0 if text cursor is active; A=$20 if graphics cursor  $^$ 0xc7af
    BEQ +                                               ; if (text cursor active) then branch  $^$ 0xc7b2
    JMP .setGraphicsCursorToLeftHandColumn              ; set graphics cursor to left hand columm  $^$ 0xc7b4
+
    JSR .setTextCursorToLeftHandColumn                  ; set text column to left hand column  $^$ 0xc7b7
    JMP .setCursorSoftwareAndHardwarePosition           ; set cursor position  $^$ 0xc7ba

; ***************************************************************************************
.clearGraphicsWindowAndHomeGraphicsCursor
    JSR .graphicsCursorHome                             ; home graphic cursor  $^$ 0xc7bd
    ; fall through...


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 16      Clear graphics window
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu16EntryPoint
    LDA .vduPixelsPerByteMinusOne                       ; pixels per byte  $^$ 0xc7c0
    BEQ .exitNoGraphics                                 ; if (current MODE has no graphics) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xc7c3
    LDX .vduBackgroundGraphicsColour                    ; background graphics colour  $^$ 0xc7c5
    LDY .vduBackgroundGCOLMode                          ; background graphics plot mode (GCOL n)  $^$ 0xc7c8
    JSR .setGraphicsColourMaskXY                        ; set graphics byte mask in .vduGraphicsColourByteOR/EOR  $^$ 0xc7cb
    LDX #.vduGraphicsWindowPixelsLeftLow - .vduVariablesStart  $^$ 0xc7ce
                                                        ; source      = graphics window
    LDY #.vduWorkspaceA - .vduVariablesStart            ; destination = workspace A to H  $^$ 0xc7d0
    JSR .copyEightBytesWithinVDUVariables               ; copy graphics window coordinates to workspace  $^$ 0xc7d2
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xc7d5
    LDA .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsTopLow                  ; graphics window top low  $^$ 0xc7d6
    SBC .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsBottomLow               ; graphics window bottom low  $^$ 0xc7d9
    TAY                                                 ; Y=difference  $^$ 0xc7dc
    INY                                                 ; increment  $^$ 0xc7dd
    STY .vduClearGraphicsWindowLineCount                ; and store in workspace (this is line count)  $^$ 0xc7de
-
    LDX #.vduWorkspaceE - .vduVariablesStart            ; graphics window right column  $^$ 0xc7e1
    LDY #.vduWorkspaceA - .vduVariablesStart            ; graphics window left column  $^$ 0xc7e3
    JSR .fillRow                                        ; fillRow  $^$ 0xc7e5
    LDA .vduWorkspaceG                                  ; decrement window height in pixels  $^$ 0xc7e8
    BNE +                                               ;  $^$ 0xc7eb
    DEC .vduWorkspaceH                                  ;  $^$ 0xc7ed
+
    DEC .vduWorkspaceG                                  ;  $^$ 0xc7f0
    DEC .vduClearGraphicsWindowLineCount                ; decrement line count  $^$ 0xc7f3
    BNE -                                               ; if (not zero) then branch (do it again)  $^$ 0xc7f6
.exitNoGraphics
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc7f8


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 17      Define text colour
;
; The parameter is the logical colour to use as the current text foreground colour. If the
; top bit is set, then the current text background is changed. This is the equivalent of
; BASIC's COLOUR command.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu17EntryPoint
    LDY #0                                              ; Y = 0 (to set text foreground colour)  $^$ 0xc7f9
    BEQ .defineTextOrGraphicsColour                     ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xc7fb


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 18      Define graphics colour
;
; This sets the current graphics foreground or background colour. It is the equivalent of
; BASIC's GCOL command.
;
; The first parameter is the GCOL mode: 0=Normal, 1=OR, 2=AND, 3=EOR, 4=Invert
;
; This signifies how to modify the colour of pixels that will be drawn in the future. This
; can depend on both the current graphics colour and the colour of the current pixel already
; on screen.
;
; The second parameter:
;
;   bits 0-6 is the logical colour to use.
;   bit 7    set indicates that the current background colour should be set, otherwise
;            the current foreground colour is set.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu18ParameterGCOLNumber           = .vduQueueEndByte-1
.vdu18ParameterLogicalColour        = .vduQueueEndByte

.vdu18EntryPoint
    LDY #2                                              ; Y = 2 (to set graphics foreground colour)  $^$ 0xc7fd

.defineTextOrGraphicsColour
    LDA .vdu18ParameterLogicalColour                    ; get last parameter  $^$ 0xc7ff
    BPL +                                               ; if (not negative, it's a foreground colour) then branch  $^$ 0xc802
    INY                                                 ; increment y (to set text/graphics background colour)  $^$ 0xc804
+
    AND .vduNumberOfLogicalColoursMinusOne              ; ensure colour is at most 'number of logical colours less 1'  $^$ 0xc805
    STA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; store it  $^$ 0xc808
    LDA .vduNumberOfLogicalColoursMinusOne              ; number of logical colours less 1  $^$ 0xc80a
    BEQ .exit3                                          ; if (not in a graphics MODE) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xc80d
    AND #7                                              ; limit to an available colour (and clear M)  $^$ 0xc80f
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xc811
    ADC .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; add last parameter to get pointer to table.  $^$ 0xc812
    TAX                                                 ; X is the offset into the tables of colours.  $^$ 0xc814
                                                        ; X = (number of logical colours - 1 + logicalColour)
    LDA .twoColourMODEParameterTable-1,X                ; get plot options from table  $^$ 0xc815
    STA .vduForegroundTextColour,Y                      ; store current colour:  $^$ 0xc818
                                                        ;
                                                        ;       Y=0 means text foreground
                                                        ;       Y=1 means text background
                                                        ;       Y=2 means graphics foreground
                                                        ;       Y=3 means graphics background
    CPY #2                                              ;  $^$ 0xc81b
    BCS .setGraphicsGCOLColour                          ; if (graphics colour changed) then branch (set graphics colour)  $^$ 0xc81d
    LDA .vduForegroundTextColour                        ; foreground text colour  $^$ 0xc81f
    EOR #$FF                                            ; invert  $^$ 0xc822
    STA .vduTextColourByteEOR                           ; text colour byte to EOR-ed into memory  $^$ 0xc824
    EOR .vduBackgroundTextColour                        ; background text colour  $^$ 0xc826
    STA .vduTextColourByteOR                            ; text colour byte to OR-ed into memory  $^$ 0xc829
.exit3
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc82b

; ***************************************************************************************
.setGraphicsGCOLColour
    LDA .vdu18ParameterGCOLNumber                       ; get first parameter  $^$ 0xc82c
    STA .vduForegroundGraphicsColour,Y                  ; text colour Y=0=foreground; 1=background etc.  $^$ 0xc82f
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc832

; ***************************************************************************************
.restoreMODE7TextBackgroundColour
    LDA #32                                             ;  $^$ 0xc833
    STA .vduBackgroundTextColour                        ; background text colour  $^$ 0xc835
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc838


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 20      Restore default colours
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu20EntryPoint
    LDX #5                                              ; X = 5, loop counter  $^$ 0xc839
    LDA #0                                              ; A = 0  $^$ 0xc83b
-
    STA .vduForegroundTextColour,X                      ; zero all colours  $^$ 0xc83d
    DEX                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc840
    BPL -                                               ; until X=$FF  $^$ 0xc841
    LDX .vduNumberOfLogicalColoursMinusOne              ; number of logical colours less 1  $^$ 0xc843
    BEQ .restoreMODE7TextBackgroundColour               ; if (none, it's MODE 7) then branch  $^$ 0xc846
    LDA #$FF                                            ; A=$FF  $^$ 0xc848
    CPX #15                                             ;  $^$ 0xc84a
    BNE +                                               ; if (not 16 colours; ie. not MODE 2) then branch  $^$ 0xc84c
    LDA #$3F                                            ; A=$3F  $^$ 0xc84e
+
    STA .vduForegroundTextColour                        ; foreground text colour  $^$ 0xc850
    STA .vduForegroundGraphicsColour                    ; foreground graphics colour  $^$ 0xc853
    EOR #$FF                                            ; invert A  $^$ 0xc856
    STA .vduTextColourByteOR                            ; text colour byte to be OR-ed into memory  $^$ 0xc858
    STA .vduTextColourByteEOR                           ; text colour byte to be EOR-ed into memory  $^$ 0xc85a
    STX .vdu19ParameterLogicalColour                    ; set first parameter of 5  $^$ 0xc85c
    CPX #3                                              ;  $^$ 0xc85f
    BEQ .restore4Colours                                ; if (there are 4 colours) then branch  $^$ 0xc861
    BCC .restore2Colours                                ; if (there are 2 colours) then branch  $^$ 0xc863
.restore16Colours                                       ; there are 16 colours
    STX .vdu19ParameterPhysicalColour                   ; set second parameter  $^$ 0xc865
-
    JSR .vdu19EntryPoint                                ; VDU 19 - define logical colour  $^$ 0xc868
    DEC .vdu19ParameterPhysicalColour                   ; decrement first parameter  $^$ 0xc86b
    DEC .vdu19ParameterLogicalColour                    ; and last parameter  $^$ 0xc86e
    BPL -                                               ;  $^$ 0xc871
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc873

.restore4Colours
    LDX #7                                              ; X = 7  $^$ 0xc874
    STX .vdu19ParameterPhysicalColour                   ; set first parameter  $^$ 0xc876
-
    JSR .vdu19EntryPoint                                ; and do VDU 19  $^$ 0xc879
    LSR .vdu19ParameterPhysicalColour                   ;  $^$ 0xc87c
    DEC .vdu19ParameterLogicalColour                    ;  $^$ 0xc87f
    BPL -                                               ;  $^$ 0xc882
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc884

.restore2Colours
    LDX #7                                              ; X = 7  $^$ 0xc885
    JSR +                                               ; store physical colour and execute VDU 19  $^$ 0xc887
    LDX #0                                              ; X = 0  $^$ 0xc88a
    STX .vdu19ParameterLogicalColour                    ; store it as  $^$ 0xc88c
+
    STX .vdu19ParameterPhysicalColour                   ; both parameters  $^$ 0xc88f
    ; fall through...


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 19      Write palette
;
; Map a logical colour to a physical colour
;
;               VDU 19,logical colour,physics colour,0,0,0
;
; Logical colours are numbers stored in memory to represent a colour. Logical colours are
; in the range 0-15.
;
; Physical colours are numbers that represent actual colours:
;
;                 0 = black             8 = flashing black-white
;                 1 = red               9 = flashing red-cyan
;                 2 = green            10 = flashing green-magenta
;                 3 = yellow           11 = flashing yellow-blue
;                 4 = blue             12 = flashing blue-yellow
;                 5 = magenta          13 = flashing magenta-green
;                 6 = cyan             14 = flashing cyan-red
;                 7 = white            15 = flashing white-black
;
; The palette defines which physical colour is displayed for each logical colour.
; The Video ULA hardware stores and manages this palette information.
;
; Flashing colours
; ----------------
; The OS (in the vertical sync interrupt) updates timers to know when to change the current
; appearance of flashing colours. When it's time, the OS signals the VideoULA to flip the
; flashing bit, thereby changing the current appearance.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu19ParameterLogicalColour  = $031F
.vdu19ParameterPhysicalColour = $0320

.vdu19EntryPoint
    PHP                                                 ; push flags  $^$ 0xc892
    SEI                                                 ; disable interrupts  $^$ 0xc893
    LDA .vdu19ParameterLogicalColour                    ; get logical colour  $^$ 0xc894
    AND .vduNumberOfLogicalColoursMinusOne              ; AND with number of logical colours  $^$ 0xc897
                                                        ; less 1 to make legal.
    TAX                                                 ; store logical colour in X  $^$ 0xc89a
    LDA .vdu19ParameterPhysicalColour                   ; A=physical colour  $^$ 0xc89b
.writePaletteAX
    AND #15                                             ; make legal  $^$ 0xc89e
    STA .vduColourPaletteStart,X                        ; store physical in colour palette  $^$ 0xc8a0
    TAY                                                 ; remember physical colour in Y  $^$ 0xc8a3
    LDA .vduNumberOfLogicalColoursMinusOne              ; number of logical colours less 1  $^$ 0xc8a4
    STA .tempStoreFA                                    ; store it  $^$ 0xc8a7
    CMP #3                                              ; is it a 4 colour MODE?  $^$ 0xc8a9
    PHP                                                 ; save flags  $^$ 0xc8ab
    TXA                                                 ; recall A = logical colour  $^$ 0xc8ac
-
    ROR                                                 ; rotate the logical colour (A) into  $^$ 0xc8ad
                                                        ; the top bits of .tempStoreFA
    ROR .tempStoreFA                                    ; rotate the (number of colours  $^$ 0xc8ae
                                                        ; in the MODE-1) down by one bit
    BCS -                                               ; if (there are more set bits) then  $^$ 0xc8b0
                                                        ; branch (loop back)
    ASL .tempStoreFA                                    ; the final rotate wasn't needed,  $^$ 0xc8b2
                                                        ; so shift left to rectify
                                                        ; at this point .tempStoreFA holds
                                                        ; the logical colour in the top N bits
                                                        ; where N is the number of bits
                                                        ; required to store a colour in
                                                        ; the current MODE.
    TYA                                                 ; recall physical colour  $^$ 0xc8b4
    ORA .tempStoreFA                                    ; OR in the physical colour into  $^$ 0xc8b5
                                                        ; the bottom bits
    TAX                                                 ; store value in X. This is working  $^$ 0xc8b7
                                                        ; towards being the value to send to
                                                        ; the palette register on the Video ULA.
    LDY #0                                              ; Y=0  $^$ 0xc8b8
-
    PLP                                                 ; recall flags  $^$ 0xc8ba
    PHP                                                 ; store flags  $^$ 0xc8bb
    BNE .notFourColourMODE                              ; if (not a four colour MODE, i.e.  $^$ 0xc8bc
                                                        ; A !=3 earlier) then branch

    ; deal with four colour MODEs
    AND #%01100000                                      ; Test bits 5 and 6  $^$ 0xc8be
    BEQ +                                               ; if (both bit are clear) then branch  $^$ 0xc8c0
    CMP #%01100000                                      ;  $^$ 0xc8c2
    BEQ +                                               ; if (both bits are set) then branch  $^$ 0xc8c4
    TXA                                                 ; recall X value.  $^$ 0xc8c6
    EOR #%01100000                                      ; invert bits 5 and 6 (one of which  $^$ 0xc8c7
                                                        ; is set and the other clear).
    BNE .notFourColourMODE                              ; ALWAYS branch. A = value to send  $^$ 0xc8c9
                                                        ; to palette register of the Video ULA.

+
    TXA                                                 ; X=A  $^$ 0xc8cb
.notFourColourMODE
    JSR .osbyte155Internal                              ; pass data to palette register  $^$ 0xc8cc
    TYA                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc8cf
    SEC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc8d0
    ADC .vduNumberOfLogicalColoursMinusOne              ;  $^$ 0xc8d1
    TAY                                                 ; Y = Y + number of logical colours - 1  $^$ 0xc8d4
    TXA                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc8d5
    ADC #16                                             ;  $^$ 0xc8d6
    TAX                                                 ; X = X + 16  $^$ 0xc8d8
    CPY #16                                             ;  $^$ 0xc8d9
    BCC -                                               ; if (Y < 16) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xc8db
    PLP                                                 ; pull flags twice  $^$ 0xc8dd
    PLP                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc8de
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc8df


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   OSWORD 12 - Write Palette
;
; On Entry:
;   .oswordX/Y is the address of the five bytes of parameters:
;       byte 0: logical colour
;       byte 1: physical colour
;       byte 2: zero
;       byte 3: zero
;       byte 4: zero
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osword12EntryPoint
    PHP                                                 ; push flags  $^$ 0xc8e0
    AND .vduNumberOfLogicalColoursMinusOne              ; and with number of logical colours less 1  $^$ 0xc8e1
    TAX                                                 ; X=A  $^$ 0xc8e4
    INY                                                 ; Y=Y+1  $^$ 0xc8e5
    LDA (.oswordX),Y                                    ; get physical colour  $^$ 0xc8e6
    JMP .writePaletteAX                                 ; do VDU19 with parameters in X and A  $^$ 0xc8e8


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 22      Select MODE
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu22Parameter = .vduQueueEndByte

.vdu22EntryPoint
    LDA .vdu22Parameter                                 ; get parameter  $^$ 0xc8eb
    JMP .setMODE                                        ; change MODE  $^$ 0xc8ee


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 23      Define Character
;
; See guide.png
;
; On Entry:
;   A = 0 sets CRTC 6845 register:
;       VDU 23,0,R,X,0,0,0,0,0,0 - program CRTC register R with value V
;       See Chapter 3 section 'CRTC registers'
;   A = 1 turns the cursor on or off:
;       VDU 23,1,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0 - turn cursor off
;       VDU 23,1,1,0,0,0,0,0,0,0 - turn cursor on
;   A = 32-255 means define character
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu23ParameterLogicalColour = .vduQueueStartByte
.vdu23Parameter1 = .vduQueueEndByte - 8
.vdu23Parameter2 = .vduQueueEndByte - 7
.vdu23Parameter3 = .vduQueueEndByte - 6
.vdu23Parameter4 = .vduQueueEndByte - 5
.vdu23Parameter5 = .vduQueueEndByte - 4
.vdu23Parameter6 = .vduQueueEndByte - 3
.vdu23Parameter7 = .vduQueueEndByte - 2
.vdu23Parameter8 = .vduQueueEndByte - 1
.vdu23Parameter9 = .vduQueueEndByte

.vdu23EntryPoint
    LDA .vdu23ParameterLogicalColour                    ; get character to define  $^$ 0xc8f1
    CMP #.charSPACE                                     ;  $^$ 0xc8f4
    BCC .vdu23SetCRTCRegisterOrCursorVisibility         ; if (less then SPACE) then branch  $^$ 0xc8f6
                                                        ; (it is an instruction to set a CRT
                                                        ; register or cursor visibility)
    PHA                                                 ; save parameter  $^$ 0xc8f8
    LSR                                                 ; A = A / 32  $^$ 0xc8f9
    LSR                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc8fa
    LSR                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc8fb
    LSR                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc8fc
    LSR                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc8fd
    TAX                                                 ; store font zone (1-7) in X  $^$ 0xc8fe
    LDA .fontMaskTable,X                                ; look up single bit representing  $^$ 0xc8ff
                                                        ; the font zone (character / 32)
    BIT .vduFontFlags                                   ; font flag  $^$ 0xc902
    BNE +                                               ; if (not zero) then branch (storage  $^$ 0xc905
                                                        ; area is established already)
    ORA .vduFontFlags                                   ; OR with font flag to set bit  $^$ 0xc907
                                                        ; found to be 0
    STA .vduFontFlags                                   ; font flag  $^$ 0xc90a
    TXA                                                 ; get back font zone (1-7)  $^$ 0xc90d
    AND #3                                              ; AND with 3 to clear all but bits  $^$ 0xc90e
                                                        ; 0 and 1 (A = 1, 2, 3)
    CLC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc910
    ADC #>.characterDefinitions - 1                     ; A=$C0, $C1, $C2 to select a  $^$ 0xc911
                                                        ; character page in ROM
    STA .vduTempStoreDF                                 ; store it in the high byte  $^$ 0xc913
    LDA .vduFontZoneAddressesHigh1 - 1,X                ; get font address (high byte)  $^$ 0xc915
    STA .vduTempStoreDD                                 ; store it in the high byte  $^$ 0xc918
    LDY #0                                              ;  $^$ 0xc91a
    STY .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; store zero in the low bytes  $^$ 0xc91c
    STY .vduTempStoreDE                                 ;  $^$ 0xc91e
-
    LDA (.vduTempStoreDE),Y                             ; copy character definition  $^$ 0xc920
    STA (.vduTempStoreDC),Y                             ;  $^$ 0xc922
    DEY                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc924
    BNE -                                               ;  $^$ 0xc925
+
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xc927
    JSR .getCharacterDefinitionAddress                  ; set up character definition pointers  $^$ 0xc928
    LDY #7                                              ; Y=loop counter  $^$ 0xc92b
-
    LDA .vdu23Parameter2,Y                              ; transfer definition parameters  $^$ 0xc92d
    STA (.vduTempStoreDE),Y                             ; to RAM definition  $^$ 0xc930
    DEY                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc932
    BPL -                                               ;  $^$ 0xc933
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc935

    PLA                                                 ; [unused. Was used in MOS 0.92]  $^$ 0xc936

.exit4
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc937

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Plot extension
;
; If calling VDU 25 (PLOT) in a non-graphics mode, or using a plot type that is reserved
; for future expansion, then this routine is called. It calls the VDUV vector which allows
; user programs or Paged ROMs to intercept the call and provide new functionality.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vduPlotExtension
    LDA .vdu25Parameter5                                ; A = fifth VDU parameter  $^$ 0xc938
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xc93b
-
    JMP (.vectorVDUV)                                   ; jump via VDUV vector  $^$ 0xc93c
