; ***************************************************************************************
;
; VDU 23 with 0-31 as the next byte
;
; VDU 23,0      - set CRTC Register
; VDU 23,1      - turn cursor on or off
; VDU 23,2-31   - call VDUV extension vector
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu23SetCRTCRegisterOrCursorVisibility
    CMP #1                                              ; does A=1  $^$ 0xc93f
    BCC .vdu23CommaZeroSetCRTCRegister                  ; if (A = 0) then branch (set CRTC register)  $^$ 0xc941
    BNE -                                               ; if (A != 1) then branch (to VDUV vector)  $^$ 0xc943
    JSR .isTextCursorActive                             ; set A=0 if text cursor is active; A=$20 if graphics cursor  $^$ 0xc945
    BNE .exit4                                          ; if (graphics cursor is active) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xc948

    ; handle text cursor...
    LDA #32                                             ;  $^$ 0xc94a
    LDY .vdu23Parameter2                                ; Y = second VDU parameter  $^$ 0xc94c
    BEQ .setCursorOnOrOff                               ; if (Y=0) then branch (turn cursor off)  $^$ 0xc94f

.setTextCursor
    LDA .vduLastCursorStartRegisterValue                ; get last setting of CRTC register  $^$ 0xc951

.setCursorOnOrOff
    LDY #.crtcCursorStartRegister                       ; Y = .crtcCursorStartRegister  $^$ 0xc954
    BNE .setCRTCRegisterDirect                          ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xc956

; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu23CommaZeroSetCRTCRegister
    LDA .vdu23Parameter3                                ; get third parameter (value to write)  $^$ 0xc958
    LDY .vdu23Parameter2                                ; get second parameter (CRTC register to set)  $^$ 0xc95b
.setCRTCRegisterAY
    CPY #.crtcVerticalSyncPositionRegister              ;  $^$ 0xc95e
    BCC .setCRTCRegisterDirect                          ; if (Y < 7) then set register Y with value A directly  $^$ 0xc960
    BNE +                                               ; if (Y > 7) branch  $^$ 0xc962

    ; deal with vertical sync position register
    ADC .vduVerticalAdjust                              ; add screen vertical display  $^$ 0xc964
                                                        ; adjustment + 1 (carry set)
+
    CPY #.crtcInterlaceAndDelayRegister                 ;  $^$ 0xc967
    BNE +                                               ; if (Y != 8) then branch  $^$ 0xc969

    ; deal with interlace and delay register
    ORA #0                                              ; test if bit 7 set  $^$ 0xc96b
    BMI +                                               ; if (bit 7 set) then branch  $^$ 0xc96d
    EOR .vduInterlaceValue                              ; set interlace value (0 or 1)  $^$ 0xc96f

+
    CPY #.crtcCursorStartRegister                       ;  $^$ 0xc972
    BNE .setCRTCRegisterDirect                          ; if (Y != 10) then branch - set register Y with value A directly  $^$ 0xc974

    ; deal with cursor start register
    STA .vduLastCursorStartRegisterValue                ; last setting of CRTC register  $^$ 0xc976
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A  $^$ 0xc979
    LDA .vduStatusByte                                  ; VDU status byte  $^$ 0xc97a
    AND #%00100000                                      ; check bit 5 (print at graphics cursor)  $^$ 0xc97c
    PHP                                                 ; push flags  $^$ 0xc97e
    TYA                                                 ; A = value to set  $^$ 0xc97f
    LDY #.crtcCursorStartRegister                       ; Y=10  $^$ 0xc980
    PLP                                                 ; pull flags  $^$ 0xc982
    BNE +                                               ; if (graphics cursor is active) then branch (return)  $^$ 0xc983
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.setCRTCRegisterDirect
    STY .crtcAddressRegister                            ; Y is which CRTC register to write to  $^$ 0xc985
    STA .crtcAddressWrite                               ; write value A into register Y  $^$ 0xc988
+
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xc98b


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 25      Plot
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu25Parameter5 = $031F
.vdu25EntryPoint
    LDX .vduPixelsPerByteMinusOne                       ; get pixels per byte  $^$ 0xc98c
    BEQ .vduPlotExtension                               ; if (zero, i.e. no graphics available) then branch (plot extension)  $^$ 0xc98f
    JMP .vdu25Plot                                      ; jump to main plot routine  $^$ 0xc991

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Hardware screen scroll up/down
;
; Changes the start address of the display
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.hardwareScrollDown
    LDX .vduScreenTopLeftAddressLow                     ; screen top left address low  $^$ 0xc994
    LDA .vduScreenTopLeftAddressHigh                    ; screen top left address high  $^$ 0xc997
    JSR .subtractNumberOfBytesInARowFromAX              ; subtract bytes per character row from this  $^$ 0xc99a
    BCS +                                               ; if (no wraparound needed) then branch  $^$ 0xc99d

    ADC .vduScreenSizeHighByte                          ; screen RAM size high byte to wrap around  $^$ 0xc99f
    BCC +                                               ;  $^$ 0xc9a2

.hardwareScrollUp
    LDX .vduScreenTopLeftAddressLow                     ; screen top left address low  $^$ 0xc9a4
    LDA .vduScreenTopLeftAddressHigh                    ; screen top left address high  $^$ 0xc9a7
    JSR .addNumberOfBytesInACharacterRowToAX            ; add bytes per character row  $^$ 0xc9aa
    BPL +                                               ;  $^$ 0xc9ad

    SEC                                                 ; wrap around  $^$ 0xc9af
    SBC .vduScreenSizeHighByte                          ; screen RAM size high byte  $^$ 0xc9b0
+
    STA .vduScreenTopLeftAddressHigh                    ; screen top left address high  $^$ 0xc9b3
    STX .vduScreenTopLeftAddressLow                     ; screen top left address low  $^$ 0xc9b6
    LDY #.crtcStartScreenAddressHighRegister            ; Y = value to change screen address  $^$ 0xc9b9
    BNE .setHardwareScreenOrCursorAddress               ; ALWAYS branch to set screen address  $^$ 0xc9bb


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 26      Reset to default windows
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu26EntryPoint
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0  $^$ 0xc9bd
    LDX #.vduWorkspaceE - .vduVariablesStart            ; X=loop counter  $^$ 0xc9bf
-
    STA .vduVariablesStart,X                            ; zero a whole bunch of vdu variables,  $^$ 0xc9c1
    DEX                                                 ; including the text and graphics  $^$ 0xc9c4
    BPL -                                               ; windows  $^$ 0xc9c5

    ; use data for current screen mode
    LDX .vduCurrentScreenMODE                           ; screen MODE  $^$ 0xc9c7

    ; reset text window
    LDY .textWindowRightColumnTable,X                   ; text window right edge maximum  $^$ 0xc9ca
    STY .vduTextWindowRight                             ; store in the text window right  $^$ 0xc9cd
    JSR .calculateBytesPerTextWindowRow                 ; calculate number of bytes in a text  $^$ 0xc9d0
                                                        ; window row
    LDY .textWindowBottomRowTable,X                     ; text window bottom edge maximum  $^$ 0xc9d3
    STY .vduTextWindowBottom                            ; bottom edge  $^$ 0xc9d6

    ; reset graphics window
    LDY #3                                              ;  $^$ 0xc9d9
    STY .vdu24ParameterTopEdgeHigh                      ; top edge high byte    = 3  $^$ 0xc9db
    INY                                                 ; Y = 4  $^$ 0xc9de
    STY .vdu24ParameterRightEdgeHigh                    ; right edge high byte  = 4  $^$ 0xc9df
    DEC .vdu24ParameterTopEdgeLow                       ; top edge low          = $FF  $^$ 0xc9e2
    DEC .vdu24ParameterRightEdgeLow                     ; right edge low        = $FF  $^$ 0xc9e5
                                                        ;
                                                        ; so now top edge = $03FF = 1023
                                                        ; and right edge  = $04FF = 1279
                                                        ;
    JSR .vdu24EntryPoint                                ; do VDU 24 (define graphics  $^$ 0xc9e8
                                                        ; window)

    ; reset scrolling
    LDA #%11110111                                      ; }  $^$ 0xc9eb
    JSR .clearVDUStatusByteFlags                        ; } clear bit 3 of .vduStatusByte  $^$ 0xc9ed
    LDX .vduScreenTopLeftAddressLow                     ; screen start address low  $^$ 0xc9f0
    LDA .vduScreenTopLeftAddressHigh                    ; screen start address high  $^$ 0xc9f3

    ; reset cursor
.setTextCursorCRTCAddress
    STX .vduTextCursorCRTCAddressLow                    ; text cursor CRTC address  $^$ 0xc9f6
    STA .vduTextCursorCRTCAddressHigh                   ; text cursor CRTC address  $^$ 0xc9f9
    BPL .setHardwareCursorAddress                       ; set cursor position  $^$ 0xc9fc
    SEC                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xc9fe
    SBC .vduScreenSizeHighByte                          ; } screen RAM size high byte  $^$ 0xc9ff
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Set cursor screen address
;
; On Entry:
;       AX holds the screen address
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.setHardwareCursorAddress
    STX .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow                 ; set screen address of cursor from AX  $^$ 0xca02
    STA .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressHigh                ;  $^$ 0xca04
    LDX .vduTextCursorCRTCAddressLow                    ; text cursor CRTC address  $^$ 0xca06
    LDA .vduTextCursorCRTCAddressHigh                   ; text cursor CRTC address  $^$ 0xca09
    LDY #.crtcCursorPositionHighRegister                ; Y=14  $^$ 0xca0c
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Set hardware screen or cursor address
;
; On Entry:
;       The screen address or cursor position address is in AX
;       Y holds either .crtcCursorPositionHighRegister to change the cursor position
;                   or .crtcStartScreenAddressHighRegister to change the screen address
; ***************************************************************************************
.setHardwareScreenOrCursorAddress
    PHA                                                 ; store A  $^$ 0xca0e
    LDA .vduCurrentScreenMODE                           ; screen MODE  $^$ 0xca0f
    CMP #7                                              ; is it MODE 7?  $^$ 0xca12
    PLA                                                 ; restore A  $^$ 0xca14
    BCS .setCursorPositionMODE7                         ; if (MODE 7 selected) then branch  $^$ 0xca15
    STX .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; store X  $^$ 0xca17
    LSR                                                 ; divide X/A by 8  $^$ 0xca19
    ROR .vduTempStoreDA                                 ;  $^$ 0xca1a
    LSR                                                 ;  $^$ 0xca1c
    ROR .vduTempStoreDA                                 ;  $^$ 0xca1d
    LSR                                                 ;  $^$ 0xca1f
    ROR .vduTempStoreDA                                 ;  $^$ 0xca20
    LDX .vduTempStoreDA                                 ;  $^$ 0xca22
    JMP .setTwoCRTCRegisters                            ; set cursor position AX  $^$ 0xca24

.setCursorPositionMODE7
    SBC #$74                                            ; MODE 7 subtract $74  $^$ 0xca27
    EOR #$20                                            ; EOR with $20 (See NAUG Section  $^$ 0xca29
                                                        ; 13.3.11 - MODE 7 scrolling,
                                                        ; Page 200)
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Write to two sequential registers on the CRTC
;
; On Entry:
;       Y = register number
;       A = First value to write (to register Y)
;       X = Second value to write (to register Y+1)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.setTwoCRTCRegisters
    STY .crtcAddressRegister                            ; set which CRTC register to write into  $^$ 0xca2b
    STA .crtcAddressWrite                               ; write A into CRTC register  $^$ 0xca2e
    INY                                                 ; increment Y to the next CRTC register  $^$ 0xca31
    STY .crtcAddressRegister                            ; set which CRTC register to write into  $^$ 0xca32
    STX .crtcAddressWrite                               ; write X into CRTC register  $^$ 0xca35
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xca38


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 24      Define graphics window
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu24ParameterLeftEdgeLow      = .vduQueueEndByte - 7
.vdu24ParameterLeftEdgeHigh     = .vduQueueEndByte - 6
.vdu24ParameterBottomEdgeLow    = .vduQueueEndByte - 5
.vdu24ParameterBottomEdgeHigh   = .vduQueueEndByte - 4
.vdu24ParameterRightEdgeLow     = .vduQueueEndByte - 3
.vdu24ParameterRightEdgeHigh    = .vduQueueEndByte - 2
.vdu24ParameterTopEdgeLow       = .vduQueueEndByte - 1
.vdu24ParameterTopEdgeHigh      = .vduQueueEndByte

.vdu24EntryPoint
    JSR .exchangeGraphicsCursorPositionWithWorkspaceABCD    ; exchange graphics cursor position with .vduWorkspaceABCD  $^$ 0xca39
                                                            ; will swap them back at the end
    LDX #.vdu24ParameterLeftEdgeLow - .vduVariablesStart    ; src = parameters  $^$ 0xca3c
    LDY #.vduWorkspaceE - .vduVariablesStart                ; dest = Workspace EFGH  $^$ 0xca3e
    JSR .coordinateSubtraction                              ; EFGH = (width = right - left,  $^$ 0xca40
                                                            ;         height = top - bottom)
                                                            ; Accumulator = height (high byte)
    ORA .vduWorkspaceF                                      ; OR with high byte of width  $^$ 0xca43
    BMI .exchangeGraphicsCursorPositionWithWorkspaceABCD    ; if (either width or height is negative) then branch (to exchange back and exit)  $^$ 0xca46
    LDX #.vdu24ParameterRightEdgeLow - .vduVariablesStart   ; point X to right edge low  $^$ 0xca48
    JSR .plotConvertExternalAbsoluteCoordinatesToPixels     ; scale pointers to MODE  $^$ 0xca4a
    LDX #.vdu24ParameterLeftEdgeLow - .vduVariablesStart    ; point X to left edge low  $^$ 0xca4d
    JSR .plotConvertExternalAbsoluteCoordinatesToPixels     ; scale pointers to MODE  $^$ 0xca4f
    LDA .vdu24ParameterBottomEdgeHigh                       ; check for negative edges  $^$ 0xca52
    ORA .vdu24ParameterLeftEdgeHigh                         ;  $^$ 0xca55
    BMI .exchangeGraphicsCursorPositionWithWorkspaceABCD    ; if (negative) then branch (to exchange back and exit)  $^$ 0xca58
    LDA .vdu24ParameterTopEdgeHigh                          ;  $^$ 0xca5a
    BNE .exchangeGraphicsCursorPositionWithWorkspaceABCD    ; if (non zero) then branch (to exchange back and exit)  $^$ 0xca5d
    LDX .vduCurrentScreenMODE                               ; get screen MODE  $^$ 0xca5f
    LDA .vdu24ParameterRightEdgeHigh                        ; right edge high  $^$ 0xca62
    STA .vduTempStoreDA                                     ; store it  $^$ 0xca65
    LDA .vdu24ParameterRightEdgeLow                         ; right edge low  $^$ 0xca67
    LSR .vduTempStoreDA                                     ;  $^$ 0xca6a
    ROR                                                     ;  $^$ 0xca6c
    LSR .vduTempStoreDA                                     ;  $^$ 0xca6d
    BNE .exchangeGraphicsCursorPositionWithWorkspaceABCD    ; if (negative) then branch (to exchange back and exit)  $^$ 0xca6f
    ROR                                                     ;  $^$ 0xca71
    LSR                                                     ;  $^$ 0xca72
    CMP .textWindowRightColumnTable,X                       ; compare with text window right hand edge maximum  $^$ 0xca73
    BEQ +                                                   ; if (equal) then branch  $^$ 0xca76
    BPL .exchangeGraphicsCursorPositionWithWorkspaceABCD    ; if (non-negative) then branch (to exchange back and exit)  $^$ 0xca78
+
    LDY #.vduGraphicsWindowPixelsLeftLow - .vduVariablesStart ; destination = graphics window extents  $^$ 0xca7a
    LDX #.vdu24ParameterLeftEdgeLow - .vduVariablesStart    ; source = parameters  $^$ 0xca7c
    JSR .copyEightBytesWithinVDUVariables                   ; copy source to destination  $^$ 0xca7e
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.exchangeGraphicsCursorPositionWithWorkspaceABCD
    LDX #.vduGraphicsCursorPositionXLow - .vduVariablesStart  $^$ 0xca81
                                                        ; } swap graphics cursor
    LDY #.vduWorkspaceA - .vduVariablesStart            ; } position with Workspace  $^$ 0xca83
    JMP .exchangeFourBytes                              ; } ABCD  $^$ 0xca85

; ***************************************************************************************
.calculateBytesPerTextWindowRow
    INY                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xca88
    TYA                                                 ; } A = Y + 1  $^$ 0xca89
    LDY #0                                              ; Y=0  $^$ 0xca8a
    STY .vduTextWindowWidthInBytesHigh                  ; text window width high (bytes)  $^$ 0xca8c
    STA .vduTextWindowWidthInBytesLow                   ; text window width low (bytes)  $^$ 0xca8f
    LDA .vduBytesPerCharacter                           ; bytes per character  $^$ 0xca92
    LSR                                                 ; divide by 2  $^$ 0xca95
    BEQ +                                               ; if (zero) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xca96
-
    ASL .vduTextWindowWidthInBytesLow                   ; text window width low (bytes)  $^$ 0xca98
    ROL .vduTextWindowWidthInBytesHigh                  ; text window width high (bytes)  $^$ 0xca9b
    LSR                                                 ; divide by 2  $^$ 0xca9e
    BCC -                                               ; if (carry clear) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xca9f
+
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcaa1


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 29      Set graphics origin
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu29ParameterStart = $320

.vdu29EntryPoint
    LDX #.vdu29ParameterStart - .vduVariablesStart          ; } copy the four bytes from the  $^$ 0xcaa2
    LDY #.vduGraphicsWindowOriginXLow - .vduVariablesStart  ; } vdu queue parameters to the  $^$ 0xcaa4
    JSR .copyFourBytesWithinVDUVariables                    ; } current graphics origin  $^$ 0xcaa6
    JMP .convertPixelGraphicsCoordinatesToExternal          ; set up external coordinates for graphics  $^$ 0xcaa9


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   VDU 127     Delete
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu127EntryPoint
    JSR .vdu8EntryPoint                                 ; cursor left  $^$ 0xcaac
    JSR .isTextCursorActive                             ; set A=0 if text cursor is active  $^$ 0xcaaf
                                                        ;  or A=$20 if graphics cursor
    BNE .deleteCharacterAtGraphicsCursor                ; if (graphics cursor active) then branch  $^$ 0xcab2
    LDX .vduNumberOfLogicalColoursMinusOne              ; number of logical colours less 1  $^$ 0xcab4
    BEQ .deleteCharacterInMODE7                         ; if (MODE 7) then branch  $^$ 0xcab7
    STA .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; store A (always 0)  $^$ 0xcab9
    LDA #>.characterDefinitions                         ; A=high byte of characters in ROM  $^$ 0xcabb
    STA .vduTempStoreDF                                 ; store in .vduTempStoreDF (.vduTempStoreDE)  $^$ 0xcabd
                                                        ; now points to the first character
                                                        ; definition: the 'space' pattern
    JMP .displayACharacterAtAddress                     ; display a space  $^$ 0xcabf

; ***************************************************************************************
.deleteCharacterInMODE7
    LDA #.charSPACE                                     ; }  $^$ 0xcac2
    JMP .displayCharacterMODE7                          ; } display a space  $^$ 0xcac4

; ***************************************************************************************
.deleteCharacterAtGraphicsCursor
    LDA #.charDELETE                                    ; ASCII code for delete  $^$ 0xcac7
    JSR .getCharacterDefinitionAddress                  ; set up character definition pointers  $^$ 0xcac9
    LDX .vduBackgroundGraphicsColour                    ; background graphics colour  $^$ 0xcacc
    LDY #0                                              ; normal GCOL mode  $^$ 0xcacf
    JMP .plotACharacterWithXYAsGraphicsColourAndGCOLMode ; plot character in background colour  $^$ 0xcad1

; ***************************************************************************************
; On Entry:
;       A = High byte of 16 bit value
;       X = Low byte of 16 bit value
.addNumberOfBytesInACharacterRowToAX
    PHA                                                 ; store A  $^$ 0xcad4
    TXA                                                 ; A=X  $^$ 0xcad5
    CLC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcad6
    ADC .vduBytesPerCharacterRowLow                     ; add bytes per character row  $^$ 0xcad7
    TAX                                                 ; put low byte back into X  $^$ 0xcada
    PLA                                                 ; recall A  $^$ 0xcadb
    ADC .vduBytesPerCharacterRowHigh                    ; add bytes per character row high byte (and carry)  $^$ 0xcadc
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcadf

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Paged mode scrolling
;
; When paged mode is enabled, listing lots of text stops scrolling when the screen is full
; until the user presses SHIFT to display the next page of text.
;
; Even without paged mode enabled, holding SHIFT and CTRL will inhibit scrolling (pauses)
; until at least one of the keys is released.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.handleScrollingInPagedMode
    JSR .clearPagedModeCounter                          ; clear paged mode line counter  $^$ 0xcae0
.handleScrollingInPagedModeInternal
    ; first check for SHIFT and CTRL pressed together - this loops until at least one key is released
    JSR .osbyte118EntryPoint                            ; OSBYTE 118 - set keyboard LEDs based on current keyboard state  $^$ 0xcae3
    BCC +                                               ; if (CTRL not pressed) then branch  $^$ 0xcae6
    BMI .handleScrollingInPagedMode                     ; if (SHIFT pressed) then branch back  $^$ 0xcae8
+

    ; check flags for relevant state
    LDA .vduStatusByte                                  ; VDU status byte  $^$ 0xcaea
    EOR #%00000100                                      ; invert bit 2 (paged scrolling)  $^$ 0xcaec
    AND #%01000110                                      ; if (there are 2 cursors, OR paged mode is off, OR not paged scrolling)...  $^$ 0xcaee
    BNE .exit5                                          ; ...then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xcaf0

    ; check the paged mode counter to see if it has run out of lines
    LDA .pagedModeCounter                               ; paged mode counter  $^$ 0xcaf2
    BMI .incrementPagedModeAndExit                      ; if (negative) then branch (increment paged mode counter and exit)  $^$ 0xcaf5

    ; check if we are at the bottom of the screen (exit if not)
    LDA .vduTextCursorYPosition                         ; current text line  $^$ 0xcaf7
    CMP .vduTextWindowBottom                            ; bottom edge  $^$ 0xcafa
    BCC .incrementPagedModeAndExit                      ; increment line counter and exit  $^$ 0xcafd

    ; check if we have shown enough lines to fill the text window vertically
    LSR                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xcaff
    LSR                                                 ; } A = A / 4  $^$ 0xcb00
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xcb01
    ADC .pagedModeCounter                               ; paged mode counter  $^$ 0xcb02
    ADC .vduTextWindowTop                               ; top of text window  $^$ 0xcb05
    CMP .vduTextWindowBottom                            ; bottom edge  $^$ 0xcb08
    BCC .incrementPagedModeAndExit                      ; increment line counter and exit  $^$ 0xcb0b

    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xcb0d
-
    JSR .osbyte118EntryPoint                            ; OSBYTE 118 - set keyboard LEDs based on current keyboard state  $^$ 0xcb0e
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xcb11
    BPL -                                               ; if (SHIFT not pressed) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xcb12
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.clearPagedModeCounter
    LDA #255                                            ;  $^$ 0xcb14
    STA .pagedModeCounter                               ; set paged mode counter  $^$ 0xcb16
.incrementPagedModeAndExit
    INC .pagedModeCounter                               ; increment paged mode counter  $^$ 0xcb19
.exit5
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcb1c


; ***************************************************************************************
; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Chapter 6: Changing MODEs
;
; ***************************************************************************************
; ***************************************************************************************

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Initialise VDU variables and change MODE
;
; This is called at reset time
;
; On Entry:
;       A = screen MODE number
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.initialiseVDUVariablesAndSetMODE
    PHA                                                 ; save A (screen mode number)  $^$ 0xcb1d

    ; Clear all VDU variables (0-126)
    LDX #.vduVariablesEnd - .vduVariablesStart          ; loop counter  $^$ 0xcb1e
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0  $^$ 0xcb20
    STA .vduStatusByte                                  ; VDU status byte to set default conditions (zero)  $^$ 0xcb22
-
    STA .vduVariablesStart-1,X                          ; zero VDU variables (0-126)  $^$ 0xcb24
    DEX                                                 ; with this loop  $^$ 0xcb27
    BNE -                                               ;  $^$ 0xcb28

    ; implode character definitions
    JSR .osbyte20EntryPoint                             ; implode character definitions (A = 0)  $^$ 0xcb2a
    PLA                                                 ; get back A (screen mode number)  $^$ 0xcb2d

    ; Set teletext cursor
    LDX #$7F                                            ; X=$7F  $^$ 0xcb2e
    STX .vduTeletextCharacterForCursor                  ; set mode 7 cursor character  $^$ 0xcb30
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Set MODE
;
; On Entry:
;       A = screen MODE number
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.setMODE
    BIT .systemAvailableRAM                             ; test available RAM pages ($40 = 16k; $80 = 32k)  $^$ 0xcb33
    BMI +                                               ; if (32k available) then branch  $^$ 0xcb36
    ORA #4                                              ; ensure only modes 4-7 are available  $^$ 0xcb38
+
    AND #7                                              ; X = A AND 7 (to ensure a legal mode)  $^$ 0xcb3a
    TAX                                                 ; X = mode  $^$ 0xcb3c

    ; Set characteristic vdu variables for the new mode
    STX .vduCurrentScreenMODE                           ; set screen mode  $^$ 0xcb3d
    LDA .numberOfColoursMinusOneInMODETable,X           ; get number of colours -1 in mode from table  $^$ 0xcb40
    STA .vduNumberOfLogicalColoursMinusOne              ; set number of logical colours less 1  $^$ 0xcb43
    LDA .bytesPerCharacter,X                            ; get number of bytes /character from table  $^$ 0xcb46
    STA .vduBytesPerCharacter                           ; set bytes per character  $^$ 0xcb49
    LDA .pixelsPerByteMinusOneInMODETable,X             ; get display mode pixels/byte from table  $^$ 0xcb4c
    STA .vduPixelsPerByteMinusOne                       ; set pixels per byte-1  $^$ 0xcb4f
    BNE +                                               ; if (in a graphics mode) then branch  $^$ 0xcb52
    LDA #7                                              ; this is a text mode; set A = 7  $^$ 0xcb54
+
    ASL                                                 ; A = A * 2  $^$ 0xcb56
    TAY                                                 ; Y = 2 * (pixels per byte-1), index into a table of colour masks  $^$ 0xcb57
    LDA .sixteenColourMODEMaskTable - 1,Y               ; mask table  $^$ 0xcb58
    STA .vduColourMaskRight                             ; store as colour mask right  $^$ 0xcb5b
-
    ASL                                                 ; shift A left  $^$ 0xcb5e
    BPL -                                               ; until the top bit becomes set  $^$ 0xcb5f
    STA .vduColourMaskLeft                              ; store as colour mask left  $^$ 0xcb61

    LDY .screenDisplayMemoryIndexTable,X                ; screen display memory index table  $^$ 0xcb64
    STY .vduCurrentScreenMODEGroup                      ; MODE group = screen memory size:  $^$ 0xcb67
                                                        ;       0 = 20k (MODE 0,1,2)
                                                        ;       1 = 16k (MODE 3)
                                                        ;       2 = 10k (MODE 4,5)
                                                        ;       3 = 8k (MODE 6)
                                                        ;       4 = 1k (MODE 7)

    LDA .systemVIAHardwareScrollTable2,Y                ; get system VIA parameter for setting hardware scrolling value  $^$ 0xcb6a
    JSR .writeAToSystemVIARegisterB                     ; write hardware scrolling value to System VIA  $^$ 0xcb6d
    LDA .systemVIAHardwareScrollTable1,Y                ; get system VIA parameter for setting hardware scrolling value  $^$ 0xcb70
    JSR .writeAToSystemVIARegisterB                     ; write hardware scrolling value to System VIA  $^$ 0xcb73

    LDA .screenMemorySizeInBytesHigh,Y                  ; screen RAM size high byte table  $^$ 0xcb76
    STA .vduScreenSizeHighByte                          ; screen RAM size high byte  $^$ 0xcb79

    LDA .screenMemoryStartHigh,Y                        ; screen ram address high byte  $^$ 0xcb7c
    STA .vduStartScreenAddressHighByte                  ; high byte of screen RAM address  $^$ 0xcb7f

                                                        ; A=Y=the screen memory type
    TYA                                                 ; A = Y           A = 0 1 2 3 4  $^$ 0xcb82
    ADC #2                                              ; A = A + 2       A = 2 3 4 5 6  $^$ 0xcb83
    EOR #7                                              ; A = A EOR 7     A = 5 4 3 2 1  $^$ 0xcb85
    LSR                                                 ; A = A / 2       A = 2 2 1 1 0  $^$ 0xcb87

    TAX                                                 ; X=A Index into multiplication table  $^$ 0xcb88
                                                        ; (0 = MODE 7
                                                        ;  1 = MODE 4,5,6
                                                        ;  2 = MODE 0,1,2,3)

    LDA .multiplicationTabletoUseLow,X                  ; load the low byte of the multiplication table to use  $^$ 0xcb89
    STA .vduMultiplicationTableLow                      ; store  $^$ 0xcb8c
    LDA #>.multiplyBy640Table                           ; high byte of multiplication tables  $^$ 0xcb8e
    STA .vduMultiplicationTableHigh                     ; store. Now (.vduMultiplicationTableLow) points to 640x multiplication table or 40x.  $^$ 0xcb90
    LDA .bytesPerRowLow,X                               ; get number of bytes per row (low byte) from table  $^$ 0xcb92

    STA .vduBytesPerCharacterRowLow                     ; store bytes per character row  $^$ 0xcb95
    STX .vduBytesPerCharacterRowHigh                    ; bytes per character row (high byte)  $^$ 0xcb98
    LDA #%01000011                                      ;  $^$ 0xcb9b
    JSR .clearVDUStatusByteFlags                        ; clear bits 2,3,4,5,7 in .vduStatusByteFlags:  $^$ 0xcb9d
                                                        ; bit 2 = paged scrolling selected
                                                        ; bit 3 = software scrolling (text window)
                                                        ; bit 4 = not used
                                                        ; bit 5 = graphics cursor enabled (VDU 5)
                                                        ; bit 7 = VDU disabled


    LDX .vduCurrentScreenMODE                           ; screen mode  $^$ 0xcba0
    LDA .videoULAVideoControlRegisterDefaultValuesPerMODE,X ; get video ULA control setting  $^$ 0xcba3
    JSR .setVideoULA                                    ; set video ULA using OSBYTE 154  $^$ 0xcba6

    ; Set CRTC registers for the current mode
    PHP                                                 ; push flags  $^$ 0xcba9
    SEI                                                 ; disable interrupts  $^$ 0xcbaa
    LDX .crtcCursorEndRegisterTable,Y                   ; get cursor end register data from table  $^$ 0xcbab
    LDY #11                                             ; Y = 11  $^$ 0xcbae
-
    LDA .crtcRegisters0to11ForMODEs012,X                ; get entry from CRTC table  $^$ 0xcbb0
    JSR .setCRTCRegisterAY                              ; set CRTC Register Y to A  $^$ 0xcbb3
    DEX                                                 ; reduce pointers  $^$ 0xcbb6
    DEY                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcbb7
    BPL -                                               ; if (still >=0) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xcbb8
    PLP                                                 ; pull flags  $^$ 0xcbba
    JSR .vdu20EntryPoint                                ; set default colours  $^$ 0xcbbb
    JSR .vdu26EntryPoint                                ; set default windows  $^$ 0xcbbe

.initializeDisplayAndHomeCursor
    LDX #0                                              ; X = 0  $^$ 0xcbc1
    LDA .vduStartScreenAddressHighByte                  ; high byte of screen RAM address  $^$ 0xcbc3
    STX .vduScreenTopLeftAddressLow                     ; screen start address low  $^$ 0xcbc6
    STA .vduScreenTopLeftAddressHigh                    ; screen start address high  $^$ 0xcbc9
    JSR .setTextCursorCRTCAddress                       ; use X and Y to set new cursor address  $^$ 0xcbcc
    LDY #.crtcStartScreenAddressHighRegister            ;  $^$ 0xcbcf
    JSR .setTwoCRTCRegisters                            ; set registers 12 and 13 in CRTC  $^$ 0xcbd1
    LDA .vduBackgroundTextColour                        ; background text colour  $^$ 0xcbd4
    LDX .vduCurrentScreenMODEGroup                      ; MODE group = screen memory size  $^$ 0xcbd7
                                                        ; 0=20k (MODE 0,1,2)
                                                        ; 1=16k (MODE 3)
                                                        ; 2=10k (MODE 4,5)
                                                        ; 3=8k (MODE 6)
                                                        ; 4=1k (MODE 7)
    LDY .clearScreenRoutineEntryPointLow,X              ; get section control number  $^$ 0xcbda
    STY .vduJumpVectorLow                               ; set it in jump vector low  $^$ 0xcbdd
    LDY #>.clearScreenRoutineEntryPointMODE012          ; high byte of address of screen clearing routine  $^$ 0xcbe0
    STY .vduJumpVectorHigh                              ; upper byte of link address  $^$ 0xcbe2
    LDX #0                                              ; X = 0  $^$ 0xcbe5
    STX .pagedModeCounter                               ; paged mode counter  $^$ 0xcbe7
    STX .vduTextCursorXPosition                         ; text column  $^$ 0xcbea
    STX .vduTextCursorYPosition                         ; current text line  $^$ 0xcbed
    JMP (.vduJumpVectorLow)                             ; jump indirect - this calls the screen clearing routine  $^$ 0xcbf0

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSWORD 10 - Read character definition
;
; On Entry:
;       A          = character to read
;       .oswordX/Y = address of buffer to store the eight bytes of results
; ***************************************************************************************
.osword10EntryPoint
    JSR .getCharacterDefinitionAddress                  ; set up character definition pointers  $^$ 0xcbf3
    LDY #0                                              ; Y=0  $^$ 0xcbf6
-
    LDA (.vduTempStoreDE),Y                             ; get first byte  $^$ 0xcbf8
    INY                                                 ; Y=Y+1  $^$ 0xcbfa
    STA (.oswordX),Y                                    ; store it in YX  $^$ 0xcbfb
    CPY #8                                              ; until Y=8  $^$ 0xcbfd
    BNE -                                               ;  $^$ 0xcbff
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcc01

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Screen clear routine
;
; On Entry:
;       A contains byte for the background colour which is set in every byte of the screen
;
; To visualise the pattern of bytes that are cleared see cls.ssd
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.clearScreenRoutineEntryPointMODE012
    STA $3000,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc02
    STA $3100,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc05
    STA $3200,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc08
    STA $3300,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc0b
    STA $3400,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc0e
    STA $3500,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc11
    STA $3600,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc14
    STA $3700,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc17
    STA $3800,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc1a
    STA $3900,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc1d
    STA $3A00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc20
    STA $3B00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc23
    STA $3C00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc26
    STA $3D00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc29
    STA $3E00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc2c
    STA $3F00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc2f

.clearScreenRoutineEntryPointMODE3
    STA $4000,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc32
    STA $4100,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc35
    STA $4200,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc38
    STA $4300,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc3b
    STA $4400,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc3e
    STA $4500,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc41
    STA $4600,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc44
    STA $4700,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc47
    STA $4800,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc4a
    STA $4900,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc4d
    STA $4A00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc50
    STA $4B00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc53
    STA $4C00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc56
    STA $4D00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc59
    STA $4E00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc5c
    STA $4F00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc5f
    STA $5000,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc62
    STA $5100,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc65
    STA $5200,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc68
    STA $5300,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc6b
    STA $5400,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc6e
    STA $5500,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc71
    STA $5600,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc74
    STA $5700,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc77

.clearScreenRoutineEntryPointMODE45
    STA $5800,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc7a
    STA $5900,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc7d
    STA $5A00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc80
    STA $5B00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc83
    STA $5C00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc86
    STA $5D00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc89
    STA $5E00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc8c
    STA $5F00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc8f

.clearScreenRoutineEntryPointMODE6
    STA $6000,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc92
    STA $6100,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc95
    STA $6200,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc98
    STA $6300,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc9b
    STA $6400,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcc9e
    STA $6500,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcca1
    STA $6600,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcca4
    STA $6700,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcca7
    STA $6800,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xccaa
    STA $6900,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xccad
    STA $6A00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xccb0
    STA $6B00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xccb3
    STA $6C00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xccb6
    STA $6D00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xccb9
    STA $6E00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xccbc
    STA $6F00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xccbf
    STA $7000,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xccc2
    STA $7100,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xccc5
    STA $7200,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xccc8
    STA $7300,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcccb
    STA $7400,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xccce
    STA $7500,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xccd1
    STA $7600,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xccd4
    STA $7700,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xccd7
    STA $7800,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xccda
    STA $7900,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xccdd
    STA $7A00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcce0
    STA $7B00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcce3

.clearScreenRoutineEntryPointMODE7
    STA $7C00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcce6
    STA $7D00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xcce9
    STA $7E00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xccec
    STA $7F00,X                                         ;  $^$ 0xccef
    INX                                                 ;  $^$ 0xccf2
    BEQ .exit7                                          ; if (all done) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xccf3
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.executeRequiredVDUFunction
    JMP (.vduJumpVectorLow)                             ; loop back (using the jump vector  $^$ 0xccf5
                                                        ; set up previously) to the
                                                        ; appropriate address for the current
                                                        ; MODE.

; ***************************************************************************************
; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Chapter 7: Graphics cursor and soft character definitions
;
; ***************************************************************************************
; ***************************************************************************************

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Subtract the number of bytes in a row from AX
;
; On Entry:
;       A = High byte of 16 bit value
;       X = Low byte of 16 bit value
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.subtractNumberOfBytesInARowFromAX
    PHA                                                 ; store A  $^$ 0xccf8
    TXA                                                 ; A=X  $^$ 0xccf9
    SEC                                                 ; set carry for subtraction  $^$ 0xccfa
    SBC .vduBytesPerCharacterRowLow                     ; bytes per character row  $^$ 0xccfb
    TAX                                                 ; result goes into X  $^$ 0xccfe
    PLA                                                 ; recall A  $^$ 0xccff
    SBC .vduBytesPerCharacterRowHigh                    ; bytes per character row  $^$ 0xcd00
    CMP .vduStartScreenAddressHighByte                  ; high byte of screen RAM address  $^$ 0xcd03
.exit6
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcd06

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 20 - 'Explode' soft character definitions
;
; This sets how much RAM is reserved for custom ('soft') character definitions. These areas
; of memory are sometimes known as 'font zones'.
;
; On Entry:
;       X   memory assigned          character range   notes
;       0   $0C00->$0CFF               $80-$8F         minimum memory assigned ('imploded')
;       1   OSHWM->OSHWM+$FF           $A0-$BF         includes allocations above
;       2   OSHWM+$100->OSHWM+$1FF     $C0-$DF         includes allocations above
;       3   OSHWM+$200->OSHWM+$2FF     $E0-$FF         includes allocations above
;       4   OSHWM+$300->OSHWM+$3FF     $20-$3F         includes allocations above
;       5   OSHWM+$400->OSHWM+$4FF     $40-$5F         includes allocations above
;       6   OSHWM+$500->OSHWM+$5FF     $60-$7F         includes allocations above
;
; Here OSHWM refers to the value of .defaultOSHWM, which holds the value of OSHWM before any
; font explosions.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte20EntryPoint
    LDA #%00001111                                      ;  $^$ 0xcd07
    STA .vduFontFlags                                   ; characters 160-255 have soft character definitions  $^$ 0xcd09
    LDA #>.softCharacterDefinitions                     ; page for software character definitions  $^$ 0xcd0c
    LDY #.vduFontZoneAddressesHigh7 - .vduFontZoneAddressesHigh1     ; set loop counter  $^$ 0xcd0e
-
    STA .vduFontZoneAddressesHigh1,Y                    ; set all font zone addresses (high byte) to $0C  $^$ 0xcd10
    DEY                                                 ; to indicate the page available  $^$ 0xcd13
    BPL -                                               ; for user character definitions  $^$ 0xcd14

    CPX #7                                              ;  $^$ 0xcd16
    BCC +                                               ; if (X < 7, i.e. parameter is in range) then branch  $^$ 0xcd18
    LDX #6                                              ; X=6  $^$ 0xcd1a
+
    STX .softCharacterDefinitionsSwitch                 ; character definition explosion switch  $^$ 0xcd1c
    LDA .defaultOSHWM                                   ; A = initial OSHWM value, before font  $^$ 0xcd1f
                                                        ;     explosions.
    LDX #0                                              ; X = 0, loop counter  $^$ 0xcd22
-
    CPX .softCharacterDefinitionsSwitch                 ; character definition explosion switch  $^$ 0xcd24
    BCS +                                               ;  $^$ 0xcd27
    LDY .softCharacterRamAllocationTable,X              ; Y = RAM allocation offset  $^$ 0xcd29
    STA .vduFontZoneAddressesHigh1,Y                    ; store in relevant font zone address  $^$ 0xcd2c
    ADC #1                                              ; add 1 page (carry clear)  $^$ 0xcd2f
    INX                                                 ; X=X+1  $^$ 0xcd31
    BNE -                                               ; if (X is not zero) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xcd32
+
    STA .currentOSHWM                                   ; store new value of PAGE (OSHWM)  $^$ 0xcd34
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A  $^$ 0xcd37
    BEQ .exit6                                          ; if (zero) then branch (return)  $^$ 0xcd38

    LDX #.romServiceCallFontImplosionExplosionWarning   ; } issue ROM service call to let ROMs  $^$ 0xcd3a
                                                        ; } know of the font explosion and
    JMP .osbyte143EntryPoint                            ; } to let languages know OSHWM  $^$ 0xcd3c
                                                        ; } is changing. Y is new PAGE number

; ***************************************************************************************
.moveTextCursorToNextLine
    LDA #2                                              ; A=2 to check if scrolling disabled  $^$ 0xcd3f
    BIT .vduStatusByte                                  ; test VDU status byte  $^$ 0xcd41
    BNE +                                               ; if (scrolling is disabled) then branch  $^$ 0xcd43
    BVC .exit8                                          ; if (cursor editing mode is disabled) then return  $^$ 0xcd45
+
    LDA .vduTextWindowBottom                            ; bottom edge of text window  $^$ 0xcd47
    BCC +                                               ; if (carry clear on entry) then branch  $^$ 0xcd4a
    LDA .vduTextWindowTop                               ; get top of text window  $^$ 0xcd4c
+
    BVS .moveTextCursorToNextLineCursorEditing          ; if (cursor editing mode enabled) then branch  $^$ 0xcd4f
    STA .vduTextCursorYPosition                         ; set current text line  $^$ 0xcd51
    PLA                                                 ; pull return link from stack  $^$ 0xcd54
    PLA                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcd55
    JMP .setCursorSoftwareAndHardwarePosition           ; set cursor position  $^$ 0xcd56

; ***************************************************************************************
.moveTextCursorToNextLineCursorEditing
    PHP                                                 ; push flags  $^$ 0xcd59
    CMP .vduTextInputCursorYCoordinate                  ; Y coordinate of text input cursor  $^$ 0xcd5a
    BEQ .pullAndExit                                    ; if (A = line count) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xcd5d
    PLP                                                 ; get back flags  $^$ 0xcd5f
    BCC .incYCoordinate                                 ;  $^$ 0xcd60
    DEC .vduTextInputCursorYCoordinate                  ; Y coordinate of text input cursor  $^$ 0xcd62
.exit7
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcd65

; ***************************************************************************************
.incYCoordinate
    INC .vduTextInputCursorYCoordinate                  ; Y coordinate of text input cursor  $^$ 0xcd66
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcd69

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Set up a write cursor
;
; When entering a line of text, if the user presses a cursor key then two cursors are shown:
; The WRITE cursor is shown at the point of text entry (looks like a solid block character),
; and is the position at which new characters will be input.
; The READ cursor (shown as a flashing underline) is positioned by the cursor keys.
; The COPY key reads the character under the READ cursor and enters it at WRITE cursor.
;
; Editing finishes when RETURN is pressed.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.setUpWriteCursor
    PHP                                                 ; save flags  $^$ 0xcd6a
    PHA                                                 ; save A  $^$ 0xcd6b
    LDY .vduBytesPerCharacter                           ;  $^$ 0xcd6c
    DEY                                                 ; Y = bytes per character - 1  $^$ 0xcd6f
    BNE .restoreWriteCursorNonMODE7                     ; if (not MODE 7) then branch  $^$ 0xcd70
    LDA .vduMODE7CursorCharacter                        ; get MODE 7 write character  $^$ 0xcd72
                                                        ; cursor character $7F
    STA (.vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow),Y             ; store it at top scan line of current  $^$ 0xcd75
                                                        ; character
.pullTwiceAndExit
    PLA                                                 ; pull A  $^$ 0xcd77
.pullAndExit
    PLP                                                 ; pull flags  $^$ 0xcd78
.exit8
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcd79

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Restore a normal cursor
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.restoreWriteCursor
    PHP                                                 ; push flags  $^$ 0xcd7a
    PHA                                                 ; push A  $^$ 0xcd7b
    LDY .vduBytesPerCharacter                           ;  $^$ 0xcd7c
    DEY                                                 ; Y = bytes per character - 1  $^$ 0xcd7f
    BNE .restoreWriteCursorNonMODE7                     ; if (not MODE 7) then branch  $^$ 0xcd80
    LDA (.vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow),Y             ; read from cursor screen address  $^$ 0xcd82
    STA .vduMODE7CursorCharacter                        ; store it  $^$ 0xcd84
    LDA .vduTeletextCharacterForCursor                  ; MODE 7 write cursor character  $^$ 0xcd87
    STA (.vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow),Y             ; store it in MODE 7 screen address  $^$ 0xcd8a
    JMP .pullTwiceAndExit                               ; and exit  $^$ 0xcd8c

; ***************************************************************************************
.restoreWriteCursorNonMODE7
    LDA #$FF                                            ; A=$FF (cursor byte mask)  $^$ 0xcd8f
    CPY #31                                             ; check bytes per character  $^$ 0xcd91
    BNE +                                               ; if (not MODE 2) then branch  $^$ 0xcd93
    LDA #$3F                                            ; A=$3F (cursor byte mask)  $^$ 0xcd95
+
    STA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; store it  $^$ 0xcd97
-
    LDA (.vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow),Y             ; get scan line byte  $^$ 0xcd99
    EOR .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; invert it  $^$ 0xcd9b
    STA (.vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow),Y             ; store it on scan line  $^$ 0xcd9d
    DEY                                                 ; decrement scan line counter  $^$ 0xcd9f
    BPL -                                               ; do it again  $^$ 0xcda0
    BMI .pullTwiceAndExit                               ; ALWAYS branch (pull and exit)  $^$ 0xcda2

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Software scroll text window downwards
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.scrollTextWindowDownwards
    JSR .checkVerticalTextWindowBoundsAndMoveToLeftColumn   ;  $^$ 0xcda4
    LDA .vduTextWindowBottom                            ; bottom edge  $^$ 0xcda7
    STA .vduTextCursorYPosition                         ; current text line  $^$ 0xcdaa
    JSR .setTextCursorScreenAddresses                   ; set cursor screen addresses  $^$ 0xcdad
.loopBackScrollDown
    JSR .subtractNumberOfBytesInARowFromAX              ; subtract bytes per character row  $^$ 0xcdb0
    BCS +                                               ;  $^$ 0xcdb3
    ADC .vduScreenSizeHighByte                          ; screen RAM size high byte  $^$ 0xcdb5
+
    STA .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; store A  $^$ 0xcdb8
    STX .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; X  $^$ 0xcdba
    STA .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; A again  $^$ 0xcdbc
    BCS .noWraparound                                   ; if (C set; there was no wraparound) then branch  $^$ 0xcdbe
-
    JSR .copyCharacterLineOfTextWindow                  ; copy line to new position  $^$ 0xcdc0
                                                        ; using (.vduTempStoreDA) for read and
                                                        ; (.vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow)
                                                        ; for write
    JMP +                                               ;  $^$ 0xcdc3

.noWraparound
    JSR .subtractNumberOfBytesInARowFromAX              ; subtract bytes per character row  $^$ 0xcdc6
    BCC -                                               ; if (outside screen RAM) then branch  $^$ 0xcdc9
    JSR .copyCharacterRow                               ; copy a character row of the text window  $^$ 0xcdcb
+
    LDA .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; set write pointer from read pointer  $^$ 0xcdce
    LDX .vduTempStoreDA                                 ;  $^$ 0xcdd0
    STA .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressHigh                ;  $^$ 0xcdd2
    STX .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow                 ;  $^$ 0xcdd4
    DEC .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; decrement window height  $^$ 0xcdd6
    BNE .loopBackScrollDown                             ; if (not zero) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xcdd8

.exchangeTextCursorPositionWithWorkspaceAB
    LDX #.vduWorkspaceA - .vduVariablesStart            ; point to workspace  $^$ 0xcdda

    LDY #.vduTextCursorXPosition - .vduVariablesStart   ; point to text column/line  $^$ 0xcddc
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.exchangeTwoVDUBytes
    LDA #2                                              ; number of bytes to swap  $^$ 0xcdde
    BNE .exchangeABytes                                 ; ALWAYS branch. Exchange  $^$ 0xcde0
                                                        ; (.vduWorkspaceA/B)+Y with (.workspaceA/B)+X

; ***************************************************************************************
.exchangeGraphicsCursorWithOldPosition
    LDX #.vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXLow - .vduVariablesStart     ; point to graphics cursor  $^$ 0xcde2
.exchangeOldGraphicsCursorPositionWithVariableX
    LDY #.vduOldGraphicsCursorPixelsXLow - .vduVariablesStart  ; point to last graphics cursor  $^$ 0xcde4
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.exchangeFourBytes
    LDA #4                                              ; A = 4  $^$ 0xcde6
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.exchangeABytes
    STA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; store it as loop counter  $^$ 0xcde8
-
    LDA .vduVariablesStart,X                            ; get byte  $^$ 0xcdea
    PHA                                                 ; store it  $^$ 0xcded
    LDA .vduVariablesStart,Y                            ; get byte pointed to by Y  $^$ 0xcdee
    STA .vduVariablesStart,X                            ; put it in 300+X  $^$ 0xcdf1
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xcdf4
    STA .vduVariablesStart,Y                            ; put it in 300+Y  $^$ 0xcdf5
    INX                                                 ; increment pointers  $^$ 0xcdf8
    INY                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcdf9
    DEC .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; decrement loop counter  $^$ 0xcdfa
    BNE -                                               ; if (not zero) then branch (loop back and do it again)  $^$ 0xcdfc
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcdfe

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Software scroll text window upwards
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.scrollTextWindowUpwards
    JSR .checkVerticalTextWindowBoundsAndMoveToLeftColumn   ;  $^$ 0xcdff
    LDY .vduTextWindowTop                               ; top of text window  $^$ 0xce02
    STY .vduTextCursorYPosition                         ; current text line  $^$ 0xce05
    JSR .setTextCursorScreenAddresses                   ; set cursor screen addresses  $^$ 0xce08
.loopBackScrollUp
    JSR .addNumberOfBytesInACharacterRowToAX            ; add bytes per character row  $^$ 0xce0b
    BPL +                                               ;  $^$ 0xce0e
    SEC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xce10
    SBC .vduScreenSizeHighByte                          ; screen RAM size high byte  $^$ 0xce11
+
    STA .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; (.vduTempStoreDA)=X/A  $^$ 0xce14
    STX .vduTempStoreDA                                 ;  $^$ 0xce16
    STA .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; .vduTempStoreDC=A  $^$ 0xce18
    BCC +                                               ;  $^$ 0xce1a
-
    JSR .copyCharacterLineOfTextWindow                  ; copy line to new position  $^$ 0xce1c
                                                        ; using (.vduTempStoreDA) for read
                                                        ; and (.vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow) for write
    JMP .finishScroll                                   ;  $^$ 0xce1f

+
    JSR .addNumberOfBytesInACharacterRowToAX            ; add bytes per char. row  $^$ 0xce22
    BMI -                                               ; if (outside screen RAM) then branch  $^$ 0xce25
    JSR .copyCharacterRow                               ; copy a character row of the text window  $^$ 0xce27
.finishScroll
    LDA .vduTempStoreDC                                 ;  $^$ 0xce2a
    LDX .vduTempStoreDA                                 ;  $^$ 0xce2c
    STA .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressHigh                ;  $^$ 0xce2e
    STX .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow                 ;  $^$ 0xce30
    DEC .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; decrement window height  $^$ 0xce32
    BNE .loopBackScrollUp                               ; if (not zero) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xce34
    BEQ .exchangeTextCursorPositionWithWorkspaceAB      ; ALWAYS branch - swap text cursor position with workspace  $^$ 0xce36


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Copy bytes of one character row of the text window
;
; On Entry:
;       .vduTempStoreDA/DB                   is address to copy from
;       .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow/High is the destination address
;       .vduTextWindowWidthInBytesLow/High   is number of bytes to copy
; ***************************************************************************************
.copyCharacterRow
    LDX .vduTextWindowWidthInBytesHigh                  ; text window width high (bytes)  $^$ 0xce38
    BEQ +                                               ; if (no more than 256 bytes to copy) then branch  $^$ 0xce3b

    LDY #0                                              ; Y=0 to set loop counter  $^$ 0xce3d
-
    LDA (.vduTempStoreDA),Y                             ; } copy 256 bytes  $^$ 0xce3f
    STA (.vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow),Y             ; }  $^$ 0xce41
    INY                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xce43
    BNE -                                               ; } loop till Y=0 again  $^$ 0xce44
    INC .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressHigh                ; increment high bytes  $^$ 0xce46
    INC .vduTempStoreDB                                 ;  $^$ 0xce48
    DEX                                                 ; decrement window width  $^$ 0xce4a
    BNE -                                               ; if (not done yet) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xce4b
+
    LDY .vduTextWindowWidthInBytesLow                   ; text window width low (bytes)  $^$ 0xce4d
    BEQ +                                               ; if (text window is zero bytes wide) then branch (return)  $^$ 0xce50
-
    DEY                                                 ; Y=Y-1  $^$ 0xce52
    LDA (.vduTempStoreDA),Y                             ; copy Y bytes  $^$ 0xce53
    STA (.vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow),Y             ;  $^$ 0xce55
    TYA                                                 ; A=Y  $^$ 0xce57
    BNE -                                               ; if (not done yet) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xce58
+
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xce5a


; ***************************************************************************************
.checkVerticalTextWindowBoundsAndMoveToLeftColumn
    JSR .exchangeTextCursorPositionWithWorkspaceAB      ; exchange text cursor position with workspaceAB  $^$ 0xce5b
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xce5e
    LDA .vduTextWindowBottom                            ; bottom edge  $^$ 0xce5f
    SBC .vduTextWindowTop                               ; top of text window  $^$ 0xce62
    STA .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; store height of text area  $^$ 0xce65
    BNE .setTextCursorToLeftHandColumn                  ; set text column to left hand column  $^$ 0xce67
    PLA                                                 ; get back return address (to exit caller routine early)  $^$ 0xce69
    PLA                                                 ;  $^$ 0xce6a
    JMP .exchangeTextCursorPositionWithWorkspaceAB      ; exchange text cursor position with workspaceAB  $^$ 0xce6b

; ***************************************************************************************
.setTextCursorToLeftHandColumn
    LDA .vduTextWindowLeft                              ; text window left  $^$ 0xce6e
    BPL .storeTextCursorXSetCarryAndReturn              ; ALWAYS branch (set X window position)  $^$ 0xce71

; ***************************************************************************************
.copyCharacterLineOfTextWindow
    LDA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xce73
    PHA                                                 ; push A  $^$ 0xce75
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xce76
    LDA .vduTextWindowRight                             ; text window right  $^$ 0xce77
    SBC .vduTextWindowLeft                              ; text window left  $^$ 0xce7a
    STA .vduTempStoreDF                                 ; store text window width  $^$ 0xce7d
--
    LDY .vduBytesPerCharacter                           ; bytes per character to set loop counter  $^$ 0xce7f
    DEY                                                 ; copy loop  $^$ 0xce82
-
    LDA (.vduTempStoreDA),Y                             ; source: copy from .vduTempStoreDA/DB  $^$ 0xce83
    STA (.vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow),Y             ; destination: store to screen  $^$ 0xce85
    DEY                                                 ;  $^$ 0xce87
    BPL -                                               ; keep copying for one character  $^$ 0xce88
    LDX #2                                              ; X=2 loop counter  $^$ 0xce8a
-
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xce8c
    LDA .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow,X               ;  $^$ 0xce8d
    ADC .vduBytesPerCharacter                           ; move screen pointer on by bytes per character  $^$ 0xce8f
    STA .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow,X               ; and (when X=0) do the same with .vduTempStoreDA/DB  $^$ 0xce92
    LDA .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressHigh,X              ;  $^$ 0xce94
    ADC #0                                              ;  $^$ 0xce96
    BPL +                                               ; if (this remains in screen RAM OK) then branch  $^$ 0xce98
    SEC                                                 ; wrap around screen  $^$ 0xce9a
    SBC .vduScreenSizeHighByte                          ; take off screen RAM size high byte  $^$ 0xce9b
+
    STA .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressHigh,X              ; store high byte  $^$ 0xce9e
    DEX                                                 ; X = X - 2  $^$ 0xcea0
    DEX                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcea1
    BEQ -                                               ; if (X = 0) then branch (loop back  $^$ 0xcea2
                                                        ; to adjust second set of pointers)
    DEC .vduTempStoreDF                                 ; decrement text window width counter  $^$ 0xcea4
    BPL --                                              ; if (still +ve) then branch (loop  $^$ 0xcea6
                                                        ; back and do it all again)
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xcea8
    STA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; and store it  $^$ 0xcea9
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xceab

; ***************************************************************************************
.clearOneLine
    LDA .vduTextCursorXPosition                         ; text column  $^$ 0xceac
    PHA                                                 ; save it  $^$ 0xceaf
    JSR .setTextCursorToLeftHandColumn                  ; set text column to left hand column  $^$ 0xceb0
    JSR .setTextCursorScreenAddresses                   ; set cursor screen addresses  $^$ 0xceb3
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xceb6
    LDA .vduTextWindowRight                             ; text window right  $^$ 0xceb7
    SBC .vduTextWindowLeft                              ; text window left  $^$ 0xceba
    STA .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; as window width  $^$ 0xcebd
--
    LDA .vduBackgroundTextColour                        ; background text colour  $^$ 0xcebf
    LDY .vduBytesPerCharacter                           ; bytes per character  $^$ 0xcec2
-
    DEY                                                 ; Y=Y-1 decrementing loop counter  $^$ 0xcec5
    STA (.vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow),Y             ; store background colour at this  $^$ 0xcec6
                                                        ; point on screen
    BNE -                                               ; if (Y is not zero) then branch  $^$ 0xcec8
                                                        ; (loop back)
    TXA                                                 ; A=X  $^$ 0xceca
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry to add  $^$ 0xcecb
    ADC .vduBytesPerCharacter                           ; bytes per character  $^$ 0xcecc
    TAX                                                 ; X=A restoring it  $^$ 0xcecf
    LDA .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressHigh                ; get high byte  $^$ 0xced0
    ADC #0                                              ; add carry if any  $^$ 0xced2
    BPL +                                               ; if (+ve) then branch  $^$ 0xced4
    SEC                                                 ; wrap around  $^$ 0xced6
    SBC .vduScreenSizeHighByte                          ; screen RAM size high byte  $^$ 0xced7
+
    STX .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow                 ; restore values  $^$ 0xceda
    STA .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressHigh                ;  $^$ 0xcedc
    DEC .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; decrement window width  $^$ 0xcede
    BPL --                                              ; and if not 0 do it all again  $^$ 0xcee0
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xcee2

.storeTextCursorXSetCarryAndReturn
    STA .vduTextCursorXPosition                         ; restore text column  $^$ 0xcee3
.setCarryAndReturn
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xcee6
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcee7

; ***************************************************************************************
.validatePositionAndSetupScreenAddress
    LDX .vduTextCursorXPosition                         ; get text cursor X position  $^$ 0xcee8
    CPX .vduTextWindowLeft                              ; test against left edge of text window  $^$ 0xceeb
    BMI .setCarryAndReturn                              ; if (less than left edge) then branch (return with carry set)  $^$ 0xceee
    CPX .vduTextWindowRight                             ; test against right edge of text window  $^$ 0xcef0
    BEQ +                                               ; if (equal to right edge) then branch (thats OK)  $^$ 0xcef3
    BPL .setCarryAndReturn                              ; if (greater than right edge) then branch (return with carry set)  $^$ 0xcef5
+
    LDX .vduTextCursorYPosition                         ; current text line  $^$ 0xcef7
    CPX .vduTextWindowTop                               ; test against top edge of text window  $^$ 0xcefa
    BMI .setCarryAndReturn                              ; if (less than top edge) then branch (return with carry set)  $^$ 0xcefd
    CPX .vduTextWindowBottom                            ; test against bottom edge of text window  $^$ 0xceff
    BEQ .setTextCursorScreenAddresses                   ; if (equal to bottom edge) then branch (ok to set cursor screen addresses)  $^$ 0xcf02
    BPL .setCarryAndReturn                              ; if (greater than bottom edge) then branch (return with carry set)  $^$ 0xcf04
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Set text cursor screen addresses from X,Y position
;
; Let X,Y be the text cursor position (in absolute character cells from top left corner)
;
;     MODE 0: address = screen_start + Y*640 + X* 8
;     MODE 1: address = screen_start + Y*640 + X*16
;     MODE 2: address = screen_start + Y*640 + X*32
;     MODE 3: address = screen_start + Y*640 + X* 8
;     MODE 4: address = screen_start + Y*320 + X* 8
;     MODE 5: address = screen_start + Y*320 + X*16
;     MODE 6: address = screen_start + Y*320 + X* 8
;     MODE 7: address = screen_start + Y* 40 + X
;
; Given the text cursor X,Y position, use the multiplication table and other characteristic
; values for the current MODE to calculate the address on screen.
;
; On Entry:
;       .vduTextCursorX/YPosition stores the X,Y coordinates of the text cursor
;
; On Exit:
;       Carry clear
;       Stores the result in .vduTextCursorCRTCAddressLow/High, then wraps the address back on
;       screen if beyond the bottom of the screen. Store the new wrapped result in
;       .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow/High.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.setTextCursorScreenAddresses
    LDA .vduTextCursorYPosition                         ; current text line  $^$ 0xcf06
    ASL                                                 ; multiply by two to get table offset  $^$ 0xcf09
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A  $^$ 0xcf0a
    LDA (.vduMultiplicationTableLow),Y                  ; get CRTC multiplication table pointer  $^$ 0xcf0b
    STA .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressHigh                ; .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressHigh=A  $^$ 0xcf0d
    INY                                                 ; Y=Y+1  $^$ 0xcf0f
    LDA #2                                              ; A=2  $^$ 0xcf10
    AND .vduCurrentScreenMODEGroup                      ; AND with MODE group:  $^$ 0xcf12
                                                        ;   0 = 20k (MODE 0,1,2)
                                                        ;   1 = 16k (MODE 3)
                                                        ;   2 = 10k (MODE 4,5)
                                                        ;   3 = 8k (MODE 6)
                                                        ;   4 = 1k (MODE 7)
    PHP                                                 ; save flags  $^$ 0xcf15
    LDA (.vduMultiplicationTableLow),Y                  ; get CRTC multiplication table pointer  $^$ 0xcf16
    PLP                                                 ; pull flags  $^$ 0xcf18
    BEQ +                                               ; branch if MODE 0,1,2,3 or 7  $^$ 0xcf19
