    LSR .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressHigh                ; MODE 4,5,6: Halve value from multiplication table (high and low bytes)  $^$ 0xcf1b
    ROR                                                 ; A = A / 2 + (128*carry)  $^$ 0xcf1d
+
    ADC .vduScreenTopLeftAddressLow                     ; add start of screen (low)  $^$ 0xcf1e
    STA .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow                 ; store  $^$ 0xcf21
    LDA .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressHigh                ; get offset from start of screen (high)  $^$ 0xcf23
    ADC .vduScreenTopLeftAddressHigh                    ; add start of screen (high)  $^$ 0xcf25
    TAY                                                 ; store in Y  $^$ 0xcf28
    LDA .vduTextCursorXPosition                         ; text column  $^$ 0xcf29
    LDX .vduBytesPerCharacter                           ; bytes per character  $^$ 0xcf2c
    DEX                                                 ; X=X-1  $^$ 0xcf2f
    BEQ .mode7Cursor                                    ; if (in MODE 7) then branch  $^$ 0xcf30
    CPX #15                                             ; is it mode 1 or mode 5? (four colour modes = 16 bytes per character)  $^$ 0xcf32
    BEQ .mode1or5Cursor                                 ; if (mode 1 or 5) then branch (with carry set)  $^$ 0xcf34
    BCC .mode0346Cursor                                 ; if (mode 0,3,4, or 6) then branch (with carry clear)  $^$ 0xcf36
    ASL                                                 ; A=A*16 if entered here (MODE 2)  $^$ 0xcf38
.mode1or5Cursor
    ASL                                                 ; A=A*8 if entered here  $^$ 0xcf39
.mode0346Cursor
    ASL                                                 ; A=A*4 if entered here  $^$ 0xcf3a
    ASL                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcf3b
    BCC .skipIncs                                       ; if (carry clear) then branch  $^$ 0xcf3c
    INY                                                 ; Y=Y+2  $^$ 0xcf3e
    INY                                                 ; Y is the high byte of the address  $^$ 0xcf3f
.skipIncs
    ASL                                                 ; A=A*2  $^$ 0xcf40
    BCC .skipInc                                        ; if (carry clear) branch (to add to .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow)  $^$ 0xcf41
    INY                                                 ; Y=Y+1  $^$ 0xcf43
.mode7Cursor
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xcf44
.skipInc
    ADC .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow                 ; add to .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow  $^$ 0xcf45
    STA .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow                 ; and store it  $^$ 0xcf47
    STA .vduTextCursorCRTCAddressLow                    ; text cursor CRTC address  $^$ 0xcf49
    TAX                                                 ; X=A  $^$ 0xcf4c
    TYA                                                 ; A=Y  $^$ 0xcf4d
    ADC #0                                              ; add carry if set  $^$ 0xcf4e
    STA .vduTextCursorCRTCAddressHigh                   ; store the text cursor CRTC address (before any wraparound)  $^$ 0xcf50
    BPL +                                               ; if (not negative) then branch  $^$ 0xcf53
    SEC                                                 ; wrap around...  $^$ 0xcf55
    SBC .vduScreenSizeHighByte                          ; ...subtract the screen size (high byte)  $^$ 0xcf56
+
    STA .vduWriteCursorScreenAddressHigh                ; store in high byte  $^$ 0xcf59
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xcf5b
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcf5c

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Display a character at the current graphics cursor
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.plotACharacterAtGraphicsCursor
    LDX .vduForegroundGraphicsColour                    ; foreground graphics colour  $^$ 0xcf5d
    LDY .vduForegroundGCOLMode                          ; foreground graphics GCOL mode  $^$ 0xcf60
.plotACharacterWithXYAsGraphicsColourAndGCOLMode
    JSR .setGraphicsColourMaskXY                        ; set graphics byte mask in .vduGraphicsColourByteOR/EOR  $^$ 0xcf63
    JSR .copyGraphicsCursorPixelPositionToWorkspaceABCD ; copy graphics cursor in pixels to workspace (.vduWorkspaceA-D)  $^$ 0xcf66
    LDY #0                                              ; Y=0  $^$ 0xcf69
.displayNextRowOfCharacter
    STY .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; .vduTempStoreDC=Y  $^$ 0xcf6b
    LDY .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; Y=.vduTempStoreDC [redundant instruction]  $^$ 0xcf6d
    LDA (.vduTempStoreDE),Y                             ; get pattern byte  $^$ 0xcf6f
    BEQ .characterPatternZero                           ; if (A=0) then branch  $^$ 0xcf71
    STA .vduTempStoreDD                                 ; .vduTempStoreDD = 1 bit character pattern byte  $^$ 0xcf73
-
    BPL +                                               ; if (pattern's top bit is clear) then branch (nothing to draw)  $^$ 0xcf75
    JSR .plotAPixelInACharacter                         ; display a pixel  $^$ 0xcf77
+
    INC .vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXLow                    ; current horizontal graphics cursor  $^$ 0xcf7a
    BNE +                                               ;  $^$ 0xcf7d
    INC .vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXHigh                   ; current horizontal graphics cursor  $^$ 0xcf7f
+
    ASL .vduTempStoreDD                                 ; shift the bit pattern left to draw next pixel  $^$ 0xcf82
    BNE -                                               ; if (there's still something left to draw) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xcf84
.characterPatternZero
    LDX #.vduWorkspaceA - .vduVariablesStart            ; source is workspace  $^$ 0xcf86
    LDY #.vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXLow - .vduVariablesStart  $^$ 0xcf88
                                                        ; destination is horizontal graphics cursor pixel position
    JSR .copyTwoBytesWithinVDUVariables                 ; copy two bytes  $^$ 0xcf8a
    LDY .vduGraphicsCursorPixelsYLow                    ; }  $^$ 0xcf8d
    BNE +                                               ; }  $^$ 0xcf90
    DEC .vduGraphicsCursorPixelsYHigh                   ; } decrement graphics cursor Y pixel position  $^$ 0xcf92
+                                                       ; }
    DEC .vduGraphicsCursorPixelsYLow                    ; }  $^$ 0xcf95
    LDY .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; loop counter  $^$ 0xcf98
    INY                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcf9a
    CPY #8                                              ;  $^$ 0xcf9b
    BNE .displayNextRowOfCharacter                      ; if (Y<8) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xcf9d
    LDX #.vduWorkspaceA - .vduVariablesStart            ; source: workspaceA-D  $^$ 0xcf9f
    LDY #.vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXLow - .vduVariablesStart  $^$ 0xcfa1
                                                        ; destination: graphics cursor position
    JMP .copyFourBytesWithinVDUVariables                ; copy to graphics cursor position  $^$ 0xcfa3

; ***************************************************************************************
.graphicsCursorHome
    LDX #.vduGraphicsWindowPixelsTopLow - .vduVariablesStart ; source bytes (graphics window top)  $^$ 0xcfa6
    LDY #.vduGraphicsCursorPixelsYLow - .vduVariablesStart   ; destination bytes (graphics cursor Y)  $^$ 0xcfa8
    JSR .copyTwoBytesWithinVDUVariables                      ; copy two bytes  $^$ 0xcfaa
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.setGraphicsCursorToLeftHandColumn
    LDX #.vduGraphicsWindowPixelsLeftLow - .vduVariablesStart ; source: left edge of graphics  $^$ 0xcfad
                                                              ; window
    LDY #.vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXLow - .vduVariablesStart    ; destination: graphics cursor  $^$ 0xcfaf
                                                              ; X coordinate
    JSR .copyTwoBytesWithinVDUVariables                       ; copy two bytes  $^$ 0xcfb1
    JMP .convertPixelGraphicsCoordinatesToExternal            ; set up external coordinates for graphics  $^$ 0xcfb4

; ***************************************************************************************
.displayACharacter
    LDX .vduNumberOfLogicalColoursMinusOne              ; number of logical colours less 1  $^$ 0xcfb7
    BEQ .displayCharacterMODE7                          ; if (MODE 7) then branch  $^$ 0xcfba
    JSR .getCharacterDefinitionAddress                  ; set up character definition pointers  $^$ 0xcfbc
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.displayACharacterAtAddress
    LDX .vduNumberOfLogicalColoursMinusOne              ; number of logical colours less 1  $^$ 0xcfbf
    LDA .vduStatusByte                                  ; VDU status byte  $^$ 0xcfc2
    AND #$20                                            ; and check bit 5 (printing at graphics cursor)  $^$ 0xcfc4
    BNE .plotACharacterAtGraphicsCursor                 ; if (set) then branch  $^$ 0xcfc6
    LDY #7                                              ; Y=7  $^$ 0xcfc8
    CPX #3                                              ;  $^$ 0xcfca
    BEQ .displayACharacter4ColourMODE                   ; if (X = 3) then branch to handle 4 colour MODEs  $^$ 0xcfcc
    BCS .displayACharacter16ColourMODE                  ; if (X > 3) then branch to deal with 16 colours  $^$ 0xcfce

    ; display a character in a 2 colour MODE
-
    LDA (.vduTempStoreDE),Y                             ; get pattern byte  $^$ 0xcfd0
    ORA .vduTextColourByteOR                            ; adjust for current foreground and background colour  $^$ 0xcfd2
    EOR .vduTextColourByteEOR                           ; adjust for current foreground and background colour  $^$ 0xcfd4
    STA (.vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow),Y             ; write to screen  $^$ 0xcfd6
    DEY                                                 ; Y=Y-1  $^$ 0xcfd8
    BPL -                                               ; if (still +ve) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xcfd9
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcfdb

; ***************************************************************************************
.displayCharacterMODE7
    LDY #2                                              ; Y=2, loop counter/index into the teletext conversion table  $^$ 0xcfdc
-
    CMP .teletextCharacterConversionTable,Y             ; compare with teletext conversion table  $^$ 0xcfde
    BEQ .convertMODE7Character                          ; if (found character to convert) then branch  $^$ 0xcfe1
    DEY                                                 ; Y=Y-1  $^$ 0xcfe3
    BPL -                                               ; loop back until done  $^$ 0xcfe4
.writeByteToMODE7Screen
    STA (.vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow,X)             ; write byte to screen  $^$ 0xcfe6
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcfe8

; ***************************************************************************************
.convertMODE7Character
    LDA .teletextCharacterConversionTable + 1,Y         ; convert with teletext conversion table  $^$ 0xcfe9
    BNE .writeByteToMODE7Screen                         ; ALWAYS branch back to write it  $^$ 0xcfec

; ***************************************************************************************
.displayACharacter4ColourMODE
    LDA (.vduTempStoreDE),Y                             ; get pattern byte  $^$ 0xcfee
    PHA                                                 ; save it  $^$ 0xcff0
    LSR                                                 ; move high nybble to low  $^$ 0xcff1
    LSR                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcff2
    LSR                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcff3
    LSR                                                 ;  $^$ 0xcff4
    TAX                                                 ; X=A  $^$ 0xcff5
    LDA .fourColourMODEByteMaskTable,X                  ; convert 4 bits of the character  $^$ 0xcff6
                                                        ; definition into bytes to write
                                                        ; to the screen
    ORA .vduTextColourByteOR                            ; adjust for current foreground and background colour  $^$ 0xcff9
    EOR .vduTextColourByteEOR                           ; adjust for current foreground and background colour  $^$ 0xcffb
    STA (.vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow),Y             ; write to screen  $^$ 0xcffd
    TYA                                                 ; A=Y  $^$ 0xcfff
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xd000
    ADC #8                                              ; add 8 to move screen RAM pointer 8 bytes  $^$ 0xd001
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A  $^$ 0xd003
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xd004
    AND #%00001111                                      ; clear high nybble  $^$ 0xd005
    TAX                                                 ; X=A  $^$ 0xd007
    LDA .fourColourMODEByteMaskTable,X                  ; 4 colour MODE byte mask look up table  $^$ 0xd008
    ORA .vduTextColourByteOR                            ; adjust for current foreground and background colour  $^$ 0xd00b
    EOR .vduTextColourByteEOR                           ; adjust for current foreground and background colour  $^$ 0xd00d
    STA (.vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow),Y             ; write to screen  $^$ 0xd00f
    TYA                                                 ; A=Y  $^$ 0xd011
    SBC #8                                              ; A=A-9  $^$ 0xd012
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A  $^$ 0xd014
    BPL .displayACharacter4ColourMODE                   ; if (not negative) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xd015
.exit9
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd017

; ***************************************************************************************
.nextPatternByte
    TYA                                                 ; Y=Y-$21  $^$ 0xd018
    SBC #$21                                            ;  $^$ 0xd019
    BMI .exit9                                          ; if (Y is negative) then branch (return)  $^$ 0xd01b
    TAY                                                 ; A=Y  $^$ 0xd01d
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.displayACharacter16ColourMODE
    LDA (.vduTempStoreDE),Y                             ; get pattern byte  $^$ 0xd01e
    STA .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; store it  $^$ 0xd020
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xd022
.iloop
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0  $^$ 0xd023
    ROL .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; carry now occupies bit 0 of DC  $^$ 0xd025
    BEQ .nextPatternByte                                ; when DC=0 again branch to deal  $^$ 0xd027
                                                        ; with next pattern byte
    ROL                                                 ; get bit 7 from .vduTempStoreDC into A bit 0  $^$ 0xd029
    ASL .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; rotate again to get second  $^$ 0xd02a
    ROL                                                 ; bit into A  $^$ 0xd02c
    TAX                                                 ; and store result in X  $^$ 0xd02d
    LDA .sixteenColourMODEByteMaskTable,X               ; convert two bits of the character  $^$ 0xd02e
                                                        ; definition into bytes to write
                                                        ; to the screen
    ORA .vduTextColourByteOR                            ; adjust for current foreground and background colour  $^$ 0xd031
    EOR .vduTextColourByteEOR                           ; adjust for current foreground and background colour  $^$ 0xd033
    STA (.vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow),Y             ; and store result  $^$ 0xd035
    CLC                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd037
    TYA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd038
    ADC #8                                              ; } Y=Y+8 moving screen RAM pointer on 8 bytes  $^$ 0xd039
    TAY                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd03b
    BCC .iloop                                          ; branch back to deal with next bit pair  $^$ 0xd03c
    ; fall through...


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Get character definition address
;
; On Entry:
;       A is the ascii code for a printable character 32-255 (bit pattern abcdefgh)
; On Exit:
;       .vduTempStoreDE/F is the address of the character definition either from the default
;                      ROM characters or the soft character definitions
; ***************************************************************************************
.getCharacterDefinitionAddress
    ASL                                                 ; bcdefgh0  C=a  $^$ 0xd03e
    ROL                                                 ; cdefgh0a  C=b  $^$ 0xd03f
    ROL                                                 ; defgh0ab  C=c  $^$ 0xd040
    STA .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; save this pattern (defgh0ab)  $^$ 0xd041
    AND #%00000011                                      ; 000000ab  $^$ 0xd043
    ROL                                                 ; 00000abc  C=0  $^$ 0xd045
    TAX                                                 ; X = soft font zone (1 - 7)  $^$ 0xd046
    AND #%00000011                                      ; A = 000000bc (1 - 3)  $^$ 0xd047
    ADC #>.characterDefinitions - 1                     ; A = high byte of character definitions ($C0, $C1, $C2)  $^$ 0xd049
    TAY                                                 ; Y = high byte of ROM address of character  $^$ 0xd04b
    LDA .fontMaskTable,X                                ; get single bit set depending on X (1-7)  $^$ 0xd04c
    BIT .vduFontFlags                                   ; test font flags to see if there are soft character definitions  $^$ 0xd04f
    BEQ +                                               ; if (hard character definitions) then branch  $^$ 0xd052
    LDY .vduFontZoneAddressesHigh1 - 1,X                ; get high byte from table for soft character definitions  $^$ 0xd054
+
    STY .vduTempStoreDF                                 ; store Y in high byte of address  $^$ 0xd057
    LDA .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; get back pattern (defgh0ab)  $^$ 0xd059
    AND #%11111000                                      ; defgh000  $^$ 0xd05b
    STA .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; and store it. This is 8 times the  $^$ 0xd05d
                                                        ; ASCII character giving the low
                                                        ; byte of the address
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd05f

;
; See plot.png
; The plot routine is a multi-purpose tool for drawing graphics. It renders points,
; lines, dotted lines, filled triangles, and single horizontal line fills. It can also just
; move the current graphics cursor position. The lower three bits of the plot type hold plot
; options:
;
; Plot Options:
;   0         Move relative to last point
;   1         Draw relative to last point in foreground colour
;   2         Draw relative to last point in inverse colour
;   3         Draw relative to last point in background colour
;   4         Move absolute
;   5         Draw absolute in foreground colour
;   6         Draw absolute in inverse colour
;   7         Draw absolute in background colour
;
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; PLOT TYPE   RANGE IN BINARY      BITS3-6    DESCRIPTION
; RANGE       abcdefgh-abcdefgh    bcde
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; 0-7         00000000-00000111    0000       Move/Draw line with standard options 0-7
; 8-15        00001000-00001111    0001       As 0-7 but with the last point in a line omitted
;                                             when plotting with GCOL mode 3 (EOR) or 4
;                                             (INVERT)
; 16-23       00010000-00010111    0010       As 0-7 but with a dotted line
; 24-31       00011000-00011111    0011       As 0-7 but with a dotted line and the last point
;                                             in a line omitted when plotting with GCOL mode 3
;                                             (EOR) or 4 (INVERT)
; 32-39       00100000-00100111    0100       RESERVED for future expansion
; 40-47       00101000-00101111    0101       RESERVED for future expansion
; 48-55       00110000-00110111    0110       RESERVED for future expansion
; 56-63       00111000-00111111    0111       RESERVED for future expansion
; 64-71       01000000-01000111    1000       As 0-7 but only a single point is plotted
; 72-79       01001000-01001111    1001       As 0-7 but fill one line horizontally left and
;                                             right
; 80-87       01010000-01010111    1010       As 0-7 but fill a triangle
; 88-95       01011000-01011111    1011       As 0-7 but fill one line horizontally right
; 96-103      01100000-01100111    1100       RESERVED for future expansion
; 104-111     01101000-01101111    1101       RESERVED for future expansion
; 112-119     01110000-01110111    1110       RESERVED for future expansion
; 120-127     01111000-01111111    1111       RESERVED for future expansion
; 128-255     10000000-11111111    xxxx       RESERVED for future expansion
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
;
; Coordinate Systems
;
; The standard graphics coordinate system ranges from (0,0) at the bottom left of the screen
; to (1280 x 1024) at the top right. This coordinate range represents the entire screen
; regardless of the actual number of pixels available on screen.
;
; The graphics window origin can be changed to specify where a pixel drawn at (0,0) actually
; appears on the screen. This is a translation of the coordinate system.
;
; These resolution independent coordinates are called 'external' coordinates in this document.
;
; When calling the OS, external coordinates can optionally be specified 'relative' to the last
; point plotted. Coordinates are also always specified relative to the current graphics window
; origin. When translated into full screen coordinates these are known here as 'absolute'
; coordinates.
;
; Within OS routines absolute coordinates are scaled down to a pixel based scale. These are
; called 'pixel' coordinates. Pixel coordinates are never 'relative' coordinates in the sense
; above, but that doesn't stop OS routines temporarily storing the difference between two
; pixel based coordinates as part of its calculations of course.
;
; Conversions between the coordinate systems are done via:
;
;       .plotConvertExternalAbsoluteCoordinatesToPixels
;       .plotConvertExternalRelativeCoordinatesToPixels
;       .convertPixelGraphicsCoordinatesToExternal
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.vdu25ParameterPlotType = .vduQueueEndByte - 4
.vdu25ParameterXLow     = .vduQueueEndByte - 3
.vdu25ParameterXHigh    = .vduQueueEndByte - 2
.vdu25ParameterYLow     = .vduQueueEndByte - 1
.vdu25ParameterYHigh    = .vduQueueEndByte
.vdu25Plot
    LDX #.vdu25ParameterXLow - .vduVariablesStart       ; X is offset to X Coordinate (low)  $^$ 0xd060
    JSR .plotConvertExternalRelativeCoordinatesToPixels ; translate coordinates  $^$ 0xd062

    LDA .vdu25ParameterPlotType                         ; get plot type  $^$ 0xd065
    CMP #4                                              ; check for plot type four (move absolute)  $^$ 0xd068
    BEQ .plotMoveGraphicsCursorInAbsolutePixels         ; if (plot type is four) then branch (move absolute)  $^$ 0xd06a
    LDY #5                                              ; Y=5  $^$ 0xd06c
    AND #3                                              ; mask only bits 0 and 1  $^$ 0xd06e
    BEQ +                                               ; if (result is 0) then branch (it's a move operation)  $^$ 0xd070
    LSR                                                 ; check bit zero  $^$ 0xd072
    BCS .plotWithGraphicsColour                         ; if (plot option needs foreground or background graphics colour) then branch  $^$ 0xd073
    DEY                                                 ; Y=4 ('inverse' plot option)  $^$ 0xd075
    BNE +                                               ; ALWAYS branch. The logic inverse colour must be wanted  $^$ 0xd076

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Plot with graphics character
;
; On Entry:
;       A=0 it's a foreground colour
;       A=1 it's a background colour
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.plotWithGraphicsColour
    TAX                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd078
    LDY .vduForegroundGCOLMode,X                        ; get foreground or background graphics PLOT mode (into Y)  $^$ 0xd079
    LDA .vduForegroundGraphicsColour,X                  ; }  $^$ 0xd07c
    TAX                                                 ; } get foreground or background graphics colour (into X)  $^$ 0xd07f
+
    JSR .setGraphicsColourMaskXY                        ; set up colour masks in .vduGraphicsColourByteOR/EOR  $^$ 0xd080

    LDA .vdu25ParameterPlotType                         ; get plot type  $^$ 0xd083
    BMI .plotExtensionLocal                             ; if (128-255) then branch (it's RESERVED for future expansion)  $^$ 0xd086

    ; deal with plot 0-127
    ASL                                                 ; bcdefgh0  $^$ 0xd088
    BPL .plotType0to63                                  ; if (bit 7 is now 0, i.e. plot type is 0-63) then branch  $^$ 0xd089

    ; deal with plot 64-127
    AND #%11110000                                      ; bcde0000  $^$ 0xd08b
    ASL                                                 ; cde00000  $^$ 0xd08d
    BEQ .plotPointAndMove                               ; if (zero) then branch (plot type 64-71 was called, single point plot)  $^$ 0xd08e

    ; deal with plot 72-127
    EOR #%01000000                                      ; cDe00000 (inverted bit d)  $^$ 0xd090
    BEQ .plotFillTriangleLocal                          ; if (bit 'D' clear; i.e. bit 'd' set) then branch (plot type 80-87, fill triangle)  $^$ 0xd092

    ; deal with plot 72-79 or 88-127
    PHA                                                 ; push cDe00000  $^$ 0xd094
    JSR .copyPlotParametersToGraphicsCursorPixelPosition ; copy parameters, setting XY in current graphics  $^$ 0xd095
                                                        ; coordinates
    PLA                                                 ; get back cDe00000  $^$ 0xd098
    EOR #%01100000                                      ; cdE00000 (invert bit D back to d, and invert bit e)  $^$ 0xd099
    BEQ .storeAndLateralFillLeftRight                   ; if (cdE00000 == 00000000) (ie.  $^$ 0xd09b
                                                        ; cde == 001) then branch (type
                                                        ; is 72-79, it's a lateral fill
                                                        ; left/right)

    ; deal with plot 88-127
    CMP #%01000000                                      ; if (cdE00000 == 01000000) (ie.  $^$ 0xd09d
                                                        ; cde == 011) then type is 88-95
                                                        ; (it's a lateral fill right)
    BNE .plotExtensionLocal                             ; otherwise branch (RESERVED for  $^$ 0xd09f
                                                        ; future expansion)

    ; deal with plot 88-95
.plotLateralFillRight                                   ;
    LDA #2                                              ; A=2  $^$ 0xd0a1
    STA .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; .vduTempStoreDC = 2  $^$ 0xd0a3
    JMP .lateralFillRight                               ; lateral fill right  $^$ 0xd0a5

; ***************************************************************************************
.plotFillTriangleLocal
    JMP .plotFillTriangle                               ; to fill triangle routine  $^$ 0xd0a8

; ***************************************************************************************
.plotExtensionLocal
    JMP .vduPlotExtension                               ; VDU extension access entry  $^$ 0xd0ab

; ***************************************************************************************
.storeAndLateralFillLeftRight
    STA .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; .vduTempStoreDC = 0  $^$ 0xd0ae
    JMP .lateralFillLeftRight                           ; lateral fill left and right  $^$ 0xd0b0

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Set graphics colour and GCOL mode bytes
;
; When writing graphics pixels to the screen, two bytes are used to adjust the byte to write
; based on the current colour and GCOL mode.
; This routine sets these two bytes .vduGraphicsColourByteOR and .vduGraphicsColourByteEOR
;
; GCOL Mode
; ---------
; 0 = Normal Mode: Sets the pixel to the current colour
; 1 =     OR Mode: Sets the pixel to the current colour  OR-ed with the colour on screen
; 2 =    AND Mode: Sets the pixel to the current colour AND-ed with the colour on screen
; 3 =    EOR Mode: Sets the pixel to the current colour EOR-ed with the colour on screen
; 4 = Invert Mode: Inverts the colour already on screen
;
; Suppose 'C' is the byte that when written to the screen sets each pixel of the byte to
; the current graphics colour.
;
; Then the two bytes are set as follows:
;       ------------------------------------------------------------------------
;       0=Normal Mode  | .vduGraphicsColourByteOR  = (C OR $FF) EOR $00 = $FF
;                      | .vduGraphicsColourByteEOR = (C OR $00) EOR $FF = C EOR $FF
;       ------------------------------------------------------------------------
;       1=OR Mode      | .vduGraphicsColourByteOR  = (C OR $00) EOR $00 = C
;                      | .vduGraphicsColourByteEOR = (C OR $FF) EOR $FF = 0
;       ------------------------------------------------------------------------
;       2=AND Mode     | .vduGraphicsColourByteOR  = (C OR $00) EOR $FF = C EOR $FF
;                      | .vduGraphicsColourByteEOR = (C OR $00) EOR $FF = C EOR $FF
;       ------------------------------------------------------------------------
;       3=EOR Mode     | .vduGraphicsColourByteOR  = (C OR $FF) EOR $FF = 0
;                      | .vduGraphicsColourByteEOR = (C OR $00) EOR $00 = C
;       ------------------------------------------------------------------------
;       4=Invert Mode  | .vduGraphicsColourByteOR  = (C OR $FF) EOR $FF = 0
;                      | .vduGraphicsColourByteEOR = (C OR $FF) EOR $00 = $FF
;       ------------------------------------------------------------------------
;
; When writing a pixel, start with a byte 'B', just the bits required to set one pixel to
; white. Then the pixel is written like so:
;
;            temp = (B AND .vduGraphicsColourByteOR) OR (current screen byte)
; new screen byte = (.vduGraphicsColourByteEOR AND B) EOR temp
;
; [A quirk: This routine is called with Y=5 for a relative move PLOT operation, but as
;           there's nothing to draw, the results are unused in this case.]
;
; On Entry:
;       X = colour byte to set
;       Y = GCOL Mode (0=Normal, 1=OR, 2=AND, 3=EOR, 4=Invert)
;
; On Exit:
;       .vduGraphicsColourByteOR / EOR hold the appropriate mask values
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.setGraphicsColourMaskXY
    TXA                                                 ; A=X  $^$ 0xd0b3
    ORA .gcolPlotOptionsTable,Y                         ; OR with GCOL plot options table byte  $^$ 0xd0b4
    EOR .gcolPlotOptionsTable + 1,Y                     ; EOR with following byte  $^$ 0xd0b7
    STA .vduGraphicsColourByteOR                        ; and store it  $^$ 0xd0ba
    TXA                                                 ; A=X  $^$ 0xd0bc
    ORA .gcolPlotOptionsTable - 1,Y                     ;  $^$ 0xd0bd
    EOR .gcolPlotOptionsTable + 4,Y                     ;  $^$ 0xd0c0
    STA .vduGraphicsColourByteEOR                       ; masks are stored in .vduGraphicsColourByteOR/EOR  $^$ 0xd0c3
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd0c5

; ***************************************************************************************
; Continue processing of a PLOT command, where the plot type is in the range 0-63
.plotType0to63
    ASL                                                 ; cdefgh00  $^$ 0xd0c6
    BMI .plotExtensionLocal                             ; if (options are in range 32-63) then branch (not implemented)  $^$ 0xd0c7
    ASL                                                 ; defgh000  $^$ 0xd0c9
    ASL                                                 ; efgh0000  $^$ 0xd0ca
    BPL +                                               ; if (still +ve; type is 0-7 or 16-23) then branch (skips plot point)  $^$ 0xd0cb

    JSR .plotPoint                                      ; type is 8-15 or 24-31. We want to  $^$ 0xd0cd
                                                        ; omit the last point when drawing
                                                        ; in invert mode, so we do this by
                                                        ; displaying a point, which will get
                                                        ; inverted (erased) again in the
                                                        ; normal course of drawing the line.
+
    JSR .plotLine                                       ; draw a line or dotted line  $^$ 0xd0d0
    JMP .plotMoveGraphicsCursorInAbsolutePixels         ; move the graphics cursor  $^$ 0xd0d3

; ***************************************************************************************
; Plot a single point and move the graphics cursor position
.plotPointAndMove
    JSR .plotPoint                                      ; display a point  $^$ 0xd0d6
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
; Move the current graphics cursor position, to new absolute pixel coordinates given by
; the vdu25Parameters.
.plotMoveGraphicsCursorInAbsolutePixels
    JSR .exchangeGraphicsCursorWithOldPosition          ; swap current and last graphics  $^$ 0xd0d9
                                                        ; position. The current position
                                                        ; becomes the previous position.
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.copyPlotParametersToGraphicsCursorPixelPosition
    LDY #.vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXLow - .vduVariablesStart ; destination is the graphics cursor position in pixels  $^$ 0xd0dc
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.copyParameterPointToDestinationY
    LDX #.vdu25ParameterXLow - .vduVariablesStart       ; source is the position coordinate on the VDU queue  $^$ 0xd0de
    JMP .copyFourBytesWithinVDUVariables                ; copy four bytes  $^$ 0xd0e0

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Plot one pixel of a character
;
; See Characters.png
; When drawing a character at the graphics cursor, this draws an individual pixel
; of that character. It uses the current graphics cursor position as the position to plot.
;
; Each pixel is tested to see if it's within the bounds of the current graphics window,
; so characters can be partially drawn.
; ***************************************************************************************
.plotAPixelInACharacter
    LDX #.vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXLow - .vduVariablesStart  ;  $^$ 0xd0e3
    JSR .checkPointXInBoundsAndSetScreenAddresses       ; calculate position  $^$ 0xd0e5
    BEQ .plotPointWithinBounds                          ; if (within bounds) then branch  $^$ 0xd0e8
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd0ea

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Plots a single point
;
; This checks the point against the graphics window, gets the screen address details, then
; renders the pixel by writing to the screen address, applying the colour masks and plot type.
;
; On Entry:
;       X holds the offset into the VDU variables for four bytes holding the position to plot
;       at.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.plotPoint
    JSR .checkParameterInBoundsAndSetScreenAddresses    ; check in bounds and set up screen addresses  $^$ 0xd0eb
    BNE +                                               ; if (A is not zero) then branch (return)  $^$ 0xd0ee
.plotPointWithinBounds
    LDY .vduGraphicsCursorVerticalOffsetInCell          ; get current graphics scan line  $^$ 0xd0f0
.plotPointWithinBoundsAtY
    LDA .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ;  $^$ 0xd0f3
    AND .vduGraphicsColourByteOR                        ;  $^$ 0xd0f5
    ORA (.vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow),Y    ;  $^$ 0xd0f7
    STA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ;  $^$ 0xd0f9
    LDA .vduGraphicsColourByteEOR                       ;  $^$ 0xd0fb
    AND .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ;  $^$ 0xd0fd
    EOR .vduTempStoreDA                                 ;  $^$ 0xd0ff
    STA (.vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow),Y    ; put it back again  $^$ 0xd101
+
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd103

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Plots a filled whole byte (as part of a lateral fill)
;
; On Entry:
;       Y is the vertical offset within a character cell (0-7)
; ***************************************************************************************
.plotByte
    LDA (.vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow),Y    ;  $^$ 0xd104
    ORA .vduGraphicsColourByteOR                        ;  $^$ 0xd106
    EOR .vduGraphicsColourByteEOR                       ;  $^$ 0xd108
    STA (.vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow),Y    ;  $^$ 0xd10a
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd10c


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Check that the graphics cursor is within the graphics window
;
; On Exit:
;   .vduTempStoreDA is zero if the point is within the graphics window, or the four low bits
;                indicate which regions failed:
;
;       %0000   success (point is within window)
;       %0001   graphics cursor X is left of  the left   edge of the graphics window
;       %0010   graphics cursor X is right of the right  edge of the graphics window
;       %0100   graphics cursor Y is below    the bottom edge of the graphics window
;       %1000   graphics cursor Y is above    the top    edge of the graphics window
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.checkGraphicsCursorIsWithinGraphicsWindow
    LDX #.vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXLow - .vduVariablesStart ; X is the offset to check the graphics cursor  $^$ 0xd10d
.checkPointXIsWithinGraphicsWindow
    LDY #0                                              ;  $^$ 0xd10f
    STY .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; .vduTempStoreDA is initialised to zero (stores the error code)  $^$ 0xd111
    LDY #2                                              ; Y is the index to check the vertical bounds of the graphics window  $^$ 0xd113
    JSR .checkPointIsWithinWindowHorizontalOrVertical   ; check graphics cursor is within window vertically  $^$ 0xd115
    ASL .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; } Shift up error results two bits to make room for the next horizontal test results  $^$ 0xd118
    ASL .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd11a
    DEX                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd11c
    DEX                                                 ; reduce index by two to check the X position  $^$ 0xd11d
    LDY #0                                              ; Y is the index to check the horizontal bounds of the graphics window  $^$ 0xd11e
    JSR .checkPointIsWithinWindowHorizontalOrVertical   ; check graphics cursor is within window horizontally  $^$ 0xd120
    INX                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd123
    INX                                                 ; } Restore X to initial value  $^$ 0xd124
    LDA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; A = error code (0,1,2,4,5,6,8,9,10) depending on which bounds are exceeded  $^$ 0xd125
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd127


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Check coordinate of a point is in the window bounds (horizontal or vertical)
;
; On Entry:
;       X is the offset to the coordinate to check minus two bytes
;       Y is the offset to the second variable to check (0 for horizontal or 2 for vertical)
; On Exit:
;       .vduTempStoreDA is the error code (0 = no error, 1 = first check failed, 2 = second check
;       failed)
;       Zero flag set if no error
; ***************************************************************************************
.checkPointIsWithinWindowHorizontalOrVertical
    LDA .vduVariablesStart + 2,X                        ; } Subtract two sixteen bit variables, compare the results.  $^$ 0xd128
    CMP .vduVariablesStart + 0,Y                        ; } if var[X+2,X+3] < var[Y,Y+1] then error  $^$ 0xd12b
    LDA .vduVariablesStart + 3,X                        ; }  $^$ 0xd12e
    SBC .vduVariablesStart + 1,Y                        ; }  $^$ 0xd131
    BMI .oneError                                       ; branch if error  $^$ 0xd134

    LDA .vduVariablesStart + 4,Y                        ; } Subtract two sixteen bit variables, compare the results.  $^$ 0xd136
    CMP .vduVariablesStart + 2,X                        ; } if var[Y+4,Y+5] < var[X+2,X+3] then error  $^$ 0xd139
    LDA .vduVariablesStart + 5,Y                        ; }  $^$ 0xd13c
    SBC .vduVariablesStart + 3,X                        ; }  $^$ 0xd13f
    BPL +                                               ; if (no violation) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xd142
    INC .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; increment error code  $^$ 0xd144
.oneError
    INC .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; increment error code  $^$ 0xd146
+
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd148


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Convert external absolute coordinates to pixels
;
; Convert external, absolute coordinates to pixels (horizontal and vertical)
;
; On Entry:
;       X is the offset in vdu variables to the coordinate to convert
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.plotConvertExternalAbsoluteCoordinatesToPixels
    LDA #$FF                                            ; A=$FF to ensure absolute coordinates  $^$ 0xd149
    BNE +                                               ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xd14b


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Convert external relative coordinates to pixels
;
; Convert pair of external coordinates to pixels (horizontal and vertical)
;
; On Entry:
;       X is the offset in vdu variables to the coordinate to convert
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.plotConvertExternalRelativeCoordinatesToPixels
    LDA .vdu25ParameterPlotType                                     ; get first parameter in plot  $^$ 0xd14d
+
    STA .vduTempStoreDA                                             ; store in .vduTempStoreDA  $^$ 0xd150
    LDY #2                                                          ; Y=2 (for vertical  $^$ 0xd152
                                                                    ; coordinate)
    JSR .convertExternalRelativeCoordinateToAbsoluteAndDivideByTwo  ; convert  $^$ 0xd154
    JSR .signedDivideCoordinateByTwo                                ; divide by 2 again to  $^$ 0xd157
                                                                    ; convert 1023 to 0-255
                                                                    ; for pixels
    LDY #0                                                          ; Y=0 (for horizontal  $^$ 0xd15a
                                                                    ; coordinate)
    DEX                                                             ;  $^$ 0xd15c
    DEX                                                             ; X-=2  $^$ 0xd15d
    JSR .convertExternalRelativeCoordinateToAbsoluteAndDivideByTwo  ; convert  $^$ 0xd15e

    LDY .vduPixelsPerByteMinusOne                       ; get number of pixels per byte (-1)  $^$ 0xd161
                                                        ;     7 for MODE 0
                                                        ;     3 for MODE 1
                                                        ;     1 for MODE 2
                                                        ;     0 for MODE 3
                                                        ;     7 for MODE 4
                                                        ;     3 for MODE 5
                                                        ;     0 for MODE 6
                                                        ;     0 for MODE 7

    CPY #3                                              ;  $^$ 0xd164
    BEQ +                                               ; if (MODE 1 or 5) then branch (divide by 2)  $^$ 0xd166
    BCS .doneDividing                                   ; if (MODE 0 or 4) then branch (no division needed)  $^$ 0xd168
    JSR .signedDivideCoordinateByTwo                    ; if (MODE 2,3,6 or 7) then divide by 4  $^$ 0xd16a
                                                        ;                   (divide by two twice)
+
    JSR .signedDivideCoordinateByTwo                    ; divide by 2  $^$ 0xd16d
.doneDividing
    LDA .vduCurrentScreenMODEGroup                      ; MODE group  $^$ 0xd170
    BNE .signedDivideCoordinateByTwo                    ; if (MODEs 3-7) then branch (divide by 2 again)  $^$ 0xd173
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd175

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Converts the vdu queue parameter to absolute coordinates and divides by two
;
; On Entry:
;       X               is the offset to the vdu queue parameter coordinate to convert
;       Y               is 0 or 2 for the horizontal or vertical cursor coordinates
;       .vduTempStoreDA is the plot type (to check for relative coordinate conversion)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.convertExternalRelativeCoordinateToAbsoluteAndDivideByTwo
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xd176
    LDA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; get .vduTempStoreDA  $^$ 0xd177
    AND #4                                              ; }  $^$ 0xd179
    BEQ .addPreviousCoordinate                          ; } if (relative coordinates) then branch (add previous coordinate)  $^$ 0xd17b
    LDA .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsBottomLow,X             ; get coordinate  $^$ 0xd17d
    PHA                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd180
    LDA .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsBottomHigh,X            ;  $^$ 0xd181
    BCC .addGraphicsOrigin                              ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xd184

.addPreviousCoordinate
    LDA .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsBottomLow,X             ; get coordinate  $^$ 0xd186
    ADC .vduGraphicsCursorPositionXLow,Y                ; add cursor position  $^$ 0xd189
    PHA                                                 ; save it  $^$ 0xd18c
    LDA .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsBottomHigh,X            ;  $^$ 0xd18d
    ADC .vduGraphicsCursorPositionXHigh,Y               ; add cursor  $^$ 0xd190
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xd193

.addGraphicsOrigin
    STA .vduGraphicsCursorPositionXHigh,Y               ; save new cursor  $^$ 0xd194
    ADC .vduGraphicsWindowOriginXHigh,Y                 ; add graphics origin  $^$ 0xd197
    STA .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsBottomHigh,X            ; store it  $^$ 0xd19a
    PLA                                                 ; get back low byte  $^$ 0xd19d
    STA .vduGraphicsCursorPositionXLow,Y                ; save it in new cursor low  $^$ 0xd19e
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xd1a1
    ADC .vduGraphicsWindowOriginXLow,Y                  ; add to graphics orgin  $^$ 0xd1a2
    STA .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsBottomLow,X             ; store it  $^$ 0xd1a5
    BCC .signedDivideCoordinateByTwo                    ; if (carry clear) then branch (skip over next statement)  $^$ 0xd1a8
    INC .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsBottomHigh,X            ; increment high byte  $^$ 0xd1aa
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Divides the signed 16 bit coordinate value by two
;
; On Entry:
;       X is the offset to the coordinate from .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsBottomLow
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.signedDivideCoordinateByTwo
    LDA .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsBottomHigh,X            ; get high byte  $^$ 0xd1ad
    ASL                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd1b0
    ROR .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsBottomHigh,X            ; divide by 2  $^$ 0xd1b1
    ROR .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsBottomLow,X             ;  $^$ 0xd1b4
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd1b7

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Convert pixel coordinates to external absolute coordinates
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.convertPixelGraphicsCoordinatesToExternal
    LDY #.vduGraphicsCursorPositionXLow - .vduVariablesStart ; destination: graphics cursor in external coordinates  $^$ 0xd1b8
    JSR .copyGraphicsCursorPixelPosition                ; source is graphics cursor in pixel coordinates.  $^$ 0xd1ba
                                                        ; copy pixel coordinates to external coordinates.
    LDX #2                                              ; X=2 (offset to update the vertical coordinate)  $^$ 0xd1bd
    LDY #2                                              ; Y=2 (shift twice to multiply by four)  $^$ 0xd1bf
    JSR +                                               ; multiply .vduGraphicsCursorPositionY by 4 and subtract graphics origin  $^$ 0xd1c1
                                                        ; this is the external Y coordinate.
    LDX #0                                              ; X=0 (offset to update the horizontal coordinate)  $^$ 0xd1c4
    LDY #4                                              ; Y=4  $^$ 0xd1c6
    LDA .vduPixelsPerByteMinusOne                       ; get number of pixels/byte  $^$ 0xd1c8
-
    DEY                                                 ; Y=Y-1  $^$ 0xd1cb
    LSR                                                 ; divide by 2  $^$ 0xd1cc
    BNE -                                               ; if (result not 0) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xd1cd

    ; Pixels                                     Number of
    ; per byte   Screen     Y       MODE       multiplication
    ; minus one   MODE     Now      group      steps (#shifts)
    ; --------------------------------------------------------
    ;    7       MODE 0     1         0              1  (x1)
    ;    3       MODE 1     2         0              2  (x2)
    ;    1       MODE 2     3         0              3  (x4)
    ;    0       MODE 3     -         1              -
    ;    7       MODE 4     1         2              2  (x2)
    ;    3       MODE 5     2         2              3  (x4)
    ;    0       MODE 6     -         3              -
    ;    0       MODE 7     -         4              -
    ; --------------------------------------------------------

    LDA .vduCurrentScreenMODEGroup                      ; MODE group  $^$ 0xd1cf
    BEQ +                                               ; if (zero) then branch  $^$ 0xd1d2
    INY                                                 ; Y holds the number of multiplication steps (1, 2 or 3)  $^$ 0xd1d4
+
-
    ASL .vduGraphicsCursorPositionXLow,X                ; } multiply coordinate by 2  $^$ 0xd1d5
    ROL .vduGraphicsCursorPositionXHigh,X               ; }  $^$ 0xd1d8
    DEY                                                 ; Y-Y-1  $^$ 0xd1db
    BNE -                                               ; if (Y != 0) then branch (do it again)  $^$ 0xd1dc

    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xd1de
    JSR +                                               ; do one coordinate  $^$ 0xd1df
    INX                                                 ; increment X  $^$ 0xd1e2
+
    LDA .vduGraphicsCursorPositionXLow,X                ; get current graphics position in external coordinates  $^$ 0xd1e3
    SBC .vduGraphicsWindowOriginXLow,X                  ; subtract origin  $^$ 0xd1e6
    STA .vduGraphicsCursorPositionXLow,X                ; store in graphics cursor position  $^$ 0xd1e9
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd1ec


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Plot a line or a dotted line
;
; Bresenham's line drawing algorithm is used.
; See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bresenham%27s_line_algorithm
;
; In the enclosed BASIC program, we sketch out the ideas behind the assembly that follows.
; The code plots a bunch of random lines on the screen using standard OS line drawing, then
; undraws the same set of lines using a BASIC routine that mimics the OS code. The process
; is slow (it's written in unoptimised BASIC) but it unplots the exact same pixels
; as the OS routine. See lines.ssd.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.plotLine
    JSR .plotLineInitialiseDeltaValues                  ;  $^$ 0xd1ed

; Now we have set the delta values:
;
;   Set .vduPlotLineDeltaX = graphics cursorX - parameterX  (lets call this dX)
;   Set .vduPlotLineDeltaY = graphics cursorY - parameterY  (lets call this dY)
;
; At this point, the values in .vduPlotLineDeltaX/Y are the delta in pixels for the line.
; The values are 16 bit signed integers. Positive values are to the left and down on screen,
; like so:
;
;                                         |
;                                         |
;                                         |
;                       dX /______________|_____________
;                          \           ###|<-(current graphics
;                                   ###   |   cursor position)
;                                ###      |
;                             ###         |
;        (new parameter -> ###           \|/
;           coordinates)                 dY
;
;
; Now calculate the dominant axis, i.e. which of dx and dy has the largest magnitude.

    LDA .vduPlotLineDeltaYHigh                          ;  $^$ 0xd1f0
    EOR .vduPlotLineDeltaXHigh                          ; check high bytes for different sign bit in dX/dY  $^$ 0xd1f3
    BMI .sectionB                                       ; if (result -ve; then deltas are different in sign) then branch later  $^$ 0xd1f6

; -------------SECTION A-------------
; dX and dY have the same sign
    LDA .vduPlotLineDeltaYLow                           ; }  $^$ 0xd1f8
    CMP .vduPlotLineDeltaXLow                           ; } if (dY >= dX) then A = dY - dX  $^$ 0xd1fb
    LDA .vduPlotLineDeltaYHigh                          ; }               else A = dY - dX - 1  $^$ 0xd1fe
    SBC .vduPlotLineDeltaXHigh                          ; }  $^$ 0xd201
                                                        ; } Result: A is positive if dY > dX, A is negative if dY < dX, otherwise A = 0.
                                                        ; }    i.e. A is SIGN(dY - dX), C = carry of difference (^)
; ----------SECTION A ENDS-----------
    JMP .plotLineGotDeltas                              ;  $^$ 0xd204

.sectionB
; -------------SECTION B-------------
; dX and dY have different signs
    LDA .vduPlotLineDeltaXLow                           ; } A = (dX + dY) (high byte)  $^$ 0xd207
    CLC                                                 ; } (where deltas are different in sign, so really a subtraction)  $^$ 0xd20a
    ADC .vduPlotLineDeltaYLow                           ; }  $^$ 0xd20b
    LDA .vduPlotLineDeltaXHigh                          ; } Result: A is positive if (dX > -dY), A is negative if dX < -dY, otherwise A = 0  $^$ 0xd20e
    ADC .vduPlotLineDeltaYHigh                          ; }    i.e. A is SIGN(dX - dY), C = carry of difference  $^$ 0xd211
; ----------SECTION B ENDS-----------


; Table of examples (Part 1)
;         A=   B=  C=  D=           --------SECTION A---------- ----------SECTION B----------
;         dX   dX  dY  dY   signs   Carry= Result                Carry=   Result
;  dX dY  Low  Hi Low  Hi  differ?  (C>=A) D-B-(1-Carry)       (A+C)>255  (B+D+Carry)
; -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
;  3   1  $03 $00 $01 $00     no      0    $FF (Result Carry=0)     -     -
;  1   3  $01 $00 $03 $00     no      1    $00 (Result Carry=1)     -     -
; -3   1  $FD $FF $01 $00     yes     -     -                       0     $FF (Result Carry=0)
; -1   3  $FF $FF $03 $00     yes     -     -                       1     $00 (Result Carry=1)
;  3  -1  $03 $00 $FF $FF     yes     -     -                       1     $00 (Result Carry=1)
;  1  -3  $01 $00 $FD $FF     yes     -     -                       0     $FF (Result Carry=0)
; -3  -1  $FD $FF $FF $FF     no      1    $00 (Result Carry=1)     -     -
; -1  -3  $FF $FF $FD $FF     no      0    $FF (Result Carry=0)     -     -
; --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

.plotLineGotDeltas
    ; based on the calculations just done, we work out the dominant axis, X=0 for the X-axis
    ; being dominant (dX being at least as large in magnitude as dY), X=2 for the Y-axis
    ; (dY being larger).
    ROR                                                 ; make top bit of A = 'result carry'  $^$ 0xd214
                                                        ; from above
    LDX #0                                              ; X = 0  $^$ 0xd215
    EOR .vduPlotLineDeltaYHigh                          ; check if carry from result above has  $^$ 0xd217
                                                        ; same sign as workspaceD
    BPL +                                               ; if (dY has same sign as A) then branch (with X=0)  $^$ 0xd21a
    LDX #2                                              ; X=2  $^$ 0xd21c
+
    STX .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; store X: 0 means dx is the  $^$ 0xd21e
                                                        ; dominant axis, at least as large
                                                        ; in magnitude as dy; 2 means dy is
                                                        ; dominant

    LDA .vduPlotLineRoutineAddresses,X                  ; } set up the address of one of two  $^$ 0xd220
    STA .vduJumpVectorLow                               ; } line drawing routines into  $^$ 0xd223
    LDA .vduPlotLineRoutineAddresses+1,X                ; } .vduJumpVectorLow/High (based on  $^$ 0xd226
    STA .vduJumpVectorHigh                              ; } X=0 or 2)  $^$ 0xd229

    LDA .vduPlotLineDeltaXHigh,X                        ; choose which side of the line  $^$ 0xd22c
                                                        ; dY = -dX to draw on. (values $00
                                                        ; or $FF)

; Table of examples (Part 2)
;            carry flag
;  dX dY   EOR top bit of D   .vduTempStoreDE  .vduPlotLineDeltaXHigh,X
; -------------------------------------------------------------
;  3   1    0 EOR 0 = 0       0                $00
;  1   3    1 EOR 0 = 1       2 (Y dominant)   $00
; -3   1    0 EOR 0 = 0       0                $FF (dy < -dx)
; -1   3    1 EOR 0 = 1       2 (Y dominant)   $00
;  3  -1    1 EOR 1 = 0       0                $00
;  1  -3    0 EOR 1 = 1       2 (Y dominant)   $FF (dy < -dx)
; -3  -1    1 EOR 1 = 0       0                $FF (dy < -dx)
; -1  -3    0 EOR 1 = 1       2 (Y dominant)   $FF (dy < -dx)
; -------------------------------------------------------------

    BPL +                                                   ; if (dY >=-dX) then branch  (start drawing from the new parameter position)  $^$ 0xd22f
    LDX #.vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXLow - .vduVariablesStart  ; source: current graphics cursor    (start drawing from current cursor position)  $^$ 0xd231
    BNE .parametersSet                                      ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xd233

+
    LDX #.vdu25ParameterXLow - .vduVariablesStart       ; source: vdu queue parameters (start drawing from new cursor position)  $^$ 0xd235
.parametersSet
    ;
    ; The line's start point is the point furthest left (when X is the dominant axis) or
    ; nearest the bottom (when Y is the dominant axis). The X register now holds the offset
    ; to the vdu variable for the start point of the line.
    ;
    STX .vduTempStoreDF                                 ; source: (offset to vdu variable for the start point, store in .vduTempStoreDF)  $^$ 0xd237
    LDY #.vduPlotLineCurrentPointXLow - .vduVariablesStart ; destination: current point  $^$ 0xd239
    JSR .copyFourBytesWithinVDUVariables                ; copy the start point to the current point  $^$ 0xd23b

    LDA .vduTempStoreDF                                 ; get offset to vdu variable for the start point  $^$ 0xd23e
    EOR #4                                              ; switch X to point at whichever of (vdu queue parameters / current graphics cursor) wasn't chosen before,  $^$ 0xd240
                                                        ; i.e. the end of the line to draw
    STA .vduTempStoreDD                                 ; .vduTempStoreDD = offset to vdu variable for the end of the line  $^$ 0xd242
    ORA .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; OR with 0 or 2 (if Y is the dominant axis we offset by 2 to copy the Y coordinate of the end point;  $^$ 0xd244
                                                        ; otherwise copy the X coordinate). We will use this later to check for termination on plotting the line.
    TAX                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd246
    JSR .copyTwoBytesWithinVDUVariablesToPlotLineTerminationValue ; copy final coordinate to  $^$ 0xd247
                                                        ; termination value. We use this later
                                                        ; to check for termination on plotting
                                                        ; the line.

    LDA .vdu25ParameterPlotType                         ; get plot type  $^$ 0xd24a
    AND #%00010000                                      ; check bit 4 (dotted line)  $^$ 0xd24d
    ASL                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd24f
    ASL                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd250
    ASL                                                 ; move to bit 7  $^$ 0xd251
    STA .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; store whether we want a dotted line ($80) or not ($00)  $^$ 0xd252

    LDX #.vduPlotLineCurrentPointXLow - .vduVariablesStart ;  $^$ 0xd254
    JSR .checkPointXIsWithinGraphicsWindow              ; check if current point is out of bounds  $^$ 0xd256
    STA .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; store error code (which directions we are out of bounds)  $^$ 0xd259
    BEQ +                                               ; if (none) then branch  $^$ 0xd25b
    LDA #%01000000                                      ; }  $^$ 0xd25d
    ORA .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; } Set bit 6 of .vduTempStoreDB to indicate out of bounds  $^$ 0xd25f
    STA .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; } (Bit 7 is still set for a dotted line.)  $^$ 0xd261
+
    LDX .vduTempStoreDD                                 ;  $^$ 0xd263
    JSR .checkPointXIsWithinGraphicsWindow              ; check other end of line for out of bounds  $^$ 0xd265
    BIT .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; BIT test (AND) together the bits of the two out of bounds calculations  $^$ 0xd268
                                                        ; this checks if the two ends of the line are out of bounds in the same direction
                                                        ; (e.g. both to the right of the right edge)
    BEQ .worthPlottingLine                              ; if (result is zero) then branch  $^$ 0xd26a
    RTS                                                 ; the line is all off screen, so return  $^$ 0xd26c

.worthPlottingLine

    ; now we work out if the end point of the line is beyond the graphics window boundary.
    ; if so then we set the termination value to the edge of the graphics window.
    LDX .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; .vduTempStoreDE holds the dominant axis value (0 or 2)  $^$ 0xd26d
    BEQ +                                               ; if (X=0) then branch (skip the next bit. Bits 0 and 1 of A are the error code results for the X axis)  $^$ 0xd26f
    LSR                                                 ; } here the Y axis is dominant.  $^$ 0xd271
    LSR                                                 ; } shift the error code down twice so that the 'out of bounds' results for the Y axis are in bits 0 and 1  $^$ 0xd272
+
    AND #2                                              ; clear all but bit 1  $^$ 0xd273
                                                        ; NOTE: bit 1 is set if the end point is either:
                                                        ;                 to the right of the graphics window (when X axis is dominant)
                                                        ;             or above the top of the graphics window (when Y axis is dominant)
    BEQ +                                               ; if (bit 2 clear) then branch (end point is ok, NOT off to the right/above the graphics window)  $^$ 0xd275
    TXA                                                 ; } The end point is beyond the right or top of the graphics window, so we set  $^$ 0xd277
    ORA #4                                              ; } the termination variable (.vduPlotLineTerminationValue) to the edge of the screen.  $^$ 0xd278
                                                        ; } Set bit 3 of X
    TAX                                                 ; } (now X is the offset to  $^$ 0xd27a
                                                        ; } .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsRightLow
                                                        ; } or .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsTopLow)
    JSR .copyTwoBytesWithinVDUVariablesToPlotLineTerminationValue ; copy final X or Y coordinate to the termination value  $^$ 0xd27b
+
    JSR .plotLineInitializeVariables                    ; initialise variables (error term and absolute coordinates)  $^$ 0xd27e

    ; work out which of four plot routines we want to use (calculate X = 0 to 3)
    LDA .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; get the dominant axis (0 or 2)  $^$ 0xd281
    EOR #2                                              ; EOR it with 2 to get the non-dominant axis (2 or 0)  $^$ 0xd283
    TAX                                                 ; X=A  $^$ 0xd285
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A  $^$ 0xd286
    LDA .vduPlotLineDeltaXHigh                          ; } compare high bytes of dX and dY  $^$ 0xd287
    EOR .vduPlotLineDeltaYHigh                          ; }  $^$ 0xd28a
    BPL +                                               ; if (signs are the same) then branch  $^$ 0xd28d
    INX                                                 ; X=X+1 (X is 3 or 1)  $^$ 0xd28f
+

    ; remember the address of which routine to call
    LDA .vduRoutineBranchVectorAddressesLow,X           ; get address and store at .vduPlotLineRoutineLow/High  $^$ 0xd290
    STA .vduPlotLineRoutineLow                          ; routine 0 is for a dominant Y axis, and same signs of dX/dY       (.plotLineDominantYAxisSameSign)  $^$ 0xd293
    LDA .vduRoutineBranchVectorAddressesHigh,X          ; routine 1 is for a dominant Y axis, and different signs of dX/dY  (.plotLineDominantYAxisDifferentSign)  $^$ 0xd296
    STA .vduPlotLineRoutineHigh                         ; routine 2 is for a dominant X axis, and same signs of dX/dY       (.plotLineDominantXAxisSameSign)  $^$ 0xd299
                                                        ; routine 3 is for a dominant X axis, and different signs of dX/dY  (.plotLineDominantXAxisDifferentSign)

    LDA #127                                            ; } set dotted line flag.  $^$ 0xd29c
    STA .vduPlotLinePlotDottedPixelFlag                 ; } 127 = draw a dot; 128 is skip.  $^$ 0xd29e
    BIT .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; check bit 6 to see if current point is out of bounds  $^$ 0xd2a1
    BVS .currentPointIsOutOfBounds                      ; if (out of bounds) then branch  $^$ 0xd2a3

    ; get absolute distance to the graphics window edge
    LDA .vduGraphicsWindowBoundariesTable,X             ; get offset to graphics window boundary  $^$ 0xd2a5
    TAX                                                 ; X=offset to VDU variable for edge  $^$ 0xd2a8
                                                        ; of graphics window

    SEC                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd2a9
    LDA .vduVariablesStart + 0,X                        ; }  $^$ 0xd2aa
    SBC .vduPlotLineCurrentPointXLow,Y                  ; } Y = non-dominant axis  $^$ 0xd2ad
    STA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; } get distance to edge:  $^$ 0xd2b0
    LDA .vduVariablesStart + 1,X                        ; } graphics window boundary - current point  $^$ 0xd2b2
    SBC .vduPlotLineCurrentPointXHigh,Y                 ; }  $^$ 0xd2b5
    LDY .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd2b8
    TAX                                                 ; } XY = distance to window edge  $^$ 0xd2ba

    BPL +                                               ; if(distance is positive) then branch  $^$ 0xd2bb
    JSR .negateAY                                       ; negate AY: Make sure distance to edge  $^$ 0xd2bd
                                                        ; is positive (note A=X from above)
+
    TAX                                                 ; } XY = ABS(distance to window edge)  $^$ 0xd2c0

    ; add one to distance in XY
    INY                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd2c1
    BNE +                                               ; } Increment XY  $^$ 0xd2c2
    INX                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd2c4
+                                                       ; }
    TXA                                                 ; A = high byte  $^$ 0xd2c5

    BEQ +                                               ; if (A=0) then branch (not out of bounds)  $^$ 0xd2c6
    LDY #0                                              ; Y=0  $^$ 0xd2c8
+
    STY .vduTempStoreDF                                 ; .vduTempStoreDF = low byte of distance,  $^$ 0xd2ca
                                                        ; or zero if high byte is non-zero.
                                                        ; In other words: if this value is
                                                        ; one, then it's the last pixel.
    BEQ +                                               ; ALWAYs branch  $^$ 0xd2cc

.currentPointIsOutOfBounds
    TXA                                                 ; A = X (quadrant 0-3)  $^$ 0xd2ce
    LSR                                                 ; carry = signs differ  $^$ 0xd2cf
    ROR                                                 ; $80 = signs differ, $00 otherwise  $^$ 0xd2d0
    ORA #2                                              ; set bit one  $^$ 0xd2d1
    EOR .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; flip bit one of .vduTempStoreDE (dominant axis)  $^$ 0xd2d3
                                                        ; and flip bit 7 if signs differ
    STA .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; and store  $^$ 0xd2d5

    ; Now .vduTempStoreDE stores:
    ;
    ;   bit 7 = set if signs differ
    ;   bit 1 = set if X axis dominant
    ;
    ; this is used later in .plotLineContinuesOutOfBounds

+
    LDX #.vduPlotLineCurrentPointXLow - .vduVariablesStart  ; } set screen address variables  $^$ 0xd2d7
    JSR .setScreenAddress                                   ; } based on current point  $^$ 0xd2d9

    LDX .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd2dc
    BNE +                                               ; }  $^$ 0xd2de
    DEC .vduTempStoreDD                                 ; } Decrement DC/DD  $^$ 0xd2e0
+                                                       ; }
    DEX                                                 ; } (we will store X later)  $^$ 0xd2e2

.plotLineLoop
    LDA .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; bit 7 set if dotted line; bit 6 set if out of bounds  $^$ 0xd2e3
    BEQ .writePointToScreen                             ; if (solid line in bounds) then branch (write to screen)  $^$ 0xd2e5
    BPL .plotLineCheckNowInBounds                       ; if (solid line, but not in bounds) then branch  $^$ 0xd2e7

    ; deal with dotted line
    BIT .vduPlotLinePlotDottedPixelFlag                 ; check top bit: 127 for a dot; 128 for a gap  $^$ 0xd2e9
    BPL +                                               ; if (dot should be drawn) then branch  $^$ 0xd2ec
    DEC .vduPlotLinePlotDottedPixelFlag                 ; decrement to 127  $^$ 0xd2ee
    BNE .postWritePointToScreen                         ; ALWAYs branch  $^$ 0xd2f1

+
    INC .vduPlotLinePlotDottedPixelFlag                 ; increment to 128  $^$ 0xd2f3
    ASL                                                 ; push bit 6 (out of bounds flag) into bit 7  $^$ 0xd2f6
    BPL .writePointToScreen                             ; if (not out of bounds) then branch  $^$ 0xd2f7

.plotLineCheckNowInBounds
    STX .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; store/remember X  $^$ 0xd2f9
    LDX #.vduPlotLineCurrentPointXLow - .vduVariablesStart  ;  $^$ 0xd2fb
    JSR .checkPointXInBoundsAndSetScreenAddresses       ; check in bounds (and if so calculate screen addresses)  $^$ 0xd2fd
    LDX .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; recall X  $^$ 0xd300

    ORA #0                                              ; recall flags for A  $^$ 0xd302
    BNE .postWritePointToScreen                         ; if (not in bounds) then branch  $^$ 0xd304

    ; At last, we get to actually draw a point
.writePointToScreen
    LDA .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ; byte mask for current graphics point  $^$ 0xd306
    AND .vduGraphicsColourByteOR                        ; and with graphics colour OR byte  $^$ 0xd308
    ORA (.vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow),Y    ; or  with curent graphics cell line  $^$ 0xd30a
    STA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; store result  $^$ 0xd30c
    LDA .vduGraphicsColourByteEOR                       ; same again with colour EOR byte  $^$ 0xd30e
    AND .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ;  $^$ 0xd310
    EOR .vduTempStoreDA                                 ;  $^$ 0xd312
    STA (.vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow),Y    ; then store it in current graphics row  $^$ 0xd314

.postWritePointToScreen
    SEC                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd316
    LDA .vduPlotLineErrorTermLow                        ; }  $^$ 0xd317
    SBC .vduPlotLineAbsNonDominantAxisDeltaLow          ; }  $^$ 0xd31a
    STA .vduPlotLineErrorTermLow                        ; } error_term = error_term - non-dominant axis delta  $^$ 0xd31d
    LDA .vduPlotLineErrorTermHigh                       ; }  $^$ 0xd320
    SBC .vduPlotLineAbsNonDominantAxisDeltaHigh         ; }  $^$ 0xd323

    BCS +                                               ; if (error_term >= 0, i.e. error still ok) then branch (forwards)  $^$ 0xd326

    STA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd328
    LDA .vduPlotLineErrorTermLow                        ; }  $^$ 0xd32a
    ADC .vduPlotLineAbsDominantAxisDeltaLow             ; }  $^$ 0xd32d
    STA .vduPlotLineErrorTermLow                        ; } error_term = error_term + dominant axis delta  $^$ 0xd330
    LDA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd333
    ADC .vduPlotLineAbsDominantAxisDeltaHigh            ; }  $^$ 0xd335
    CLC                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd338
+                                                       ; }
    STA .vduPlotLineErrorTermHigh                       ; }  $^$ 0xd339

    PHP                                                 ; store flags (carry clear if we will move in both axes)  $^$ 0xd33c
    BCS .jumpVectorMoveOnePixelInDominantAxis           ; if (error term still ok) then branch  $^$ 0xd33d
                                                        ; (indirectly
                                                        ;  to .plotLineMoveToNextColumnRight
                                                        ;  or .plotLineMoveToNextRowUp
                                                        ;  which moves along the dominant axis
                                                        ;  right or up one pixel)

    JMP (.vduPlotLineRoutineLow)                        ; jump to one of the next four line  $^$ 0xd33f
                                                        ; routines below, which move the
                                                        ; sub-dominant axis one pixel in the
                                                        ; appropriate direction, and then
                                                        ; updates in the dominant axis: move
