                                                        ; up or right one pixel.

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Move up one pixel (in the non-dominant axis)
;
; This is moving in the non-dominant axis. Then jump to update the dominant axis.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.plotLineDominantXAxisSameSign                          ;
    DEY                                                 ; Y=Y-1 (moving one row up the screen)  $^$ 0xd342
    BPL .jumpVectorMoveOnePixelInDominantAxis           ; if (still in same character cell) then branch  $^$ 0xd343
    JSR .moveGraphicsCursorAddressUpOneCharacterCell    ; call subroutine to advance cursor address to the next cell up  $^$ 0xd345
.jumpVectorMoveOnePixelInDominantAxis
    JMP (.vduJumpVectorLow)                             ; jump to update dominant axis  $^$ 0xd348
                                                        ; moving up or right one pixel

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Move down one pixel (in the non-dominant axis)
;
; This is moving in the non-dominant axis. Then jump to update the dominant axis.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.plotLineDominantXAxisDifferentSign                     ;
    INY                                                 ; Y=Y+1 (moving down one row in the character cell)  $^$ 0xd34b
    CPY #8                                              ; }  $^$ 0xd34c
    BNE .jumpVectorMoveOnePixelInDominantAxis           ; } if (still in the same character cell) then branch  $^$ 0xd34e

    CLC                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd350
    LDA .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow        ; }  $^$ 0xd351
    ADC .vduBytesPerCharacterRowLow                     ; } add a row onto the graphic cursor address  $^$ 0xd353
    STA .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow        ; }  $^$ 0xd356
    LDA .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellHigh       ; }  $^$ 0xd358
    ADC .vduBytesPerCharacterRowHigh                    ; }  $^$ 0xd35a
    BPL +                                               ; if (result +ve) then branch (we are within screen RAM)  $^$ 0xd35d
    SEC                                                 ; we are above screen RAM  $^$ 0xd35f
    SBC .vduScreenSizeHighByte                          ; subtract screen memory size high  $^$ 0xd360
+
    STA .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellHigh       ; store it (this wraps around point to screen RAM)  $^$ 0xd363
    LDY #0                                              ; Y=0  $^$ 0xd365
    JMP (.vduJumpVectorLow)                             ; jump to update dominant axis  $^$ 0xd367

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Move right one pixel (in the non-dominant axis)
;
; This is moving in the non-dominant axis. Then jump to update the dominant axis.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.plotLineDominantYAxisSameSign
    LSR .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                             ; shift byte mask right  $^$ 0xd36a
    BCC .jumpVectorMoveOnePixelInDominantAxis               ; if (still in the same byte) then branch  $^$ 0xd36c
    JSR .moveGraphicsCursorAddressTotheRightAndUpdateMask   ; update address and mask  $^$ 0xd36e
    JMP (.vduJumpVectorLow)                                 ; jump to update dominant axis  $^$ 0xd371

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Move left one pixel (in the non-dominant axis)
;
; This is moving in the non-dominant axis. Then jump to update the dominant axis.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.plotLineDominantYAxisDifferentSign
    ASL .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                             ; shift byte mask left  $^$ 0xd374
    BCC .jumpVectorMoveOnePixelInDominantAxis               ; if (still in the same byte) then branch  $^$ 0xd376
    JSR .moveGraphicsCursorAddressTotheLeftAndUpdateMask    ; move graphics cursor address left and update mask value  $^$ 0xd378
    JMP (.vduJumpVectorLow)                                 ; jump to update dominant axis  $^$ 0xd37b

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Move up one pixel (in the dominant axis)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.plotLineMoveToNextRowUp
    DEY                                                 ; decrement row within character cell  $^$ 0xd37e
    BPL .plotLineCheckForTermination                    ; if (still in cell) then branch  $^$ 0xd37f
    JSR .moveGraphicsCursorAddressUpOneCharacterCell    ; move up one cell  $^$ 0xd381
    BNE .plotLineCheckForTermination                    ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xd384

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Move right one pixel (in the dominant axis)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.plotLineMoveToNextColumnRight
    LSR .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                             ; shift byte mask  $^$ 0xd386
    BCC .plotLineCheckForTermination                        ; if (still in the same byte) branch  $^$ 0xd388
    JSR .moveGraphicsCursorAddressTotheRightAndUpdateMask   ; update address and mask  $^$ 0xd38a
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.plotLineCheckForTermination
    PLP                                                 ; pull flags (carry clear if we moved in both axes)  $^$ 0xd38d
    INX                                                 ; X (also in .vduTempStoreDC) holds the  $^$ 0xd38e
                                                        ; low byte of the loop counter
    BNE +                                               ; if (X > 0) then branch  $^$ 0xd38f
    INC .vduTempStoreDD                                 ; .vduTempStoreDD holds the high byte  $^$ 0xd391
                                                        ; of the loop counter
    BEQ .plotLineFinished                               ; if (loop counter is zero) then branch (finished)  $^$ 0xd393
+
    BIT .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; top bit set if dotted line,  $^$ 0xd395
                                                        ; bit 6 set if out of bounds
    BVS .plotLineContinuesOutOfBounds                   ; if (out of bounds) then branch (line is not on screen yet)  $^$ 0xd397
    BCS .plotLineLoopLocal                              ; if (only moved in dominant axis) then branch (keep going)  $^$ 0xd399
    DEC .vduTempStoreDF                                 ; set to one only if it's the last pixel at the graphics window edge  $^$ 0xd39b
    BNE .plotLineLoopLocal                              ; if (not at edge of window) then branch (keep going)  $^$ 0xd39d

.plotLineFinished
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd39f

.plotLineContinuesOutOfBounds
    ; increment the actual pixel coordinate along then loop back
    LDA .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; A=.vduTempStoreDE  $^$ 0xd3a0
    STX .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; Remember X  $^$ 0xd3a2
    AND #2                                              ; clear all but bit 1  $^$ 0xd3a4
    TAX                                                 ; X=2 if X axis is dominant; 0 otherwise  $^$ 0xd3a6
    BCS ++                                              ; if (moved in dominant axis only) then branch  $^$ 0xd3a7
    BIT .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; check bit 7 of .vduTempStoreDE  $^$ 0xd3a9
    BMI +                                               ; if (signs of dx,dy differ) then branch (decrement value)  $^$ 0xd3ab
    INC .vduPlotLineCurrentPointXLow,X                  ; }  $^$ 0xd3ad
    BNE ++                                              ; } Increment .vduPlotLineCurrentPointX (Y axis dominant)  $^$ 0xd3b0
    INC .vduPlotLineCurrentPointXHigh,X                 ; }        or .vduPlotLineCurrentPointY (X axis dominant)  $^$ 0xd3b2
    BCC ++                                              ; } ALWAYs branch  $^$ 0xd3b5
+
    LDA .vduPlotLineCurrentPointXLow,X                  ; }  $^$ 0xd3b7
    BNE +                                               ; }  $^$ 0xd3ba
    DEC .vduPlotLineCurrentPointXHigh,X                 ; } Decrement .vduPlotLineCurrentPointX (Y axis dominant)  $^$ 0xd3bc
+                                                       ; }        or .vduPlotLineCurrentPointY (X axis dominant)
    DEC .vduPlotLineCurrentPointXLow,X                  ; }  $^$ 0xd3bf
++
    TXA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd3c2
    EOR #2                                              ; } invert bit 2 of X  $^$ 0xd3c3
    TAX                                                 ; } X=0 if X axis dominant; 2 if Y axis dominant  $^$ 0xd3c5

    INC .vduPlotLineCurrentPointXLow,X                  ; }  $^$ 0xd3c6
    BNE +                                               ; } increment .vduPlotLineCurrentPointX (X axis dominant)  $^$ 0xd3c9
    INC .vduPlotLineCurrentPointXHigh,X                 ; }        or .vduPlotLineCurrentPointY (Y axis dominant)  $^$ 0xd3cb
+
    LDX .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; Restore X  $^$ 0xd3ce

.plotLineLoopLocal
    JMP .plotLineLoop                                   ; jump back to continue plotting the line  $^$ 0xd3d0


; ***************************************************************************************
.moveGraphicsCursorAddressUpOneCharacterCell
    SEC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd3d3
    LDA .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow        ; }  $^$ 0xd3d4
    SBC .vduBytesPerCharacterRowLow                     ; }  $^$ 0xd3d6
    STA .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow        ; } subtract number of bytes per line  $^$ 0xd3d9
    LDA .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellHigh       ; } from address  $^$ 0xd3db
    SBC .vduBytesPerCharacterRowHigh                    ; }  $^$ 0xd3dd
    CMP .vduStartScreenAddressHighByte                  ; compare with bottom of screen memory  $^$ 0xd3e0
    BCS +                                               ; if (inside screen RAM) then branch  $^$ 0xd3e3
    ADC .vduScreenSizeHighByte                          ; add screen memory size to wrap it  $^$ 0xd3e5
                                                        ; around
+
    STA .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellHigh       ; store in current address of graphics  $^$ 0xd3e8
                                                        ; cell top line
    LDY #7                                              ; Y=7  $^$ 0xd3ea
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd3ec


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Update the mask value, and move graphics cursor address on to next cell to the right
;
; On Entry:
;       Carry always SET
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.moveGraphicsCursorAddressTotheRightAndUpdateMask
    LDA .vduColourMaskLeft                              ; get current left colour mask  $^$ 0xd3ed
    STA .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ; store it  $^$ 0xd3f0
    LDA .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow        ; }  $^$ 0xd3f2
    ADC #7                                              ; } get current graphics cursor  $^$ 0xd3f4
    STA .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow        ; } address and add 8 to move to  $^$ 0xd3f6
    BCC +                                               ; } next cell to the right  $^$ 0xd3f8
    INC .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellHigh       ; }  $^$ 0xd3fa
+
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd3fc

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Update the mask value, and move graphics cursor address on to previous cell to the left
;
; On Entry:
;       Carry always SET
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.moveGraphicsCursorAddressTotheLeftAndUpdateMask
    LDA .vduColourMaskRight                             ; get right colour mask  $^$ 0xd3fd
    STA .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ; store it  $^$ 0xd400
    LDA .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow        ; A=top line graphics cell low  $^$ 0xd402
    BNE +                                               ; if (not zero) then branch  $^$ 0xd404
    DEC .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellHigh       ; decrement high byte  $^$ 0xd406
+
    SBC #8                                              ; subtract 8 (carry is always SET)  $^$ 0xd408
    STA .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow        ; and store in low byte  $^$ 0xd40a
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd40c

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Initialise delta values to (current cursor - params position)
;
; Called at the start of the line drawing, this function takes the current graphics cursor
; position, subtracts the desired graphics cursor position (two 16 bit values on the VDU
; queue), and stores the result in workspace A/B/C/D.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.plotLineInitialiseDeltaValues
    LDY #.vduPlotLineDeltaXLow - .vduVariablesStart     ; destination: .vduPlotLineDeltaX/Y  $^$ 0xd40d
    LDX #.vdu25ParameterXLow - .vduVariablesStart       ; source: four parameters on the VDU queue  $^$ 0xd40f
                                                        ; and the graphics cursor position
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Coordinate subtraction
;
; On Entry:
;       X = source offset into vdu variables      (we read offsets 0-7)
;       Y = destination offset into vdu variables (we write offsets 0-3)
;
; On Exit:
;   Stores 16 bit width and height based on the difference of four
;   16 bit source coordinates (left, bottom, right, top)
;       width  = right - left
;       height = top - bottom
;   i.e.
;       let src  = .vduVariablesStart + X
;       let dest = .vduVariablesStart + Y
;       dest[0,1] = src[4,5] - src[0,1] = width
;       dest[2,3] = src[6,7] - src[2,3] = height
;
;   A = height (high byte)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.coordinateSubtraction
    JSR +                                               ; first calculate width  $^$ 0xd411
    INX                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd414
    INX                                                 ; } add 2 to X and Y  $^$ 0xd415
    INY                                                 ; } i.e. move offsets on for Y values  $^$ 0xd416
    INY                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd417
                                                        ; finally calculate height
+
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xd418
    LDA .vduVariablesStart + 4,X                        ; subtract coordinates  $^$ 0xd419
    SBC .vduVariablesStart + 0,X                        ;  $^$ 0xd41c
    STA .vduVariablesStart + 0,Y                        ;  $^$ 0xd41f
    LDA .vduVariablesStart + 5,X                        ;  $^$ 0xd422
    SBC .vduVariablesStart + 1,X                        ;  $^$ 0xd425
    STA .vduVariablesStart + 1,Y                        ;  $^$ 0xd428
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd42b

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Initialise line drawing variables
;
; Swaps the delta coordinates to make the non-dominant axis first. Stores absolute values of
; the deltas in .vduPlotLineAbsNonDominantAxisDeltaLow/High
;        and in .vduPlotLineAbsDominantAxisDeltaLow/High
; Initialises the loop counter (-ve of the number of pixels to draw along the dominant axis)
; Initialises the error term.
;
; In steps:
;   1. Make sure the dominant axis is stored second, by swapping coordinates if needed.
;   2. Both coordinates are then made positive and stored in:
;           .vduPlotLineAbsNonDominantAxisDeltaLow/High
;           .vduPlotLineAbsDominantAxisDeltaLow/High
;   3. .vduTempStoreDC/DD stores the negative of the number of steps to take along the dominant axis.
;   4. .vduPlotLineErrorTermLow/High stores half .vduPlotLineAbsDominantAxisDelta. This is the error variable.
;
; On Entry:
;       The original signed (dX, dY) delta values are stored at:
;           (.vduPlotLineDeltaXLow/High, .vduPlotLineDeltaYLow/High)
;
; On Exit:
;       .vduPlotLineAbsNonDominantAxisDeltaLow/High initialised
;       .vduPlotLineAbsDominantAxisDeltaLow/High initialised
;       .vduPlotLineErrorTermLow/High initialised
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.plotLineInitializeVariables
    LDA .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; get the dominant axis (0 or 2)  $^$ 0xd42c
    BNE +                                               ; if (Y axis is dominant) then branch  $^$ 0xd42e
    LDX #.vduPlotLineDeltaXLow - .vduVariablesStart     ; X is workspace A  $^$ 0xd430
    LDY #.vduPlotLineDeltaYLow - .vduVariablesStart     ; Y is workspace C  $^$ 0xd432
    JSR .exchangeTwoVDUBytes                            ; exchange the X and Y variables.  $^$ 0xd434
                                                        ; So the dominant axis is now the
                                                        ; first coordinate.
+
    LDX #.vduPlotLineDeltaXLow - .vduVariablesStart     ; source: .workspaceABCD (the start  $^$ 0xd437
                                                        ; coordinates)
    LDY #.vduPlotLineAbsNonDominantAxisDeltaLow - .vduVariablesStart ; destination: absolute  $^$ 0xd439
                                                        ; deltas in X and Y with the
                                                        ; non-dominant axis first
    JSR .copyFourBytesWithinVDUVariables                ; copy four bytes  $^$ 0xd43b
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xd43e
    LDX .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; get the dominant axis (0 or 2)  $^$ 0xd43f
    LDA .vduPlotLineTerminationValueLow                 ; }  $^$ 0xd441
    SBC .vduPlotLineCurrentPointXLow,X                  ; }     AY = .vduPlotLineTerminationValue - .vduPlotLineCurrentPointX or Y  $^$ 0xd444
    TAY                                                 ; } ie. AY = finalPoint - start point (in dominant axis)  $^$ 0xd447
    LDA .vduPlotLineTerminationValueHigh                ; }  $^$ 0xd448
    SBC .vduPlotLineCurrentPointXHigh,X                 ; }  $^$ 0xd44b
    BMI +                                               ; if (startPoint > finalPoint) then branch  $^$ 0xd44e
    JSR .negateAY                                       ; negate value stored in A and Y  $^$ 0xd450
+
    STA .vduTempStoreDD                                 ; store high byte of negative value     } this is the -ve of the number of steps we  $^$ 0xd453
    STY .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; store low byte of negative value      } need to take when plotting the line.  $^$ 0xd455
    LDX #.vduPlotLineErrorTermLow - .vduVariablesStart  ;  $^$ 0xd457

; fall through to do:
;   .vduPlotLineAbsDominantAxisDelta    = ABS(.vduPlotLineAbsDominantAxisDelta)
;   .vduPlotLineAbsNonDominantAxisDelta = ABS(.vduPlotLineAbsNonDominantAxisDelta)
;   .vduPlotLineErrorTerm               = .vduPlotLineAbsDominantAxisDelta / 2

; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Line Initialisation
;
; This is used in both line drawing and triangle filling to initialise the variables needed
; to track along the edge. Sets the deltas to absolute values, and initialises an error
; term to half the absolute delta in Y.
;
;   Let src  = .vduVariablesStart + X
;   src[4,5] = ABS(src[4,5])
;   src[2,3] = ABS(src[2,3])
;   src[0,1] = src[4,5] / 2
;
; On Entry:
;       X = source (offset from .vduVariablesStart)
;
; On Exit:
;       AY = absolute value of src[2,3]
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.lineInitialisation
    JSR .absoluteValue                                  ; make src[4,5] positive  $^$ 0xd459
    LSR                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd45c
    STA .vduVariablesStart + 1,X                        ; }  $^$ 0xd45d
    TYA                                                 ; } src[0,1] = src[4,5] / 2  $^$ 0xd460
    ROR                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd461
    STA .vduVariablesStart,X                            ; }  $^$ 0xd462
    DEX                                                 ; point to src[0,1]  $^$ 0xd465
    DEX                                                 ; and fall through to make src[2,3] positive  $^$ 0xd466
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Absolute value
;
; Make sure that the 16 bit coordinate at (vduVariablesStart + 4 + X)
; is not negative, by negating it if necessary.
;
; On Entry:
;       X is offset to vdu variable i.e.:
;       (vduVariablesStart + 4 + X) has the low byte of the coordinate
;       (vduVariablesStart + 5 + X) has the high byte of the coordinate
;
; On Exit:
;       A is the high byte of the result (also stored in .vduVariablesStart + 5 + X)
;       Y is the low byte of the result  (also stored in .vduVariablesStart + 4 + X)
;       X is preserved
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.absoluteValue
    LDY .vduVariablesStart + 4,X                        ;  $^$ 0xd467
    LDA .vduVariablesStart + 5,X                        ;  $^$ 0xd46a
    BPL +                                               ; if (A is +ve) then branch (return)  $^$ 0xd46d
    JSR .negateAY                                       ; negate AY  $^$ 0xd46f
    STA .vduVariablesStart + 5,X                        ; store back again  $^$ 0xd472
    PHA                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd475
    TYA                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd476
    STA .vduVariablesStart + 4,X                        ;  $^$ 0xd477
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xd47a
+
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd47b

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Copy eight bytes (four coordinates) of VDU variables
;
; On Entry:
;       X = source (offset from .vduVariablesStart)
;       Y = destination (offset from .vduVariablesStart)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.copyEightBytesWithinVDUVariables
    LDA #8                                              ; A = 8  $^$ 0xd47c
    BNE .copyABytesWithinVDUVariables                   ; ALWAYS branch - copy 8 bytes  $^$ 0xd47e

; ***************************************************************************************
; On Entry:
;       X = source (offset from .vduVariablesStart)
.copyTwoBytesWithinVDUVariablesToPlotLineTerminationValue
    LDY #.vduPlotLineTerminationValueLow - .vduVariablesStart ; Y = destination offset from .vduVariablesStart  $^$ 0xd480
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Copy two bytes (one coordinate) of VDU variables
;
; On Entry:
;       X = source (offset from .vduVariablesStart)
;       Y = destination (offset from .vduVariablesStart)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.copyTwoBytesWithinVDUVariables
    LDA #2                                              ; A = 2  $^$ 0xd482
    BNE .copyABytesWithinVDUVariables                   ; ALWAYS branch - copy 2 bytes  $^$ 0xd484

; ***************************************************************************************
.copyGraphicsCursorPixelPositionToWorkspaceABCD
    LDY #.vduWorkspaceA - .vduVariablesStart            ; destination = offset to workspaceA  $^$ 0xd486
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
; On Entry:
;       Y = destination (offset from .vduVariablesStart)
.copyGraphicsCursorPixelPosition
    LDX #.vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXLow  - .vduVariablesStart     ; source = offset to graphics cursor position  $^$ 0xd488
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Copy four bytes (e.g. one pair of coordinates) of VDU variables
;
; On Entry:
;       X = source (offset from .vduVariablesStart)
;       Y = destination (offset from .vduVariablesStart)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.copyFourBytesWithinVDUVariables
    LDA #4                                              ; number of bytes to copy  $^$ 0xd48a
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Copy a number of bytes in VDU variables
;
; On Entry:
;       A = number of bytes to copy
;       X = source (offset from .vduVariablesStart)
;       Y = destination (offset from .vduVariablesStart)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.copyABytesWithinVDUVariables
    STA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; store A as a loop counter  $^$ 0xd48c
-
    LDA .vduVariablesStart,X                            ; load value from source address  $^$ 0xd48e
    STA .vduVariablesStart,Y                            ; store value in destination address  $^$ 0xd491
    INX                                                 ; move index forwards  $^$ 0xd494
    INY                                                 ; move index forwards  $^$ 0xd495
    DEC .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; decrement loop counter  $^$ 0xd496
    BNE -                                               ; loop back until done  $^$ 0xd498
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd49a


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Negate the sixteen bit value in A and Y
;
; On Entry:
;       A = high byte
;       Y = low byte
;
; On Exit:
;       A = high byte of negated value
;       Y = low byte of negated value
;       Preserves X
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.negateAY
    PHA                                                 ; save A  $^$ 0xd49b
    TYA                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd49c
    EOR #$FF                                            ;  $^$ 0xd49d
    TAY                                                 ; Y=255 - Y  $^$ 0xd49f
    PLA                                                 ; restore A  $^$ 0xd4a0
    EOR #$FF                                            ; A=255 - A  $^$ 0xd4a1
    INY                                                 ; Y=Y+1 (effectively making Y = 256 - initialY)  $^$ 0xd4a3
    BNE +                                               ; if (Y != 0) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xd4a4
    CLC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd4a6
    ADC #1                                              ; A+=1  $^$ 0xd4a7
+
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd4a9

; ***************************************************************************************
.checkPixelIsBackgroundColour
    JSR .checkParameterInBoundsAndSetScreenAddresses    ; check window boundaries and set up screen addresses  $^$ 0xd4aa
    BNE .outsideBoundaries                              ; if (outside) then branch  $^$ 0xd4ad
    LDA (.vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow),Y    ; get byte from current graphics cell  $^$ 0xd4af
    EOR .vduBackgroundGraphicsColour                    ; compare with current background colour  $^$ 0xd4b1
    STA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; store it  $^$ 0xd4b4
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd4b6

; ***************************************************************************************
.outsideBoundaries
    PLA                                                 ; remove one return address from the  $^$ 0xd4b7
    PLA                                                 ; stack to early out of the lateral  $^$ 0xd4b8
                                                        ; fill
-
    INC .vduGraphicsCursorPixelsYLow                    ; increment current graphics cursor y pixel position  $^$ 0xd4b9
    JMP .setNextPixelPosition                           ; exit having pushed the cursor up one  $^$ 0xd4bc

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Lateral fill left and right
;
; Fill to the left and right of the current parameter coordinate until a non-background
; colour is found. Fills in the foreground colour using the current GCOL mask settings.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.lateralFillLeftRight
    JSR .checkPixelIsBackgroundColour                   ; check pixel is background colour  $^$ 0xd4bf
    AND .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ; check just the bits for the current pixel  $^$ 0xd4c2
    BNE -                                               ; if (non-background pixel found) then branch  $^$ 0xd4c4

    ; fill left
    LDX #0                                              ; X=0 (check width in pixels to the left)  $^$ 0xd4c6
    JSR .lateralFillGetWidthToWindowEdge                ; Find distance to edge of window:  $^$ 0xd4c8
                                                        ; On exit, X and .vduTempStoreDB=negated
                                                        ; distance to edge of window
    BEQ .lateralFillLeftDone                            ; if (zero width) then branch  $^$ 0xd4cb
    LDY .vduGraphicsCursorVerticalOffsetInCell          ; Y = row within character cell  $^$ 0xd4cd
    ASL .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ; shift mask for next pixel left  $^$ 0xd4d0
    BCS .lateralFillLeftLoop                            ; if (next character cell left reached) then branch  $^$ 0xd4d2
    JSR .lateralFillLeftPartialByte                     ; fill the partial first byte  $^$ 0xd4d4
    BCC .lateralFillLeftDone                            ; if (finished) then branch  $^$ 0xd4d7

.lateralFillLeftLoop
    JSR .moveGraphicsCursorAddressTotheLeftAndUpdateMask ; move cursor left and reset mask  $^$ 0xd4d9
    LDA (.vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow),Y    ; get byte from screen  $^$ 0xd4dc
    EOR .vduBackgroundGraphicsColour                    ; EOR with background colour  $^$ 0xd4de
    STA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; and store  $^$ 0xd4e1
    BNE .lateralFillLeftNearlyDone                      ; if (not background colour) then branch  $^$ 0xd4e3

    ; found byte with background colour
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xd4e5
    TXA                                                 ; A=X=negated distance to edge of window (low byte)  $^$ 0xd4e6
    ADC .vduPixelsPerByteMinusOne                       ; add pixels/byte (including carry)  $^$ 0xd4e7
    BCC +                                               ; if (carry clear) then branch  $^$ 0xd4ea
    INC .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; increment high byte of distance to left edge of window  $^$ 0xd4ec
    BPL .lateralFillLeftNearlyDone                      ; if (reached edge of window) then branch  $^$ 0xd4ee
+
    TAX                                                 ; X=A=negated distance to edge of window (low byte)  $^$ 0xd4f0

    ; plot a byte in the foreground colour using GCOL options
    JSR .plotByte                                       ; plot a byte  $^$ 0xd4f1

    ; loop back
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xd4f4
    BCS .lateralFillLeftLoop                            ; ALWAYS branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xd4f5

; ***************************************************************************************
.lateralFillLeftNearlyDone
    JSR .lateralFillLeftPartialByte                     ; fill the final pixels in the last (leftmost byte) of the row  $^$ 0xd4f7

.lateralFillLeftDone
    LDY #0                                              ; Y=0  $^$ 0xd4fa
    JSR .lateralFillSetParamAtGivenDistanceFromEdge     ; Restore original position  $^$ 0xd4fc
    LDY #.vdu25ParameterXLow - .vduVariablesStart       ;    }  $^$ 0xd4ff
    LDX #.vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXLow - .vduVariablesStart ; } swap parameter with graphics cursor position  $^$ 0xd501
    JSR .exchangeFourBytes                              ;    }  $^$ 0xd503

    ; fill right
.lateralFillRight
    JSR .checkPixelIsBackgroundColour                   ; check screen pixel  $^$ 0xd506
    LDX #4                                              ; X=4 (right hand edge of graphics window)  $^$ 0xd509
    JSR .lateralFillGetWidthToWindowEdge                ; get distance to right hand edge of graphics window  $^$ 0xd50b
    TXA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd50e
    BNE +                                               ; }  $^$ 0xd50f
    DEC .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; } subtract one from distance to right edge  $^$ 0xd511
+                                                       ; }
    DEX                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd513

.lateralFillRightFirstByteLoop
    JSR .lateralFillRightPartialByte                    ;  $^$ 0xd514
    BCC .lateralFillRightDone                           ;  $^$ 0xd517

.lateralFillRightLoop
    JSR .moveGraphicsCursorAddressTotheRightAndUpdateMask ;  $^$ 0xd519
    LDA (.vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow),Y    ; get byte from graphics line  $^$ 0xd51c
    EOR .vduBackgroundGraphicsColour                    ; EOR with background colour  $^$ 0xd51e
    STA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; and store it  $^$ 0xd521
    LDA .vduTempStoreDC                                 ;  $^$ 0xd523
    BNE .lateralFillRightFirstByteLoop                  ; if (A is not zero) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xd525

    LDA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; A=.vduTempStoreDA  $^$ 0xd527
    BNE .lateralFillRightNearlyDone                     ; if (A is not zero) then branch  $^$ 0xd529

    ; found byte with background colour
    SEC                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd52b
    TXA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd52c
    ADC .vduPixelsPerByteMinusOne                       ; }  $^$ 0xd52d
    BCC +                                               ; }  $^$ 0xd530
    INC .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; } (X, .vduTempStoreDB) +=  $^$ 0xd532
                                                        ; } pixels per byte
    BPL .lateralFillRightNearlyDone                     ; }  $^$ 0xd534
+                                                       ; }
    TAX                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd536

    ; plot a byte in the foreground colour using GCOL options
    JSR .plotByte                                       ; plot a byte  $^$ 0xd537

    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xd53a
    BCS .lateralFillRightLoop                           ; ALWAYS branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xd53b

; ***************************************************************************************
.lateralFillRightNearlyDone
    JSR .lateralFillRightPartialByte                    ;  $^$ 0xd53d

.lateralFillRightDone
    LDY #4                                              ;  $^$ 0xd540
    JSR .lateralFillSetParamAtGivenDistanceFromEdge     ;  $^$ 0xd542
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.setNextPixelPosition
    JSR .plotMoveGraphicsCursorInAbsolutePixels         ; set graphics cursor position  $^$ 0xd545
    JMP .convertPixelGraphicsCoordinatesToExternal      ; scale positions  $^$ 0xd548

; ***************************************************************************************
.lateralFillRightPartialByte
    LDA .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ; get byte mask  $^$ 0xd54b
    PHA                                                 ; save it  $^$ 0xd54d
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xd54e
    BCC .lateralFillRightGetMask                        ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xd54f

; ***************************************************************************************
.lateralFillRightGetMaskLoop
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xd551
    INX                                                 ; X=X+1  $^$ 0xd552
    BNE +                                               ; if (not zero) then branch  $^$ 0xd553
    INC .vduTempStoreDB                                 ;  $^$ 0xd555
    BPL .lateralFillSaveMaskAndPlotPoint                ; if (+ve) then branch  $^$ 0xd557

+
    LSR .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ; shift mask  $^$ 0xd559
    BCS .lateralFillSaveMaskAndPlotPoint                ; if (carry set) then branch  $^$ 0xd55b
    ORA .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ; OR with mask  $^$ 0xd55d
    PHA                                                 ; save result  $^$ 0xd55f
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.lateralFillRightGetMask
    LDA .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ; A=.vduCurrentPlotByteMask  $^$ 0xd560
    BIT .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; test bits of .vduTempStoreDA  $^$ 0xd562
    PHP                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd564
    PLA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd565
    EOR .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; } flags = flags EOR .vduTempStoreDC  $^$ 0xd566
    PHA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd568
    PLP                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd569
    BEQ .lateralFillRightGetMaskLoop                    ;  $^$ 0xd56a
    PLA                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd56c
    EOR .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ; A=A EOR .vduCurrentPlotByteMask (byte mask)  $^$ 0xd56d

.lateralFillSaveMaskAndPlotPoint
    STA .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ; store it  $^$ 0xd56f
    JMP .plotPointWithinBounds                          ; and display a pixel  $^$ 0xd571

; ***************************************************************************************
.lateralFillLeftPartialByte
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0  $^$ 0xd574
    CLC                                                 ; Clear carry  $^$ 0xd576
    BCC .lateralFillLeftGetMask                         ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xd577

; ***************************************************************************************
.lateralFillLeftGetMaskLoop
    INX                                                 ; X=X+1  $^$ 0xd579
    BNE +                                               ; if (X is not zero) then branch  $^$ 0xd57a
    INC .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; inc .vduTempStoreDB  $^$ 0xd57c
    BPL .lateralFillSaveMaskAndPlotPoint                ; if (+ve) then branch  $^$ 0xd57e
+
    ASL                                                 ; A=A*2  $^$ 0xd580
    BCS .lateralFillLeftGotMaskNowPlotPoint             ; if (C set) then branch  $^$ 0xd581

.lateralFillLeftGetMask
    ORA .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ; A=A OR (.vduCurrentPlotByteMask)  $^$ 0xd583
    BIT .vduTempStoreDA                                 ;  $^$ 0xd585
    BEQ .lateralFillLeftGetMaskLoop                     ;  $^$ 0xd587
    EOR .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ; A=A EOR .vduCurrentPlotByteMask  $^$ 0xd589
    LSR                                                 ; divide by 2  $^$ 0xd58b
    BCC .lateralFillSaveMaskAndPlotPoint                ; if (carry clear) then branch  $^$ 0xd58c

.lateralFillLeftGotMaskNowPlotPoint
    ROR                                                 ; A=A/2 (final step to get mask)  $^$ 0xd58e
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xd58f
    BCS .lateralFillSaveMaskAndPlotPoint                ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xd590

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Get width of parameter point to graphics window edge
;
; On Entry:
;       X = 0 (left edge) or 4 (right edge)
;
; On Exit:
;       .vduTempStoreDB is the negation of the width (high byte)
;       X = Y =         the negation of the width (low byte)
;       A = 0 (and Z=0) if there is zero width
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.lateralFillGetWidthToWindowEdge
    LDA .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsLeftLow,X               ; }  $^$ 0xd592
    SEC                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd595
    SBC .vdu25ParameterXLow                             ; }  $^$ 0xd596
    TAY                                                 ; } AY = window left/right - paramX  $^$ 0xd599
    LDA .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsLeftHigh,X              ; }  $^$ 0xd59a
    SBC .vdu25ParameterXHigh                            ; }  $^$ 0xd59d

    BMI +                                               ; }  $^$ 0xd5a0
    JSR .negateAY                                       ; } make sure AY is negative  $^$ 0xd5a2
+
    STA .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; store A (high coordinate)  $^$ 0xd5a5
    TYA                                                 ; A = low coordinate  $^$ 0xd5a7
    TAX                                                 ; X = low coordinate  $^$ 0xd5a8
    ORA .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; A = low OR high coordinate (checking for zero width?)  $^$ 0xd5a9
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd5ab

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Set parameter X coordinate to the given distance from the left/right edge of the window
;
; On Entry:
;       X, .vduTempStoreDB is negated distance to left/right edge of window
;       Y is 0 (left edge of graphics window)
;         or 4 (right edge of graphics window)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.lateralFillSetParamAtGivenDistanceFromEdge
    STY .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; Y=.vduTempStoreDA  $^$ 0xd5ac
    TXA                                                 ; A=X  $^$ 0xd5ae
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A=X  $^$ 0xd5af
    LDA .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; A=.vduTempStoreDB  $^$ 0xd5b0
    BMI +                                               ; if (-ve) then branch  $^$ 0xd5b2
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0  $^$ 0xd5b4

    ; at this point AY = width to add to edge of window
    ; but if we are looking at the left edge, then negate AY first
+
    LDX .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; X=.vduTempStoreDA  $^$ 0xd5b6
    BNE +                                               ; if (X is not zero) then branch  $^$ 0xd5b8
    JSR .negateAY                                       ; negate  $^$ 0xd5ba
+
    PHA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd5bd
    CLC                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd5be
    TYA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd5bf
    ADC .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsLeftLow,X               ; } paramX = AY + window left/right edge  $^$ 0xd5c0
    STA .vdu25ParameterXLow                             ; }  $^$ 0xd5c3
    PLA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd5c6
    ADC .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsLeftHigh,X              ; }  $^$ 0xd5c7
    STA .vdu25ParameterXHigh                            ; }  $^$ 0xd5ca
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd5cd


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSWORD 13 - Read last two graphic cursor positions
;
; On Entry:
;       .oswordX/Y is the address of the eight bytes of parameters for the result
;
; On Exit:
;       The eight bytes at .oswordX/Y hold the result:
;           byte 0: Previous X (low byte)
;           byte 1: Previous X (high byte)
;           byte 2: Previous Y (low byte)
;           byte 3: Previous Y (high byte)
;           byte 4: Current X (low byte)
;           byte 5: Current X (high byte)
;           byte 6: Current Y (low byte)
;           byte 7: Current Y (high byte)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osword13EntryPoint
    LDA #3                                              ; A=3 (offset into oswordX block)  $^$ 0xd5ce
    JSR +                                               ;  $^$ 0xd5d0
    LDA #7                                              ; A=7 (offset into oswordX block)  $^$ 0xd5d3
+
    PHA                                                 ; Save A  $^$ 0xd5d5
    JSR .exchangeGraphicsCursorWithOldPosition          ; exchange old graphics cursor position with current  $^$ 0xd5d6
    JSR .convertPixelGraphicsCoordinatesToExternal      ; convert to external coordinates  $^$ 0xd5d9
    LDX #3                                              ; X=3  $^$ 0xd5dc
    PLA                                                 ; save A  $^$ 0xd5de
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A  $^$ 0xd5df
-
    LDA .vduGraphicsCursorPositionXLow,X                ; get graphics coordinate  $^$ 0xd5e0
    STA (.oswordX),Y                                    ; store it in OS buffer  $^$ 0xd5e3
    DEY                                                 ; decrement Y and X  $^$ 0xd5e5
    DEX                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd5e6
    BPL -                                               ; if (+ve) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xd5e7
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd5e9


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Fill triangle
;
; A filled triangle is drawn. It is drawn in rows from the bottom of the triangle to the top.
;
; Here we define the 'main line' as the edge of the triangle from the bottommost vertex
; to the topmost vertex. The other two edges are the lower and upper 'minor lines'.
;
; The triangle is drawn in two 'halves'. The first 'half' is for the rows of lower minor line,
; and the second 'half' is for the rows of upper minor line. See the diagram below.
;
; On Entry:
;       .vdu25ParameterLow/High             }
;       .vduGraphicsCursorPixels            } three points that define the triangle
;       .vduOldGraphicsCursorPixels         }
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.plotFillTriangle
    ; store variables
    LDX #.vdu25ParameterXLow - .vduVariablesStart              ; X = source: parameter  $^$ 0xd5ea
    LDY #.vduPlotTriStorageForCoordinates - .vduVariablesStart ; Y = destination: storage  $^$ 0xd5ec
    JSR .copyEightBytesWithinVDUVariables               ; remember the parameter position and  $^$ 0xd5ee
                                                        ; the current graphics cursor
                                                        ; position.

    ; sort the three points of the triangle into order vertically
    JSR .sortParameterPointAndOldPosition                     ; }  $^$ 0xd5f1
    LDX #.vduOldGraphicsCursorPixelsXLow - .vduVariablesStart ; }  $^$ 0xd5f4
    LDY #.vduGraphicsCursorPixelsXLow - .vduVariablesStart    ; } sort positions by Y  $^$ 0xd5f6
    JSR .sortCoordinatesXY                                    ; } coordinate  $^$ 0xd5f8
    JSR .sortParameterPointAndOldPosition                     ; }  $^$ 0xd5fb

    ; The three points of the triangle (now sorted from lowest to highest) are:
    ;
    ;                                               ##  <-.vduGraphicsCursorPixels
    ;                                             ###      /|\
    ;                                           ##  #       |
    ;                     upper minor line->  ##   #        |
    ;                                       ##     #        | second 'half' of triangle
    ;                                     ##      #         | to draw
    ;                                   ##        #         |
    ;                                 ##         #         \|/
    ; .vduOldGraphicsCursorPixels->  #           #         /|\
    ;                                 #         #           |
    ;                                 #         #  <-main   |
    ;                                  #       #     line   |
    ;                                  #       #            |
    ;               lower minor line->  #     #             | first 'half' of triangle
    ;                                   #     #             | to draw
    ;                                    #   #              |
    ;                                    #   #              |
    ;                                     # #               |
    ;                                     # #               |
    ;                                      #               \|/
    ;                                      #  <-.vdu25Parameter
    ;

    ; get the dX, dY for the main line
    LDX #.vdu25ParameterXLow - .vduVariablesStart       ; X = source (parameter and graphics  $^$ 0xd5fe
                                                        ;             cursor)
                                                        ;  offset 0,1,2,3 = parameter
                                                        ;  offset 4,5,6,7 = graphics cursor
    LDY #.vduPlotTriMainLineDeltaXLow - .vduVariablesStart ; Y = destination (main line delta)  $^$ 0xd600
    JSR .coordinateSubtraction                          ; maindelta = (graphics cursor-param)  $^$ 0xd602

    LDA .vduPlotTriMainLineDeltaXHigh                   ;  $^$ 0xd605
    STA .vduPlotTriMainLineXDirectionFlag               ; store high byte of delta X to  $^$ 0xd608
                                                        ; use as a flag when updating our
                                                        ; position.
                                                        ; See .fillTriangleUpdateLinePosition

    ; initialise variables for the main line
    LDX #.vduPlotTriMainLineErrorTermLow - .vduVariablesStart ;  $^$ 0xd60b
    JSR .lineInitialisation                             ; Initialise variables for the main  $^$ 0xd60d
                                                        ; line. This makes the deltas positive
                                                        ; and initialises the error term.

    ; copy .vdu25Parameter to current main edge point
    LDY #.vduPlotTriMainLineCurrentPointXLow - .vduVariablesStart ; }  $^$ 0xd610
    JSR .copyParameterPointToDestinationY                         ; } main edge point = parameter point  $^$ 0xd612

    ; swap graphics cursor points
    JSR .exchangeGraphicsCursorWithOldPosition          ;  $^$ 0xd615

    ; fill the bottom half of the triangle
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xd618
    JSR .plotFillTriangleHalf                           ; fill bottom 'half' of triangle  $^$ 0xd619

    ; swap graphics cursor points back
    JSR .exchangeGraphicsCursorWithOldPosition          ;  $^$ 0xd61c

    ; swap parameter point with old graphics cursor
    LDX #.vdu25ParameterXLow - .vduVariablesStart       ;  $^$ 0xd61f
    JSR .exchangeOldGraphicsCursorPositionWithVariableX ;  $^$ 0xd621

    ; Now our triangle looks like this:
    ;                                               ##  <-.vduGraphicsCursorPixels
    ;                                             ###      /|\
    ;                                           ##  #       |
    ;                     upper minor line->  ##   #        |
    ;                                       ##     #        | second 'half' of triangle
    ;                                     ##      #         | to draw
    ;                                   ##        #         |
    ;                                 ##         #         \|/
    ;             .vdu25Parameter->  #############         /|\
    ;                                 ###########           |
    ;                                 ###########  <-main   |
    ;                                  #########     line   |
    ;                                  #########            |
    ;               lower minor line->  #######             | first 'half' of triangle
    ;                                   #######             | is filled
    ;                                    #####              |
    ;                                    #####              |
    ;                                     ###               |
    ;                                     ###               |
    ;                                      #               \|/
    ;                                      #  <-.vduOldGraphicsCursorPixels
    ;
    ; It is now half filled, and the parameters of the vertices have been swapped ready for
    ; filling the second half.

    ; fill the top half of the triangle
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xd624
    JSR .plotFillTriangleHalf                           ; fill top 'half' of triangle  $^$ 0xd625

    ; restore parameter point and graphics cursor variables back to where they started.
    LDX #.vduPlotTriStorageForCoordinates - .vduVariablesStart ; X = source  $^$ 0xd628
    LDY #.vdu25ParameterXLow - .vduVariablesStart              ; Y = destination  $^$ 0xd62a
    JSR .copyEightBytesWithinVDUVariables               ; restore original parameter position  $^$ 0xd62c
                                                        ; and graphics cursor position

    ; move the graphics cursor to the new parameter point, and return
    JMP .plotMoveGraphicsCursorInAbsolutePixels         ;  $^$ 0xd62f


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Sort the parameter point and the old graphics cursor point, sorting by Y coordinate
;
; if (parameter point is higher or level with old graphics cursor) then swap points in place
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.sortParameterPointAndOldPosition
    LDX #.vdu25ParameterXLow - .vduVariablesStart               ; } Sort paramX and old  $^$ 0xd632
    LDY #.vduOldGraphicsCursorPixelsXLow - .vduVariablesStart   ; } graphics position X  $^$ 0xd634
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Sort one point with another, sorting by Y coordinate
;
; given two pairs of coordinates (one indexed by register X the other by register Y), sort
; them by their Y coordinates (lowest first)
;
; if (point X is higher or level with point Y) then swap points in place
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.sortCoordinatesXY
    LDA .vduVariablesStart + 2,X                        ; Y coordinate low byte  $^$ 0xd636
    CMP .vduVariablesStart + 2,Y                        ; Y coordinate low byte  $^$ 0xd639
    LDA .vduVariablesStart + 3,X                        ; Y coordinate high byte  $^$ 0xd63c
    SBC .vduVariablesStart + 3,Y                        ; Y coordinate high byte  $^$ 0xd63f
    BMI .exit10                                         ; if (Y coordinates of variable indexed by Y > Y coordinate of variable indexed by X) then branch (return)  $^$ 0xd642
    JMP .exchangeFourBytes                              ; swap coordinates  $^$ 0xd644


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 134 - Read text cursor position
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte134EntryPoint
    LDA .vduTextCursorXPosition                         ; read current text cursor X position  $^$ 0xd647
    SEC                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd64a
    SBC .vduTextWindowLeft                              ; } subtract text window left position  $^$ 0xd64b
    TAX                                                 ; X = text cursor X - text window left  $^$ 0xd64e
    LDA .vduTextCursorYPosition                         ; get current text cursor Y position  $^$ 0xd64f
    SEC                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd652
    SBC .vduTextWindowTop                               ; } subtract text window top position  $^$ 0xd653
    TAY                                                 ; Y = text cursor Y - text window top  $^$ 0xd656
.exit10
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd657


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Fill half a triangle
;
; Draws rows of a triangle from bottom to top following the main line and the minor line
; as edges, until we reach the top of the minor line. See .plotFillTriangle. The minor line
; starts at the parameter point and moves up the screen to the current graphics point.
;
; On Entry:
;       Carry clear = first half of triangle is being drawn
;       Carry set = second half of triangle is being drawn
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.plotFillTriangleHalf
    PHP                                                 ; store flags  $^$ 0xd658

    ; find the dX, dY for the minor line
    LDX #.vdu25ParameterXLow - .vduVariablesStart           ; X = src (offset 4=graphics cursor)  $^$ 0xd659
    LDY #.vduPlotTriMinorLineDeltaXLow - .vduVariablesStart ; Y = destination (minor delta)  $^$ 0xd65b
    JSR .coordinateSubtraction                          ; minor delta = graphics cursor - param  $^$ 0xd65d

    ; Get and store the sign of the delta in X, so we know which way to update in X later.
    ; See .fillTriangleUpdateLinePosition.
    LDA .vduPlotTriMinorLineDeltaXHigh                  ; get high byte of deltaX  $^$ 0xd660
    STA .vduPlotTriMinorLineXDirectionFlag              ; store as flag  $^$ 0xd663

    ; initialise the minor line variables:
    ;       .vduPlotTriMinorLineDeltaX = ABS(.vduPlotTriMinorLineDeltaX)
    ;       .vduPlotTriMinorLineDeltaY = ABS(.vduPlotTriMinorLineDeltaY)
    ;       .vduPlotTriMinorLineErrorTerm = .vduPlotTriMinorLineDeltaY / 2
    LDX #.vduPlotTriMinorLineErrorTermLow - .vduVariablesStart ;  $^$ 0xd666
    JSR .lineInitialisation  $^$ 0xd668

    ; initialise current point on the minor line
    LDY #.vduPlotTriMinorLineCurrentPointXLow - .vduVariablesStart ;  $^$ 0xd66b
    JSR .copyParameterPointToDestinationY               ; current minor line point = parameter point  $^$ 0xd66d

    ; calculate triangle fill 'height' = parameter point Y - graphics cursor height
    ; this is actually the negative of the height to fill, which we use as a loop counter
    SEC                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd670
    LDA .vdu25ParameterYLow                             ; }  $^$ 0xd671
    SBC .vduGraphicsCursorPixelsYLow                    ; }  $^$ 0xd674
    STA .vduTriangleFillHeightLow                       ; }  $^$ 0xd677
    LDA .vdu25ParameterYHigh                            ; } height = paramY - cursorY  $^$ 0xd67a
    SBC .vduGraphicsCursorPixelsYHigh                   ; }  $^$ 0xd67d
    STA .vduTriangleFillHeightHigh                      ; }  $^$ 0xd680
    ORA .vduTriangleFillHeightLow                       ; check number of rows to draw  $^$ 0xd683
    BEQ +                                               ; if (no rows to draw) then branch (finish up)  $^$ 0xd686

    ; loop to fill each row (.vduTriangleFillHeight is the loop counter, counting up)
.plotFillTriangleHalfLoop
    JSR .fillRowLeftToRightBetweenMainAndMinorLines     ; fill one row  $^$ 0xd688

    ; update the minor line position
    LDX #.vduPlotTriMinorLineErrorTermLow - .vduVariablesStart  ;  $^$ 0xd68b
    JSR .fillTriangleUpdateLinePosition                         ;  $^$ 0xd68d

    ; update the main line position
    LDX #.vduPlotTriMainLineErrorTermLow - .vduVariablesStart   ;  $^$ 0xd690
    JSR .fillTriangleUpdateLinePosition                         ;  $^$ 0xd692

    ; increment the loop counter until we hit zero
    INC .vduTriangleFillHeightLow                       ; update loop counter (low)  $^$ 0xd695
    BNE .plotFillTriangleHalfLoop                       ; if (counter not done yet) then branch (loop back and do it again)  $^$ 0xd698
    INC .vduTriangleFillHeightHigh                      ; increment loop counter (high)  $^$ 0xd69a
    BNE .plotFillTriangleHalfLoop                       ; if (counter not done yet) then branch (loop back and do it again)  $^$ 0xd69d

    ; finish up
+
    PLP                                                 ; pull flags  $^$ 0xd69f
    BCC .exit10                                         ; if (carry clear) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xd6a0

    ; At this point carry is set (we are drawing the top half of the triangle). We draw the
    ; final row at top of the triangle...

.fillRowLeftToRightBetweenMainAndMinorLines
    LDX #.vduPlotTriMinorLineCurrentPointXLow - .vduVariablesStart  ;  $^$ 0xd6a2
    LDY #.vduPlotTriMainLineCurrentPointXLow - .vduVariablesStart   ;  $^$ 0xd6a4
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Fill a single horizontal row
;
; Used as part of clearing the graphics window or filling a triangle.
;
; On Entry:
;       X = offset into VDU variables for one extreme graphics pixel X coordinate
;       Y = offset into VDU variables for the other extreme graphics pixel X coordinate
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.fillRow
    STX .vduTempStoreDE                                 ;  $^$ 0xd6a6
    LDA .vduVariablesStart,X                            ; }  $^$ 0xd6a8
    CMP .vduVariablesStart,Y                            ; }  $^$ 0xd6ab
    LDA .vduVariablesStart + 1,X                        ; } if (leftmost <= rightmost) then branch  $^$ 0xd6ae
    SBC .vduVariablesStart + 1,Y                        ; }  $^$ 0xd6b1
    BMI +                                               ; }  $^$ 0xd6b4

    TYA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd6b6
    LDY .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd6b7
    TAX                                                 ; } swap X and Y so (leftmost < rightmost)  $^$ 0xd6b9
    STX .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd6ba
+
    STY .vduTempStoreDF                                 ; .vduTempStoreDF=offset to leftmost coordinate  $^$ 0xd6bc
    LDA .vduVariablesStart,Y                            ;  $^$ 0xd6be
    PHA                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd6c1
    LDA .vduVariablesStart + 1,Y                        ;  $^$ 0xd6c2
    PHA                                                 ; push graphics window left edge coordinate  $^$ 0xd6c5
    LDX .vduTempStoreDF                                    ; check leftmost coordinate  $^$ 0xd6c6
    JSR .checkPointXIsWithinGraphicsWindow              ; check window bounds  $^$ 0xd6c8
    BEQ +                                               ; if (within bounds) then branch  $^$ 0xd6cb

    ; out of bounds. Work out what to do.
    CMP #2                                              ; }  $^$ 0xd6cd
    BNE .donePlottingPoints                             ; } if (reason for being out of bounds  $^$ 0xd6cf
                                                        ; } is not just that it's too far
                                                        ; } right) then branch (finish up)

    ; out of bounds (point is right of the right hand edge of the graphics window)
    LDX #.vduGraphicsWindowPixelsRightLow - .vduVariablesStart ; source = right edge of graphics window  $^$ 0xd6d1
    LDY .vduTempStoreDF                                 ; destination = leftmost pixel coordinate  $^$ 0xd6d3
    JSR .copyTwoBytesWithinVDUVariables                 ; copy coordinate  $^$ 0xd6d5
    LDX .vduTempStoreDF                                 ; X = offset to leftmost pixel coordinate  $^$ 0xd6d8
+
    JSR .setScreenAddress                               ; set a screen address  $^$ 0xd6da
    LDX .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; X=offset to rightmost pixel X coordinate  $^$ 0xd6dd
    JSR .checkPointXIsWithinGraphicsWindow              ; check window bounds  $^$ 0xd6df

    LSR                                                 ; A = reason for being offscreen / 2  $^$ 0xd6e2
                                                        ; (checks for offscreen to the right / up / down)
    BNE .donePlottingPoints                             ; if (point is offscreen to the right, up or down) then branch (finish up)  $^$ 0xd6e3
    BCC +                                               ; if (not outside bounds to the left of the graphics window) then branch  $^$ 0xd6e5

    ; out of bounds (point is left of the graphics window left edge)
    LDX #.vduGraphicsWindowPixelsLeftLow - .vduVariablesStart  ; outside the left edge, leftmost = left edge instead.  $^$ 0xd6e7
+
    LDY .vduTempStoreDF                                 ; Y = offset to leftmost pixel coordinate  $^$ 0xd6e9
    SEC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd6eb
    LDA .vduVariablesStart,Y                            ; }  $^$ 0xd6ec
    SBC .vduVariablesStart,X                            ; }  $^$ 0xd6ef
    STA .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; } tempStoreDC/DD = width of row to fill (rightmost - leftmost)  $^$ 0xd6f2
    LDA .vduVariablesStart + 1,Y                        ; }  $^$ 0xd6f4
    SBC .vduVariablesStart + 1,X                        ; }  $^$ 0xd6f7
    STA .vduTempStoreDD                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd6fa

    ; First calculate leftmost byte to write
    LDA #0                                              ;  $^$ 0xd6fc
-
    ASL                                                 ; shift current mask left  $^$ 0xd6fe
    ORA .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ; OR in the mask for a pixel  $^$ 0xd6ff
    LDY .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; } get low byte (as decremented by .calculateLeftmostByte)  $^$ 0xd701
    BNE .calculateLeftmostByte                          ; } check to see if we are done yet (check if width = 0)  $^$ 0xd703
    DEC .vduTempStoreDD                                 ; } decrement high byte if needed  $^$ 0xd705
    BPL .calculateLeftmostByte                          ; } if (width > 0, i.e. not done yet) then branch  $^$ 0xd707

    ; we get here if width is now zero, i.e. the leftmost byte is all we needed to draw
    STA .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ;  $^$ 0xd709
    JSR .plotPointWithinBounds                          ; display final byte  $^$ 0xd70b

.donePlottingPoints
    ; we get here when we are done drawing all the pixels
    LDX .vduTempStoreDF                                 ; restore X = offset to leftmost coordinate  $^$ 0xd70e
    PLA                                                 ; pull A  $^$ 0xd710
    STA .vduVariablesStart + 1,X                        ; restore left edge of graphics window  $^$ 0xd711
    PLA                                                 ; pull A  $^$ 0xd714
    STA .vduVariablesStart,X                            ; restore left edge of graphics window  $^$ 0xd715
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd718

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Calculate leftmost byte
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.calculateLeftmostByte
    DEC .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; decrement width  $^$ 0xd719
    TAX                                                 ; check the pixel mask  $^$ 0xd71b
    BPL -                                               ; loop back until mask has bit set in bit 7  $^$ 0xd71c

    STA .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ; store the full mask  $^$ 0xd71e
    JSR .plotPointWithinBounds                          ; display a point (write leftmost byte to screen)  $^$ 0xd720

    LDX .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd723
    INX                                                 ; } increment width (was decremented  $^$ 0xd725
    BNE +                                               ; } one too many times)  $^$ 0xd726
    INC .vduTempStoreDD                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd728

    ; we are going to write a line of completely filled bytes.
    ; first calculate the number of bytes we need to fill (= width in pixels / pixels per byte)
+
    TXA                                                 ; A = X = width low byte  $^$ 0xd72a
    PHA                                                 ; Push width (low)  $^$ 0xd72b
    LSR .vduTempStoreDD                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd72c
    ROR                                                 ; } divide .vduTempStoreDD (high byte) and Accumulator (low byte) by two  $^$ 0xd72e
    LDY .vduPixelsPerByteMinusOne                       ; get number of pixels/byte  $^$ 0xd72f
    CPY #3                                              ; check for four colour MODEs  $^$ 0xd732
    BEQ +                                               ; if (four colour MODE) then branch (only divide by 2 once more)  $^$ 0xd734
    BCC .finishedGettingByteCount                       ; if (>four colour mode, i.e. MODE 2) then branch  $^$ 0xd736

    ; two colour mode
    LSR .vduTempStoreDD                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd738
    ROR                                                 ; } divide .vduTempStoreDD (high byte) and Accumulator (low byte) by two  $^$ 0xd73a

    ; four colour mode
+
    LSR .vduTempStoreDD                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd73b
    LSR                                                 ; } divide .vduTempStoreDD (high byte) and Accumulator (low byte) by two  $^$ 0xd73d


    ; finished getting the number of bytes to fill. At this point the accumulator holds the
    ; number of filled bytes we need to draw
.finishedGettingByteCount
    LDY .vduGraphicsCursorVerticalOffsetInCell          ; Y=line in current graphics cell containing current point  $^$ 0xd73e
    TAX                                                 ; X=number of bytes to fill  $^$ 0xd741
    BEQ .finalByte                                      ; if (no full bytes to write) then branch (plot final byte)  $^$ 0xd742

    ; loop to fill all the complete bytes we can
.loopPlotBytes
    TYA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd744
    SEC                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd745
    SBC #8                                              ; } Y=Y-8, move to next cell left  $^$ 0xd746
    TAY                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd748

    BCS +                                               ;  $^$ 0xd749
    DEC .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellHigh       ; decrement high byte of current graphics cursor  $^$ 0xd74b
+
    JSR .plotByte                                       ; display a filled byte  $^$ 0xd74d
    DEX                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd750
    BNE .loopPlotBytes                                  ; if (more bytes to fill) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xd751

    ; now we may need to plot some pixels into the final byte
.finalByte
    PLA                                                 ; restore pixel width  $^$ 0xd753
    AND .vduPixelsPerByteMinusOne                       ; check modulo pixels per byte  $^$ 0xd754
    BEQ .donePlottingPoints                             ; if (no remainder, i.e. no more pixels to write) then branch  $^$ 0xd757
    TAX                                                 ; remainder = loop counter  $^$ 0xd759
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0  $^$ 0xd75a

-
    ASL                                                 ; shift A  $^$ 0xd75c
    ORA .vduColourMaskRight                             ; OR with right colour mask  $^$ 0xd75d
    DEX                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd760
    BNE -                                               ; if (not done shifting the right colour mask) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xd761

    STA .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ; store as byte mask  $^$ 0xd763
    TYA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd765
    SEC                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd766
    SBC #8                                              ; } Y=Y-8  $^$ 0xd767
    TAY                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd769
    BCS +                                               ; if (carry set) then branch  $^$ 0xd76a
    DEC .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellHigh       ; decrement byte of top line off current graphics cursor cell  $^$ 0xd76c
+
    JSR .plotPointWithinBoundsAtY                       ; display final point  $^$ 0xd76e
    JMP .donePlottingPoints                             ; jump to next point  $^$ 0xd771

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Update one edge when filling a triangle
;
; Update the variables of one edge, looping if needed to move the position up by one row.
; We update either the 'main line' or the 'minor line'. See .plotFillTriangle.
;
; On Entry:
;       X = .vduPlotTriMainLineErrorTermLow  - .vduVariablesStart    to update the main edge
;       X = .vduPlotTriMinorLineErrorTermLow - .vduVariablesStart    to update the minor edge
;
; Offsets 0-10 from X are used in the code below and refer to:
;
;       0,1 = error term
;       2,3 = delta X
;       4,5 = delta Y
;       6,7 = current point X
;       8,9 = current point Y
;       10  = X direction flag (top bit set means decrement X, otherwise increment X)
;
; See .vduPlotTriMainLineErrorTermLow for the variables.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.fillTriangleUpdateLinePosition
    INC .vduVariablesStart + 8,X                        ; }  $^$ 0xd774
    BNE +                                               ; } Increment current Y position  $^$ 0xd777
    INC .vduVariablesStart + 9,X                        ; }  $^$ 0xd779
+
    SEC                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd77c
    LDA .vduVariablesStart,X                            ; }  $^$ 0xd77d
    SBC .vduVariablesStart + 2,X                        ; }  $^$ 0xd780
    STA .vduVariablesStart,X                            ; } error -= delta X  $^$ 0xd783
    LDA .vduVariablesStart + 1,X                        ; }  $^$ 0xd786
    SBC .vduVariablesStart + 3,X                        ; }  $^$ 0xd789
    STA .vduVariablesStart + 1,X                        ; }  $^$ 0xd78c
    BPL .exit11                                         ; if (error >=0) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xd78f

.fillTriangleUpdatePositionLoop
    LDA .vduVariablesStart + 10,X                       ;  $^$ 0xd791
    BMI .fillTriangleMoveLeft                           ; if (X direction flag set) then branch  $^$ 0xd794

.fillTriangleMoveRight
    INC .vduVariablesStart + 6,X                        ; }  $^$ 0xd796
    BNE .updateErrorTerm                                ; } increment current X  $^$ 0xd799
    INC .vduVariablesStart + 7,X                        ; }  $^$ 0xd79b
    JMP .updateErrorTerm                                ; jump forward  $^$ 0xd79e

.fillTriangleMoveLeft
    LDA .vduVariablesStart + 6,X                        ; }  $^$ 0xd7a1
    BNE +                                               ; }  $^$ 0xd7a4
    DEC .vduVariablesStart + 7,X                        ; } decrement current X  $^$ 0xd7a6
+                                                       ; }
    DEC .vduVariablesStart + 6,X                        ; }  $^$ 0xd7a9

.updateErrorTerm
    CLC                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd7ac
    LDA .vduVariablesStart,X                            ; }  $^$ 0xd7ad
    ADC .vduVariablesStart+4,X                          ; }  $^$ 0xd7b0
    STA .vduVariablesStart,X                            ; } error += deltaY  $^$ 0xd7b3
    LDA .vduVariablesStart+1,X                          ; }  $^$ 0xd7b6
    ADC .vduVariablesStart+5,X                          ; }  $^$ 0xd7b9
    STA .vduVariablesStart+1,X                          ; }  $^$ 0xd7bc
    BMI .fillTriangleUpdatePositionLoop                 ; if (still on same row) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xd7bf

.exit11
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd7c1


; ***************************************************************************************
; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Chapter 9: Cursor editing mode
;
; ***************************************************************************************
; ***************************************************************************************

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 135 - Read character at text cursor position
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte135EntryPoint
    LDY .vduNumberOfLogicalColoursMinusOne              ; get number of logical colours for current MODE  $^$ 0xd7c2
    BNE .nonMODE7ReadCharacter                          ; if (MODE is not 7) then branch  $^$ 0xd7c5
    LDA (.vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow),Y             ; read MODE 7 character from screen  $^$ 0xd7c7
    LDY #2                                              ; Y=2  $^$ 0xd7c9
-
    CMP .teletextCharacterConversionTable + 1,Y         ; compare with conversion table  $^$ 0xd7cb
    BNE +                                               ; if (not equal) then branch  $^$ 0xd7ce
    LDA .teletextCharacterConversionTable,Y             ; get previous byte from table  $^$ 0xd7d0
    DEY                                                 ; Y=Y-1  $^$ 0xd7d3
+
    DEY                                                 ; Y=Y-1  $^$ 0xd7d4
    BPL -                                               ; if (+ve) then branch (loop back and do it again)  $^$ 0xd7d5
.finishUpFX135
    LDY .vduCurrentScreenMODE                           ; Y = current screen MODE  $^$ 0xd7d7
    TAX                                                 ; X = character  $^$ 0xd7da
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd7db

; ***************************************************************************************
.nonMODE7ReadCharacter
    JSR .readCharacterDefinitionMaskFromScreen          ; read from screen, making a one bit  $^$ 0xd7dc
