                                                        ; mask of 8 bytes to match against
                                                        ; each character, in workspaceA-H
    LDX #.charSPACE                                     ; Start with the space character (loop counter)  $^$ 0xd7df
.readCharLoop
    TXA                                                 ; Loop through each character in turn looking to see if it matches workspaceA-H  $^$ 0xd7e1
    PHA                                                 ; Save character  $^$ 0xd7e2
    JSR .getCharacterDefinitionAddress                  ; get character definition address for character A  $^$ 0xd7e3
    PLA                                                 ; recall character  $^$ 0xd7e6
    TAX                                                 ; move to X  $^$ 0xd7e7
-
    LDY #7                                              ; Y=7  $^$ 0xd7e8
--
    LDA .vduWorkspaceA,Y                                ; get byte in workspaceA-H copy  $^$ 0xd7ea
    CMP (.vduTempStoreDE),Y                             ; check against character definition  $^$ 0xd7ed
    BNE +                                               ; if (not the same) then branch (to skip to next character)  $^$ 0xd7ef
    DEY                                                 ; Y--  $^$ 0xd7f1
    BPL --                                              ; if (still non-negative) then branch (back to loop eight times, to check each row of the character)  $^$ 0xd7f2
    TXA                                                 ; At this point the character matches  $^$ 0xd7f4
    CPX #.charDELETE                                    ; but if it's the DELETE character then pretend we didn't match and carry on  $^$ 0xd7f5
    BNE .finishUpFX135                                  ; if (we are NOT the DELETE character) then branch (to finish up)  $^$ 0xd7f7
+
    INX                                                 ; no match on this character so increment to next character  $^$ 0xd7f9
    LDA .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd7fa
    CLC                                                 ; } Add 8 to address of character definition to move on to the next character  $^$ 0xd7fc
    ADC #8                                              ; } Affects low byte only as we check one page of characters at a time  $^$ 0xd7fd
    STA .vduTempStoreDE                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd7ff
    BNE -                                               ; if (we have not reached the end of the page) then branch (back to check the character)  $^$ 0xd801

    TXA                                                 ; A=X  $^$ 0xd803
    BNE .readCharLoop                                   ; if (character number not zero) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xd804
    BEQ .finishUpFX135                                  ; ALWAYS branch (finish up)  $^$ 0xd806

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Read character from screen pixels
;
; Reads 8x8 cell of pixels from the screen. This will be compared against each of the
; character definitions to determine which character is on screen. This is for the
; cursor editing mode feature.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.readCharacterDefinitionMaskFromScreen
    LDY #7                                              ; Y=7  $^$ 0xd808
.setupPatternLoop
    STY .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; .vduTempStoreDA=Y (loop counter)  $^$ 0xd80a
    LDA #1                                              ; A=1  $^$ 0xd80c
    STA .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; .vduTempStoreDB=A  $^$ 0xd80e
--
    LDA .vduColourMaskLeft                              ; A=left colour mask  $^$ 0xd810
    STA .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; store in .vduTempStoreDC  $^$ 0xd813
    LDA (.vduWriteCursorScreenAddressLow),Y             ; get a byte from current text character  $^$ 0xd815
    EOR .vduBackgroundTextColour                        ; EOR with text background colour  $^$ 0xd817
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xd81a
-
    BIT .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; and check bits of colour mask  $^$ 0xd81b
    BEQ +                                               ; if (result = 0) then branch (this becomes a zero bit in our mask)  $^$ 0xd81d
    SEC                                                 ; set carry. This becomes a one bit in our mask  $^$ 0xd81f
+
    ROL .vduTempStoreDB                                 ; Rotate left and add the carry in the low bit  $^$ 0xd820
    BCS +                                               ; if (carry now set; bit 7 originally set) then branch (because we are done:  $^$ 0xd822
                                                        ;               the initial value of 1 has rotated through the 8 bits and into the carry)
    LSR .vduTempStoreDC                                 ; shift mask right one place for the next pixel  $^$ 0xd824
    BCC -                                               ; if (carry clear; nothing shifted off the left) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xd826
    TYA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd828
    ADC #7                                              ; } Y = Y + 8 (Carry is set, so adding 7 + carry = 8)  $^$ 0xd829
    TAY                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd82b
    BCC --                                              ; if (no overflow from the add) then branch (loop back, move on to the next cell to read from)  $^$ 0xd82c
+
    LDY .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; read modified values into Y and A  $^$ 0xd82e
    LDA .vduTempStoreDB                                 ;  $^$ 0xd830
    STA .vduWorkspaceA,Y                                ; store copy  $^$ 0xd832
    DEY                                                 ; and do it again  $^$ 0xd835
    BPL .setupPatternLoop                               ; until 8 bytes copied  $^$ 0xd836
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd838

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Read pixel
;
; On Entry:
;       A = VDU variable offset for the graphics coordinates to use.
;
; On Exit:
;       A = current colour at the coordinate specified OR
;       A = $FF if coordinate is out of bounds
; ***************************************************************************************
.readPixel
    PHA                                                 ; store A  $^$ 0xd839
    TAX                                                 ; X=A  $^$ 0xd83a
    JSR .plotConvertExternalAbsoluteCoordinatesToPixels ; set up positional data  $^$ 0xd83b
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xd83e
    TAX                                                 ; X=A  $^$ 0xd83f
    JSR .checkPointXInBoundsAndSetScreenAddresses       ; set a screen address after checking for window bounds  $^$ 0xd840
    BNE ++                                              ; if (out of bounds) then branch (exit with A=$FF)  $^$ 0xd843
    LDA (.vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow),Y    ; get row of current graphics cell  $^$ 0xd845
-
    ASL                                                 ; A=A*2, Carry=bit 7  $^$ 0xd847
    ROL .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; .vduTempStoreDA=.vduTempStoreDA+2 +Carry,  $^$ 0xd848
                                                        ; Carry=bit 7 of .vduTempStoreDA
    ASL .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ; byte mask=byte mask*2 + Carry  $^$ 0xd84a
    PHP                                                 ; save flags  $^$ 0xd84c
    BCS +                                               ; if (carry set) then branch  $^$ 0xd84d
    LSR .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; restore .vduTempStoreDA with bit 7=0  $^$ 0xd84f
+
    PLP                                                 ; pull flags  $^$ 0xd851
    BNE -                                               ; if (Z set) then branch  $^$ 0xd852
    LDA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; A=.vduTempStoreDA AND number of colours in current MODE -1  $^$ 0xd854
    AND .vduNumberOfLogicalColoursMinusOne              ;  $^$ 0xd856
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd859

++
    LDA #$FF                                            ; A=$FF  $^$ 0xd85a
-
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd85c


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Check the graphics point on the VDU queue is within the graphics window
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.checkParameterInBoundsAndSetScreenAddresses
    LDX #.vdu25ParameterXLow - .vduVariablesStart       ; X is the offset to the desired parameter for the point in graphics coordinates  $^$ 0xd85d
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Check the given point is within the graphics window
;
; Takes the graphics coordinates pointed to by X, checks whether they are in the bounds of
; the graphics window, and if so sets up screen addresses.
;
; On Entry:
;       X is the vdu variables offset to the graphics point to check
; On Exit:
;       .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow/High is the screen address
;       Y is the vertical offset within the character cell (0-7)
;       Z is clear (i.e. BNE will branch) if coordinates are outside the graphics area
; ***************************************************************************************
.checkPointXInBoundsAndSetScreenAddresses
    JSR .checkPointXIsWithinGraphicsWindow              ;  $^$ 0xd85f
    BNE -                                               ; if (point is not in graphics window) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xd862
.setScreenAddress
    LDA .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsBottomLow,X             ; read low byte of Y coordinate  $^$ 0xd864
    EOR #$FF                                            ; Flip the coordinates to be from the top of the screen  $^$ 0xd867
    TAY                                                 ; Remember in Y  $^$ 0xd869
    AND #7                                              ; A = row within a character cell  $^$ 0xd86a
    STA .vduGraphicsCursorVerticalOffsetInCell          ; store row (0-7)  $^$ 0xd86c
    TYA                                                 ; A=Y  $^$ 0xd86f
    LSR                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd870
    LSR                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd871
    LSR                                                 ; } divide by 8  $^$ 0xd872
    ASL                                                 ; Multiply by two to give the offset in the multiplication table  $^$ 0xd873
    TAY                                                 ; Y = offset into multiplication table  $^$ 0xd874
    LDA (.vduMultiplicationTableLow),Y                  ; Get high byte of offset from screen RAM start  $^$ 0xd875
    STA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; store it  $^$ 0xd877
    INY                                                 ; Y=Y+1  $^$ 0xd879
    LDA (.vduMultiplicationTableLow),Y                  ; get low byte  $^$ 0xd87a
    LDY .vduCurrentScreenMODEGroup                      ; check MODE group  $^$ 0xd87c
    BEQ +                                               ; if (zero, i.e. MODEs 0,1,2) then branch (skip this next bit)  $^$ 0xd87f
    LSR .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; } divide the offset by two  $^$ 0xd881
    ROR                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd883
+
    ADC .vduScreenTopLeftAddressLow                     ; add the screen top left address (low)  $^$ 0xd884
    STA .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow        ; store it  $^$ 0xd887
    LDA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; get high byte  $^$ 0xd889
    ADC .vduScreenTopLeftAddressHigh                    ; add with carry the screen top left address (high)  $^$ 0xd88b
    STA .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellHigh       ; store it  $^$ 0xd88e
    LDA .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsLeftHigh,X              ;  $^$ 0xd890
    STA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; store x coordinate of point (high)  $^$ 0xd893
    LDA .vduGraphicsWindowPixelsLeftLow,X               ; get x coordinate of point (low)  $^$ 0xd895
    PHA                                                 ; remember it  $^$ 0xd898
    AND .vduPixelsPerByteMinusOne                       ; get the horizontal X offset within the range of pixelsPerByte  $^$ 0xd899
    ADC .vduPixelsPerByteMinusOne                       ; add the pixels per byte minus one,  $^$ 0xd89c
                                                        ; which offsets to (one more than) the
                                                        ; start of the MODE mask table for the
                                                        ; current MODE
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A  $^$ 0xd89f
    LDA .sixteenColourMODEMaskTable - 1,Y               ; read byte mask  $^$ 0xd8a0
    STA .vduCurrentPlotByteMask                         ; store it  $^$ 0xd8a3
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xd8a5
    LDY .vduPixelsPerByteMinusOne                       ; Y=number of pixels per byte minus one  $^$ 0xd8a6
    CPY #3                                              ; compare with 3  $^$ 0xd8a9
    BEQ +                                               ; if (MODE 1 or 5) then branch forward  $^$ 0xd8ab
    BCS ++                                              ; if (MODE 0 or 4) then branch forward  $^$ 0xd8ad
    ASL                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd8af
    ROL .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; } (A,.vduTempStoreDA) *= 2  $^$ 0xd8b0
+
    ASL                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xd8b2
    ROL .vduTempStoreDA                                 ; } (A,.vduTempStoreDA) *= 2  $^$ 0xd8b3
++
    AND #$F8                                            ; clear bits 0-2  $^$ 0xd8b5
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xd8b7
    ADC .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow        ; add A/.vduTempStoreDA to screen address  $^$ 0xd8b8
    STA .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellLow        ;  $^$ 0xd8ba
    LDA .vduTempStoreDA                                 ;  $^$ 0xd8bc
    ADC .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellHigh       ;  $^$ 0xd8be
    BPL +                                               ; if (result +ve) then branch  $^$ 0xd8c0
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xd8c2
    SBC .vduScreenSizeHighByte                          ; and subtract screen memory size making it wrap round  $^$ 0xd8c3
+
    STA .vduScreenAddressOfGraphicsCursorCellHigh       ; store it  $^$ 0xd8c6
    LDY .vduGraphicsCursorVerticalOffsetInCell          ; get line in graphics cell containing current graphics  $^$ 0xd8c8
.zeroAReturn
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0 to set Z flag (valid result)  $^$ 0xd8cb
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd8cd

; ***************************************************************************************
.splitIntoTwoCursors
    PHA                                                 ; Push A  $^$ 0xd8ce
    LDA #$A0                                            ; A=$A0  $^$ 0xd8cf
    LDX .twosComplimentOfNumberOfBytesInVDUQueue        ; X=number of items in VDU queue  $^$ 0xd8d1
    BNE .pullAndReturn2                                 ; if (not 0) then branch  $^$ 0xd8d4
    BIT .vduStatusByte                                  ; check VDU status byte  $^$ 0xd8d6
    BNE .pullAndReturn2                                 ; if (either VDU is disabled, or plot to graphics cursor enabled) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xd8d8
    BVS +                                               ; if (cursor editing mode enabled) then branch  $^$ 0xd8da
    LDA .vduLastCursorStartRegisterValue                ; get CRTC register start setting  $^$ 0xd8dc
    AND #%10011111                                      ; clear bits 5 and 6  $^$ 0xd8df
    ORA #%01000000                                      ; set bit 6 to modify last cursor size setting  $^$ 0xd8e1
    JSR .setCursorOnOrOff                               ; change cursor format  $^$ 0xd8e3
    LDX #.vduTextCursorXPosition - .vduVariablesStart          ; source = text cursor  $^$ 0xd8e6
    LDY #.vduTextInputCursorXCoordinate - .vduVariablesStart   ; destination = text input cursor  $^$ 0xd8e8
    JSR .copyTwoBytesWithinVDUVariables                 ; set text input cursor from text output cursor  $^$ 0xd8ea
    JSR .restoreWriteCursor                             ; modify character at cursor position  $^$ 0xd8ed
    LDA #2                                              ;  $^$ 0xd8f0
    JSR .setVDUStatusByteFlags                          ; bit 1 of VDU status is set to bar scrolling  $^$ 0xd8f2
+
    LDA #%10111111                                      ;  $^$ 0xd8f5
    JSR .clearVDUStatusByteFlags                        ; bit 6 of VDU status (separated cursors) is set to zero  $^$ 0xd8f7
    PLA                                                 ; Pull A  $^$ 0xd8fa
    AND #%01111111                                      ; clear high bit (7)  $^$ 0xd8fb
    JSR .vduChrEntryPoint                               ; call VDU routine  $^$ 0xd8fd
    LDA #%01000000                                      ; set bit six (separate cursors)  $^$ 0xd900
    JMP .setVDUStatusByteFlags                          ; set separated cursors and return  $^$ 0xd902

; ***************************************************************************************
.readCharacterFromScreenAndCursorRight
    LDA #%00100000                                      ; A=$20  $^$ 0xd905
    BIT .vduStatusByte                                  ;  $^$ 0xd907
    BVC .zeroAReturn                                    ; if (bit 6 clear; not in cursor editing mode) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xd909
    BNE .zeroAReturn                                    ; if (bit 5 set; graphics cursor enabled) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xd90b
    JSR .osbyte135EntryPoint                            ; read a character from the screen  $^$ 0xd90d
    BEQ .exit12                                         ; if (A = 0, i.e. failed to read) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xd910
    PHA                                                 ; store A  $^$ 0xd912
    JSR .vdu9EntryPoint                                 ; perform cursor right  $^$ 0xd913
.pullAndReturn2
    PLA                                                 ; restore A  $^$ 0xd916
.exit12
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd917

; ***************************************************************************************
; When editing a line with two cursors, pressing return terminates the edit.
; This clears the VDU status flags and restores the text cursor to normal.
.terminateEdit
    LDA #%10111101                                      ; }  $^$ 0xd918
    JSR .clearVDUStatusByteFlags                        ; } clear bits 2 and 6 of VDU status (page scrolling; separated cursors)  $^$ 0xd91a
    JSR .setTextCursor                                  ; set text cursor (CRTC hardware)  $^$ 0xd91d
    LDA #.charRETURN                                    ; continue processing as a RETURN character  $^$ 0xd920
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd922


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 132 - Read HIMEM (start of screen memory)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte132EntryPoint
    LDX .vduCurrentScreenMODE                           ; get current screen MODE  $^$ 0xd923
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 133 - Read start of screen memory for given MODE
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte133EntryPoint
    TXA                                                 ; X=MODE number  $^$ 0xd926
    AND #7                                              ; keep it in range 0-7  $^$ 0xd927
    TAY                                                 ; Y=MODE number  $^$ 0xd929
    LDX .screenDisplayMemoryIndexTable,Y                ; X = get screen RAM size index  $^$ 0xd92a
    LDA .screenMemoryStartHigh,X                        ; A = high byte of start address  $^$ 0xd92d
    LDX #0                                              ; X = 0 (low byte of result)  $^$ 0xd930
    BIT .systemAvailableRAM                             ; get available RAM  $^$ 0xd932
    BMI .returnTheScreenAddress                         ; if (32k available) then branch  $^$ 0xd935
    AND #$3F                                            ; AND A with $3F to bring into memory range for a 16K BBC Micro  $^$ 0xd937
    CPY #4                                              ;  $^$ 0xd939
    BCS .returnTheScreenAddress                         ; if (MODE number >= 4) then branch (to return the value)  $^$ 0xd93b
    TXA                                                 ; return zero (Model A can't display MODEs 0-3)  $^$ 0xd93d
.returnTheScreenAddress
    TAY                                                 ; Y = high byte of screen address  $^$ 0xd93e
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xd93f


; ***************************************************************************************
; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Chapter 10: Resets
;
; ***************************************************************************************
; ***************************************************************************************


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Default vector table
;
; Default handlers for vectors, used at RESET time.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.defaultVectorTable
    ;     value                     name           address      address label
    !word .badCommandError        ; USERV          $0200-1      .vectorUSERV
    !word .brkHandler             ; BRKV           $0202-3      .vectorBRKV
    !word .irq1Handler            ; IRQ1V          $0204-5      .vectorIRQ1V
    !word .irq2Handler            ; IRQ2V          $0206-7      .vectorIRQ2V
    !word .oscliEntryPoint        ; CLIV           $0208-9      .vectorCLIV
    !word .osbyteEntryPoint       ; BYTEV          $020A-B      .vectorBYTEV
    !word .oswordEntryPoint       ; WORDV          $020C-D      .vectorWORDV
    !word .oswrchEntryPoint       ; WRCHV          $020E-F      .vectorWRCHV
    !word .osrdchEntryPoint       ; RDCHV          $0210-1      .vectorRDCHV
.defaultFileSystemVectors
    !word .osfileEntryPoint       ; FILEV          $0212-3      .vectorFILEV
    !word .osargsEntryPoint       ; ARGSV          $0214-5      .vectorARGSV
    !word .osbgetEntryPoint       ; BGETV          $0216-7      .vectorBGETV
    !word .osbputEntryPoint       ; BPUTV          $0218-9      .vectorBPUTV
    !word .return                 ; GBPBV          $021A-B      .vectorGBPBV
    !word .osfindEntryPoint       ; FINDV          $021C-D      .vectorFINDV
    !word .fscEntryPoint          ; FSCV           $021E-F      .vectorFSCV
    !word .return                 ; EVNTV          $0220-1      .vectorEVNTV
    !word .return                 ; UPTV           $0222-3      .vectorUPTV
    !word .return                 ; NETV           $0224-5      .vectorNETV
    !word .return                 ; VDUV           $0226-7      .vectorVDUV
    !word .keyEntryPoint          ; KEYV           $0228-9      .vectorKEYV
    !word .insEntryPoint          ; INSBV          $022A-B      .vectorINSV
    !word .remEntryPoint          ; REMVB          $022C-D      .vectorREMV
    !word .cnpEntryPoint          ; CNPV           $022E-F      .vectorCNPV
    !word .return                 ; IND1V          $0230-1      .vectorIND1V
    !word .return                 ; IND2V          $0232-3      .vectorIND2V
    !word .return                 ; IND3V          $0234-5      .vectorIND3V
.defaultVectorTableEnd

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; MOS Variables Default Values
;
; Read/written by OSBYTEs 166-252
;
; ***************************************************************************************

    !word .mosVariablesMinus166   ; MOS variables address (add OSBYTE number)     $0236-7   *FX 166/7
    !word .extendedVectorSpace    ; Address of ROM pointer table                  $0238-9   *FX 168/9
    !word .romTypeTable           ; ROM information table address                 $023A-B   *FX 170/1
    !word .keyDataTable1 - 16     ; Key translation table address                 $023C-D   *FX 172/3
    !word .vduVariablesStart      ; VDU variables start                           $023E-F   *FX 174/5
    !byte 0                       ; vertical sync counter                         $0240     *FX 176
    !byte 0                       ; current input buffer number                   $0241     *FX 177
    !byte $FF                     ; keyboard interrupt enable flag ($FF=enabled)  $0242     *FX 178
    !byte 0                       ; primary OSHWM (default PAGE)                  $0243     *FX 179
    !byte 0                       ; current OSHWM (PAGE)                          $0244     *FX 180
    !byte 1                       ; RS-423 Mode                                   $0245     *FX 181
    !byte 0                       ; character definition explosion state          $0246     *FX 182
    !byte 0                       ; Filing system flag ROM=2; tape=0              $0247     *FX 183
    !byte 0                       ; current Video ULA control register            $0248     *FX 184
    !byte 0                       ; current palette setting                       $0249     *FX 185
    !byte 0                       ; number of ROM enabled at last BRK             $024A     *FX 186
    !byte $FF                     ; number of BASIC ROM                           $024B     *FX 187
    !byte 4                       ; current ADC channel number                    $024C     *FX 188
    !byte 4                       ; maximum ADC channel number                    $024D     *FX 189
    !byte 0                       ; ADC conversion type: 0 or $0C=12 bit; 8=8 Bit $024E     *FX 190
    !byte $FF                     ; RS-423 busy flag (bit 7 clear=busy)           $024F     *FX 191
    !byte $56                     ; curent ACIA control register setting          $0250     *FX 192
    !byte $19                     ; flash counter                                 $0251     *FX 193
    !byte $19                     ; mark period count                             $0252     *FX 194
    !byte $19                     ; space period count                            $0253     *FX 195
    !byte 50                      ; keyboard Auto-repeat delay                    $0254     *FX 196
    !byte 8                       ; keyboard Auto-repeat rate                     $0255     *FX 197
    !byte 0                       ; *EXEC file handle  (0 -not allocated)         $0256     *FX 198
    !byte 0                       ; *SPOOL file handle (0 -not allocated)         $0257     *FX 199
    !byte 0                       ; bit 0 Escape enable/disable                   $0258     *FX 200
                                  ; bit 1 BREAK normal/clear memory
    !byte 0                       ; Econet disable keyboard flag                  $0259     *FX 201
    !byte %00100000               ; keyboard status    bit 3=1 SHIFT pressed      $025A     *FX 202
                                  ;                    bit 4=0 CAPS LOCK
                                  ;                    bit 5=0 SHIFT LOCK
                                  ;                    bit 6=1 CTRL pressed
                                  ;                    bit 7=1 SHIFT enabled
    !byte 9                       ; buffer space left at buffer full signal       $025B     *FX 203
    !byte 0                       ; RS-423 input suppression flag                 $025C     *FX 204
    !byte 0                       ; cassette/RS-423 flag (0=tape, $40=RS-423)     $025D     *FX 205
    !byte 0                       ; Econet OS call interception flag (bit 7)      $025E     *FX 206
    !byte 0                       ; Econet OSRDCH interception flag (bit 7)       $025F     *FX 207
    !byte 0                       ; Econet OSWRCH interception flag (bit 7)       $0260     *FX 208
    !byte $50                     ; speech enable/disable flag ($50/$20)          $0261     *FX 209
    !byte 0                       ; sound output disable flag                     $0262     *FX 210
    !byte 3                       ; BELL channel number                           $0263     *FX 211
    !byte $90                     ; BELL amplitude (or envelope number)           $0264     *FX 212
    !byte 100                     ; BELL pitch (approx Treble C, 523.013Hz)       $0265     *FX 213
    !byte 6                       ; BELL duration (in 20ths of a second)          $0266     *FX 214
    !byte $81                     ; bit 7=0 ignore start up message               $0267     *FX 215
                                  ; bit 0=1 lock up if !BOOT error from *disc* and no language set
    !byte 0                       ; length of KEY string                          $0268     *FX 216
    !byte 0                       ; PRINT line counter                            $0269     *FX 217
    !byte 0                       ; 2s compliment of number of items in VDU queue $026A     *FX 218
    !byte 9                       ; TAB key value                                 $026B     *FX 219
    !byte $1B                     ; ESCAPE Character                              $026C     *FX 220

    ; The following four bytes are how characters are interpreted when placed into an input buffer

    !byte $01                     ; C0-CF                                         $026D     *FX 221
    !byte $D0                     ; D0-DF                                         $026E     *FX 222
    !byte $E0                     ; E0-EF                                         $026F     *FX 223
    !byte $F0                     ; F0-FF                                         $0270     *FX 224

    ; The next four bytes are the key status (soft key or codes) for:
    ;
    ;            function key
    ;      SHIFT-function key
    ;       CTRL-function key
    ; CTRL-SHIFT-function key
    ;
    ; 0 means ignore key
    ; 1 means expand as the normal soft key number
    ; 2-$FF means expand as the normal soft key number + this value

    !byte $01                     ; 80-8F                                         $0271     *FX 225
    !byte $80                     ; 90-9F                                         $0272     *FX 226
    !byte $90                     ; A0-AF                                         $0273     *FX 227
    !byte $00                     ; B0-BF                                         $0274     *FX 228

    !byte $00                     ; ESCAPE key status (0=ESC, 1=ASCII)            $0275     *FX 229
    !byte $00                     ; ESCAPE action                                 $0276     *FX 230
.allBitsSet
    !byte $FF                     ; User VIA 6522 Bit IRQ mask                    $0277     *FX 231
    !byte $FF                     ; ACIA 6850 Bit IRQ bit mask                    $0278     *FX 232
    !byte $FF                     ; System VIA 6522 IRQ bit mask                  $0279     *FX 233
    !byte $00                     ; Tube presence flag                            $027A     *FX 234
    !byte $00                     ; speech processor presence flag                $027B     *FX 235
    !byte $00                     ; character destination status                  $027C     *FX 236
    !byte $00                     ; cursor editing state                          $027D     *FX 237

.softResetHWM
; ************************* SOFT reset high water mark **********************************

    !byte $00                     ; unused                                        $027E     *FX 238
    !byte $00                     ; unused                                        $027F     *FX 239
    !byte $00                     ; country code (0=UK,1=US)                      $0280     *FX 240
    !byte $00                     ; user flag                                     $0281     *FX 241
    !byte $64                     ; serial ULA control register setting           $0282     *FX 242
    !byte $05                     ; current system clock store pointer            $0283     *FX 243
    !byte $FF                     ; soft key status (inconsistent)                $0284     *FX 244
    !byte $01                     ; printer destination (parallel printer)        $0285     *FX 245
    !byte 10                      ; printer ignore character (line feed)          $0286     *FX 246

.hardResetHWM
; ************************* HARD reset high water mark **********************************

    !byte $00                     ; user BREAK routine address JMP                $0287     *FX 247
    !byte $00                     ; user BREAK routine address low                $0288     *FX 248
    !byte $00                     ; user BREAK routine address high               $0289     *FX 249
    !byte $00                     ; unused                                        $028A     *FX 250
    !byte $00                     ; unused                                        $028B     *FX 251
    !byte $FF                     ; current language ROM number                   $028C     *FX 252

.powerOnResetHWM
; ********************** RESET High Water mark for Power on *****************************

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Reset entry point
;
; Called on:
;       * Power on
;       * when a HARD BREAK occurs      (CTRL BREAK keys)
;       * when a SOFT BREAK occurs      (BREAK key)
;
; On Entry:
;       On power on: 6522 System VIA IER bits 0 to 6 will all be clear
;       On BREAK   : 6522 System VIA IER bits 0 to 6 at least one bit will be set
;
; This code runs through a list of steps:
;
;     * Store an RTI instruction at $0D00 (to stop executing any more NMI routines)
;     * Disable interrupts (stop executing any more IRQs)
;     * Clear decimal flag (decimal mode is never used within the OS. IRQ interrupts turn
;       it off while they run. Decimal mode must be off before calling any OS routine)
;     * Reset the stack pointer
;     * Clear RAM if needed (also detect amount of RAM present, either 16k or 32k, and
;       record this)
;     * Initialise System VIA registers
;     * Read keyboard
;     * Initialise OS vectors and variables ($0200 upwards, amount depending on type of
;       reset)
;     * Initialise JIM (which gives access to an optional 64k or more of Paged Memory)
;     * Enable some interrupts
;     * Clear sounds
;     * Initialise ROMs
;     * Initialise speech system if present
;     * Clear the screen
;     * Insert F10 key code into keyboard buffer if needed (implements effect of *KEY 10)
;     * Execute user boot code if present
;     * Set cassette options
;     * Initialise Tube
;     * Initialise ROMs (post Tube initialisation)
;     * Show 'BBC Computer 32K' message (or "16K", or no memory number on a SOFT BREAK)
;     * Initialise keyboard LEDs
;     * Select Filing System ROM
;     * Execute !BOOT if needed
;     * Find best language to enter, and enter it
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.resetEntryPoint
    LDA #$40                                            ; the numerical value of the RTI opcode  $^$ 0xd9cd
    STA .nmiEntryPoint                                  ; store RTI instruction at the start of the NMI routine  $^$ 0xd9cf

    SEI                                                 ; disable interrupts just in case  $^$ 0xd9d2
    CLD                                                 ; clear decimal flag  $^$ 0xd9d3
    LDX #$FF                                            ; reset stack to where it should be  $^$ 0xd9d4
    TXS                                                 ; ($01FF)  $^$ 0xd9d6
    LDA .systemVIAInterruptEnableRegister               ; read interupt enable register of the system VIA  $^$ 0xd9d7
    ASL                                                 ; shift bit 7 (reading IER always returns 1 in bit 7) into carry  $^$ 0xd9da
    PHA                                                 ; save what's left (for use later when setting page 2: just before .setUpPage2)  $^$ 0xd9db
    BEQ .clearRAM                                       ; if (power on) then branch  $^$ 0xd9dc
    LDA .escapeAndBreakEffect                           ; read BREAK Action flags (set by *FX200,n)  $^$ 0xd9de
    LSR                                                 ; divide by 2 to get the break action  $^$ 0xd9e1
    CMP #1                                              ;  $^$ 0xd9e2
    BNE .setUpSystemVIA                                 ; if (break action says we don't need to clear RAM) then branch  $^$ 0xd9e4
    LSR                                                 ; set A=0 (since A=1 at this point)  $^$ 0xd9e6
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
; Clears all of RAM except the first byte in each Page. This avoids overwriting the RTI instruction at $0D00.
.clearRAM
    LDX #4                                              ; start clearing memory from page 4 ($0400)  $^$ 0xd9e7
    STX $01                                             ; store a non-zero number at $01  $^$ 0xd9e9
    STA $00                                             ; store A (currently zero) at $00  $^$ 0xd9eb

    TAY                                                 ; and set Y (loop counter) to zero  $^$ 0xd9ed
-
    STA ($00),Y                                         ; clear RAM  $^$ 0xd9ee
    CMP $01                                             ; check high byte of address  $^$ 0xd9f0
    BEQ +                                               ; if (zero) then branch:  $^$ 0xd9f2

    ; This happens when we clear byte $4001 on a 16k machine the RAM memory addressing loops
    ; it around to write a zero into $0001. We are done at this point and branch out to avoid
    ; overwriting the rest of zero page.

    INY                                                 ; increment loop counter  $^$ 0xd9f4
    BNE -                                               ; if (not zero) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xd9f5
    INY                                                 ; increment again (Y=1) this avoids overwriting RTI instruction at $D00  $^$ 0xd9f7
    INX                                                 ; increment X  $^$ 0xd9f8
    INC $01                                             ; increment high byte of address  $^$ 0xd9f9
    BPL -                                               ; loop until A=$80 then exit  $^$ 0xd9fb

+
    STX .systemAvailableRAM                             ; writes marker for available RAM ($40=16k; $80=32k)  $^$ 0xd9fd
    STX .softKeyConsistencyFlag                         ; write non-zero value in soft key consistency flag  $^$ 0xda00
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.setUpSystemVIA
    LDX #%00001111                                      ; set System VIA PORT B to output on bits 0-3; input on bits 4-7  $^$ 0xda03
    STX .systemVIADataDirectionRegisterB                ;  $^$ 0xda05

; The next loop writes 14, 13, 12, 11, 10, 9, 8 in turn to System VIA Register B which:
;       - turns CAPS LOCK off;
;       - sets the hardware scroll address to $3000;
;       - enables keyboard auto scanning;
;       - enable read/write speech;
;       - disable sound;
;
; (See .systemVIARegisterB)
-
    DEX                                                 ; loop counter  $^$ 0xda08
    STX .systemVIARegisterB                             ; write system VIA register B  $^$ 0xda09
    CPX #9                                              ;  $^$ 0xda0c
    BCS -                                               ; if (X>=9) then branch (loop back and do it again)  $^$ 0xda0e
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Read the keyboard 8 times with internal key numbers 9-1
;
; This reads the state of the CTRL key and the 'keyboard links', a set of DIP switches next
; to the keyboard. See .scanKeyboard for internal key numbers.
;
; These are rotated into the 8 bits of .interruptAccumulator for further processing
;
; ***************************************************************************************
    INX                                                 ; X=9 (loop counter)  $^$ 0xda10
-
    TXA                                                 ; Start of loop to interrogate keyboard  $^$ 0xda11
    JSR .interrogateKeyboard                            ; with A = 9...1 which reads keyboard links 9-2 and CTRL key  $^$ 0xda12
    CPX #$80                                            ; set carry if the 'key' or 'link' is 'pressed' or 'set'  $^$ 0xda15
    ROR .interruptAccumulator                           ; rotate carry into MSB into bit 7 of .interruptAccumulator  $^$ 0xda17
    TAX                                                 ; get back value of X for loop  $^$ 0xda19
    DEX                                                 ; decrement it  $^$ 0xda1a
    BNE -                                               ; if (not zero) then branch (do loop again)  $^$ 0xda1b

    ; At this point Carry(C) and .interruptAccumulator holds:
    ; C = }
    ; 0 = } screen MODE on startup
    ; 1 = }
    ; 2 = if clear reverse SHIFT BREAK action
    ; 3 = }
    ; 4 = } set disc drive timings
    ; 5 = not used
    ; 6 = not used
    ; 7 = CTRL key

    STX .lastResetType                                  ; set last reset type = 0  $^$ 0xda1d
    ROL .interruptAccumulator                           ;  $^$ 0xda20

    ; At this point .interruptAccumulator holds keyboard links:
    ; 0 = }
    ; 1 = } screen MODE on startup
    ; 2 = }
    ; 3 = if clear reverse SHIFT BREAK action
    ; 4 = }
    ; 5 = } set disc drive timings
    ; 6 = not used
    ; 7 = not used
    ; C = CTRL key

    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Initialise keyboard lights, Work out what variables to reset
;
; ***************************************************************************************
    JSR .keyboardIndicators                             ; set LEDs. carry flag (CTRL key) is put into bit zero of A  $^$ 0xda22
    ROR                                                 ; put bit zero of A (CTRL key) into carry flag  $^$ 0xda25

    ; set up page 2 based on reset type
    LDX #<.softResetLWM                                 ; X = low water mark for setting OS variables (writes to range $200+X -> $2FF)  $^$ 0xda26
    LDY #.powerOnResetHWM - .defaultVectorTable         ; Y = high water mark for writing default values into OS variables (writes to range $200+Y -> $0200)  $^$ 0xda28
    PLA                                                 ; get back A (which is .systemVIAInterruptEnableRegister shifted left once)  $^$ 0xda2a
    BEQ +                                               ; if (A=0) then branch (power on reset, with X=$9C Y=$8D)  $^$ 0xda2b
    LDY #.softResetHWM - .defaultVectorTable            ; set value for soft reset HWM  $^$ 0xda2d
    BCC .setUpPage2                                     ; if (soft reset) then branch  $^$ 0xda2f
    LDY #.hardResetHWM - .defaultVectorTable            ; hard reset  $^$ 0xda31
    INC .lastResetType                                  ; reset type=1  $^$ 0xda33
+
    INC .lastResetType                                  ; 'power on' or hard reset  $^$ 0xda36
    LDA .interruptAccumulator                           ; get keyboard links set  $^$ 0xda39
    EOR #%11111111                                      ; invert all bits  $^$ 0xda3b
    STA .startUpOptions                                 ; and record as start up options  $^$ 0xda3d
    LDX #<.hardResetLWM                                 ;  $^$ 0xda40
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Reset OS Variables
;
; On Entry:
;       .lastResetType is reset type:
;
;        0    Soft reset    X=<.softResetLWM    Y=.softResetHWM    - .defaultVectorTable
;        1    Power on      X=<.hardResetLWM    Y=.powerOnResetHWM - .defaultVectorTable
;        2    Hard reset    X=<.hardResetLWM    Y=.hardResetHWM    - .defaultVectorTable
;
;   - Set variables at $200+X and up to zero or 255
;   - Copy default values for variables into $0200+Y-1 and below from .defaultVectorTable
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.setUpPage2
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0  $^$ 0xda42
-
    CPX #$CE                                            ; this loop writes zero into the addresses in range $0290/C to $02CD...  $^$ 0xda44
    BCC +                                               ;  $^$ 0xda46
    LDA #$FF                                            ; ... and writes 255 into addresses in range $02CE to $02FF  $^$ 0xda48
+
    STA .page2Start,X                                   ;  $^$ 0xda4a
    INX                                                 ;  $^$ 0xda4d
    BNE -                                               ;  $^$ 0xda4e
                                                        ; At this point A=$FF and X=0
    STA .userVIADataDirectionRegisterA                  ; set port A of user VIA to all outputs (printer out)  $^$ 0xda50
    TXA                                                 ; A=0  $^$ 0xda53
    LDX #$E2                                            ; loop counter  $^$ 0xda54
-
    STA $00,X                                           ; }  $^$ 0xda56
    INX                                                 ; } this loop stores zero in zero-page memory locations $E2 to $FF  $^$ 0xda58
    BNE -                                               ; }  $^$ 0xda59
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Copy the default vectors and MOS variables
;
; Y is the loop counter (set up above, depending on boot type).
; ***************************************************************************************
-
    LDA .defaultVectorTable - 1,Y                       ; read data from default table+Y  $^$ 0xda5b
    STA .page2Start - 1,Y                               ; write data to $0200+Y  $^$ 0xda5e
    DEY                                                 ; decrement loop counter  $^$ 0xda61
    BNE -                                               ; branch back  $^$ 0xda62
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Put a SPACE in the first key pressed variable
;
; ***************************************************************************************
    LDA #.internalKeyNumberSPACEBAR                     ; }  $^$ 0xda64
    STA .firstKeyPressedInternal                        ; } store SPACE in .firstKeyPressedInternal  $^$ 0xda66
    JSR .setupACIA                                      ; set up ACIA  $^$ 0xda68
                                                        ; X=0
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Set system and user VIA registers
;
; ***************************************************************************************
    LDA #$7F                                            ; Disable interrupts (top bit clear and all others set means disable all interrupts)  $^$ 0xda6b
    INX                                                 ; X=1  $^$ 0xda6d
-
    STA .systemVIAInterruptFlagRegister,X               ; Set .systemVIAInterruptEnableRegister and .systemVIAInterruptFlagRegister  $^$ 0xda6e
    STA .userVIAInterruptFlagRegister,X                 ; Set   .userVIAInterruptEnableRegister and   .userVIAInterruptFlagRegister  $^$ 0xda71
    DEX                                                 ; X--  $^$ 0xda74
    BPL -                                               ; loop back if X >= 0  $^$ 0xda75
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Check for initialising JIM device
;
; ***************************************************************************************
    CLI                                                 ; briefly allow interrupts (JIM based hardware can cause an  $^$ 0xda77
                                                        ; interrupt here, which will set .interruptAccumulator to $7F,
                                                        ; according to the comments in the original source code)
    SEI                                                 ; then disallow again (N.B. All VIA IRQs are disabled)  $^$ 0xda78
    BIT .interruptAccumulator                           ; if bit six is set, then we have JIM hardware to initialize.  $^$ 0xda79
    BVC +                                               ; if (bit six clear) then branch over next instruction  $^$ 0xda7b
    JSR .jimPagedEntryJumper                            ; This calls the JIM paged entry point (to initialise JIM based hardware.)  $^$ 0xda7d
+
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Enable interrupts
;
; Initialises System VIA registers to enable a default set of interrupts:
;
;       The Vertical sync interrupt (50Hz)
;       The Analogue to Digital Converter complete interrupt
;       A timer interrupt for Speech
;       The 100Hz timer
;
; Initialises the 100Hz timer to $270E = 9998 uS (two less than expected because the latch
; reload costs 2uS)
;
; Initialises other devices to default settings (light pen strobe, printer, user port)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
    LDX #%11110010                                      ; enable some System VIA interrupts:  $^$ 0xda80
    STX .systemVIAInterruptEnableRegister               ;   1   Vertical sync  $^$ 0xda82
                                                        ;   4   Analogue conversion finished
                                                        ;   5   Timer 2 counter (for speech)
                                                        ;   6   Timer 1 counter (100Hz)
    LDX #%00000100                                      ; set system VIA PCR  $^$ 0xda85
    STX .systemVIAPeripheralControlRegister             ; set the PCR:  $^$ 0xda87
                        ; CA1 has negative active edge       (vertical sync)
                        ; CA2 positive edges active on input (keyboard)
                        ; CB1 has negative active edge       (end of analogue conversion)
                        ; CB2 negative active edges on input (light pen strobe)

    LDA #%01100000                                      ; set system VIA ACR  $^$ 0xda8a
    STA .systemVIAAuxiliaryControlRegister              ; Disable latches and shift register  $^$ 0xda8c
                                                        ; (bits 0-4 = %00000)
                                                        ; timer 2 countdown (for Speech)
                                                        ; with pulses on input pin PB6
                                                        ; (bit 5 = %1)
                                                        ; timer 1 free-run mode (100Hz timer)
                                                        ; with PB7 disabled
                                                        ; (bit 6-7 = %01)

    LDA #$0E                                            ; set system VIA Timer 1 counter (Low)  $^$ 0xda8f
    STA .systemVIATimer1LatchLow                        ; this becomes effective when Timer 1 Counter High set  $^$ 0xda91

    STA .userVIAPeripheralControlRegister               ; set user VIA PCR:  $^$ 0xda94
                        ; CA1 interrupt on -ve edge     (usually printer Acknowledge)
                        ; CA2 high output               (usually printer strobe)
                        ; CB1 interrupt on -ve edge     (user port)
                        ; CB2 negative edge             (user port)

    STA .adcStartConversionRegister                     ; Start analogue to digital conversion  $^$ 0xda97
                                                        ; A=%1110, meaning channel 2 of range 0-3,
                                                        ; twelve bit conversion.

    CMP .userVIAPeripheralControlRegister               ; check user VIA PCR  $^$ 0xda9a
    BEQ +                                               ; if (printer present) then branch  $^$ 0xda9d
    INC .userVIAIRQBitMask                              ; increment user VIA mask to 0 to ignore all user VIA interrupts  $^$ 0xda9f
+
    LDA #$27                                            ; set Timer 1 (high byte) to $27.  $^$ 0xdaa2
                                                        ; this sets Timer 1 to $270E (=9998 uS)
    STA .systemVIATimer1LatchHigh                       ; so interrupt occurs  $^$ 0xdaa4
                                                        ; every 100th of a second
    STA .systemVIATimer1CounterHigh                     ; set counter (high byte) which  $^$ 0xdaa7
                                                        ; actually starts the timer
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Clear all sounds; Initialise the Serial ULA; Reset soft key definitions
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.resetClearAllSounds
    JSR .clearSoundChannels                             ; clear the sound channels  $^$ 0xdaaa

    ; Initialise the serial ULA
    LDA .serialULARegisterCopy                          ; read serial ULA control register (OS copy)  $^$ 0xdaad
    AND #$7F                                            ; zero bit 7  $^$ 0xdab0
    JSR .setSerialULADirectly                           ; and set up serial ULA  $^$ 0xdab2

    ; reset function keys
    LDX .softKeyConsistencyFlag                         ; get soft key status flag  $^$ 0xdab5
    BEQ .selectROMLoop                                  ; if (keys OK) then branch  $^$ 0xdab8
    JSR .osbyte18EntryPoint                             ; reset function keys  $^$ 0xdaba
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Read ROM Types
;
; Check each sideways ROM (aka Paged ROM) and make a catalogue of their types X = 0...15
;
; Note that the OS itself is not a Paged ROM. As originally shipped, BASIC is the only
; Paged ROM present. The OS supports 16 Paged ROMS (0-15). There are only five slots in
; the original machine, so extra hardware is required to support more Paged ROMs.
;
; ROM Header
; ----------
; $8000 = language entry point      (.romLanguageEntry)
; $8003 = service entry point       (.romServiceEntry)
; $8006 = ROM Type byte (see below) (.romTypeByte)
; $8007 = copyright message         (.romCopyrightOffsetPointer)
; $8009 = offset to title string    (.romTitleString)
;
; ROM Type Byte
; -------------
; bits 0-3  Processor Type (see below)
; bit 4     not used (Electron only)
; bit 5     Language ROM has a relocation address provided. The ROM can only run on the second
;           processor when located at that address.
; bit 6     If set, this is a language ROM (and can be chosen on RESET). Otherwise this is
;           a utility or Filing System ROM.
; bit 7     ROM has a service entry. All ROMs should have this bit set. (The BASIC ROM is the
;           exception, it does not have this bit set).
;
; Processor Type
; --------------
; Language ROMs can be copied across to a second processor and run there. Processor codes
; have been assigned:
;
;  0 = 6502 BASIC
;  1 = 6502 Turbo code
;  2 = 6502 machine code
;  3 = 68000 code
;  4 = -
;  5 = -
;  6 = -
;  7 = PDP-11 code
;  8 = Z80 code
;  9 = 32016 code
; 10 = -
; 11 = 80186 code
; 12 = 80286 code
; 13 = ARM code
; 14 = -
; 15 = -
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.selectROMLoop
    JSR .selectROM                                      ; select ROM X  $^$ 0xdabd
    LDX #3                                              ; set X to point to offset in table  $^$ 0xdac0
    LDY .romCopyrightOffsetPointer                      ; get copyright offset from ROM  $^$ 0xdac2
-
    LDA .romStartAddress,Y                              ; get first byte  $^$ 0xdac5
    CMP .copyrightString,X                              ; compare it with table byte  $^$ 0xdac8
    BNE .noCopyright                                    ; if (no copyright) then branch  $^$ 0xdacb
    INY                                                 ; point to next byte in ROM  $^$ 0xdacd
    DEX                                                 ; point to previous byte in ")C(",0 string  $^$ 0xdace
    BPL -                                               ; if (still +ve) then branch (go back to check next byte)  $^$ 0xdacf
                                                        ; this point is reached if 4 bytes indicate valid ROM

    ; Check the first 1K of each ROM against higher priority ROMs to ensure that
    ; there are no matches. If a match is found, ignore the lower priority ROM
    LDX .currentlySelectedROM                           ; get RAM copy of ROM number in X  $^$ 0xdad1
    LDY .currentlySelectedROM                           ; and Y  $^$ 0xdad3

.nextROM
    INY                                                 ; increment Y to check  $^$ 0xdad5
    CPY #16                                             ; check ROM number against 16  $^$ 0xdad6
    BCS .romComparisonDone                              ; if (ROM number is 16 or more) then branch (done checking each ROM, store catalogue byte)  $^$ 0xdad8
    TYA                                                 ; put Y in A  $^$ 0xdada
    EOR #$FF                                            ; invert it  $^$ 0xdadb
    STA .tempStoreFA                                    ; and store at .tempStoreFA  $^$ 0xdadd
    LDA #$7F                                            ; }  $^$ 0xdadf
    STA .tempStoreFB                                    ; } store $7F at .tempStoreFB to get address $7FFF-Y  $^$ 0xdae1

.nextByteInROM
    STY .romSelectRegister                              ; switch the ROM into the memory map  $^$ 0xdae3
    LDA (.tempStoreFA),Y                                ; get byte  $^$ 0xdae6
    STX .romSelectRegister                              ; switch the original ROM into the memory map  $^$ 0xdae8
    CMP (.tempStoreFA),Y                                ; and compare with previous byte called  $^$ 0xdaeb
    BNE .nextROM                                        ; if (not the same) then branch (go back and do it again with next ROM)  $^$ 0xdaed
    INC .tempStoreFA                                    ; increment .tempStoreFA to point to new location  $^$ 0xdaef
    BNE .nextByteInROM                                  ; if (.tempStoreFA is not zero) then branch (check next byte)  $^$ 0xdaf1
    INC .tempStoreFB                                    ; increment tempStoreFB (high byte of address)  $^$ 0xdaf3
    LDA .tempStoreFB                                    ; load it  $^$ 0xdaf5
    CMP #$84                                            ; check if it has reached $84 = $80 + (4*256 bytes), i.e. 1k checked  $^$ 0xdaf7
    BCC .nextByteInROM                                  ; if (not checked 1k yet) then branch (check next 256 bytes)  $^$ 0xdaf9

.noCopyright
    LDX .currentlySelectedROM                           ; X=current ROM  $^$ 0xdafb
    BPL +                                               ; if (+ve) then branch  $^$ 0xdafd

.romComparisonDone
    LDA .romTypeByte                                    ; get rom type byte  $^$ 0xdaff
    STA .romTypeTable,X                                 ; store it in catalogue  $^$ 0xdb02
    AND #$8F                                            ; check for BASIC  $^$ 0xdb05
    BNE +                                               ; if (not BASIC) then branch  $^$ 0xdb07
    STX .basicROMNumber                                 ; store X at BASIC pointer  $^$ 0xdb09
+
    INX                                                 ; increment X to point to next ROM  $^$ 0xdb0c
    CPX #16                                             ; check X against 16  $^$ 0xdb0d
    BCC .selectROMLoop                                  ; if (15 or less) then branch (back for next ROM)  $^$ 0xdb0f
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Check for speech system
;
; ***************************************************************************************
    BIT .systemVIARegisterB                             ; check for speech system  $^$ 0xdb11
    BMI .skipSpeech                                     ; if (bit 7 set) then branch (no speech system fitted)  $^$ 0xdb14

    DEC .speechSystemPresentFlag                        ; .speechSystemPresentFlag set to $FF to indicate speech present  $^$ 0xdb16

-
    LDY #$FF                                            ; Y=$FF (speech 'reset' command)  $^$ 0xdb19
    JSR .osbyte159EntryPoint                            ; initialise speech generator  $^$ 0xdb1b
    DEX                                                 ; loop counter X from 16 to zero  $^$ 0xdb1e
    BNE -                                               ; branch back unless zero  $^$ 0xdb1f

    STX .systemVIATimer2CounterLow                      ;  $^$ 0xdb21
    STX .systemVIATimer2CounterHigh                     ; clear Timer 2 to zero (used for Speech)  $^$ 0xdb24
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Initialise screen, execute any BOOT interception code
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.skipSpeech
    LDA .startUpOptions                                 ; get back start up options (bits 0-2 are MODE)  $^$ 0xdb27
    JSR .initialiseScreenOnReset                        ; then jump to screen initialisation  $^$ 0xdb2a

    ; *KEY 10 facility (insert the *KEY 10 character code into the keyboard buffer)
    LDY #.charKEY10                                     ; }  $^$ 0xdb2d
    JSR .insertByteIntoKeyboardBuffer                   ; } enter $CA in keyboard buffer. This activates the *KEY 10 facility.  $^$ 0xdb2f

    ; execute any user BOOT interception code, if present (with carry clear)
    JSR .osbyte247EntryPoint                            ; call user boot routine if present, with carry clear  $^$ 0xdb32
                                                        ; it's called again later with carry set

    JSR .setupTapeOptions                               ; set up cassette options [normally  $^$ 0xdb35
                                                        ; at 300 baud, but if the user BOOT
                                                        ; interception code sets Z then
                                                        ; 1200 baud]
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Initialise Tube
;
; ***************************************************************************************
    LDA #%10000001                                      ; test for Tube to FIFO buffer 1  $^$ 0xdb38
    STA .tubeULAStatusRegister                          ;  $^$ 0xdb3a
    LDA .tubeULAStatusRegister                          ; test for Tube presence  $^$ 0xdb3d
    ROR                                                 ; put bit 0 into carry  $^$ 0xdb40
    BCC +                                               ; if (no Tube present) then branch  $^$ 0xdb41
    LDX #.romServiceCallTubeMainInitialisation          ; }  $^$ 0xdb43
    JSR .osbyte143EntryPoint                            ; } initialise Tube system (issue ROM service call)  $^$ 0xdb45
    BNE +                                               ; if (Tube not initialised) then branch  $^$ 0xdb48
    DEC .tubePresentFlag                                ; set Tube flag to show it's active  $^$ 0xdb4a
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Initialize ROMs, claim memory from OSHWM
;
; Note that OSBYTE 143 issues the service call to all ROMs in turn (in slot order 15-0).
;
; ***************************************************************************************
+
    LDY #>.initialOSHWM                                 ; set default value of PAGE: $0E00  $^$ 0xdb4d
    LDX #.romServiceCallAbsoluteWorkspaceClaim          ; issue claim absolute workspace call  $^$ 0xdb4f
    JSR .osbyte143EntryPoint                            ; via .osbyte143EntryPoint  $^$ 0xdb51
    LDX #.romServiceCallPrivateWorkspaceClaim           ; send private workspace claim call  $^$ 0xdb54
    JSR .osbyte143EntryPoint                            ; via .osbyte143EntryPoint  $^$ 0xdb56
    STY .defaultOSHWM                                   ; set primary OSHWM  $^$ 0xdb59
    STY .currentOSHWM                                   ; set current OSHWM  $^$ 0xdb5c
    LDX #.romServiceCallTubeSystemPostInitialisation    ; send to the Tube with the 'post  $^$ 0xdb5f
                                                        ; initialisation' reason (e.g.
                                                        ; second processor can decide to
                                                        ; explode the character set etc.)
    LDY .tubePresentFlag                                ; Y=$FF if Tube present else Y=0  $^$ 0xdb61
    JSR .osbyte143EntryPoint                            ; and make call via .osbyte143EntryPoint  $^$ 0xdb64
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Show bootup message
;
; The startup message can only be suppressed if a ROM requests it on initialisation. Otherwise
; the .startupMessageSuppressionAndBootOptions variable was reset to its default value when
; resetting MOS variables above.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
    AND .startupMessageSuppressionAndBootOptions        ; check (result of post-init AND bit 7  $^$ 0xdb67
                                                        ; of .startupMessageSuppressionAndBootOptions)
    BPL .skipStartupMessage                             ; if (result clear) then branch (skip  $^$ 0xdb6a
                                                        ; startup message)
    LDY #.bootMessage - .vduBaseAddress - 1             ;  $^$ 0xdb6c
    JSR .displayString                                  ; output 'BBC Computer ' message  $^$ 0xdb6e
    LDA .lastResetType                                  ; 0=soft reset, anything else continue  $^$ 0xdb71
    BEQ .outputTwoNewlines                              ; if (soft reset) then branch (skip  $^$ 0xdb74
                                                        ; forward)
    LDY #.bootMessageMemory32 - .vduBaseAddress - 1     ; set to point to 32k message  $^$ 0xdb76
    BIT .systemAvailableRAM                             ; read available RAM ($40 = 16k  $^$ 0xdb78
                                                        ; $80 = 32k)
    BMI +                                               ; if (32k RAM available) then branch  $^$ 0xdb7b
    LDY #.bootMessageMemory16 - .vduBaseAddress - 1     ; set to point to 16K message  $^$ 0xdb7d
+
    JSR .displayString                                  ; write message with '16K' or '32K'  $^$ 0xdb7f

.outputTwoNewlines
    LDY #.bootMessageEnding  - .vduBaseAddress - 1      ; and two newlines  $^$ 0xdb82
    JSR .displayString                                  ;  $^$ 0xdb84
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Execute user BREAK intercept, set keyboard LEDs
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.skipStartupMessage
    SEC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xdb87
    JSR .osbyte247EntryPoint                            ; call user break intercept if present  $^$ 0xdb88
                                                        ; (with carry set)
    JSR .osbyte118EntryPoint                            ; set up keyboard LEDs to reflect  $^$ 0xdb8b
                                                        ; current keyboard status
                                                        ; also tests for SHIFT pressed
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Get !BOOT options, and ask ROMs to handle it
;
; Note that OSBYTE 143 issues the service call to all ROMs in turn (in slot order 15-0).
; This stops when one of the ROMs returns zero, indicating it will accept the auto-boot.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
    PHP                                                 ; remember flags  $^$ 0xdb8e
    PLA                                                 ; and recall flags in A = nvbdizc  $^$ 0xdb8f
    LSR                                                 ;  $^$ 0xdb90
    LSR                                                 ;  $^$ 0xdb91
    LSR                                                 ;  $^$ 0xdb92
    LSR                                                 ; A=0000nvbd  $^$ 0xdb93
    EOR .startUpOptions                                 ; EOR with start up options, in  $^$ 0xdb94
                                                        ; particular check bit 3 (if clear
                                                        ; reverse SHIFT BREAK action)
    AND #8                                              ; isolate bit 3 only  $^$ 0xdb97
    TAY                                                 ; Y=0 (execute !BOOT) or 8 (don't  $^$ 0xdb99
                                                        ; execute !BOOT)
    LDX #.romServiceCallAutoBoot                        ; X = rom service call for auto-boot  $^$ 0xdb9a
    JSR .osbyte143EntryPoint                            ; ask each ROM in turn if they want  $^$ 0xdb9c
                                                        ; to handle it
    BEQ .checkForFindingLanguageROM                     ; if (a ROM accepts this call) then  $^$ 0xdb9f
                                                        ; branch (to enter language ROM)
    TYA                                                 ; put result from ROM (Y register) in  $^$ 0xdba1
                                                        ; A (to test if it's zero)
    BNE .setTapeFSAndFindLanguageROM                    ; if (Y != 0, i.e. no filing system  $^$ 0xdba2
                                                        ; accepts it) then branch
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Select the *ROM filing system
;
; ***************************************************************************************
    LDA #141                                            ; }  $^$ 0xdba4
    JSR .osbyte141EntryPoint                            ; } select ROM filing system  $^$ 0xdba6
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Execute !BOOT
;
; ***************************************************************************************
    LDX #<.runBootString                                ;  $^$ 0xdba9
    LDY #>.runBootString                                ;  $^$ 0xdbab
    DEC .startupMessageSuppressionAndBootOptions        ; decrement boot options  $^$ 0xdbad
    JSR .OSCLI                                          ; and execute */!BOOT  $^$ 0xdbb0
    INC .startupMessageSuppressionAndBootOptions        ; restore boot options  $^$ 0xdbb3
    BNE .checkForFindingLanguageROM                     ; ALWAYS branch, don't reset filing system  $^$ 0xdbb6

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Select TAPE filing system
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.setTapeFSAndFindLanguageROM
    LDA #0                                              ; }  $^$ 0xdbb8
    TAX                                                 ; } set tape filing system  $^$ 0xdbba
    JSR .setTapeOrROMFS                                 ; }  $^$ 0xdbbb
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Look for language ROM
;
; Looks for the 'best' language ROM (the language with the highest ROM slot number) and
; enters it
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.checkForFindingLanguageROM
    LDA .lastResetType                                  ; get last RESET Type  $^$ 0xdbbe
    BNE .findBestLanguageROM                            ; if (not soft reset) then branch  $^$ 0xdbc1

    LDX .languageROMNumber                              ; get current language ROM number  $^$ 0xdbc3
    BPL .resetAndEnterLanguageROM                       ; if (language available) then branch (initialise and enter ROM)  $^$ 0xdbc6

.findBestLanguageROM
    LDX #15                                             ; set pointer to highest available ROM  $^$ 0xdbc8
-
    LDA .romTypeTable,X                                 ; get ROM type from map  $^$ 0xdbca
    ROL                                                 ; put bit 6 into bit 7  $^$ 0xdbcd
    BMI .resetAndEnterLanguageROM                       ; if (bit 7 set then ROM has a language entry) then branch (initialise and enter ROM)  $^$ 0xdbce

    DEX                                                 ;  $^$ 0xdbd0
    BPL -                                               ; search for language until X=255  $^$ 0xdbd1
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; No language ROM present, so check for second processor
;
; If present, ask the second processor to copy an appropriate language ROM onto the second
; processor and run there. The Tube interface is implemented by the 'DNFS' ROM. Initialising
; the DNFS ROM copies Tube service code into the current language workspace at $0400-$07FF.
; Calling .tubeCopyLanguageROMToSecondProcessor ($0400) is therefore calling into the Tube
; service code, to find and copy the code of an appropriate language ROM into the second
; processor and run it there. The language ROM identifies the processor type it's designed
; for by the ROM header's processor type byte (See .selectROMLoop).
;
; ***************************************************************************************
    LDA #0                                              ; No language found.  $^$ 0xdbd3
    BIT .tubePresentFlag                                ; check if Tube is present  $^$ 0xdbd5
    BMI .tubeCopyLanguageROMToSecondProcessorLocal      ; if (Tube present) then branch (call into Tube code)  $^$ 0xdbd8
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.brkNoLanguageError
    BRK                                                 ;  $^$ 0xdbda
    !byte $F9                                           ; error number
    !text "Language?",0                                 ; message

; ***************************************************************************************
.resetAndEnterLanguageROM
    CLC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xdbe6
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 142 - Enter language ROM (at $8000)
;
; On Entry:
;       X = ROM number
;       C set if OSBYTE call;
;       C clear if initialisation
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte142EntryPoint
    PHP                                                 ; save flags  $^$ 0xdbe7
    STX .languageROMNumber                              ; put X in current ROM number  $^$ 0xdbe8
    JSR .selectROM                                      ; select that ROM  $^$ 0xdbeb
    LDA #>(.romTitleString - 1)                         ; } AY=address of ROM title string  $^$ 0xdbee
    LDY #<(.romTitleString - 1)                         ; }  $^$ 0xdbf0
    JSR .displayStringAY                                ; display text string held in ROM at .romTitleString  $^$ 0xdbf2
    STY .languageVersionString                          ; save Y on exit (end of language string)  $^$ 0xdbf5
    JSR .OSNEWL                                         ; two line feeds  $^$ 0xdbf7
    JSR .OSNEWL                                         ; are output  $^$ 0xdbfa
    PLP                                                 ; then get back flags  $^$ 0xdbfd
    LDA #1                                              ; A=1 required for language entry  $^$ 0xdbfe
    BIT .tubePresentFlag                                ; check if the Tube is present  $^$ 0xdc00
    BMI .tubeCopyLanguageROMToSecondProcessorLocal      ; and branch if so  $^$ 0xdc03
    JMP .romLanguageEntry                               ; enter language at $8000  $^$ 0xdc05

; ***************************************************************************************
.tubeCopyLanguageROMToSecondProcessorLocal
    JMP .tubeCopyLanguageROMToSecondProcessor           ; enter Tube environment  $^$ 0xdc08

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Read a byte from a given ROM
;
; On Entry:
;       Y = ROM number
; $F6/$F7 = address
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osrdrmEntryPoint
    LDX .currentlySelectedROM                           ; get current ROM number into X  $^$ 0xdc0b
    STY .currentlySelectedROM                           ; store new number  $^$ 0xdc0d
    STY .romSelectRegister                              ; switch the ROM into the memory map  $^$ 0xdc0f
    LDY #0                                              ; get current PHROM address  $^$ 0xdc12
    LDA (.romAddressLow),Y                              ; and get byte  $^$ 0xdc14
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Select ROM
;
; On Entry:
;       X = ROM number (0-15)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.selectROM
    STX .currentlySelectedROM                           ; RAM copy of current ROM  $^$ 0xdc16
