; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSWRCH - write character
;
; This is the main entry point for writing characters to the display and/or to other devices
; such as ECONET, a printer, RS-423 or to a file.
;
; Note: the .characterDestinationsAvailableFlags has the following bits:
;
;   bit 0 - enable RS-423 driver
;   bit 1 - disable VDU driver
;   bit 2 - disable printer driver
;   bit 3 - enable printer, independent of VDU 2/3 (=CTRL B/C)
;   bit 4 - disable SPOOLed output
;   bit 5 - not used, zero
;   bit 6 - disable printer driver (unless preceded by VDU 1)
;   bit 7 - not used, zero
;
; On Entry:
;       A = character to write
; On Exit:
;       A, X, Y are preserved
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.oswrchEntryPoint
    PHA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xe0a4
    TXA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xe0a5
    PHA                                                 ; } store A,X,Y registers  $^$ 0xe0a6
    TYA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xe0a7
    PHA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xe0a8
    TSX                                                 ; X = stack pointer  $^$ 0xe0a9
    LDA .stackPage + 3,X                                ; peek into stack to get A value back  $^$ 0xe0aa
    PHA                                                 ; push A again  $^$ 0xe0ad
    BIT .econetWriteCharacterInterceptionFlag           ; check OSWRCH interception flag  $^$ 0xe0ae
    BPL .skipEconetProcessing                           ; if (not set) then branch (skip Econet)  $^$ 0xe0b1
    TAY                                                 ; pass character to Y  $^$ 0xe0b3
    LDA #4                                              ; A=4 for OSWRCH service call  $^$ 0xe0b4
    JSR .netvJumper                                     ; call NETV code  $^$ 0xe0b6
    BCS .oswrchFinishUp                                 ; if (claimed) then branch (finish up and exit)  $^$ 0xe0b9

.skipEconetProcessing
    CLC                                                 ; prepare to not send this to printer  $^$ 0xe0bb
    LDA #2                                              ; check output destination  $^$ 0xe0bc
    BIT .characterDestinationsAvailableFlags            ; is VDU driver disabled?  $^$ 0xe0be
    BNE .skipVDUOutput                                  ; yes, skip past VDU driver  $^$ 0xe0c1
    PLA                                                 ; pull character  $^$ 0xe0c3
    PHA                                                 ; push character  $^$ 0xe0c4
    JSR .vduChrEntryPoint                               ; call VDU driver  $^$ 0xe0c5
                                                        ; on exit, C=1 if character to be sent to printer
.skipVDUOutput
    LDA #8                                              ; check output destination  $^$ 0xe0c8
    BIT .characterDestinationsAvailableFlags            ; is printer separately enabled?  $^$ 0xe0ca
    BNE .printerEnabled                                 ; yes, jump to call printer driver  $^$ 0xe0cd
    BCC .printerDisabled                                ; carry clear, don't sent to printer  $^$ 0xe0cf

.printerEnabled
    PLA                                                 ; pull character  $^$ 0xe0d1
    PHA                                                 ; push character  $^$ 0xe0d2
    JSR .sendCharacterToPrinter                         ; call printer driver  $^$ 0xe0d3

.printerDisabled
    LDA .characterDestinationsAvailableFlags            ; check output destination  $^$ 0xe0d6
    ROR                                                 ; check RS-423 output bit  $^$ 0xe0d9
    BCC .skipRS423Output                                ; if (RS-423 output is disabled) then branch (skip past serial output)  $^$ 0xe0da

    ; Check for timeout
    LDY .rs423TimeoutCounter                            ; get RS-423 timout counter  $^$ 0xe0dc
    DEY                                                 ; decrease counter  $^$ 0xe0de
    BPL .skipRS423Output                                ; if (timed out) then branch (skip past serial code)  $^$ 0xe0df

    ; RS-423 output
    PLA                                                 ; pull character  $^$ 0xe0e1
    PHA                                                 ; push character  $^$ 0xe0e2
    PHP                                                 ; save IRQs  $^$ 0xe0e3
    SEI                                                 ; disable IRQs  $^$ 0xe0e4
    LDX #.bufferNumberRS423Output                       ; X=RS-423 output buffer  $^$ 0xe0e5
    PHA                                                 ; save character  $^$ 0xe0e7
    JSR .osbyte152EntryPoint                            ; examine RS-423 output buffer to see if it's empty  $^$ 0xe0e8
    BCC +                                               ; buffer is not empty, jump to send character  $^$ 0xe0eb
    JSR .clearBusyFlagAndSetRS423Active                 ; set RS-423 Active  $^$ 0xe0ed
+
    PLA                                                 ; get character  $^$ 0xe0f0
    LDX #.bufferNumberRS423Output                       ; X=RS-423 output buffer  $^$ 0xe0f1
    JSR .addByteToBuffer                                ; send character to RS-423 output buffer  $^$ 0xe0f3
    PLP                                                 ; restore IRQs  $^$ 0xe0f6

.skipRS423Output
    LDA #$10                                            ; check output destination  $^$ 0xe0f7
    BIT .characterDestinationsAvailableFlags            ; check SPOOL output  $^$ 0xe0f9
    BNE .oswrchFinishUp                                 ; if (SPOOL output disabled) then branch (skip past SPOOL output)  $^$ 0xe0fc
    LDY .spoolFileHandle                                ; get SPOOL file handle  $^$ 0xe0fe
    BEQ .oswrchFinishUp                                 ; if (not open) then branch (skip past SPOOL output)  $^$ 0xe101
    PLA                                                 ; pull character  $^$ 0xe103
    PHA                                                 ; push character  $^$ 0xe104
    SEC                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xe105
    ROR .tapeCritical                                   ; } Set tape critical flag  $^$ 0xe106
    JSR .OSBPUT                                         ; write character to SPOOL channel (A=character to write, Y=file handle)  $^$ 0xe108
    LSR .tapeCritical                                   ; clear tape critical flag  $^$ 0xe10b

.oswrchFinishUp
    PLA                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe10d
    PLA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xe10e
    TAY                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xe10f
    PLA                                                 ; } restore A,X,Y registers  $^$ 0xe110
    TAX                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xe111
    PLA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xe112
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe113


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; On Entry:
;       A=character to print
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.sendCharacterToPrinter
    BIT .characterDestinationsAvailableFlags            ; check for bit 6 set  $^$ 0xe114
    BVS .exit16                                         ; if (printer is disabled) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xe117
    CMP .printerIgnoreCharacter                         ; compare character against printer ignore character  $^$ 0xe119
    BEQ .exit16                                         ; if (the same) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xe11c

.sendValidByteToPrinter
    PHP                                                 ; save flags (including IRQ flag)  $^$ 0xe11e
    SEI                                                 ; disable interrupts  $^$ 0xe11f
    TAX                                                 ; store byte to send in X  $^$ 0xe120
    LDA #%00000100                                      ; }  $^$ 0xe121
    BIT .characterDestinationsAvailableFlags            ; } check bit 2 'disable printer driver'  $^$ 0xe123
    BNE .pullAndExit14                                  ; if (printer is disabled) then branch (pull flags and exit)  $^$ 0xe126
    TXA                                                 ; restore byte to send to A  $^$ 0xe128
    LDX #.bufferNumberPrinter                           ; X=printer buffer number  $^$ 0xe129
    JSR .addByteToBuffer                                ; put character in printer buffer  $^$ 0xe12b
    BCS .pullAndExit14                                  ; if (carry set, i.e. unsuccessful) then branch (pull flags and exit)  $^$ 0xe12e

    BIT .printerBufferEmptyFlag                         ; check buffer empty flag  $^$ 0xe130
    BPL .pullAndExit14                                  ; if (printer buffer is not empty) then branch (pull flags and exit)  $^$ 0xe133
    JSR .openPrinterChannel                             ; open printer channel  $^$ 0xe135
.pullAndExit14
    PLP                                                 ; restore flags (including IRQ flag)  $^$ 0xe138
.exit16
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe139

; ***************************************************************************************
.openPrinterChannel
    LDA .printerDestination                             ; check printer destination  $^$ 0xe13a
    BEQ .flushBufferX                                   ; if (zero) then branch (clear printer buffer and exit)  $^$ 0xe13d
    CMP #1                                              ; }  $^$ 0xe13f
    BNE .checkForSerialPrinter                          ; } if (parallel printer not selected) then branch (check for serial printer)  $^$ 0xe141

    ; deal with parallel printer
    JSR .osbyte145EntryPoint                            ; read a byte from the printer buffer  $^$ 0xe143
    ROR .printerBufferEmptyFlag                         ; rotate carry into bit 7 of the printer buffer empty flag  $^$ 0xe146
    BMI .exit17                                         ; if (printer buffer empty) then branch (return)  $^$ 0xe149

    ; To send data to the parallel printer:
    ;
    ; 1. Enable the User VIA interrupt '1'. The printer will trigger an IRQ when it is ready
    ;    for another character.
    ; 2. Write the byte to send to .userVIARegisterA
    ; 3. Set bits 1-3 of the userVIAPeripheralControlRegister to %110
    ; 4. Set bits 1-3 of the userVIAPeripheralControlRegister to %111
    ; This sends a 'STROBE' signal to advise the printer that valid data is waiting.

    LDY #%10000010                                      ; enable interrupt 1 of the user VIA  $^$ 0xe14b
    STY .userVIAInterruptEnableRegister                 ; this is triggered by the printer  $^$ 0xe14d
                                                        ; when it is ready to receive a new
                                                        ; character
    STA .userVIARegisterA                               ; pass byte to the Centronics port  $^$ 0xe150
    LDA .userVIAPeripheralControlRegister               ; }  $^$ 0xe153
    AND #%11110001                                      ; }  $^$ 0xe156
    ORA #%00001100                                      ; } pulse CA2 line to generate  $^$ 0xe158
    STA .userVIAPeripheralControlRegister               ; } STROBE signal to advise printer  $^$ 0xe15a
    ORA #%00001110                                      ; } that valid data is waiting  $^$ 0xe15d
    STA .userVIAPeripheralControlRegister               ; }  $^$ 0xe15f
    BNE .exit17                                         ; ALWAYS branch (return)  $^$ 0xe162
                                                        ; [this could just be an RTS, saving one byte]

; ***************************************************************************************
.checkForSerialPrinter
    CMP #2                                              ; }  $^$ 0xe164
    BNE .userPrinter                                    ; } if (serial printer is NOT selected) then branch (check for user printer)  $^$ 0xe166

    ; deal with serial printer
    LDY .rs423TimeoutCounter                            ; }  $^$ 0xe168
    DEY                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xe16a
    BPL .flushBufferX                                   ; } if (timeout counter is timed out) then branch (to flush the buffer)  $^$ 0xe16b
    LSR .printerBufferEmptyFlag                         ; clear printer buffer empty flag  $^$ 0xe16d

.clearBusyFlagAndSetRS423Active
    LSR .rs423ReadyFlag                                 ; clear RS-423 busy flag  $^$ 0xe170
.setRS423Active
    JSR .getRS423InputBufferFreeBytes                   ; }  $^$ 0xe173
    BCC .exit17                                         ; } if (free space in buffer is low) then branch (return)  $^$ 0xe176
    LDX #%00100000                                      ; set bit 5 on ACIA control register  $^$ 0xe178
                                                        ; set 'Request To Send' low (meaning Active)

.writeToACIARequestToSend
    LDY #%10011111                                      ; Mask for setting bits 5 and 6  $^$ 0xe17a
                                                        ; This writes the 'Request To Send'
                                                        ; value.
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 156 - Update ACIA Control Register and OS Copy
;
; write (current value AND Y) EOR X
; Preserves Y and flags
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte156EntryPoint
    PHP                                                 ; push flags  $^$ 0xe17c
    SEI                                                 ; disable interrupts  $^$ 0xe17d
    TYA                                                 ; A=Y  $^$ 0xe17e
    STX .tempStoreFA                                    ; .tempStoreFA=X  $^$ 0xe17f
    AND .rs423ControlRegisterCopy                       ; A=old value AND Y EOR X  $^$ 0xe181
    EOR .tempStoreFA                                    ;  $^$ 0xe184
    LDX .rs423ControlRegisterCopy                       ; get old value in X  $^$ 0xe186
.storeACIAAndPull
    STA .rs423ControlRegisterCopy                       ; put new value in  $^$ 0xe189
    STA .acia6850ControlRegister                        ; and store to ACIA control register  $^$ 0xe18c
    PLP                                                 ; get back flags  $^$ 0xe18f
.exit17
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe190

; ***************************************************************************************
.userPrinter
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xe191
    LDA #1                                              ; A = 1  $^$ 0xe192
    JSR .printerServiceCall                             ;  $^$ 0xe194
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 123 - Warn OS about printer going dormant
;
; This call is used by the User Print Routine to indicate to the MOS that it has finished
; its task (The User Print Routine is selected by *FX 5,3).
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte123EntryPoint
    ROR .printerBufferEmptyFlag                         ; mark printer buffer empty (clear top bit)  $^$ 0xe197
-
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe19a

; ***************************************************************************************
; Signal to the printer that there's at least one character in the printer buffer, at a
; rate of 100Hz until the printer driver deals with it.
.printerServiceCallIfNotEmpty
    BIT .printerBufferEmptyFlag                         ; check printer buffer empty flag  $^$ 0xe19b
    BMI -                                               ; if (buffer is empty) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xe19e
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0 (100Hz update when printer is active and buffer is not empty)  $^$ 0xe1a0
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Econet / User printer routines
;
; See NAUG Section 24.2.4, Page 424 for more detail on reason codes
;
; On Entry:
;       A = reason code
;           0 means 100Hz update
;           1 means become active, since printer buffer is no longer empty
;           2 means VDU 2 happened (disable printer output)
;           3 means VDU 3 happened (enable printer output)
;           5 means select new printer driver (entry via OSBYTE 5 to .selectPrinterType)
;
.printerServiceCall
    LDX #.bufferNumberPrinter                           ; X=printer buffer number  $^$ 0xe1a2
.selectPrinterType
    LDY .printerDestination                             ; Y=printer destination (*FX 5 value)  $^$ 0xe1a4
    JSR .netvJumper                                     ; let network have a look (should respond if Y=4 for net printer)  $^$ 0xe1a7
    JMP (.vectorUPTV)                                   ; let user printer routine have a look (can respond if Y=3, or 5-255 for user printer)  $^$ 0xe1aa


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Flushes the given buffer
;
; For buffer numbers, see .bufferNumberKeyboard.
;
; On Entry:
;       X=buffer number
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.flushBufferX
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xe1ad

.flushSoundBufferX
    PHA                                                 ; save A  $^$ 0xe1ae
    PHP                                                 ; save flags  $^$ 0xe1af
    SEI                                                 ; disable interrupts  $^$ 0xe1b0
    BCS .flushNonSoundBufferX                           ; if (carry set on entry) then branch  $^$ 0xe1b1
    LDA .bufferTypeAndSerialBaudRatesTable,X            ; carry clear so get byte from table  $^$ 0xe1b3
    BPL .flushNonSoundBufferX                           ; if (not sound buffer) then branch  $^$ 0xe1b6
    JSR .clearSoundChannelBuffer                        ; clear sound buffer  $^$ 0xe1b8

.flushNonSoundBufferX
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xe1bb
    ROR .bufferEmptyFlags,X                             ; rotate buffer flag to show buffer empty  $^$ 0xe1bc
    CPX #2                                              ;  $^$ 0xe1bf
    BCS .skipInputBufferHandling                        ; if (X > 1) then branch (it's not an input buffer)  $^$ 0xe1c1

    LDA #0                                              ; this is an input buffer  $^$ 0xe1c3
    STA .softKeyStringLength                            ; reset length of the *KEY string  $^$ 0xe1c5
                                                        ; currently being decoded (to stop
                                                        ; decoding a soft key, which would
                                                        ; otherwise add more characters into
                                                        ; the input buffer)
    STA .twosComplimentOfNumberOfBytesInVDUQueue        ; reset length of VDU queue  $^$ 0xe1c8

.skipInputBufferHandling
    JSR .purgeBuffer                                    ; purge buffer  $^$ 0xe1cb
    PLP                                                 ; restore flags  $^$ 0xe1ce
    PLA                                                 ; restore A  $^$ 0xe1cf
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe1d0


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Count or Purge Buffer (CNPV) - Default Entry Point
;
; On Entry:
;       X = buffer to access
;       if V set then purge buffer (else count buffer)
;       for count buffer: if C set then get bytes free
;                                  else get bytes used
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.cnpEntryPoint
    BVC .countBuffer                                    ; if (V clear) then branch (count buffer)  $^$ 0xe1d1
    LDA .bufferStartIndices,X                           ; purge buffer by setting  $^$ 0xe1d3
    STA .bufferEndIndices,X                             ; end of buffer = start of buffer  $^$ 0xe1d6
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe1d9

.countBuffer
    PHP                                                 ; push flags  $^$ 0xe1da
    SEI                                                 ; disable interrupts  $^$ 0xe1db
    PHP                                                 ; push flags  $^$ 0xe1dc
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xe1dd
    LDA .bufferEndIndices,X                             ; get end of buffer  $^$ 0xe1de
    SBC .bufferStartIndices,X                           ; subtract start of buffer  $^$ 0xe1e1
    BCS +                                               ; if (carry set) then branch  $^$ 0xe1e4
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xe1e6
    SBC .emptyBufferStartOffset,X                       ; subtract buffer start offset (i.e. add buffer length)  $^$ 0xe1e7
+
    PLP                                                 ; pull flags  $^$ 0xe1ea
    BCC +                                               ; if (carry clear) then branch (to tidy up and exit)  $^$ 0xe1eb
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xe1ed
    ADC .emptyBufferStartOffset,X                       ; adc to get bytes used  $^$ 0xe1ee
    EOR #$FF                                            ; and invert to get space left  $^$ 0xe1f1
+
    LDY #0                                              ; Y=0  $^$ 0xe1f3
    TAX                                                 ; X=A  $^$ 0xe1f5
    PLP                                                 ; get back flags  $^$ 0xe1f6
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe1f7

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Adds a byte to a buffer.
;
; On failure (e.g. the buffer is full), flash the keyboard lights and keep trying
;
; On Entry:
;       A = byte to write
;       X = buffer to write into
;
; On Exit:
;       Carry clear if successful
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.addByteToBuffer
    SEI                                                 ; prevent interrupts  $^$ 0xe1f8
    JSR .insJumper                                      ; enter a byte in buffer X  $^$ 0xe1f9
    BCC .exit18                                         ; if (successful) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xe1fc
    JSR .turnOnKeyboardLightsAndTestEscape              ; switch on both keyboard lights  $^$ 0xe1fe

    PHP                                                 ; push flags  $^$ 0xe201
    PHA                                                 ; push A  $^$ 0xe202
    JSR .keyboardIndicators                             ; switch off unselected LEDs  $^$ 0xe203
    PLA                                                 ; recall A  $^$ 0xe206
    PLP                                                 ; recall flags  $^$ 0xe207

    BMI .exit18                                         ; if (return is -ve, i.e. Escape pressed) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xe208
    CLI                                                 ; allow interrupts  $^$ 0xe20a
    BCS .addByteToBuffer                                ; if (byte didn't enter buffer) then branch (go back and try again)  $^$ 0xe20b
.exit18
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe20d


; ***************************************************************************************
; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Chapter 14: Star commands
;
; ***************************************************************************************
; ***************************************************************************************

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Clear four consecutive bytes in the OSFILE block
;
; The data required by the OSFILE call is stored at .osfileBlockStart, is 18 bytes long, and
; is as follows:
;
;       byte      description
;       0-1       address of filename
;       2-5       load address
;       6-9       execution address
;       10-13     start address (or length)
;       14-17     end address (or file attributes)
;
; This call clears one of these 4 byte addresses.
;
; On Entry:
;       X is the start offset within the OSFILE block
; On Exit:
;       Preserves A,X,Y
; ***************************************************************************************
.clearOSFILEAddress
    PHA                                                 ; push A  $^$ 0xe20e
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0  $^$ 0xe20f
    STA .osfileBlockStart + 0,X                         ; clear osfile control block workspace  $^$ 0xe211
    STA .osfileBlockStart + 1,X                         ;  $^$ 0xe214
    STA .osfileBlockStart + 2,X                         ;  $^$ 0xe217
    STA .osfileBlockStart + 3,X                         ;  $^$ 0xe21a
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xe21d
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe21e

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Shift one hex digit into an OSFILE address
;
; Used as part of .readOSFILEAddress
;
; On Entry:
;       A contains hex digit 0-15
;       X contains the offset into the .osfileBlockStart for the address to be updated
; On Exit:
;       The four byte address at .osfileBlockStart+X is shifted four binary bits and the new
;       digit is inserted at the least significant end.
;       Preserves Y
; ***************************************************************************************
.shiftDigitIntoAddress
    STY .tempWorkspaceE6                                ; remember Y  $^$ 0xe21f
    ROL                                                 ; A=A*2  $^$ 0xe221
    ROL                                                 ; *4  $^$ 0xe222
    ROL                                                 ; *8  $^$ 0xe223
    ROL                                                 ; *16  $^$ 0xe224
    LDY #4                                              ; Y=loop counter  $^$ 0xe225
-
    ROL                                                 ; A=A*32  $^$ 0xe227
    ROL .osfileBlockStart + 0,X                         ; shift bit 7 of A into shift register  $^$ 0xe228
    ROL .osfileBlockStart + 1,X                         ; and  $^$ 0xe22b
    ROL .osfileBlockStart + 2,X                         ; shift  $^$ 0xe22e
    ROL .osfileBlockStart + 3,X                         ; along  $^$ 0xe231
    BCS .brkBadAddress                                  ; if (carry set on exit, i.e. register has overflowed) then branch ('Bad address' error)  $^$ 0xe234
    DEY                                                 ; decrement Y  $^$ 0xe236
    BNE -                                               ; if (Y > 0) then branch (do another shift)  $^$ 0xe237

    LDY .tempWorkspaceE6                                ; recall original Y  $^$ 0xe239
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe23b


; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   *LOAD
;
; On Entry:
;       XY = address of rest of command line
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.starLoad
    LDA #$FF                                            ; signal that load is being performed  $^$ 0xe23c
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   *SAVE Entry (and *LOAD continued)
;
; On Entry:
;       A=0         for *SAVE
;       A=non-zero  for *LOAD
;       XY = address of rest of command line
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.starLoadSave
    STX .stringInputBufferAddressLow                    ; store address of rest of command line  $^$ 0xe23e
    STY .stringInputBufferAddressHigh                   ;  $^$ 0xe240
    STX .osfileFilenameAddressLow                       ; X and Y are stored in OSfile control block  $^$ 0xe242
    STY .osfileFilenameAddressHigh                      ;  $^$ 0xe245
    PHA                                                 ; Push A  $^$ 0xe248
    LDX #.osfileLoadAddressLow - .osfileBlockStart      ; X=2  $^$ 0xe249
    JSR .clearOSFILEAddress                             ; clear the load address  $^$ 0xe24b
    LDY #$FF                                            ; Y=255  $^$ 0xe24e
    STY .osfileExecAddressLow                           ; store $FF in exec address low byte  $^$ 0xe250

    ; For a *LOAD (A=$FF) this byte (.osfileExecAddressLow) is used as a flag (it's available
    ; since we don't need the executable address when just loading a file). Zero means use the
    ; specified load address. Non-zero means use the load address from the file. This is
    ; OSFILE behaviour.

    INY                                                 ; increment Y  $^$ 0xe253
    JSR .gsinitForFilenameParsing                       ; and call GSINIT to prepare for reading text line  $^$ 0xe254
-
    JSR .gsreadEntryPoint                               ; read a byte from text line  $^$ 0xe257
    BCC -                                               ; until end of line reached  $^$ 0xe25a
    PLA                                                 ; recall original A  $^$ 0xe25c
    PHA                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe25d
    BEQ .starSave                                       ; if (A=0, i.e. *SAVE) then branch  $^$ 0xe25e

    ; loading
    JSR .readOSFILEAddress                              ; read hex byte into start address  $^$ 0xe260
    BCS .checkForErrorAndLoadFile                       ; if (success) then branch (load using OSFILE)  $^$ 0xe263
    BEQ .callOSFILEWithParameterBlockForLoadSave        ; if (end of line found) then branch  $^$ 0xe265
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.brkBadAddress
    BRK                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe267
    !byte $FC                                           ;
    !text "Bad address", 0                              ; error


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 119 - Close Spool / Exec files
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte119EntryPoint
    LDX #.romServiceCallSpoolExecClosureWarning         ; } let the paged ROMs know about  $^$ 0xe275
    JSR .osbyte143EntryPoint                            ; } the closure of SPOOL/EXEC file  $^$ 0xe277
    BEQ .exit19                                         ; if (a ROM accepts and closes it) then branch (return)  $^$ 0xe27a
    JSR .closeSpoolOrExecFile                           ; close the current file  $^$ 0xe27c
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0  $^$ 0xe27f
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
;   *SPOOL
;
; On Entry:
;       A = 0 (and carry clear) to close the currently SPOOLed file, OR
;       A = file handle to start SPOOLing
; On Exit:
;       if closing a spooled file:
;           A, X and Y are preserved
;       if opening a spooled file:
;          A = Y = file handle for spooled file
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.starSpool
    PHP                                                 ; push flags  $^$ 0xe281
    STY .tempWorkspaceE6                                ; remember Y  $^$ 0xe282
    LDY .spoolFileHandle                                ; get file handle  $^$ 0xe284
    STA .spoolFileHandle                                ; store A as file handle  $^$ 0xe287
    BEQ +                                               ; if (Y is zero) then branch (skip forward)  $^$ 0xe28a
    JSR .OSFIND                                         ; close the file using OSFIND  $^$ 0xe28c
+
    LDY .tempWorkspaceE6                                ; recall Y  $^$ 0xe28f
    PLP                                                 ; pull flags  $^$ 0xe291
    BEQ .exit19                                         ; if (A = 0 on entry) then branch (exit, we are done)  $^$ 0xe292
    LDA #$80                                            ; A is value for 'open file for output'  $^$ 0xe294
    JSR .OSFIND                                         ; open file XY for output using OSFIND  $^$ 0xe296
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A=file handle for *SPOOLed file  $^$ 0xe299
    BEQ .badCommandError                                ; if (result is zero) then branch ('Bad command' error)  $^$ 0xe29a
    STA .spoolFileHandle                                ; store new file handle  $^$ 0xe29c
.exit19
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe29f

; ***************************************************************************************
.checkForErrorAndLoadFile
    BNE .badCommandError                                ; if (not end of command line) then branch (show 'Bad command' error)  $^$ 0xe2a0
    INC .osfileExecAddressLow                           ; increment execution address low  $^$ 0xe2a2
                                                        ; byte to zero (when A=255 as OSFILE
                                                        ; parameter, zero means use specified
                                                        ; address)

.callOSFILEWithParameterBlockForLoadSave
    LDX #<.osfileBlockStart                             ; }  $^$ 0xe2a5
    LDY #>.osfileBlockStart                             ; } XY = address of OSFILE parameter block  $^$ 0xe2a7
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xe2a9
    JMP .OSFILE                                         ; and JUMP to OSFILE  $^$ 0xe2aa

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Read hex bytes into OSFILE address (start / end / load / exec address)
;
; On Entry:
;       X is the offset to the address to write to
;
; On Exit:
;       C set on success
;       Z set if end of line found
; ***************************************************************************************
.readOSFILEAddress
    JSR .skipSpacesAndCheckForCRInStringInput           ; look for NEWline  $^$ 0xe2ad
    JSR .readHexDigit                                   ; carry is set if it finds hex digit  $^$ 0xe2b0
    BCC .exit20                                         ; so exit  $^$ 0xe2b3
    JSR .clearOSFILEAddress                             ; clear start address in OSFILE block  $^$ 0xe2b5
-
    JSR .shiftDigitIntoAddress                          ; shift lower nybble of A into shift register  $^$ 0xe2b8
    JSR .readHexDigit                                   ; then check for Hex digit  $^$ 0xe2bb
    BCS -                                               ; if (found digit) then branch (do it again)  $^$ 0xe2be
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xe2c0
.exit20
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe2c1


; ***************************************************************************************
.starSave
    LDX #.osfileStartAddressLow - .osfileBlockStart     ; X=offset into OSFILE block to clear start address  $^$ 0xe2c2
    JSR .readOSFILEAddress                              ;  $^$ 0xe2c4
    BCC .badCommandError                                ; if (no start address found) then branch (exit via 'Bad command' error)  $^$ 0xe2c7
    CLV                                                 ; clear bit 6  $^$ 0xe2c9

    ;
    ; check for '+' to indicate a length rather than the end address
    ;
    LDA (.stringInputBufferAddressLow),Y                ; read next byte from text line  $^$ 0xe2ca
    CMP #.charPLUS                                      ; is it '+'  $^$ 0xe2cc
    BNE +                                               ; if (not '+') then branch (it's the end address)  $^$ 0xe2ce
    BIT .allBitsSet                                     ; set V flag (it's the length)  $^$ 0xe2d0
    INY                                                 ; increment Y to point to hex group  $^$ 0xe2d3
+

    ;
    ; read file length/end address from command line string
    ;
    LDX #.osfileEndAddressLow - .osfileBlockStart       ; X=offset into OSFILE block for end address  $^$ 0xe2d4
    JSR .readOSFILEAddress                              ;  $^$ 0xe2d6
    BCC .badCommandError                                ; if (carry clear, i.e. no hex byte found) then branch ('Bad command' error)  $^$ 0xe2d9
    PHP                                                 ; save flags  $^$ 0xe2db
    BVC .explicitEndAddressFound                        ; if (V clear; i.e. explicit end address found; i.e. no '+') then branch  $^$ 0xe2dc

    ; add start address and length, and store as end address
    LDX #$FC                                            ; X=loop counter, from $FC incrementing to $00 (4 bytes copied)  $^$ 0xe2de
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xe2e0
-
    LDA .osfileStartAddressLow - $FC,X                  ; Get start address  $^$ 0xe2e1
    ADC .page2Start,X                                   ; add length  $^$ 0xe2e4
    STA .page2Start,X                                   ; store as end address  $^$ 0xe2e7
    INX                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe2ea
    BNE -                                               ; loop until X=0  $^$ 0xe2eb

.explicitEndAddressFound
    LDX #3                                              ; X=loop counter  $^$ 0xe2ed
-
    LDA .osfileStartAddressLow,X                        ; }  $^$ 0xe2ef
    STA .osfileExecAddressLow,X                         ; }  $^$ 0xe2f2
    STA .osfileLoadAddressLow,X                         ; } copy start adddress to load and execution addresses  $^$ 0xe2f5
    DEX                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xe2f8
    BPL -                                               ; }  $^$ 0xe2f9

    PLP                                                 ; get back flag  $^$ 0xe2fb
    BEQ .callOSFILEWithParameterBlockForLoadSave        ; if (end of command line reached) then branch to do OSFILE  $^$ 0xe2fc

    ;
    ; read command line for execution address
    ;
    LDX #.osfileExecAddressLow - .osfileBlockStart      ; X=offset into OSFILE block for execution address  $^$ 0xe2fe
    JSR .readOSFILEAddress                              ;  $^$ 0xe300
    BCC .badCommandError                                ; if (error) then branch ('Bad command' error)  $^$ 0xe303
    BEQ .callOSFILEWithParameterBlockForLoadSave        ; if (end of line reached) then branch (do OSFILE)  $^$ 0xe305

    ;
    ; read command line for load address
    ;
    LDX #.osfileLoadAddressLow - .osfileBlockStart      ; X=offset into OSFILE block for load address  $^$ 0xe307
    JSR .readOSFILEAddress                              ;  $^$ 0xe309
    BCC .badCommandError                                ; if (error) then branch ('Bad command' error)  $^$ 0xe30c
    BEQ .callOSFILEWithParameterBlockForLoadSave        ; if (end of line) then branch (do OSFILE)  $^$ 0xe30e
    ; fall through... (anything else is an error!)

; ***************************************************************************************
.badCommandError
    BRK                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe310
    !byte $FE                                           ; error number
    !text "Bad command"                                 ; error string. The following BRK
                                                        ; instruction is also the zero
                                                        ; terminator for this string.

.badKeyError
    BRK                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe31d
    !byte $FB                                           ; error number
    !text "Bad key",0                                   ; string with zero terminator

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; *KEY
;
; The *KEY <number> <string> command defines one of 16 strings. These strings are associated
; with keys on the keyboard. When the key is pressed, the contents of the string are entered
; into the input buffer ('expanded'). These are also known as 'soft key' definitions.
;
;       *KEY number     Definition
;           0-9         Function keys f0-f9
;            10         When BREAK is pressed, the contents of the string are played
;            11         COPY key
;            12         LEFT key
;            13         RIGHT key
;            14         DOWN key
;            15         UP key
;
; Whether the soft keys are expanded is controlled by OSBYTE 225 (See .functionAndCursorKeyCodes)
; For the COPY key and cursor keys to be expanded, they must also be enabled using OSBYTE 4
; with X = 2 (see .osbyte4EntryPoint) which is translated into a call to OSBYTE 237, which
; updates memory location .cursorEditingType. (See .cursorEditingType)
;
; Memory
; Soft key definitions are stored in $0B00-$0BFF (See .softKeyPage). The first 16 bytes
; ($0B00-$0B0F) are a table of byte offsets from $0B01 to the start of the string definition
; for that soft key.
;
; The seventeenth byte (at $0B10) is the offset from $0B01 to the first free byte after all
; soft key definitions (See .softKeysCurrentEndOffset). If a key has no definition, it's
; offset also points to the first free byte.
;
; The string definitions follow (with no terminators).
;
; When a new key is defined (or undefined using *KEY <number>) the existing strings are
; compacted (shuffled down in memory to leave no gaps) with the old definition removed so the
; new definition can be added on the end. (See .compactStarKeyStrings). Thus the string
; definitions always appear in memory in the order they are defined, with the latest *KEY
; definition showing last.
;
; On Entry:
;   Y = offset to source string of command line
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.starKey
    JSR .parseDecimalNumberFromString                   ; set up key number in A  $^$ 0xe322
    BCC .badKeyError                                    ; if (not valid number) then branch ('Bad key' error)  $^$ 0xe32a
    CPX #16                                             ; compare key number with 16  $^$ 0xe32c
    BCS .badKeyError                                    ; if (key number is 16 or more) then branch ('Bad key' error)  $^$ 0xe32e
    JSR .skipSpacesAndCommaValid                        ; skip commas, and check for CR  $^$ 0xe330
    PHP                                                 ; save flags for later (remember Z = CR found)  $^$ 0xe333
    LDX .softKeysCurrentEndOffset                       ; get pointer to top of existing key strings  $^$ 0xe334
    TYA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xe337
    PHA                                                 ; } save Y to preserve text pointer  $^$ 0xe338
    JSR .compactStarKeyStrings                          ; compact soft key definitions  $^$ 0xe339
    PLA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xe33c
    TAY                                                 ; } restore Y  $^$ 0xe33d
    PLP                                                 ; restore flags (recalls Z = CR found)  $^$ 0xe33e
    BNE .addStarKeyString                               ; if (CR not found) then branch (to set up new string)  $^$ 0xe33f
    RTS                                                 ; return (sets empty string)  $^$ 0xe341


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; *FX
;
; This is the entry point for the OSCLI call to execute "*FX <A>,<X>,<Y>". We parse the first
; numeric parameter ('A') then fall through to the version that parses a range of other star
; commands with 'X' and 'Y' parameters, each implemented with an OSBYTE call.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.fxEntryPoint
    JSR .parseDecimalNumberFromString                   ; convert the number to binary  $^$ 0xe342
    BCC .badCommandError                                ; if (bad number) then branch ('Bad command' error)  $^$ 0xe345
    TXA                                                 ; put the parsed first parameter in A  $^$ 0xe347
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Handle a range of star commands
;
; On Entry:
;       A = $88     *CODE
;       A = $89     *MOTOR
;       A = $8B     *OPT
;       A = $8C     *TAPE
;       A = $8D     *ROM
;       A = $90     *TV
;       A = any     *FX     (when falling through from .fxEntryPoint above)
;
; Parses star commands with one or two numeric (0-255) parameters 'X' and 'Y' (space and/or
; comma separated) then calls OSBYTE with A as above.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.starCommandsForSpecificOSBYTEs
    PHA                                                 ; save A  $^$ 0xe348
    LDA #0                                              ; }  $^$ 0xe349
    STA .starCommandXParameter                          ; } clear the X/Y parameters for the upcoming OSBYTE call  $^$ 0xe34b
    STA .starCommandYParameter                          ; }  $^$ 0xe34d
    JSR .skipSpacesAndComma                             ; skip commas and check for newline (CR)  $^$ 0xe34f
    BEQ .parsedParameters                               ; if (CR found) then branch (to call appropriate OSBYTE)  $^$ 0xe352

    JSR .parseDecimalNumberFromString                   ; parse first parameter (X Parameter for OSBYTE)  $^$ 0xe354
    BCC .badCommandError                                ; if (bad character) then branch (to give bad command error)  $^$ 0xe357
    STX .starCommandXParameter                          ; store as X parameter for OSBYTE  $^$ 0xe359
    JSR .skipSpacesAndCommaValid                        ; skip comma and check CR  $^$ 0xe35b
    BEQ .parsedParameters                               ; if (CR found) then branch (to call appropriate OSBYTE)  $^$ 0xe35e

    JSR .parseDecimalNumberFromString                   ; parse second parameter (Y Parameter for OSBYTE)  $^$ 0xe360
    BCC .badCommandError                                ; if (error) then branch ('Bad command' error)  $^$ 0xe363
    STX .starCommandYParameter                          ; store as Y parameter for OSBYTE  $^$ 0xe365
    JSR .skipSpacesAndCheckForCRInStringInput           ; now we must have a CR  $^$ 0xe367
    BNE .badCommandError                                ; if (no CR) then branch ('Bad command' error)  $^$ 0xe36a

.parsedParameters
    LDY .starCommandYParameter                          ; Y = OSBYTE parameter  $^$ 0xe36c
    LDX .starCommandXParameter                          ; X = OSBYTE parameter  $^$ 0xe36e
    PLA                                                 ; A = OSBYTE parameter  $^$ 0xe370
    JSR .OSBYTE                                         ; call OSBYTE  $^$ 0xe371
    BVS .badCommandError                                ; if (V set on return) then branch ('Bad command' error)  $^$ 0xe374
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe376

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Add a new *KEY string
; See .starKey.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.addStarKeyString
    SEC                                                 ; set carry (meaning: check for '"' marks around string)  $^$ 0xe377
    JSR .gsinitEntryPoint                               ; start reading string  $^$ 0xe378

    ; copy string into *KEY buffer
-
    JSR .gsreadEntryPoint                               ; read string  $^$ 0xe37b
    BCS +                                               ; if (end of string reached) then branch (deal with end of string)  $^$ 0xe37e
    INX                                                 ; point to first byte of new key definition  $^$ 0xe380
    BEQ .badKeyError                                    ; if (X=0, i.e. buffer overflow) then branch (exit with 'Bad Key' error)  $^$ 0xe381
    STA .softKeyPage,X                                  ; store character  $^$ 0xe383
    BCC -                                               ; if (not end of line) then branch (loop to copy next byte)  $^$ 0xe386

+
    BNE .badKeyError                                    ; if (parsing error) then branch (show 'Bad Key' error)  $^$ 0xe388
    PHP                                                 ; save flags  $^$ 0xe38a
    SEI                                                 ; disable interrupts  $^$ 0xe38b
    JSR .compactStarKeyStrings                          ; compact *KEY definitions with the stored string definition  $^$ 0xe38c

    ; Update the array of offsets that point to the start of each string
    LDX #$10                                            ; set loop counter  $^$ 0xe38f
-
    CPX .tempWorkspaceE6                                ; check for key already being defined  $^$ 0xe391
    BEQ .skipRestOfLoop                                 ; if (key already being defined) then branch (skip rest of loop)  $^$ 0xe393
    LDA .softKeyPage,X                                  ; get start of string X  $^$ 0xe395
    CMP .softKeyPage,Y                                  ; compare with start of string Y  $^$ 0xe398
    BNE .skipRestOfLoop                                 ; if (not the same) then branch (skip rest of loop)  $^$ 0xe39b
    LDA .softKeysCurrentEndOffset                       ; store top of string definition  $^$ 0xe39d
    STA .softKeyPage,X                                  ; in designated key pointer  $^$ 0xe3a0
.skipRestOfLoop
    DEX                                                 ; decrement loop pointer X  $^$ 0xe3a3
    BPL -                                               ; and do it all again  $^$ 0xe3a4
    PLP                                                 ; get back flags  $^$ 0xe3a6
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe3a7


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Get *KEY string length
;
; Get the length of a soft key definition. See .starKey.
;
; On Entry:
;       Y = *KEY number
;
; On Exit:
;       A = string length
;       Preserves X
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.getStarKeyStringLength
    PHP                                                 ; push flags  $^$ 0xe3a8
    SEI                                                 ; disable interrupts  $^$ 0xe3a9
    LDA .softKeysCurrentEndOffset                       ; get top of currently defined strings  $^$ 0xe3aa
    SEC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe3ad
    SBC .softKeyPage,Y                                  ; subtract to get the number of bytes in strings above end of string Y  $^$ 0xe3ae
    STA .tempStoreFB                                    ; store this  $^$ 0xe3b1
    TXA                                                 ; save X  $^$ 0xe3b3
    PHA                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe3b4
    LDX #$10                                            ; and X=16  $^$ 0xe3b5

-
    LDA .softKeyPage,X                                  ; get start offset (from .softKeyPage) of key string X  $^$ 0xe3b7
    SEC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe3ba
    SBC .softKeyPage,Y                                  ; subtract offset of string we are working on  $^$ 0xe3bb
    BCC +                                               ; if (carry clear, i.e. .softKeyPage+Y > .softKeyPage+X) then branch (forward)  $^$ 0xe3be
    BEQ +                                               ; if (result in A=0) then branch (forward)  $^$ 0xe3c0
    CMP .tempStoreFB                                    ; check against number of bytes above string we are working on  $^$ 0xe3c2
    BCS +                                               ; if (>= number of bytes above string we are working on) then branch  $^$ 0xe3c4
    STA .tempStoreFB                                    ; store A in .tempStoreFB  $^$ 0xe3c6
+
    DEX                                                 ; point to next lower key offset  $^$ 0xe3c8
    BPL -                                               ; if (not negative) then branch (loop back and do it again)  $^$ 0xe3c9

    PLA                                                 ; get back value of X  $^$ 0xe3cb
    TAX                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe3cc
    LDA .tempStoreFB                                    ; get back latest value of A  $^$ 0xe3cd
    PLP                                                 ; pull flags  $^$ 0xe3cf
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe3d0

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Compact *KEY strings
;
; Remove an existing definition, and move the remaining definitions down in memory (so that
; we can add a new definition on the end).
; See .starKey.
;
; On Entry:
;       .tempWorkspaceE6 = key number
; On Exit:
;       X is preserved
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.compactStarKeyStrings
    PHP                                                 ; push flags  $^$ 0xe3d1
    SEI                                                 ; disable interrupts  $^$ 0xe3d2
    TXA                                                 ; save X  $^$ 0xe3d3
    PHA                                                 ; push A  $^$ 0xe3d4
    LDY .tempWorkspaceE6                                ; get key number  $^$ 0xe3d5
    JSR .getStarKeyStringLength                         ; and set up .tempStoreFB to length of existing string  $^$ 0xe3d7
    LDA .softKeyPage,Y                                  ; get start of string Y  $^$ 0xe3da
    TAY                                                 ; put it in Y  $^$ 0xe3dd
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xe3de
    ADC .tempStoreFB                                    ; add number of bytes for existing string  $^$ 0xe3df
    TAX                                                 ; X = new end position  $^$ 0xe3e1
    STA .tempStoreFA                                    ; and store it in .tempStoreFA  $^$ 0xe3e2
    LDA .softKeyStringLength                            ; check to see if we are already defining a *KEY string  $^$ 0xe3e4
    BEQ +                                               ; if (key is not already being defined) branch  $^$ 0xe3e7
.keyInUseError
    BRK                                                 ; definition expanded) so error.  This stops *KEY 1 "*key1 FRED" etc.  $^$ 0xe3e9
    !byte $FA                                           ; error number
    !text "Key in use",0                                ;

+
    DEC .softKeyConsistencyFlag                         ; decrement consistency flag to $FF to warn that key definitions are being changed  $^$ 0xe3f6
    PLA                                                 ; pull A  $^$ 0xe3f9
    SEC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe3fa
    SBC .tempStoreFA                                    ; subtract .tempStoreFA  $^$ 0xe3fb
    STA .tempStoreFA                                    ; and re store it  $^$ 0xe3fd
    BEQ +                                               ; if (zero) then branch  $^$ 0xe3ff

    ; move string from offset X to offset Y
-
    LDA .softKeyPage + 1,X                              ; read byte from offset X  $^$ 0xe401
    STA .softKeyPage + 1,Y                              ; write character to offset Y  $^$ 0xe404
    INY                                                 ; increment pointer  $^$ 0xe407
    INX                                                 ; increment pointer  $^$ 0xe408
    DEC .tempStoreFA                                    ; decrement loop counter  $^$ 0xe409
    BNE -                                               ; if (not done yet) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xe40b

+
    TYA                                                 ; store end of moved string(s)  $^$ 0xe40d
    PHA                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe40e
    LDY .tempWorkspaceE6                                ; get back key number  $^$ 0xe40f

    ; adjust the offset to each KEY now we have moved one
    LDX #$10                                            ; point at top of last string  $^$ 0xe411
-
    LDA .softKeyPage,X                                  ; get this value  $^$ 0xe413
    CMP .softKeyPage,Y                                  ; compare it with start of new or re defined key  $^$ 0xe416
    BCC +                                               ; if (less) then branch  $^$ 0xe419
    BEQ +                                               ; if (equal) then branch  $^$ 0xe41b
    SBC .tempStoreFB                                    ; shift key definitions accordingly  $^$ 0xe41d
    STA .softKeyPage,X                                  ; store new offset to KEY X  $^$ 0xe41f
+
    DEX                                                 ; point to next lowest string def  $^$ 0xe422
    BPL -                                               ; if (X=>0) then branch (loop back and do it again)  $^$ 0xe423

    LDA .softKeysCurrentEndOffset                       ; make top of key definitions  $^$ 0xe425
    STA .softKeyPage,Y                                  ; the start of our key def  $^$ 0xe428
    PLA                                                 ; get new end of strings  $^$ 0xe42b
    STA .softKeysCurrentEndOffset                       ; and store it  $^$ 0xe42c
    TAX                                                 ; put A in X  $^$ 0xe42f
    INC .softKeyConsistencyFlag                         ; reset consistency flag  $^$ 0xe430
    PLP                                                 ; restore flags  $^$ 0xe433
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe434


; ***************************************************************************************
.bufferAddressesHigh
    !byte >(.keyboardInputBuffer - .keyboardInputBufferOffset)       ; 0 = Keyboard
    !byte >(.tapeOrRS423InputBuffer - .tapeOrRS423InputBufferOffset) ; 1 = tape/RS-423 Input
    !byte >(.tapeOrRS423OutputBuffer - .rs423OutputBufferOffset)     ; 2 = RS-423 output
    !byte >(.printerBuffer - .printerBufferOffset)                   ; 3 = printer
    !byte >(.soundChannel0Buffer - .soundChannel0BufferOffset)       ; 4 = sound channel 0
    !byte >(.soundChannel1Buffer - .soundChannel1BufferOffset)       ; 5 = sound channel 1
    !byte >(.soundChannel2Buffer - .soundChannel2BufferOffset)       ; 6 = sound channel 2
    !byte >(.soundChannel3Buffer - .soundChannel3BufferOffset)       ; 7 = sound channel 3
    !byte >(.speechBuffer - .speechBufferOffset)                     ; 8 = speech

; ***************************************************************************************
.bufferAddressesLow
    !byte <(.keyboardInputBuffer - .keyboardInputBufferOffset)       ; 0 = Keyboard
    !byte <(.tapeOrRS423InputBuffer - .tapeOrRS423InputBufferOffset) ; 1 = tape/RS-423 Input
    !byte <(.tapeOrRS423OutputBuffer - .rs423OutputBufferOffset)     ; 2 = RS-423 output
    !byte <(.printerBuffer - .printerBufferOffset)                   ; 3 = printer
    !byte <(.soundChannel0Buffer - .soundChannel0BufferOffset)       ; 4 = sound channel 0
    !byte <(.soundChannel1Buffer - .soundChannel1BufferOffset)       ; 5 = sound channel 1
    !byte <(.soundChannel2Buffer - .soundChannel2BufferOffset)       ; 6 = sound channel 2
    !byte <(.soundChannel3Buffer - .soundChannel3BufferOffset)       ; 7 = sound channel 3
    !byte <(.speechBuffer - .speechBufferOffset)                     ; 8 = speech

; ***************************************************************************************
.emptyBufferStartOffset
    !byte .keyboardInputBufferOffset                    ; 0 = Keyboard
    !byte .tapeOrRS423InputBufferOffset                 ; 1 = tape/RS-423 Input
    !byte .rs423OutputBufferOffset                      ; 2 = RS-423 output
    !byte .printerBufferOffset                          ; 3 = printer
    !byte .soundChannel0BufferOffset                    ; 4 = sound channel 0
    !byte .soundChannel1BufferOffset                    ; 5 = sound channel 1
    !byte .soundChannel2BufferOffset                    ; 6 = sound channel 2
    !byte .soundChannel3BufferOffset                    ; 7 = sound channel 3
    !byte .speechBufferOffset                           ; 8 = speech

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Get buffer address
;
; For buffer numbers, see .bufferNumberKeyboard.
;
; On Entry:
;       X=buffer number
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.getBufferAddress
    LDA .bufferAddressesLow,X                           ; get buffer base address low  $^$ 0xe450
    STA .tempStoreFA                                    ; store it  $^$ 0xe453
    LDA .bufferAddressesHigh,X                          ; get buffer base address high  $^$ 0xe455
    STA .tempStoreFB                                    ; store it  $^$ 0xe458
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe45a

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 152 - Examine buffer status
;
; On Entry:
;       X = buffer number
; On Exit:
;       X preserved
;       if buffer is empty C=1, Y is preserved
;                     else C=0, Y is offset to next character in buffer at $FA/B
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte152EntryPoint
    BIT .allBitsSet                                     ; set V flag (meaning examine buffer)  $^$ 0xe45b
    BVS .remJumper                                      ; ALWAYS branch (see .remEntryPoint  $^$ 0xe45e
                                                        ; for default entry point)

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 145 - Get byte from buffer
;
; On Entry:
;       X = buffer number
; On Exit:
;       X preserved
;       Y = character extracted
;       if buffer is empty C=1, else C=0
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte145EntryPoint
    CLV                                                 ; clear V  $^$ 0xe460
.remJumper
    JMP (.vectorREMV)                                   ; Jump via REMV. Default destination  $^$ 0xe461
                                                        ; is .remEntryPoint below

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; REMV - default entry point for remove from/examine buffer vector
;
; On Entry:
;       X = buffer number
;       V = 1 if only examination is requested
; On Exit:
;       Examination Only:   A = next byte to be removed
;                           X preserved
;                           Y = offset to next character in buffer at $FA/B
;
;       Removal:            A undefined
;                           X preserved
;                           Y = value of the byte removed
;
;       if buffer was already empty C=1
;                              else C=0
;
; Used by: OSBYTE 152 - examine buffer status
;      and OSBYTE 145 - get byte from buffer
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.remEntryPoint
    PHP                                                 ; push flags  $^$ 0xe464
    SEI                                                 ; disable interrupts  $^$ 0xe465
    LDA .bufferStartIndices,X                           ; get output pointer for buffer X  $^$ 0xe466
    CMP .bufferEndIndices,X                             ; compare to input pointer  $^$ 0xe469
    BEQ .pullSetCarryAndExit                            ; if (equal, i.e. buffer is empty) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xe46c
    TAY                                                 ; Y = buffer start position  $^$ 0xe46e
    JSR .getBufferAddress                               ; and get buffer pointer into .tempStoreFA/B  $^$ 0xe46f
    LDA (.tempStoreFA),Y                                ; read byte from buffer  $^$ 0xe472
    BVS .pullClearCarryAndExit                          ; if (V is set, i.e. only examination) then branch (exit with CARRY clear)  $^$ 0xe474
                                                        ; OSBYTE 152 has been done
    PHA                                                 ; must be OSBYTE 145 so save byte  $^$ 0xe476
    INY                                                 ; increment Y  $^$ 0xe477
    TYA                                                 ; A=Y  $^$ 0xe478
    BNE +                                               ; if (end of buffer not reached) then branch  $^$ 0xe479
    LDA .emptyBufferStartOffset,X                       ; get pointer start from offset table  $^$ 0xe47b
+
    STA .bufferStartIndices,X                           ; set buffer output pointer  $^$ 0xe47e
    CPX #2                                              ;  $^$ 0xe481
    BCC .recallAndExit                                  ; if (buffer is input; 0=keyboard or 1=RS-423 input) then branch  $^$ 0xe483

    CMP .bufferEndIndices,X                             ; for output buffers compare with buffer start  $^$ 0xe485
    BNE .recallAndExit                                  ; if (not the same, i.e. buffer is not empty) then branch  $^$ 0xe488

    LDY #.eventOutputBufferBecomesEmpty                 ; buffer is empty so Y=0  $^$ 0xe48a
    JSR .eventEntryPoint                                ; and enter EVENT routine to signal EVENT 0 - buffer becoming empty  $^$ 0xe48c

.recallAndExit
    PLA                                                 ; get back byte from buffer  $^$ 0xe48f
    TAY                                                 ; put it in Y  $^$ 0xe490
.pullClearCarryAndExit
    PLP                                                 ; get back flags  $^$ 0xe491
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry to indicate success  $^$ 0xe492
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe493

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Trigger an event
;
; Events
;
; Events are a slightly simpler way for users to use an interrupt. Events are disabled by
; default, but can be enabled via OSBYTE 14 (see .osbyte14EntryPoint). Different event types
; can be individually enabled or disabled. For the list of different event types,
; see .eventOutputBufferBecomesEmpty.
;
; Most events are generated from the default IRQ handling code. When a relevant interrupt
; happens .eventEntryPoint is called with the event type. If enabled, this calls the EVNTV
; vector with the event type in the accumulator. The default implementation of the EVNTV
; vector does nothing, but the user can intercept this vector and do their own processing.
;
; This provides a simpler (and more limited) interface to handling interrupts than
; intercepting the IRQ1 or IRQ2 vectors directly. Events can't override the default interrupt
; handling, but are executed in addition.
;
; As with regular interrupt code, event handling code must not enable interrupts, and should
; be brief (The Acorn User Guide suggests "one millisecond maximum", 2000 clock cycles,
; whereas the New Advanced User Guide suggests it should "not last for more than about 2ms").
;
; The user can generate their own events by calling .OSEVEN with A=9 (.eventUserEvent)
;
; (See NAUG Section 7, Page 119)
;
; On Entry:
;       A = parameter to pass into EVENV vector in Y
;       X = parameter to pass into EVENV vector in X
;       Y = event type
; On Exit:
;       A is preserved.
;       Flags are preserved except for carry:
;       Carry clear indicates the event was called successfully because it was enabled.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.eventEntryPoint
    PHP                                                 ; push flags  $^$ 0xe494
    SEI                                                 ; disable interrupts  $^$ 0xe495
    PHA                                                 ; push A  $^$ 0xe496
    STA .tempStoreFA                                    ; .tempStoreFA = A  $^$ 0xe497
    LDA .eventEnabledFlags,Y                            ; get enable event flag  $^$ 0xe499
    BEQ .pullTwiceSetCarryAndExit                       ; if (event is not enabled) then branch (exit with carry set)  $^$ 0xe49c
    TYA                                                 ; Y = event enabled flag  $^$ 0xe49e
    LDY .tempStoreFA                                    ; Y = original A  $^$ 0xe49f
    JSR .eventJumper                                    ; call the EVENV vector  $^$ 0xe4a1
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xe4a4
    PLP                                                 ; get back flags  $^$ 0xe4a5
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry for success  $^$ 0xe4a6
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe4a7

; ***************************************************************************************
.generateEventAndPutByteIntoBuffer
    TYA                                                 ; A=Y  $^$ 0xe4a8
    LDY #.eventCharacterEnteringInputBuffer             ; Y=2  $^$ 0xe4a9
    JSR .eventEntryPoint                                ; send event  $^$ 0xe4ab
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A  $^$ 0xe4ae
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 138 - Put byte into buffer
;
; On Entry:
;       X is buffer number
;       Y is character to be written
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte138EntryPoint
    TYA                                                 ; A=Y  $^$ 0xe4af
.insJumper
    JMP (.vectorINSV)                                   ; jump to INSV  $^$ 0xe4b0


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; INSV - insert value into buffer - default handler
;
; On Entry:
;       A is value to write
;       X is buffer number
; On Exit:
;       A preserved
;       X preserved
;       C clear on success
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.insEntryPoint
    PHP                                                 ; save flags  $^$ 0xe4b3
    SEI                                                 ; disable interrupts  $^$ 0xe4b4
    PHA                                                 ; save A  $^$ 0xe4b5
    LDY .bufferEndIndices,X                             ; get buffer input pointer  $^$ 0xe4b6
    INY                                                 ; increment Y to next byte  $^$ 0xe4b9
    BNE +                                               ; if (not reached the end index) then branch (skip forward)  $^$ 0xe4ba
    LDY .emptyBufferStartOffset,X                       ; set back to the start index  $^$ 0xe4bc
+
    TYA                                                 ; put it in A  $^$ 0xe4bf
    CMP .bufferStartIndices,X                           ; compare it with input pointer  $^$ 0xe4c0
    BEQ .insertIntoFullBuffer                           ; if (buffer is full) then branch  $^$ 0xe4c3
    LDY .bufferEndIndices,X                             ; get buffer end in Y  $^$ 0xe4c5
    STA .bufferEndIndices,X                             ; set new offset  $^$ 0xe4c8
    JSR .getBufferAddress                               ; and point .tempStoreFA/B at it  $^$ 0xe4cb
    PLA                                                 ; get back value to write  $^$ 0xe4ce
    STA (.tempStoreFA),Y                                ; write it in buffer  $^$ 0xe4cf
    PLP                                                 ; pull flags  $^$ 0xe4d1
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry for success  $^$ 0xe4d2
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe4d3

.insertIntoFullBuffer
    PLA                                                 ; get back byte  $^$ 0xe4d4
    CPX #2                                              ; }  $^$ 0xe4d5
    BCS .pullSetCarryAndExit                            ; } if we are working on output buffer then branch  $^$ 0xe4d7

    LDY #.eventInputBufferBecomesFull                   ; input buffer is full  $^$ 0xe4d9
    JSR .eventEntryPoint                                ; to service input buffer full event  $^$ 0xe4db
    PHA                                                 ; push A  $^$ 0xe4de

.pullTwiceSetCarryAndExit
    PLA                                                 ; restore A  $^$ 0xe4df
.pullSetCarryAndExit
    PLP                                                 ; restore flags  $^$ 0xe4e0
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xe4e1
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe4e2

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Check for a letter (A-Z or a-z)
;
; On Entry:
;       A = character to check
; On Exit:
;       Preserves A
;       Carry clear if character is an upper or lower case letter (A-Z or a-z)
;       otherwise carry set
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.isLetter
    PHA                                                 ; save A  $^$ 0xe4e3
    AND #$DF                                            ; convert lower to upper case  $^$ 0xe4e4
    CMP #.charA                                         ; compare with 'A'  $^$ 0xe4e6
    BCC .noLetter                                       ; if (lower than 'A') then branch (exit routine with carry set)  $^$ 0xe4e8
    CMP #.charZ + 1                                     ; compare with 'Z' + 1  $^$ 0xe4ea
    BCC .yesLetter                                      ; if (no larger than 'Z') then branch (exit with carry clear)  $^$ 0xe4ec
.noLetter
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xe4ee
.yesLetter
    PLA                                                 ; restore original value of A  $^$ 0xe4ef
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe4f0

; [ Alternatively this would use four fewer bytes...
; .isLetter
;    PHA                                                ; Save A
;    AND #$DF                                           ; convert lower to upper case
;    SEC                                                ;
;    SBC #.charA                                        ; 'A'-'Z' maps to 0-25
;    CMP #26                                            ; check if in range 0-25
;    PLA                                                ;
;    RTS                                                ; ]

; ***************************************************************************************
.insertByteIntoKeyboardBuffer
    LDX #0                                              ; X=0 to indicate keyboard buffer  $^$ 0xe4f1
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 153 - Put byte in input buffer
;
; On Entry:
;       X is buffer number:
;           1 is RS-423 input
;           0 is Keyboard
;       Y is character to be written
;
; On Exit:
;       Carry clear
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte153EntryPoint
    TXA                                                 ; A=buffer number  $^$ 0xe4f3
    AND .rs423Mode                                      ; AND with RS-423 mode:  $^$ 0xe4f4
                                                        ; (0 = treat as keyboard;
                                                        ;  1 = ignore Escapes, no events, no soft keys)
    BNE .osbyte138EntryPoint                            ; if (RS-423 input buffer) AND (RS-423 in normal mode) then branch (enter byte into buffer)  $^$ 0xe4f7
    TYA                                                 ; Y=character to write  $^$ 0xe4f9
    EOR .asciiCodeThatGeneratesESCAPEAction             ; compare with current escape ASCII code (0=match)  $^$ 0xe4fa
    ORA .escapeAction                                   ; or with current ESCAPE status (0=ESC, 1=ASCII)  $^$ 0xe4fd
    BNE .generateEventAndPutByteIntoBuffer              ; if (not ESCAPE character) OR (ESCAPE action says ASCII) then branch (to enter byte in buffer)  $^$ 0xe500
    LDA .escapeAndBreakEffect                           ; get ESCAPE/BREAK effect byte  $^$ 0xe502
    ROR                                                 ; Rotate to get ESCAPE bit into carry  $^$ 0xe505
    TYA                                                 ; get character back in A  $^$ 0xe506
    BCS .exitWithCarryClear                             ; if (escape effect disabled) then branch (exit with carry clear)  $^$ 0xe507
    LDY #.eventESCAPEConditionDetected                  ; signal event "Escape condition detected"  $^$ 0xe509
    JSR .eventEntryPoint                                ;  $^$ 0xe50b
    BCC .exitWithCarryClear                             ; if (event handles ESCAPE) then branch (exit with carry clear)  $^$ 0xe50e
    JSR .osbyte125EntryPoint                            ; set ESCAPE flag  $^$ 0xe510

.exitWithCarryClear
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xe513
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe514

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Handle cursor, COPY and soft keys for non-zero cursor editing type
;
; On Entry:
;       A = cursor editing type
;           1 = return $87 - $8B (codes for COPY, LEFT, RIGHT, DOWN, UP)
;           2 = use cursor keys as soft keys 11-15
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.handleCursorKeysAndCOPY
    ROR                                                 ; get bit 0 of cursor editing type  $^$ 0xe515
                                                        ; into carry

    ; carry is set means cursor keys return codes $87-$8B
    ; carry  clear means cursor keys and COPY key are soft keys 11=COPY,12=LEFT,13=RIGHT,
    ;                                                           14=DOWN,15=UP

    PLA                                                 ; get back character A  $^$ 0xe516
    BCS .exitWithCarryClear2                            ; if (carry set) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xe517

    ; cursor keys are 'soft'
.handleFunctionKeyPress
