;       byte 11:  change of amplitude per step during release phase (-127 to +127)
;       byte 12:  target level at end of attack phase (0 to 126)
;       byte 13:  target level at end of decay  phase (0 to 126)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osword8EntryPoint
    SBC #1                                              ; }  $^$ 0xe8ae
    ASL                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xe8b0
    ASL                                                 ; } set up appropriate displacement to storage area  $^$ 0xe8b1
    ASL                                                 ; } A=(A-1)*16 OR 15  $^$ 0xe8b2
    ASL                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xe8b3
    ORA #%00001111                                      ; }  $^$ 0xe8b4
    TAX                                                 ; X=A (destination offset)  $^$ 0xe8b6
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0 (value to write)  $^$ 0xe8b7
    LDY #16                                             ; Y = loop counter  $^$ 0xe8b9
.copyEnvelopeLoop
    CPY #14                                             ;  $^$ 0xe8bb
    BCS +                                               ; if (Y >= 14) then branch (don't read from block, just store zero in envelope buffer)  $^$ 0xe8bd
    LDA (.oswordX),Y                                    ; get byte from parameter block  $^$ 0xe8bf
+
    STA .envelopeBuffer,X                               ; and store it in appropriate area  $^$ 0xe8c1
    DEX                                                 ; decrement X  $^$ 0xe8c4
    DEY                                                 ; decrement Y  $^$ 0xe8c5
    BNE .copyEnvelopeLoop                               ; if (not zero) then branch (loop back and do it again)  $^$ 0xe8c6
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe8c8
    ; Note that envelope number is NOT transferred. The envelope number is not needed in
    ; the buffer since the address in the buffer determines the envelope number.


; ***************************************************************************************
; On Exit:
;   When Y = 0:
;       A = channel number (0-3)
;       C set if channel low byte > 15, i.e. if flush is required
;
;   When Y = 1:
;       A = Sync number (0-3)
;       C set if channel low byte > 15, i.e. if hold is required
;
.getChannelNumberAndFlush
.getSyncNumberAndHold
    LDA (.oswordX),Y                                    ; get byte (channel parameter low byte or sync parameter low byte)  $^$ 0xe8c9
    CMP #$10                                            ; is it greater than 15, if so set carry  $^$ 0xe8cb
    AND #3                                              ; get hardware channel number  $^$ 0xe8cd
    INY                                                 ; increment Y to point to byte 1 of the parameters  $^$ 0xe8cf
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe8d0


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSWORD 3 - Read interval timer
;
; The interval timer is centi-seconds and 5 bytes long.
;
; On Entry:
;       .oswordX/Y is the address for the five byte result
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osword3EntryPoint
    LDX #.countdownIntervalTimer - (.timeClockA - 5)    ; X is the offset from (clockA-5) to countdown timer  $^$ 0xe8d1
    BNE .readFiveBytesIntoBlock                         ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xe8d3

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSWORD 1 - Read system clock
;
; The system clock counts in centi-seconds since boot and is 5 bytes long.
;
; On Entry:
;       .oswordX/Y is the address for the five byte result
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osword1EntryPoint
    LDX .timeClockSwitch                                ; X=current system clock store pointer  $^$ 0xe8d5
.readFiveBytesIntoBlock
    LDY #4                                              ; Y = loop counter  $^$ 0xe8d8
-
    LDA .timeClockA - 5,X                               ; read byte  $^$ 0xe8da
    STA (.oswordX),Y                                    ; store it in parameter block  $^$ 0xe8dd
    INX                                                 ; X = X + 1  $^$ 0xe8df
    DEY                                                 ; Y = Y - 1  $^$ 0xe8e0
    BPL -                                               ; if (Y >= 0) then branch (loop back and do it again)  $^$ 0xe8e1
.exit22
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe8e3

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSWORD 4 - Write interval timer
;
; On Entry:
;       .oswordX/Y is the address of the five byte value to set
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osword4EntryPoint
    LDA #.countdownIntervalTimer - (.timeClockA - 5)    ; A=15 is the offset from clockA to countdown timer  $^$ 0xe8e4
    BNE .writeFiveBytesFromBlock                        ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xe8e6

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSWORD 2 - Write system clock
;
; On Entry:
;       .oswordX/Y is the address of the five byte value to set
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osword2EntryPoint
    LDA .timeClockSwitch                                ; get current clock store pointer  $^$ 0xe8e8
    EOR #15                                             ; and invert to get inactive clock (toggle between 5 and 10)  $^$ 0xe8eb
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry (indicates write system clock)  $^$ 0xe8ed
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Write system clock or interval timer
;
; On Entry:
;       carry clear indicates write system clock
;       carry set indicates write interval timer
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.writeFiveBytesFromBlock
    PHA                                                 ; store A  $^$ 0xe8ee
    TAX                                                 ; X=A  $^$ 0xe8ef
    LDY #4                                              ; Y=loop counter  $^$ 0xe8f0
.writeClockLoop
    LDA (.oswordX),Y                                    ; transfer 5 bytes from out parameter block  $^$ 0xe8f2
    STA .timeClockA - 5,X                               ; to the clock or timer  $^$ 0xe8f4
    INX                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe8f7
    DEY                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe8f8
    BPL .writeClockLoop                                 ; if (Y >= 0) then branch (loop)  $^$ 0xe8f9
    PLA                                                 ; restore A  $^$ 0xe8fb
    BCS .exit22                                         ; if (carry set, i.e. write to interval timer requested) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xe8fc
    STA .timeClockSwitch                                ; write back current clock (5 or 10) into switch variable  $^$ 0xe8fe
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe901

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSWORD 0 - Read line from current input into memory
;
; On Entry:
;       .oswordX/.oswordY - address of parameter block:
;           byte 0: address of input buffer for result (low)
;           byte 1: address of input buffer for result (high)
;           byte 2: maximum line length
;           byte 3: minimum acceptable ASCII code
;           byte 4: maximum acceptable ASCII code
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osword0EntryPoint
    LDY #4                                              ; Y=4  $^$ 0xe902
-
    LDA (.oswordX),Y                                    ; copy bytes 2,3,4 to absolute addresses .osword0MaxLineLength,+1,+2  $^$ 0xe904
    STA .osword0MaxLineLength-2,Y                       ;  $^$ 0xe906
    DEY                                                 ; decrement Y  $^$ 0xe909
    CPY #2                                              ; until Y=1  $^$ 0xe90a
    BCS -                                               ;  $^$ 0xe90c

    LDA (.oswordX),Y                                    ; get address of input buffer (high byte)  $^$ 0xe90e
    STA .osword0BufferAddressHigh                       ; store it in temporary buffer  $^$ 0xe910
    DEY                                                 ; decrement Y  $^$ 0xe912
    STY .pagedModeCounter                               ; Y=0 store in print line counter for paged mode  $^$ 0xe913
    LDA (.oswordX),Y                                    ; get address of input buffer (low byte)  $^$ 0xe916
    STA .osword0BufferAddressLow                        ; and store in temporary buffer  $^$ 0xe918
    CLI                                                 ; allow interrupts  $^$ 0xe91a
    BCC .readInputCharacter                             ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xe91b

; ***************************************************************************************
.readLineInputBufferFull
    LDA #.charBELL                                      ; A=7  $^$ 0xe91d
.retryReadWithoutIncrementingPosition
    DEY                                                 ; decrement Y  $^$ 0xe91f
.retryReadIncrementingPosition
    INY                                                 ; increment Y  $^$ 0xe920
.outputCharacterAndReadAgain
    JSR .OSWRCH                                         ; and call OSWRCH  $^$ 0xe921
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.readInputCharacter
    JSR .OSRDCH                                         ; read character from input stream  $^$ 0xe924
    BCS .exitWithNegativeAndCarryFlagsSet               ; if (error occurred) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xe927
    TAX                                                 ; X=A  $^$ 0xe929
    LDA .characterDestinationsAvailableFlags            ; get character destination status  $^$ 0xe92a
    ROR                                                 ; rotate the status twice to make  $^$ 0xe92d
    ROR                                                 ; carry reflect the 'disable VDU driver' bit  $^$ 0xe92e
    TXA                                                 ; restore character read  $^$ 0xe92f
    BCS +                                               ; if (vdu disabled) then branch (skip forward)  $^$ 0xe930
    LDX .twosComplimentOfNumberOfBytesInVDUQueue        ; get number of items in VDU queue  $^$ 0xe932
    BNE .outputCharacterAndReadAgain                    ; if (not zero) then branch (output character and read again)  $^$ 0xe935
+
    CMP #.charDELETE                                    ;  $^$ 0xe937
    BNE +                                               ; if (character is not DELETE) then branch forward  $^$ 0xe939
    CPY #0                                              ;  $^$ 0xe93b
    BEQ .readInputCharacter                             ; if (Y is zero, i.e. first character) then branch (read next character)  $^$ 0xe93d
    DEY                                                 ; decrement Y (position in buffer decrements)  $^$ 0xe93f
    BCS .outputCharacterAndReadAgain                    ; ALWAYS branch back to otput the DELETE and read again  $^$ 0xe940
+
    CMP #.charDisableVDUOrDeleteLine                    ; is it delete line (CTRL-U)  $^$ 0xe942
    BNE +                                               ; if (not CTRL-U) then branch forward  $^$ 0xe944
    TYA                                                 ; Y=A  $^$ 0xe946
    BEQ .readInputCharacter                             ; if (we are still reading first character) then branch back the read character  $^$ 0xe947
    LDA #.charDELETE                                    ;  $^$ 0xe949
-
    JSR .OSWRCH                                         ; }  $^$ 0xe94b
    DEY                                                 ; } output DELETE until Y=0  $^$ 0xe94e
    BNE -                                               ; }  $^$ 0xe94f
    BEQ .readInputCharacter                             ; ALWAYS branch (read character again)  $^$ 0xe951
+
    STA (.osword0BufferAddressLow),Y                    ; store character in designated buffer  $^$ 0xe953
    CMP #.charRETURN                                    ;  $^$ 0xe955
    BEQ .outputNewlineAndExit                           ; if (carriage return entered) then branch  $^$ 0xe957
    CPY .osword0MaxLineLength                           ; check the line length  $^$ 0xe959
    BCS .readLineInputBufferFull                        ; if (buffer full) then branch (loop to ring bell)  $^$ 0xe95c
    CMP .osword0MinASCIICharacter                       ; check minimum character  $^$ 0xe95e
    BCC .retryReadWithoutIncrementingPosition           ; if (less than minimum character) then branch (read at existing position)  $^$ 0xe961
    CMP .osword0MaxASCIICharacter                       ; check maximum character  $^$ 0xe963
    BEQ .retryReadIncrementingPosition                  ; if (equal to maximum character) then accept the character and move on  $^$ 0xe966
    BCC .retryReadIncrementingPosition                  ; if (less than maximum character) then accept the character and move on  $^$ 0xe968
    BCS .retryReadWithoutIncrementingPosition           ; ALWAYS branch (reject character and continue)  $^$ 0xe96a

.outputNewlineAndExit
    JSR .OSNEWL                                         ; output CR/LF  $^$ 0xe96c
    JSR .netvJumper                                     ; call Econet vector  $^$ 0xe96f
.exitWithNegativeAndCarryFlagsSet
    LDA .escapeFlag                                     ; A=ESCAPE FLAG  $^$ 0xe972
    ROL                                                 ; put bit 7 into carry  $^$ 0xe974
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe975


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 5 - Select printer type
;
; On Entry:
;       X=0       ignore printer output
;       X=1       parallel output
;       X=2       RS-423 output (will act as sink if RS-423 is enabled using OSBYTE with A=3)
;       X=3       user printer
;       X=4       Econet printer
;       X=5-255   user printer
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte5EntryPoint
    CLI                                                 ; allow interrupts briefly  $^$ 0xe976
    SEI                                                 ; disable interrupts  $^$ 0xe977
    BIT .escapeFlag                                     ; check if ESCAPE is pending  $^$ 0xe978
    BMI .exit23                                         ; if (ESCAPE is pending) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xe97a
    BIT .printerBufferEmptyFlag                         ; check bit 7 for printer buffer empty  $^$ 0xe97c
    BPL .osbyte5EntryPoint                              ; if (bit 7=0, not empty) then branch back and try again (wait until buffer is empty)  $^$ 0xe97f
    JSR .selectPrinterType                              ; check for user defined routine  $^$ 0xe981
    LDY #0                                              ; Y=0  $^$ 0xe984
    STY .osbyteY                                        ; F1=0  $^$ 0xe986
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 1 - Read/Write user flag; OSBYTE 6 - Set printer ignore character
;
; On Entry:
;       OSBYTE 1:
;           To read the user flag:  Y=$00
;           To write the user flag: X=value to write, Y=$FF
;       OSBYTE 6:
;           X = value to write
; On Exit:
;       X contains the previous value
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte1EntryPoint
.osbyte6EntryPoint
    ORA #$0280 - .mosVariablesMinus166                  ; A set to read/write locations:  $^$ 0xe988

    ; At this point, A depends on the entry point. A is set up to affect a particular
    ; system variable:
    ;
    ; Entry via OSBYTE 1: $0281 (user flag)                - .mosVariablesMinus166
    ; Entry via OSBYTE 5: $0285 (printer destination)      - .mosVariablesMinus166
    ; Entry via OSBYTE 6: $0286 (printer ignore character) - .mosVariablesMinus166
    ;
    BNE .readWriteSystemVariable                        ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xe98a


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 12 - Set keyboard autorepeat rate
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte12EntryPoint
    BNE .osbyte11EntryPoint                             ; if (.osbyteX != 0; i.e. not resetting to defaults) then branch  $^$ 0xe98c
    LDX #50                                             ; reset default delay and rate  $^$ 0xe98e
    STX .keyboardAutoRepeatDelay                        ; set keyboard autorepeat delay  $^$ 0xe990
    LDX #8                                              ; set X=8 for default autorepeat rate  $^$ 0xe993
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 11 - Set keyboard autorepeat delay
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte11EntryPoint
    ADC #$CF                                            ; A=A+208 (carry set)  $^$ 0xe995
                                                        ; So...
                                                        ; A=219 if entered from OSBYTE 11
                                                        ; A=220 if entered from OSBYTE 12
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 3 - Select output stream; OSBYTE 4 - Enable/disable cursor editing
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte3EntryPoint
.osbyte4EntryPoint
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xe997
    ADC #$E9                                            ; A = A + 233  $^$ 0xe998
                                                        ; So...
                                                        ; A=236 if entered from OSBYTE 3
                                                        ; A=237 if entered from OSBYTE 4
                                                        ; A=196 if entered from OSBYTE 11
                                                        ; A=197 if entered from OSBYTE 12
.readWriteSystemVariable
    STX .osbyteX                                        ; store X  $^$ 0xe99a
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 166 to 255 - read/write system variable
;
; Set newValue = (oldValue AND .osbyteY) EOR .osbyteX
;
; On Entry:
;       A = offset from .mosVariablesMinus166 of variable to read/write
;       .osbyteX = X parameter from entry to OSBYTE
;       .osbyteY = Y parameter from entry to OSBYTE
; On Exit:
;       X = oldValue
;       Y = value of next system variable
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte166to255EntryPoint
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A  $^$ 0xe99c
    LDA .mosVariablesMinus166,Y                         ; read current value  $^$ 0xe99d
    TAX                                                 ; preserve this in X  $^$ 0xe9a0
    AND .osbyteY                                        ; }  $^$ 0xe9a1
    EOR .osbyteX                                        ; } new value = (old value AND Y) EOR X  $^$ 0xe9a3
    STA .mosVariablesMinus166,Y                         ; store it  $^$ 0xe9a5
    LDA .mosVariablesMinus166+1,Y                       ; get value of next byte into A  $^$ 0xe9a8
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A  $^$ 0xe9ab
.exit23
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe9ac


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Table of buffer types and serial baud rates
;
; This table has dual use. It is used to set the serial baud rate (using bits 0-5), and
; also to identify a buffer as being a sound buffer (bit 7):
;
;   - bit 7 is set if buffer X is a sound buffer
;   - bit 6 is not used (always set)
;   - bits 3,4,5 indicate the serial receive baud rate
;   - bits 0,1,2 indicate the serial transmit baud rate
;
;       111 =    75 baud
;       011 =   150 baud
;       101 =   300 baud
;       001 =  1200 baud
;       110 =  2400 baud
;       010 =  4800 baud
;       100 =  9600 baud
;       000 = 19200 baud
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.bufferTypeAndSerialBaudRatesTable
    !byte %01100100                                     ; Keyboard           9600 baud (default)
    !byte %01111111                                     ; RS-423 Input         75 baud
    !byte %01011011                                     ; RS-423 output       150 baud
    !byte %01101101                                     ; serial printer      300 baud
    !byte %11001001                                     ; sound0             1200 baud
    !byte %11110110                                     ; sound1             2400 baud
    !byte %11010010                                     ; sound2             4800 baud
    !byte %11100100                                     ; sound3             9600 baud
    !byte %01000000                                     ; speech            19200 baud


; ****************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 19 - Wait for vertical sync
;
; ****************************************************************************************
.osbyte19EntryPoint
    LDA .verticalSyncCounter                            ; Read vertical sync counter  $^$ 0xe9b6
-
    CLI                                                 ; allow interrupts briefly  $^$ 0xe9b9
    SEI                                                 ; disable interrupts again  $^$ 0xe9ba
    CMP .verticalSyncCounter                            ; has the vertical sync counter changed yet?  $^$ 0xe9bb
    BEQ -                                               ; if (the values are the same) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xe9be
    ; fall through...

; ****************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 160 - Read VDU Variable
;
; ****************************************************************************************
.osbyte160EntryPoint
    LDY .vduVariablesStart + 1,X                        ; get VDU variable (often the high byte)  $^$ 0xe9c0
    LDA .vduVariablesStart,X                            ; get VDU variable (often the low byte)  $^$ 0xe9c3
    TAX                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe9c6
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe9c7

; ****************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 18 - Reset soft keys
;
; ****************************************************************************************
.osbyte18EntryPoint
    LDA #$10                                            ; set consistency flag  $^$ 0xe9c8
    STA .softKeyConsistencyFlag                         ;  $^$ 0xe9ca
    LDX #0                                              ; X=0  $^$ 0xe9cd
-
    STA .softKeyPage,X                                  ; and wipe clean  $^$ 0xe9cf
    INX                                                 ; soft key buffer  $^$ 0xe9d2
    BNE -                                               ; until X=0 again  $^$ 0xe9d3
    STX .softKeyConsistencyFlag                         ; zero consistency flag  $^$ 0xe9d5
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe9d8

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 118 - Set keyboard LEDs based on keyboard status
;
; On Exit:
;       carry is set if CTRL pressed
;       N is set if SHIFT is pressed
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte118EntryPoint
    PHP                                                 ; remember flags  $^$ 0xe9d9
    SEI                                                 ; disable interrupts  $^$ 0xe9da
    LDA #$40                                            ; switch on CAPS and SHIFT LOCK lights  $^$ 0xe9db
    JSR .turnOnKeyboardLightsAndTestEscape              ; via subroutine  $^$ 0xe9dd
    BMI .popRollAndExit                                 ; if (negative, i.e. ESCAPE condition exists) then branch  $^$ 0xe9e0
    CLC                                                 ; clear V and C  $^$ 0xe9e2
    CLV                                                 ; calling main keyboard routine to  $^$ 0xe9e3
    JSR .keyJumper                                      ; switch on lights as required  $^$ 0xe9e4
.popRollAndExit
    PLP                                                 ; recall flags  $^$ 0xe9e7
    ROL                                                 ; and rotate carry into bit 0  $^$ 0xe9e8
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe9e9

; ***************************************************************************************
.turnOnKeyboardLightsAndTestEscape
    BCC .skipKeyboardLights                             ; if (carry clear) then branch  $^$ 0xe9ea
    LDY #7                                              ; switch on SHIFT LOCK light  $^$ 0xe9ec
    STY .systemVIARegisterB                             ;  $^$ 0xe9ee
    DEY                                                 ; Y=6  $^$ 0xe9f1
    STY .systemVIARegisterB                             ; switch on CAPS LOCK light  $^$ 0xe9f2

.skipKeyboardLights
    BIT .escapeFlag                                     ; check bit 7 of escape flag indicating  $^$ 0xe9f5
                                                        ; that ESCAPE condition exists
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe9f7

; ***************************************************************************************
.writeAToSystemVIARegisterB
    PHP                                                 ; push flags  $^$ 0xe9f8
    SEI                                                 ; disable interupts  $^$ 0xe9f9
    STA .systemVIARegisterB                             ; write register B from Accumulator  $^$ 0xe9fa
    PLP                                                 ; get back flags  $^$ 0xe9fd
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe9fe

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 154 - Write to Video ULA's Video Control Register
;
; bit
;   0 - Flash colour select (which of the flashing colours is displayed)
;   1 - Teletext select
;   2 - } These two bits determine the number of characters per row
;   3 - } from this table:
;        00 = 10 characters per row
;        01 = 20 characters per row
;        10 = 40 characters per row
;        11 = 80 characters per row
;   4 - CRTC clock rate select:
;         0 = low frequency clock for MODEs 4-7
;         1 = high frequency clock for MODEs 0-3
;   5 - }
;   6 - } These three bits determine the width of cursor in bytes:
;   7 - }
;
;       000 = 0 cursor off
;       010 = 1 (for MODE 7)
;       100 = 1 (for MODEs 0,3,4,6)
;       110 = 2 (for MODEs 1,5)
;       111 = 4 (for MODE 2)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte154EntryPoint
    TXA                                                 ;  $^$ 0xe9ff
.setVideoULA
    PHP                                                 ; save flags  $^$ 0xea00
    SEI                                                 ; disable interrupts  $^$ 0xea01
    STA .videoULAVideoControlRegisterCopy               ; save RAM copy of new parameter  $^$ 0xea02
    STA .videoULAControlRegister                        ; write to control register  $^$ 0xea05
    LDA .videoULASecondFlashingColourInterval           ; get second flashing colour interval  $^$ 0xea08
    STA .videoULAFlashingColourIntervalCount            ; set flash counter to this value  $^$ 0xea0b
    PLP                                                 ; get back status  $^$ 0xea0e
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xea0f


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 155 - Set palette value
;
; On Entry:
;       X contains value to write
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte155EntryPoint
    TXA                                                 ; A = X  $^$ 0xea10
.osbyte155Internal
    EOR #7                                              ; convert to palette format required for video ULA register  $^$ 0xea11
    PHP                                                 ; remember flags (including interrupt disable flag)  $^$ 0xea13
    SEI                                                 ; prevent interrupts  $^$ 0xea14
    STA .videoULAPaletteValue                           ; store as current palette setting  $^$ 0xea15
    STA .videoULAPaletteRegister                        ; store actual colour in register  $^$ 0xea18
    PLP                                                 ; restore flags (including interrupt disable flag)  $^$ 0xea1b
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xea1c

; ***************************************************************************************
.gsinitForFilenameParsing
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xea1d
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; GSINIT - Initialise parsing of a string
;
; Initialises the parsing of a given string (the 'input' string). Usually the string is part
; of an OSCLI command line where a string is expected (e.g. the filename in a *LOAD or the
; definition of a function key in *KEY).
;
; Leading spaces are ignored. The input string can be surrounded by double quotation marks.
; The string is terminated by a carriage return, or the second double quotation mark, or
; (optionally) a space character (useful for filename parsing).
;
; Once initialised, the parsing occurs using multiple calls to GSREAD. Each call produces one
; character result based on the input string.
;
; Control codes are disallowed in the input string. However the bar character '|' can be
; used to introduce control codes into the parsed output of GSREAD, and the '|!' combination
; is used to introduce top bit set characters.
;
; '|' followed by a character (see exceptions below) gives the ASCII value minus 64.
;       e.g. |G = control code 7  (bell)
;            |M = control code 13 (carriage return)
; '|!' adds 128 to the following character.
; '||' is parsed as a single bar character.
; '|"' is parsed as double quotes.
; '|?' is parsed as the DELETE character (character 127).
;
; These can be combined, e.g. '|!|A' results in character 129 being parsed.
;
; On Entry:
;       Address for string stored at .stringInputBufferAddressLow/High
;       Y = offset into string
;       C = 0: string is terminated by a space (used for filename parsing)
;       C = 1: otherwise (used e.g. for defining a soft key with *KEY)
;
; On Exit:
;       .stringInputOptions bit 7 = double-quote character found at start
;                           bit 6 = don't stop on space character
;       Y = offset of the first non-blank character
;       A = first non-blank character
;       Z is set if string is empty
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.gsinitEntryPoint
    ROR .stringInputOptions                             ; Move carry into top bit of options  $^$ 0xea1e
    JSR .skipSpacesAndCheckForCRInStringInput           ; get character from text  $^$ 0xea20
    INY                                                 ; increment Y to point at next character  $^$ 0xea23
    CMP #.charDOUBLEQUOTE                               ; check for double quotes (") character  $^$ 0xea24
    BEQ +                                               ; if (double quotes) then branch  $^$ 0xea26
    DEY                                                 ; decrement Y  $^$ 0xea28
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xea29
+
    ROR .stringInputOptions                             ; bit 7 = double quote character found  $^$ 0xea2a
                                                        ; bit 6 = space is not a terminator
    CMP #.charRETURN                                    ; set Z flag if CR found  $^$ 0xea2c
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xea2e


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; GSREAD - Read one character by parsing the input string
;
; Parses a character from the input string previously set up by GSINIT.
; See .gsinitEntryPoint
;
; On Entry:
;       Address for string stored at .stringInputBufferAddressLow/High
;       Y = offset into string
; On Exit:
;       A = character read
;       X is preserved
;       Y = index of next character to be read
;       Carry is set if end of string reached
;       Overflow (V flag) is set if the character read was interpreted as a control code
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.gsreadEntryPoint
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0  $^$ 0xea2f
.gsreadInternal
    STA .stringInputPlingFlag                           ; store A ($80 if previous character is '!', zero otherwise)  $^$ 0xea31
    LDA (.stringInputBufferAddressLow),Y                ; read first character  $^$ 0xea33
    CMP #.charRETURN                                    ; check for CR  $^$ 0xea35
    BNE .notRETURN                                      ; if (not CR) then branch  $^$ 0xea37

    ; deal with RETURN character
    BIT .stringInputOptions                             ; check options  $^$ 0xea39
    BMI .brkBadString                                   ; if (second quotation mark needed) then branch ('Bad string' message)  $^$ 0xea3b
    BPL .finishedString                                 ; ALWAYS branch (string ok, finished)  $^$ 0xea3d

.notRETURN
    CMP #.charSPACE                                     ; check for SPACE  $^$ 0xea3f
    BCC .brkBadString                                   ; if (less then space, i.e. a control character) then branch ('Bad string' message)  $^$ 0xea41
    BNE .notSPACE                                       ; if (it's not a space) then branch  $^$ 0xea43

    ; Deal with ' ' SPACE character
    BIT .stringInputOptions                             ; check bit 6 and 7 of .stringInputOptions  $^$ 0xea45
    BMI .finishUpReadClearV                             ; if (double-quote character found) then branch  $^$ 0xea47
    BVC .finishedString                                 ; if (space character is a terminator) then branch (finished string)  $^$ 0xea49

.notSPACE
    CMP #.charDOUBLEQUOTE                               ; check for DOUBLE QUOTE  $^$ 0xea4b
    BNE .notDOUBLEQUOTE                                 ; if (not double quote) then branch  $^$ 0xea4d

    ; Deal with '"' DOUBLE QUOTE character
    BIT .stringInputOptions                             ; check options  $^$ 0xea4f
    BPL .finishUpReadClearV                             ; if (string didn't start with a double quote) then branch  $^$ 0xea51

    ; We have found a string surrounded by double quotes.
    ; Check the next character isn't also a double quote, as that's an error.
    INY                                                 ; point at next character  $^$ 0xea53
    LDA (.stringInputBufferAddressLow),Y                ; get it  $^$ 0xea54
    CMP #.charDOUBLEQUOTE                               ; check for double quotes (") character  $^$ 0xea56
    BEQ .finishUpReadClearV                             ; if (third double quote character found) then branch  $^$ 0xea58

.finishedString
    JSR .skipSpacesAndCheckForCRInStringInput           ; skip past any final SPACEs  $^$ 0xea5a
    SEC                                                 ; carry set  $^$ 0xea5d
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xea5e

.notDOUBLEQUOTE
    CMP #.charBAR                                       ; check for bar '|' character  $^$ 0xea5f
    BNE .finishUpReadClearV                             ; if (not bar) then branch  $^$ 0xea61

    ; deal with '|' vertical BAR character
    INY                                                 ; increase Y to point to next character  $^$ 0xea63
    LDA (.stringInputBufferAddressLow),Y                ; get next character  $^$ 0xea64
    CMP #.charBAR                                       ; check for '|' again  $^$ 0xea66
    BEQ .finishUpReadClearV                             ; if (bar found) then branch  $^$ 0xea68

    CMP #.charDOUBLEQUOTE                               ; check for double quotes (") character  $^$ 0xea6a
    BEQ .finishUpReadClearV                             ; if (double quotes) then branch  $^$ 0xea6c

    CMP #.charEXCLAMATIONMARK                           ; check for '!' character  $^$ 0xea6e
    BNE +                                               ; if (not '!') then branch  $^$ 0xea70

    ; deal with '|!' characters
    INY                                                 ; increment Y to next character  $^$ 0xea72
    LDA #$80                                            ; set bit 7  $^$ 0xea73
    BNE .gsreadInternal                                 ; loop back (sets bit 7 in next character)  $^$ 0xea75

    ; deal with remaining possible characters after the '|' BAR character
+
    CMP #.charSPACE                                     ; check for ' '  $^$ 0xea77
    BCC .brkBadString                                   ; if (less than space, i.e. a control code) then branch ('Bad string' message)  $^$ 0xea79

    CMP #.charQUESTIONMARK                              ; check for '|?'  $^$ 0xea7b
    BEQ +                                               ; if ('|?') then branch (set delete character)  $^$ 0xea7d

    ; Remaining '|' followed by a character is treated as a control code
    JSR .implementCTRLCodes                             ; modify code as if CTRL pressed  $^$ 0xea7f
    BIT .allBitsSet                                     ; Set V flag  $^$ 0xea82
    BVS .finishUpReadX                                  ; ALWAYS branch (finish up with V set)  $^$ 0xea85

+
    LDA #.charDELETE                                    ; delete character  $^$ 0xea87

.finishUpReadClearV
    CLV                                                 ; clear V  $^$ 0xea89
.finishUpReadX
    INY                                                 ; increment Y  $^$ 0xea8a
    ORA .stringInputPlingFlag                           ;  $^$ 0xea8b
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xea8d
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xea8e

; ***************************************************************************************
.brkBadString
    BRK                                                 ;  $^$ 0xea8f
    !byte $FD                                           ; error number
    !text "Bad string",0                                ; message (with zero terminator)

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Apply SHIFT to character in A
;
; Modify character in A as if the SHIFT key is being pressed
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.implementSHIFT
    CMP #.charZERO                                      ;  $^$ 0xea9c
    BEQ .exit24                                         ; if ('0' character found) then branch (return) (SHIFT '0' = '0')  $^$ 0xea9e
    CMP #.charAT                                        ;  $^$ 0xeaa0
    BEQ .exit24                                         ; if ('@' character found) then branch (return) (SHIFT '@' = '@')  $^$ 0xeaa2
    BCC .flipBitFourIfNotCtrlCharacter                  ; if (A < '@') then branch  $^$ 0xeaa4
                                                        ; the branch converts characters
                                                        ;       !"#$%&`()*+,-./ 123456789:;<=>?
                                                        ; into  123456789:;<=>? !"#$%&`()*+,-./
    CMP #.charDELETE                                    ;  $^$ 0xeaa6
    BEQ .exit24                                         ; if (DELETE character found) then branch (return) (SHIFT DELETE = DELETE)  $^$ 0xeaa8
    BCS .flipBitFourOnly                                ; if (greater than $7F) then branch (toggle bit 4 and exit)  $^$ 0xeaaa

    ; At this point A>64 and A<127
    ; The following code converts the following characters:
    ;        ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\]^_£ abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{|}~
    ; into   abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{|}~£_ ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\]^

.flipBitsForShift
    EOR #%00110000                                      ; flip bits 4 and 5  $^$ 0xeaac
    CMP #(.charUNDERSCORE XOR %00110000)                ; }  $^$ 0xeaae
    BEQ +                                               ; } if (it was originally underscore '_') then branch  $^$ 0xeab0

    CMP #(.charPOUND XOR %00110000)                     ; }  $^$ 0xeab2
    BNE .flipBitFourIfNotCtrlCharacter                  ; } if (it was NOT originally pound '£') then branch  $^$ 0xeab4
+
    EOR #$1F                                            ; EOR for converting pound symbol (which will become  $^$ 0xeab6
                                                        ; underscore when the EOR at .flipBitFourOnly is done)
.flipBitFourIfNotCtrlCharacter
    CMP #.charSPACE + 1                                 ; }  $^$ 0xeab8
    BCC .exit24                                         ; } if (control code) then branch (return)  $^$ 0xeaba
.flipBitFourOnly
    EOR #%00010000                                      ; flip bit 4  $^$ 0xeabc
.exit24
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xeabe

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Modify character in A as if the CTRL key is being pressed
;
; This is used both when the CTRL key is being pressed, and for parsing strings using
; GSINIT / GSREAD. See .gsinitEntryPoint.
;
;     Input     Output      Notes
;     ASCII      CTRL
;     Code       Code
;     ----------------------------------------------------------------------
;     32-63     32-63       VDU 32-63 (unchanged)
;     '@'         0         VDU 0
;     'A'         1         VDU 1
;           ...
;     'Z'        26         VDU 26
;     '['        27         VDU 27
;     '\'        28         VDU 28
;     ']'        29         VDU 29
;     '^'        30         VDU 30
;     '_'        31         VDU 31
;     '£'        31         VDU 31 this is treated as a special case.
;                                  it would otherwise result in VDU 0 [why the special case?]
;     'a'         1         VDU 1
;           ...
;     'z'        26         VDU 26
;     '{'        27         VDU 27
;     '|'        28         VDU 28
;     '}'        29         VDU 29
;     '~'        30         VDU 30
;     127       127         DELETE
;     128-255   flip bit 5  flip bit 5 [it's not clear why this is useful?]
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.implementCTRLCodes
    CMP #.charDELETE                                    ; check for DELETE  $^$ 0xeabf
    BEQ ++                                              ; if (DELETE found) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xeac1
    BCS .flipBitsForShift                               ; if (greater than $7F) then branch (process top bit characters)  $^$ 0xeac3
    CMP #.charPOUND                                     ; }  $^$ 0xeac5
    BNE +                                               ; } if (A is not '£') then branch  $^$ 0xeac7
    LDA #.charUNDERSCORE                                ; A='_'  $^$ 0xeac9
+
    CMP #.charAT                                        ; }  $^$ 0xeacb
    BCC ++                                              ; } if (A < '@') then branch (return unchanged)  $^$ 0xeacd
    AND #%00011111                                      ; at this point     A is between 64 to 126 inclusive  $^$ 0xeacf
                                                        ; zero bits 5 to 7  A is between  0 to  31 inclusive
++
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xead1

; ***************************************************************************************
.runBootString
    !text "/!BOOT",13

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 247 - Intercept BREAK
;
; On Exit:
;           Z clear if no user BREAK intercept code
; otherwise Z is set or cleared by user BREAK code
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte247EntryPoint
    LDA .breakInterceptJMPInstruction                  ; get first byte of user BREAK code (looking for 'JMP address')  $^$ 0xead9
    EOR #$4C                                           ; produces 0 if JMP absolute instruction is present  $^$ 0xeadc
    BNE +                                              ; if (not zero) then branch (return)  $^$ 0xeade
    JMP .breakInterceptJMPInstruction                  ; jump to user BREAK code  $^$ 0xeae0

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBYTE 144 - *TV
;
; On Entry:
;       X=vertical shift of display
;       Y=interlace disable flag
; On Exit:
;       X=old vertical shift of display
;       Y=old interlace disable flag
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbyte144EntryPoint
    LDA .vduVerticalAdjust                              ; VDU vertical adjustment  $^$ 0xeae3
    STX .vduVerticalAdjust                              ; store new value  $^$ 0xeae6
    TAX                                                 ; put old value in X  $^$ 0xeae9
    TYA                                                 ; put interlace flag in A  $^$ 0xeaea
    AND #1                                              ; maximum value =1  $^$ 0xeaeb
    LDY .vduInterlaceValue                              ; get old value into Y  $^$ 0xeaed
    STA .vduInterlaceValue                              ; put new value into A  $^$ 0xeaf0
+
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xeaf3

; ***************************************************************************************

    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xeb02


; ***************************************************************************************
; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Chapter 16: Sound and Speech
;
; ***************************************************************************************
; ***************************************************************************************

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Introduction
;
; The sound chip has three channels that produce square waves tones, and one noise channel.
; The OS enhances this basic functionality with OSWORD 7 - Make a sound, and OSWORD 8 -
; Define an envelope. These correspond to the BASIC commands SOUND and ENVELOPE. The SOUND
; command simplifies the process of playing regular notes and noises, and adds the ability
; to store a queue of notes to play in advance. The ENVELOPE command allows a wide variety
; of sound effects to be played by varying the pitch and amplitude of a sound every 100th
; of a second as it plays.
; See .osword7EntryPoint.
; See .osword8EntryPoint.
;
; Sound durations are specified in 1/20ths of a second allowing a single byte to sustain a
; long note up to 12.75 seconds.
;
; In addition sound is produced by VDU 7 BELL - a surprisingly accurately pitched Treble C.
; See .vdu7EntryPoint.
;
; Finally, a percussive sound can (in extremis) be produced by setting and resetting the
; cassette relay. See .osbyte137EntryPoint. This is a mechanically generated sound, not
; produced via the internal loudspeaker.
;
; Many games such as Arcadians (Aardvark, 1983) and Zalaga (Acornsoft, 1982) that sought to
; emulate arcade games used the sound capabilities to create 'musical stings' and other
; effects.
; See arcadians.mp3
; See zalaga1.mp3
; See zalaga2.mp3
;
; ***************************************************************************************

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Silence a sound channel
;
; On Entry:
;       X = buffer number (4-7) for channel (0-3)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.silenceChannelX
    LDA #4                                              ; mark end of release phase  $^$ 0xeb03
    STA .channel0PhaseCounter - .bufferNumberSound0,X   ; to channel X  $^$ 0xeb05
    LDA #$C0                                            ; code for zero volume  $^$ 0xeb08
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Set volume for channel X
;
; On Entry:
;       A = volume, where $3F (loudest) to $C0 (silent) - see table below
;       X = buffer number (4-7) for channel (0-3)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.setChannelXVolume
    STA .channel0Volume - .bufferNumberSound0,X         ; store A to give basic sound level  $^$ 0xeb0a
    LDY .soundDisableFlag                               ; get sound output/enable flag  $^$ 0xeb0d
    BEQ +                                               ; if (sound enabled) then branch  $^$ 0xeb10
    LDA #$C0                                            ; code for zero volume  $^$ 0xeb12
+
    ; we now convert the input volume into the value required to write to the sound chip
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xeb14
    SBC #$40                                            ; subtract $40  $^$ 0xeb15
    LSR                                                 ; } divide by 8  $^$ 0xeb17
    LSR                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xeb18
    LSR                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xeb19
    EOR #$0F                                            ; invert bits 0-3  $^$ 0xeb1a

;     BASIC SOUND   volume on entry     accumulator
;     volume        .channel0Volume     result now
;      -15                $3F              $10          loudest
;      -14                $37              $11
;      -13                $2F              $12
;      -12                $27              $13
;      -11                $1F              $14
;      -10                $17              $15
;       -9                $0F              $16
;       -8                $07              $17
;       -7                $FF              $18
;       -6                $F7              $19
;       -5                $EF              $1A
;       -4                $E7              $1B
;       -3                $DF              $1C
;       -2                $D7              $1D
;       -1                $CF              $1E
;        0                $C7              $1F          silent
;        -                $C0              $1F          silent

    ORA .soundParameterTable - .bufferNumberSound0,X    ; get encoded value for channel into top nybble  $^$ 0xeb1c
    ORA #$10                                            ; ensure bit 4 set (set volume)  $^$ 0xeb1f

.sendToSoundChip
    PHP                                                 ;  $^$ 0xeb21
.sendToSoundChipFlagsAreadyPushed
    SEI                                                 ; disable interrupts  $^$ 0xeb22
    LDY #$FF                                            ; }  $^$ 0xeb23
    STY .systemVIADataDirectionRegisterA                ; } set data direction to all outputs  $^$ 0xeb25
    STA .systemVIARegisterANoHandshake                  ; send data byte to sound chip  $^$ 0xeb28
    INY                                                 ; Y=0  $^$ 0xeb2b
    STY .systemVIARegisterB                             ; set the write enable line low (active)  $^$ 0xeb2c
                                                        ; to let the sound chip know there
                                                        ; is data
    LDY #2                                              ; Y = loop counter  $^$ 0xeb2f
-
    DEY                                                 ; execute a short delay (this is to  $^$ 0xeb31
    BNE -                                               ; keep the write enable line low for  $^$ 0xeb32
                                                        ; at least 8 us, 16 cycles. This is
                                                        ; required by the sound chip hardware)
                                                        ;
                                                        ; [An alternative to this loop that
                                                        ; takes the same number of cycles, but
                                                        ; is two bytes shorter would be to JSR
                                                        ; to an (existing) RTS instruction.]

    LDY #8                                              ; }  $^$ 0xeb34
    STY .systemVIARegisterB                             ; } pull the write enable line high (inactive)  $^$ 0xeb36

    LDY #4                                              ; Y = loop counter  $^$ 0xeb39
-
    DEY                                                 ; execute another short delay loop  $^$ 0xeb3b
    BNE -                                               ; [it's longer this time for some  $^$ 0xeb3c
                                                        ; reason? It seems like this loop is
                                                        ; not needed at all to me.]

    PLP                                                 ; get back flags  $^$ 0xeb3e
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xeb3f

; ***************************************************************************************
; Table to convert channel number to the bits required by the chip
.soundParameterTable
    !byte $E0,$C0,$A0,$80

; ***************************************************************************************
.skipToNextChannelLocal
    JMP .skipToNextChannel                              ; go to next channel  $^$ 0xeb44

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Update sounds in the 100Hz timer interrupt
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.processSoundInterrupt
    LDA #0                                              ;  $^$ 0xeb47
    STA .numberOfSoundChannelsOnHold                    ; zero number of channels on hold for sync  $^$ 0xeb49
    LDA .soundSyncCount                                 ; get sync count  $^$ 0xeb4c
    BNE +                                               ; if (this is not zero) then branch  $^$ 0xeb4f
    INC .numberOfSoundChannelsOnHold                    ; number of channels on hold for sync = 1  $^$ 0xeb51
    DEC .soundSyncCount                                 ; number of channels required for sync = 255  $^$ 0xeb54
+
    LDX #8                                              ; set loop counter (X = buffer number 4-7, corresponding to the channel number 0-3)  $^$ 0xeb57
.processSoundChannelLoop
    DEX                                                 ; loop counter (X=7,6,5,4)  $^$ 0xeb59
    LDA .channel0Occupancy - .bufferNumberSound0,X      ; get (sound queue occupancy)  $^$ 0xeb5a
    BEQ .skipToNextChannelLocal                         ; if (nothing playing on this channel) then branch (check next channel)  $^$ 0xeb5d
    LDA .bufferEmptyFlags,X                             ; get buffer empty flag  $^$ 0xeb5f
    BMI .chooseNextSound                                ; if (negative, i.e. buffer empty) then branch (choose the next sound to play)  $^$ 0xeb62
    LDA .channel0Duration - .bufferNumberSound0,X       ; get duration remaining  $^$ 0xeb64
    BNE .continueExistingSound                          ; if (duration remaining > 0) then branch (continue processing current sound)  $^$ 0xeb67
.chooseNextSound
    JSR .checkForNextSoundToPlay                        ; check and pick up new sound if required  $^$ 0xeb69
.continueExistingSound
    LDA .channel0Duration - .bufferNumberSound0,X       ; get duration of current sound  $^$ 0xeb6c
    BEQ .skipUpdateOfCurrentSound                       ; if (duration is zero) then branch (skip update)  $^$ 0xeb6f
    CMP #$FF                                            ; check for $FF duration (infinite duration)  $^$ 0xeb71
    BEQ .notAtEndOfCurrentSoundDuration                 ; if (infinite duration) then branch (not at end of current sound)  $^$ 0xeb73

    ; decrement 20Hz counter
    DEC .channel0Countdown20Hz - .bufferNumberSound0,X  ; decrement 10 mS count  $^$ 0xeb75
    BNE .notAtEndOfCurrentSoundDuration                 ; if (counter not reached zero) then branch (not at end of current sound)  $^$ 0xeb78

    ; reset 20Hz counter
    LDA #5                                              ; reset to 5  $^$ 0xeb7a
    STA .channel0Countdown20Hz - .bufferNumberSound0,X  ; to give 50 mSec delay  $^$ 0xeb7c

    ; decrement duration at 20Hz
    DEC .channel0Duration - .bufferNumberSound0,X       ; and decrement main counter  $^$ 0xeb7f
    BNE .notAtEndOfCurrentSoundDuration                 ; if (duration is non-zero) then branch (not at end of current sound)  $^$ 0xeb82

.skipUpdateOfCurrentSound
    JSR .checkForNextSoundToPlay                        ; check and get new sound  $^$ 0xeb84

.notAtEndOfCurrentSoundDuration
    LDA .channel0StepCountdownProgress - .bufferNumberSound0,X  ; check the step progress  $^$ 0xeb87
    BEQ +                                                       ; if (step progress counter is zero) then branch (don't decrement step progress)  $^$ 0xeb8a
    DEC .channel0StepCountdownProgress - .bufferNumberSound0,X  ; decrement step progress  $^$ 0xeb8c
    BNE .skipToNextChannelLocal                                 ; if (step progress counter is zero) then branch (check next channel)  $^$ 0xeb8f

+
    LDY .channel0EnvelopeOffset - .bufferNumberSound0,X ; get envelope data offset  $^$ 0xeb91
    CPY #$FF                                            ; check for no envelope active on this channel  $^$ 0xeb94
    BEQ .skipToNextChannelLocal                         ; if (no envelope active) then branch (check next channel)  $^$ 0xeb96

    LDA .envelopeBuffer,Y                               ; get step length (first byte of envelope data)  $^$ 0xeb98
    AND #%01111111                                      ; clear the repeat bit  $^$ 0xeb9b
    STA .channel0StepCountdownProgress - .bufferNumberSound0,X  ; store it  $^$ 0xeb9d
    LDA .channel0PhaseCounter - .bufferNumberSound0,X   ; get current phase in ADSR  $^$ 0xeba0
    CMP #4                                              ; check for release phase complete  $^$ 0xeba3
    BEQ .adjustEnvelopePitch                            ; if (release phase completed) then branch  $^$ 0xeba5

    ; set target amplitude for new phase
    LDA .channel0PhaseCounter - .bufferNumberSound0,X   ; start new step by getting current phase  $^$ 0xeba7
    CLC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xebaa
    ADC .channel0EnvelopeOffset - .bufferNumberSound0,X ; add it to envelope offset  $^$ 0xebab
    TAY                                                 ; transfer to Y  $^$ 0xebae
    LDA .envelopeBuffer + 11,Y                          ; and get target value at end of current phase  $^$ 0xebaf
    SEC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xebb2
    SBC #$3F                                            ;  $^$ 0xebb3
    STA .targetAmplitude                                ; store modified number as current target amplitude  $^$ 0xebb5

    ; set amplitude step for new phase
    LDA .envelopeBuffer + 7,Y                           ; get change of amplitude for current phase  $^$ 0xebb8
    STA .currentAmplitudeStep                           ; store as current amplitude step change  $^$ 0xebbb

    ; calculate updated volume
    LDA .channel0Volume - .bufferNumberSound0,X         ; get current volume level  $^$ 0xebbe
    PHA                                                 ; save it  $^$ 0xebc1
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry  $^$ 0xebc2
    ADC .currentAmplitudeStep                           ; add current amplitude step change  $^$ 0xebc3
    BVC .skipToggleBits                                 ; if (no overflow) then branch  $^$ 0xebc6
    ROL                                                 ; carry = bit 7. If new amplitude is negative (relatively quiet) then set the maximum volume  $^$ 0xebc8
    LDA #$3F                                            ; A=$3F (loudest volume)  $^$ 0xebc9
    BCS .skipToggleBits                                 ; if (carry set) then branch  $^$ 0xebcb
    EOR #$FF                                            ; toggle bits (A=$C0, silent)  $^$ 0xebcd

.skipToggleBits
    STA .channel0Volume - .bufferNumberSound0,X         ; store in current volume  $^$ 0xebcf
    ROL                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xebd2
    EOR .channel0Volume - .bufferNumberSound0,X         ; } take the EOR of bits 6 and 7  $^$ 0xebd3
    BPL .updateAmplitude                                ; if (bits 6 and 7 of volume are equal) then branch (to update amplitude)  $^$ 0xebd6
    LDA #$3F                                            ; }  $^$ 0xebd8
    BCC +                                               ; } if (carry clear) then branch (A=$3F); otherwise A=$C0  $^$ 0xebda
    EOR #$FF                                            ; }  $^$ 0xebdc
+
    STA .channel0Volume - .bufferNumberSound0,X         ; this is stored in current volume  $^$ 0xebde

.updateAmplitude
    DEC .currentAmplitudeStep                           ; decrement amplitude change per step  $^$ 0xebe1
    LDA .channel0Volume - .bufferNumberSound0,X         ; get volume again  $^$ 0xebe4
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xebe7
    SBC .targetAmplitude                                ; subtract target value  $^$ 0xebe8
    EOR .currentAmplitudeStep                           ; check against step value: a negative result indicates correct trend  $^$ 0xebeb
    BMI +                                               ; so jump to next part  $^$ 0xebee

    ; enter new amplitude phase
    LDA .targetAmplitude                                ;  $^$ 0xebf0
    STA .channel0Volume - .bufferNumberSound0,X         ; set target amplitude  $^$ 0xebf3
    INC .channel0PhaseCounter - .bufferNumberSound0,X   ; increment phase counter  $^$ 0xebf6
+
    PLA                                                 ; get the old volume level  $^$ 0xebf9
    EOR .channel0Volume - .bufferNumberSound0,X         ; and compare with the new volume  $^$ 0xebfa
    AND #$F8                                            ; mask out lower bits  $^$ 0xebfd
    BEQ .adjustEnvelopePitch                            ; if (they are the same) then branch (volume doesn't need changing)  $^$ 0xebff
    LDA .channel0Volume - .bufferNumberSound0,X         ; }  $^$ 0xec01
    JSR .setChannelXVolume                              ; } set new volume level  $^$ 0xec04

.adjustEnvelopePitch
    LDA .channel0Section - .bufferNumberSound0,X        ; get current pitch section (0-2)  $^$ 0xec07
    CMP #3                                              ; check if we have reached section 3  $^$ 0xec0a
    BEQ .skipToNextChannel                              ; if (current section is 3) then branch (skip rest of loop as all sections are finished)  $^$ 0xec0c
    LDA .channel0SectionCountdownProgress - .bufferNumberSound0,X   ; check progress within current pitch section  $^$ 0xec0e
    BNE .countdownTimerNotFinished                      ; if (countdown timer is not yet zero) then branch  $^$ 0xec11

    ; increment pitch section
    INC .channel0Section - .bufferNumberSound0,X        ; implement a section change  $^$ 0xec13
    LDA .channel0Section - .bufferNumberSound0,X        ; check if it's complete  $^$ 0xec16
    CMP #3                                              ;  $^$ 0xec19
    BNE +                                               ; if (not complete) then branch  $^$ 0xec1b

    ; reached end of all three pitch sections
    LDY .channel0EnvelopeOffset - .bufferNumberSound0,X ; }  $^$ 0xec1d
    LDA .envelopeBuffer,Y                               ; } get first envelope byte (top bit = repeat pitch envelope)  $^$ 0xec20
    BMI .skipToNextChannel                              ; if (negative, i.e. don't repeat pitch envelope) then branch  $^$ 0xec23
    LDA #0                                              ; }  $^$ 0xec25
    STA .channel0PitchOffset - .bufferNumberSound0,X    ; } reset to first pitch section  $^$ 0xec27
    STA .channel0Section - .bufferNumberSound0,X        ; }  $^$ 0xec2a

+
    LDA .channel0Section - .bufferNumberSound0,X        ; get number of steps in new section  $^$ 0xec2d
    CLC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xec30
    ADC .channel0EnvelopeOffset - .bufferNumberSound0,X ;  $^$ 0xec31
    TAY                                                 ;  $^$ 0xec34
    LDA .envelopeBuffer + 4,Y                           ; get envelope byte at offset 4 (number of steps in first pitch section)  $^$ 0xec35
    STA .channel0SectionCountdownProgress - .bufferNumberSound0,X   ;  $^$ 0xec38
    BEQ .skipToNextChannel                              ; if (zero) then branch (skip forwards)  $^$ 0xec3b

.countdownTimerNotFinished
    DEC .channel0SectionCountdownProgress - .bufferNumberSound0,X   ; decrement countdown timer  $^$ 0xec3d
    LDA .channel0EnvelopeOffset - .bufferNumberSound0,X ; get rate of pitch change  $^$ 0xec40
    CLC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xec43
    ADC .channel0Section - .bufferNumberSound0,X        ; add section number  $^$ 0xec44
    TAY                                                 ;  $^$ 0xec47
    LDA .envelopeBuffer + 1,Y                           ; get envelope byte 1+section (current change of pitch)  $^$ 0xec48
    CLC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xec4b
    ADC .channel0PitchOffset - .bufferNumberSound0,X    ; add to current pitch offset  $^$ 0xec4c
    STA .channel0PitchOffset - .bufferNumberSound0,X    ; save updated pitch offset  $^$ 0xec4f
    CLC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xec52
    ADC .channel0BasePitch - .bufferNumberSound0,X      ; add base pitch  $^$ 0xec53
    JSR .setPitch                                       ; set new pitch  $^$ 0xec56

.skipToNextChannel
    CPX #4                                              ;  $^$ 0xec59
    BEQ +                                               ; if (X=4, i.e. last channel) then branch (return)  $^$ 0xec5b
    JMP .processSoundChannelLoop                        ; do loop again  $^$ 0xec5d

; ***************************************************************************************
.clearSoundChannels
    LDX #8                                              ; X=8, loop counter  $^$ 0xec60
-
    DEX                                                 ; } Loop from X=7 to X=4 inclusive  $^$ 0xec62
    JSR .clearSoundChannelBuffer                        ; } clearing each sound buffer  $^$ 0xec63
    CPX #4                                              ; }  $^$ 0xec66
    BNE -                                               ; }  $^$ 0xec68
+
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xec6a

; ***************************************************************************************
.checkForNextSoundToPlay
    LDA .channel0PhaseCounter - .bufferNumberSound0,X   ; get current phase counter  $^$ 0xec6b
    CMP #4                                              ; is it 'release complete' state  $^$ 0xec6e
    BEQ +                                               ; if (release complete) then branch  $^$ 0xec70
    LDA #3                                              ; mark release in progress  $^$ 0xec72
    STA .channel0PhaseCounter - .bufferNumberSound0,X   ; store it  $^$ 0xec74
+
    LDA .bufferEmptyFlags,X                             ; check buffer empty flag  $^$ 0xec77
    BEQ .skipResetAsBufferIsNotEmpty                    ; if (buffer not empty) then branch  $^$ 0xec7a
    LDA #0                                              ; mark buffer not empty  $^$ 0xec7c
    STA .bufferEmptyFlags,X                             ; an store it  $^$ 0xec7e

    LDY #4                                              ; Y = loop counter  $^$ 0xec81
-
    STA .channel0SyncFlag - 1,Y                         ; zero sync bytes  $^$ 0xec83
    DEY                                                 ;  $^$ 0xec86
    BNE -                                               ; until Y=0  $^$ 0xec87

    STA .channel0Duration - .bufferNumberSound0,X       ; zero duration count  $^$ 0xec89
    DEY                                                 ;  $^$ 0xec8c
    STY .soundSyncCount                                 ; reset sync count to $FF (no sync)  $^$ 0xec8d

.skipResetAsBufferIsNotEmpty
    LDA .channel0SyncFlag - .bufferNumberSound0,X       ; get synchronising flag  $^$ 0xec90
    BEQ .syncSounds                                     ; if (it's zero) then branch  $^$ 0xec93
    LDA .numberOfSoundChannelsOnHold                    ; get number of channels on hold  $^$ 0xec95
    BEQ .silenceNonEnvelopeSound                        ; if (it's zero) then branch (silence sound)  $^$ 0xec98
    LDA #0                                              ;  $^$ 0xec9a
    STA .channel0SyncFlag - .bufferNumberSound0,X       ; zero synchronising flag  $^$ 0xec9c
.readNextSoundFromBufferAndProcessLocal
    JMP .readNextSoundFromBufferAndProcess              ;  $^$ 0xec9f

; ***************************************************************************************
.clearSoundChannelBuffer
    JSR .silenceChannelX                                ; silence the channel  $^$ 0xeca2
    TYA                                                 ; Y=0 A=0  $^$ 0xeca5
    STA .channel0Duration - .bufferNumberSound0,X       ; zero main count  $^$ 0xeca6
    STA .bufferEmptyFlags,X                             ; mark buffer not empty  $^$ 0xeca9
    STA .channel0Occupancy - .bufferNumberSound0,X      ; mark channel dormant  $^$ 0xecac
    LDY #3                                              ; Y=loop counter  $^$ 0xecaf
-
    STA .channel0SyncFlag,Y                             ; }  $^$ 0xecb1
    DEY                                                 ; } zero sync flags  $^$ 0xecb4
    BPL -                                               ; }  $^$ 0xecb5

    STY .soundSyncCount                                 ; reset sync to $FF (no sync)  $^$ 0xecb7
    BMI .setPitchChanged                                ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xecba

; ***************************************************************************************
.syncSoundBufferEmpty
    PHP                                                 ; save flags  $^$ 0xecbc
    SEI                                                 ; and disable interrupts  $^$ 0xecbd
    LDA .channel0PhaseCounter - .bufferNumberSound0,X   ; get ADSR phase counter  $^$ 0xecbe
    CMP #4                                              ; check for end of release phase  $^$ 0xecc1
    BNE +                                               ; if (not end of release phase) then branch  $^$ 0xecc3
    JSR .osbyte152EntryPoint                            ; examine buffer  $^$ 0xecc5
    BCC +                                               ; if (not empty, i.e. there's another sound to play) then branch  $^$ 0xecc8
    LDA #0                                              ; }  $^$ 0xecca
    STA .channel0Occupancy - .bufferNumberSound0,X      ; } mark channel as silent  $^$ 0xeccc
+
    PLP                                                 ; get back flags  $^$ 0xeccf
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.silenceNonEnvelopeSound
    LDY .channel0EnvelopeOffset - .bufferNumberSound0,X ; this value is $FF if no envelope is defined  $^$ 0xecd0
    CPY #$FF                                            ;  $^$ 0xecd3
    BNE .exit25                                         ; if (envelope defined) then branch  $^$ 0xecd5
    JSR .silenceChannelX                                ; silence channel  $^$ 0xecd7
.exit25
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xecda

; ***************************************************************************************
.syncSounds
    JSR .osbyte152EntryPoint                            ; examine next byte in buffer (sets carry if buffer empty)  $^$ 0xecdb
    BCS .syncSoundBufferEmpty                           ; if (buffer empty) then branch  $^$ 0xecde
    AND #3                                              ; get just bits 0 and 1  $^$ 0xece0
    BEQ .readNextSoundFromBufferAndProcessLocal         ; if (zero) then branch  $^$ 0xece2
    LDA .soundSyncCount                                 ; get synchronising count  $^$ 0xece4
    BEQ +                                               ; if (zero, i.e. nothing to sync) then branch  $^$ 0xece7

    INC .channel0SyncFlag - .bufferNumberSound0,X       ; set sync flag  $^$ 0xece9
    BIT .soundSyncCount                                 ; check bit 7 is clear  $^$ 0xecec
    BPL ++                                              ; if (sync required) then branch  $^$ 0xecef
    JSR .osbyte152EntryPoint                            ; get first byte from buffer  $^$ 0xecf1
    AND #3                                              ; get just bits 0 and 1  $^$ 0xecf4
    STA .soundSyncCount                                 ; store result  $^$ 0xecf6
    BPL +                                               ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xecf9

++
    DEC .soundSyncCount                                 ;  $^$ 0xecfb
+
    JMP .silenceNonEnvelopeSound                        ; silence the channel if envelope not in use  $^$ 0xecfe

; ***************************************************************************************
.setPitch
    CMP .channel0Pitch - .bufferNumberSound0,X          ; check against pitch value  $^$ 0xed01
    BEQ .exit25                                         ; if (pitch is equal) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xed04
.setPitchChanged
    STA .channel0Pitch - .bufferNumberSound0,X          ; store new pitch  $^$ 0xed06
    CPX #.bufferNumberSound0                            ; check for noise channel  $^$ 0xed09
    BNE .setPitchNotNoise                               ; if (X is not noise channel) then branch (not noise)  $^$ 0xed0b

    ; setting noise
    AND #$0F                                            ; noise value  $^$ 0xed0d
    ORA .soundParameterTable - .bufferNumberSound0,X    ; convert to chip format, by adding the value required for channel  $^$ 0xed0f
    PHP                                                 ; save flags  $^$ 0xed12
    JMP .localSendToSoundChipFlagsAreadyPushed          ; and pass to chip control routine  $^$ 0xed13

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Set the pitch of a sound
;
; On Entry:
;       A = pitch (0-255).
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.setPitchNotNoise
    PHA                                                 ; remember A = pitch (0-252)  $^$ 0xed16
    AND #3                                              ;  $^$ 0xed17
    STA .fractionalSemitones                            ; store the fractional amount (0-3) between semitones  $^$ 0xed19

    ; calculate the octave
    LDA #0                                              ;  $^$ 0xed1c
    STA .soundPitchLow                                  ; octave  $^$ 0xed1e
    PLA                                                 ; get back A = original pitch value  $^$ 0xed21
    LSR                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xed22
    LSR                                                 ; } divide by 4 (to get semitone count 0-63)  $^$ 0xed23
-
    CMP #12                                             ;  $^$ 0xed24
    BCC .finishedGettingOctave                          ; if (remainder is less than 12) then branch (we have found the right octave)  $^$ 0xed26
    INC .soundPitchLow                                  ; increment octave  $^$ 0xed28
    SBC #12                                             ; subtract 12 for each octave  $^$ 0xed2b
    BNE -                                               ; if (not zero) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xed2d

    ; at this point .soundPitchLow defines the Octave (0-5)
    ; A = the semitone within the octave

    ; get the 10 bit pitch value for the note within the octave from the pitch lookup tables
.finishedGettingOctave
    TAY                                                 ; Y = semitone within octave  $^$ 0xed2f
    LDA .soundPitchLow                                  ; get octave number into A  $^$ 0xed30
    PHA                                                 ; push it  $^$ 0xed33
    LDA .pitchLookupTableLow,Y                          ; get semitone byte from first pitch table  $^$ 0xed34
    STA .soundPitchLow                                  ; store it  $^$ 0xed37
    LDA .pitchLookupTableHigh,Y                         ; get semitone byte from second pitch table  $^$ 0xed3a
    PHA                                                 ; push second table byte  $^$ 0xed3d
    AND #3                                              ; keep two least significant bits only  $^$ 0xed3e
    STA .soundPitchHigh                                 ; save them  $^$ 0xed40
    PLA                                                 ; pull original second table byte  $^$ 0xed43
    LSR                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xed44
    LSR                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xed45
    LSR                                                 ; } shift high nybble down into low nybble  $^$ 0xed46
    LSR                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xed47
    STA .soundFractional                                ; store it (amount to subtract for each fraction (0-3) between semitones)  $^$ 0xed48

    ; adjust for any eighth tones (0-3) between semitones
    LDA .soundPitchLow                                  ;  $^$ 0xed4b
    LDY .fractionalSemitones                            ; loop counter (0-3)  $^$ 0xed4e
    BEQ ++                                              ;  $^$ 0xed51

-
    SEC                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xed53
    SBC .soundFractional                                ; } soundFractional is subtracted from A each time around the loop  $^$ 0xed54
