                                                        ;   baud ; baud ;
                                                        ;   tape ; tape ;
                                                        ;     5  ;   6  ;   5

    ; [Incidentally, this would do the same thing as below, but using four fewer bytes:
    ; ORA .tapeOrROMSwitch                                    5  ;   6  ;   7
    ; AND #3                                                  1  ;   2  ;   3
    ; RTS]

    AND #$FB                                            ;     1  ;   2  ;   1  $^$ 0xf198
    ORA .tapeOrROMSwitch                                ;     1  ;   2  ;   3  $^$ 0xf19a
    ASL                                                 ;     2  ;   4  ;   6  $^$ 0xf19d
    ORA .tapeOrROMSwitch                                ;     2  ;   4  ;   6  $^$ 0xf19e
    LSR                                                 ;     1  ;   2  ;   3  $^$ 0xf1a1
.exit27
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf1a2


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Filing system routine table
;
; The FSC routine (see below) jumps to the relevant address depending on the accumulator.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.fileSystemControlRoutineTable
    !word .starOptEntryPoint - 1                        ; *OPT
    !word .checkEOFEntryPoint - 1                       ; check EOF
    !word .starRunEntryPoint - 1                        ; */
    !word .badCommandError - 1                          ; 'Bad command' if ROMs and FS don't want it
    !word .starRunEntryPoint - 1                        ; *RUN
    !word .starCatEntryPoint - 1                        ; *CAT
    !word .osbyte119EntryPoint - 1                      ; osbyte 119 (close SPOOL and EXEC files, to get ready for a new FS)

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; FSC - File System Control
;
; On Entry
;       A is reason code. Only values 0-6 are handled:
;
;         A=0    A *OPT command has been issued. X and Y are the 2 parameters
;         A=1    EOF is being checked. On Entry: X=File handle On Exit: X=FF means EOF else 00
;         A=2    A */ command has been issued
;         A=3    An unrecognised OS command has been issued. X,Y point at command
;         A=4    A *RUN command has been issued X,Y point at filename
;         A=5    A *CAT cammand has been issued X,Y point to rest of command
;         A=6    New filing system is about to take over. Close *SPOOL and *EXEC files
;
; Just for reference, these are not implemented in OS (to be implemented by Filing System
; Paged ROMs):
;         A=7    return file handle range (X=minimum; Y=maximum)
;         A=8    OS has received a star command
;         A=9    *EX command
;         A=10   *INFO
;         A=11   *RUN command for library
;         A=12   *RENAME command
;
; See NAUG Section 16.1.7, Page 256-7
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.fscEntryPoint
    CMP #7                                              ; }  $^$ 0xf1b1
    BCS .exit27                                         ; } if A>=7 then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xf1b3
    STX .fsTempStorage                                  ; save X  $^$ 0xf1b5
    ASL                                                 ; A=A*2  $^$ 0xf1b7
    TAX                                                 ; X=A to get offset  $^$ 0xf1b8
    LDA .fileSystemControlRoutineTable + 1,X            ; get high byte of address  $^$ 0xf1b9
    PHA                                                 ; push it  $^$ 0xf1bc
    LDA .fileSystemControlRoutineTable,X                ; get low byte of address  $^$ 0xf1bd
    PHA                                                 ; push it  $^$ 0xf1c0
    LDX .fsTempStorage                                  ; restore X  $^$ 0xf1c1
    RTS                                                 ; this now jumps to (the address  $^$ 0xf1c3
                                                        ; got from the table) + 1

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; *LOAD or *RUN a file
;
; See loading.png
;
; On Entry:
;       A=0     *RUN the file
;       A=$FF   *LOAD the named file and read its catalogue information
;
; See LoadFromTape.pdf
; See LoadFromROM.pdf
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.loadFile
    PHP                                                 ; save flags on stack  $^$ 0xf1c4
    PHA                                                 ; save A on stack  $^$ 0xf1c5
    JSR .claimSerialSystemForLoadSave                   ; claim serial system for cassette  $^$ 0xf1c6
                                                        ; we can't use the cassette and the
                                                        ; RS-423 system at the same time
                                                        ; so we select the cassette here.
    LDA .fsExecutionAddressLow                          ; execution address low  $^$ 0xf1c9
    PHA                                                 ; save A on stack  $^$ 0xf1cc
    JSR .searchForFile                                  ; search for file  $^$ 0xf1cd
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xf1d0
    BEQ .checkFileAttributes                            ; if (A = 0) then branch  $^$ 0xf1d1
    LDX #3                                              ; X=3, loop counter  $^$ 0xf1d3
    LDA #$FF                                            ; A=$FF  $^$ 0xf1d5
-
    PHA                                                 ; save A on stack  $^$ 0xf1d7
    LDA .fsLoadAddressLow,X                             ; get load address  $^$ 0xf1d8
    STA .loadAddressLow,X                               ; store it as current load address  $^$ 0xf1db
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xf1dd
    AND .loadAddressLow,X                               ;  $^$ 0xf1de
    DEX                                                 ; X=X-1  $^$ 0xf1e0
    BPL -                                               ; until all 4 bytes copied  $^$ 0xf1e1

    ; [peculiarly, the code makes a special point to check for a load
    ;  address of $FFFFFFFF and signals an error if it occurs. Why?]
    CMP #$FF                                            ; check if all the bytes of the load  $^$ 0xf1e3
                                                        ; address are $FF
    BNE .checkFileAttributes                            ; if (address is valid, i.e. not all  $^$ 0xf1e5
                                                        ; four bytes $FF) then branch
                                                        ; (continue)

    ; handle error because load address is $FFFFFFFF
    JSR .beepAndCancelTapeOperation                     ; sound bell, reset ACIA and motor off  $^$ 0xf1e7
    JMP .brkBadAddress                                  ; show 'Bad address' error  $^$ 0xf1ea

; ***************************************************************************************
.checkFileAttributes
    LDA .fsBlockFlagByte                                ; block flag  $^$ 0xf1ed
    LSR                                                 ; set carry from bit 0 (file locked)  $^$ 0xf1f0
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xf1f1
    BEQ .checkAndSetEscapeEffect                        ; if (A = 0) then branch (entry is from star run)  $^$ 0xf1f2
    BCC .loadOrRun                                      ; if (carry clear, i.e. not locked) then branch  $^$ 0xf1f4
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; File locked
;
; A locked file is one with bit zero set on the block flag byte (see .fsBlockFlagByte)
; Locked files can only be *RUN, not *LOADed. This is a form of copy protection on cassette
; tapes.
;
; See Chapter 18 for data format.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.fileLocked
    JSR .cancelTapeOperationAndMotor                    ;  $^$ 0xf1f6

    BRK                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf1f9
    !byte $D5                                           ; error number
    !text "Locked",0                                    ; 'Locked' error message and zero terminator

; ***************************************************************************************
.checkAndSetEscapeEffect
    BCC .loadOrRun                                      ; if (carry clear) then branch (load)  $^$ 0xf202
    LDA #3                                              ; A=3  $^$ 0xf204
    STA .escapeAndBreakEffect                           ; store to cause ESCAPE disable and memory clear on break  $^$ 0xf206

.loadOrRun
    LDA #%00110000                                      ; check bits 4 and 5  $^$ 0xf209

    ; See .tapeCurrentOptionsByte for description of the options
    AND .tapeCurrentOptionsByte                         ; check for 'ignore errors'  $^$ 0xf20b
    BEQ +                                               ; if (ignore errors) then branch  $^$ 0xf20d
    LDA .checksumIsValidFlag                            ; get checksum result  $^$ 0xf20f
    BNE .checksumFail                                   ; if (checksum failed) then branch  $^$ 0xf211
+
    TYA                                                 ; A=Y  $^$ 0xf213
    PHA                                                 ; save A on stack  $^$ 0xf214
    JSR .startSendToSecondProcessor                     ; send to second processor if present  $^$ 0xf215
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xf218
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A  $^$ 0xf219
    JSR .setStateForLoadingBlockDataOrReset             ; set state to read block data  $^$ 0xf21a
.checksumFail
    JSR .loadBlock                                      ; load block from tape  $^$ 0xf21d
    BNE .retryAfterFailure                              ; if (not found) then branch (retry)  $^$ 0xf220
    JSR .incrementBlockNumbers                          ; increment current block number  $^$ 0xf222

+
    BIT .fsBlockFlagByte                                ; block flag  $^$ 0xf225
    BMI .reachedFinalBlock                              ; if (bit 7 set, i.e. this is the final block) then branch  $^$ 0xf228
    JSR .incrementLoadOrSaveAddress                     ; increment current load address  $^$ 0xf22a
    JSR .readBlockHeader                                ; read block header  $^$ 0xf22d
    BNE .loadOrRun                                      ; if (non zero) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xf230
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Reached final block
;
; Stores the tape file length (low/high) and two zeros into the OSFILE parameter block. Note
; the bugs below though.
;
; John Kortink found a couple of bugs in this routine.
; See http://mdfs.net/Archive/BBCMicro/2006/10/14/174712.htm
;
; People have unwittingly hit the second of these bugs:
; See https://stardot.org.uk/forums/viewtopic.php?f=54&t=13481
; See http://www.retrosoftware.co.uk/forum/viewtopic.php?p=5687#p7655
;
; The first affects the ROM filing system only. In the previously executed .filenameDone
; routine (See .filenameDone), the length of the file (.tapeFileLengthLow/High) only gets
; set if long messages are enabled, so the length returned from this routine may be wrong.
;
; The second (and more serious) affects both TAPE and ROM filing systems. The parameter block
; address (.osfileBlockAddressLow/High) is normally set up in .osfileEntryPoint
; (see .osfileEntryPoint) but has not been set up if entered via a *RUN command. So four bytes
; of memory at an arbitrary address can be corrupted here! We may just about silently get away
; with it sometimes (cross fingers) if a previous OSFILE operation happens to have set them
; up to a benign value. For example, if we CHAIN a BASIC program first, then *RUN works.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.reachedFinalBlock
    LDY #10                                             ; Y=10  $^$ 0xf232
    LDA .tapeFileLengthLow                              ; file length counter low  $^$ 0xf234
    STA (.osfileBlockAddressLow),Y                      ; OSFILE parameter block  $^$ 0xf236
    INY                                                 ; Y=Y+1  $^$ 0xf238
    LDA .tapeFileLengthHigh                             ; file length counter high  $^$ 0xf239
    STA (.osfileBlockAddressLow),Y                      ; OSFILE parameter block  $^$ 0xf23b
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0  $^$ 0xf23d
    INY                                                 ; Y=Y+1  $^$ 0xf23f
    STA (.osfileBlockAddressLow),Y                      ; OSFILE parameter block  $^$ 0xf240
    INY                                                 ; Y=Y+1  $^$ 0xf242
    STA (.osfileBlockAddressLow),Y                      ; OSFILE parameter block  $^$ 0xf243
    PLP                                                 ; get back flags  $^$ 0xf245

.beepCancelAndPrintReturn
    JSR .beepAndCancelTapeOperation                     ; bell, reset ACIA and motor  $^$ 0xf246

.printReturnSafely
    BIT .currentBlockHasDataErrorFlag                   ; current block flag  $^$ 0xf249
    BMI .exit28                                         ;  $^$ 0xf24b

.saveFlagsPrintCR
    PHP                                                 ; save flags on stack  $^$ 0xf24d
    JSR .safePrintFollowingMessage                      ; print message following call (in this case a newline character)  $^$ 0xf24e
    !byte .charRETURN, 0                                ; message
    PLP                                                 ; restore flags from stack  $^$ 0xf253
.exit28
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf254

; ***************************************************************************************
.retryAfterFailure
    JSR .searchForSpecifiedBlock                        ; search for a specified block  $^$ 0xf255
    BNE .loadOrRun                                      ; ALWAYS branch (try again)  $^$ 0xf258

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Copy filename from XY
;
; On Entry:
;       X and Y     source filename address (Low/High)
; On Exit:
;       A = 0
;       The filename is copied into the buffer at .filenameToSearchFor
; ***************************************************************************************
.getFilenameFromXY
    STX .stringInputBufferAddressLow                    ; OS filename/command line pointer  $^$ 0xf25a
    STY .stringInputBufferAddressHigh                   ; OS filename/command line pointer  $^$ 0xf25c
    LDY #0                                              ; Y=0  $^$ 0xf25e
    JSR .gsinitForFilenameParsing                       ; initialise string  $^$ 0xf260
    LDX #0                                              ; X=0  $^$ 0xf263
-
    JSR .gsreadEntryPoint                               ; GSREAD call  $^$ 0xf265
    BCS .terminateFilename                              ; if (end of character string) then branch  $^$ 0xf268
    BEQ .brkBadStringJumper                             ; if (zero found) then break ('Bad string' error)  $^$ 0xf26a
    STA .filenameToSearchFor,X                          ; store character in tape filename area  $^$ 0xf26c
    INX                                                 ; X=X+1  $^$ 0xf26f
    CPX #11                                             ; check X with 11  $^$ 0xf270
    BNE -                                               ; if (X != 11) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xf272
.brkBadStringJumper
    JMP .brkBadString                                   ; Bad String error  $^$ 0xf274


; ***************************************************************************************
.terminateFilename
    LDA #0                                              ; terminate filename with 0  $^$ 0xf277
    STA .filenameToSearchFor,X                          ;  $^$ 0xf279
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf27c

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSFILE
;
; default handling for OSFILE (for cassette and ROM filing system)
;
; parameter block located by XY
;   0-1     Address of Filename terminated by CR
;   2-4     Load Address of File
;   6-9     Execution Address of File
;   10-13   Start address of data for write operations or length of file for read operations
;   14-17   End address of Data (i.e. byte AFTER last byte to be written) or file attributes
;
; On Entry:
;   Action is determined by value in A
;
;   A=0     Save section of memory as named file, write catalogue information
;   A=1     Write catalogue information for named file             (not supported in this FS)
;   A=2     Write the LOAD       address (only) for the named File (not supported in this FS)
;   A=3     Write the EXECUTION  address (only) for the named File (not supported in this FS)
;   A=4     Write the ATTRIBUTES for the named File                (not supported in this FS)
;   A=5     Read the catalogue information and put file type in A  (not supported in this FS)
;   A=6     Delete the named file                                  (not supported in this FS)
;   A=$FF   Load the named file and read its catalogue information
;
;   XY = address of osfile block
;
; See .saveFileToTape for PDF showing the code path and how bytes are written to tape.
; See .loadFile for PDFs showing the code path and how bytes are read from tape and ROM.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osfileEntryPoint
    PHA                                                 ; save action on stack  $^$ 0xf27d
    STX .osfileBlockAddressLow                          ; osfile block pointer low  $^$ 0xf27e
    STY .osfileBlockAddressHigh                         ; osfile block pointer high  $^$ 0xf280
    LDY #0                                              ; Y=0  $^$ 0xf282
    LDA (.osfileBlockAddressLow),Y                      ; get address of filename (low byte)  $^$ 0xf284
    TAX                                                 ; store in X  $^$ 0xf286
    INY                                                 ; Y=1  $^$ 0xf287
    LDA (.osfileBlockAddressLow),Y                      ; get address of filename (high byte)  $^$ 0xf288
    TAY                                                 ; store in Y  $^$ 0xf28a
    JSR .getFilenameFromXY                              ; get filename from buffer at XY  $^$ 0xf28b
    LDY #2                                              ; Y=2  $^$ 0xf28e

    ; loop to copy load and execution addresses to .loadAddressLow
-
    LDA (.osfileBlockAddressLow),Y                      ; copy parameter block (load and exec  $^$ 0xf290
                                                        ; addresses)...
    STA .fsLoadAddressLow-2,Y                           ; ...     to .fsLoadAddressLow  $^$ 0xf292
    STA .loadAddressLow-2,Y                             ; ... and to .loadAddressLow  $^$ 0xf295
    INY                                                 ; increment y  $^$ 0xf298
    CPY #10                                             ; compare with limit  $^$ 0xf299
    BNE -                                               ; if (not done yet) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xf29b

    ; get action code, and branch to save if A=0
    PLA                                                 ; get back A (action)  $^$ 0xf29d
    BEQ .saveFileToTape                                 ; if (A == 0) then branch (save file)  $^$ 0xf29e

    ; if action is not $FF then exit
    CMP #$FF                                            ; check A with 255  $^$ 0xf2a0
    BNE .exit28                                         ; if (A != 255) then branch (exit,  $^$ 0xf2a2
                                                        ; as cassette / ROM filing systems
                                                        ; have no other options)
    ; load a file from cassette or ROM
    JMP .loadFile                                       ; load file (with A=255; Y=0)  $^$ 0xf2a4

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Save a file to tape
;
;   See Chapter 18 for Tape/ROM format.
;
; On Entry:
;       A = 0
;       Y = 10 (offset in OSFILE Block)
;
; See SaveToTape.pdf for the code path and steps for writing to tape.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.saveFileToTape
    STA .fsBlockNumberLow                               ; zero block number low  $^$ 0xf2a7
    STA .fsBlockNumberHigh                              ; zero block number high  $^$ 0xf2aa

    ; copy start address, end address into zero page copy
    ; Note Y=10 (loop counter) at this point
-
    LDA (.osfileBlockAddressLow),Y                      ; read from .OSFILE parameter block  $^$ 0xf2ad
    STA .tapeSaveStartAddressLow-10,Y                   ; store  $^$ 0xf2af
    INY                                                 ; data start and data end address  $^$ 0xf2b2
    CPY #10 + 8                                         ; check for Y=18  $^$ 0xf2b3
    BNE -                                               ; if (not finished) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xf2b5

    TXA                                                 ; A=X  $^$ 0xf2b7
    BEQ .brkBadStringJumper                             ; if (no filename found) then branch ('Bad string' error)  $^$ 0xf2b8

    JSR .claimSerialSystemForLoadSave                   ; claim serial system for load/save on cassette  $^$ 0xf2ba
    JSR .promptToRecordOnTape                           ; prompt to start recording  $^$ 0xf2bd
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0 (meaning read bytes from second processor, aka:  $^$ 0xf2c0
                                                        ;      'multiple single byte transfer: 2nd processor to I/O processor')
    JSR .secondProcessorTransfer                        ; start transfer from 2nd processor (if present)  $^$ 0xf2c2
    JSR .setupForCassetteWrite                          ; set up tape for write operation  $^$ 0xf2c5

.saveToTapeLoop
    ; calculate length to read
    SEC                                                 ; set carry  $^$ 0xf2c8
    LDX #$FD                                            ; X = loop counter (loops three times: X=$FD, $FE, $FF)  $^$ 0xf2c9

    ; loop to work out the amount of file remaining to save, to calculate block length
    ; length = end address - current address
-
    LDA .tapeSaveEndAddressLow - $00FD,X                ; read end address  $^$ 0xf2cb
    SBC .tapeSaveStartAddressLow - $00FD,X              ; subtract current start address  $^$ 0xf2ce
    STA .fsBlockLengthLow - $00FD,X                     ; store at .fsBlockLengthLow/High and  $^$ 0xf2d1
                                                        ; .fsBlockFlagByte.
                                                        ; we don't care about overwriting
                                                        ; .fsBlockFlagByte with a length
                                                        ; calculation since we are about to
                                                        ; set it anyway.
    INX                                                 ; X=X+1  $^$ 0xf2d4
    BNE -                                               ;  $^$ 0xf2d5

    ; at this point X = 0 (meaning by default it's not the last block, unless we overwrite X below)

    ; if high byte of length is non-zero, then save the full block length of $0100
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A (to set the zero flag if zero)  $^$ 0xf2d7
    BNE .setFullBlockLength                             ; if (highest byte of subtracted value is non zero) then branch  $^$ 0xf2d8

    ; check the low and mid bytes of the length to see if this this the last block
    CPX .fsBlockLengthLow                               ; } compare X with zero  $^$ 0xf2da
    LDA #$01                                            ; } calculate $0100 - block length  $^$ 0xf2dd
    SBC .fsBlockLengthHigh                              ; }  $^$ 0xf2df
    BCC .setFullBlockLength                             ; if (fsBlockLength >= $0100) then branch  $^$ 0xf2e2

    ; yes, this is the last block
    LDX #$80                                            ; X=$80 (set last block flag)  $^$ 0xf2e4
    BNE .skipSettingBlockLength                         ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xf2e6

.setFullBlockLength
    LDA #1                                              ; }  $^$ 0xf2e8
    STA .fsBlockLengthHigh                              ; } block length = $0100 (X=0 at this point)  $^$ 0xf2ea
    STX .fsBlockLengthLow                               ; }  $^$ 0xf2ed

.skipSettingBlockLength
    STX .fsBlockFlagByte                                ; store the block flag  $^$ 0xf2f0
    JSR .saveABlockToTape                               ; write block to tape  $^$ 0xf2f3
    BMI .exit29                                         ; if (negative) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xf2f6
    JSR .incrementLoadOrSaveAddress                     ; increment start save address by a page  $^$ 0xf2f8
    INC .fsBlockNumberLow                               ; block number  $^$ 0xf2fb
    BNE .saveToTapeLoop                                 ; if (not 0) then branch (loop back again)  $^$ 0xf2fe
    INC .fsBlockNumberHigh                              ; block number high  $^$ 0xf300
    BNE .saveToTapeLoop                                 ; ALWAYS branch (since block number high byte should never wrap around) (loop back again)  $^$ 0xf303

; ***************************************************************************************
.starRunEntryPoint
    JSR .getFilenameFromXY                              ; get filename from buffer at XY  $^$ 0xf305
    LDX #$FF                                            ; X=$FF  $^$ 0xf308
    STX .fsExecutionAddressLow                          ; store in low byte of execution address  $^$ 0xf30a
    JSR .loadFile                                       ; load file (with A=0)  $^$ 0xf30d
    BIT .tubePresentFlag                                ; check to see if Tube is present  $^$ 0xf310
    BPL +                                               ; if (Tube is not present) then branch  $^$ 0xf313
    LDA .fsExecutionAddressMid2                         ; execution address extend  $^$ 0xf315
    AND .fsExecutionAddressHigh                         ; execution address extend  $^$ 0xf318
    CMP #$FF                                            ; check if all bits set  $^$ 0xf31b
    BNE .sendExecAddressToRunFromTube                   ; if (top two bytes of exec address  $^$ 0xf31d
                                                        ; are not both $FF) then branch
                                                        ; (execute on the Tube)
+
    JMP (.fsExecutionAddressLow)                        ; RUN file  $^$ 0xf31f

; ***************************************************************************************
.sendExecAddressToRunFromTube
    LDX #<.fsExecutionAddressLow                        ; }  $^$ 0xf322
    LDY #>.fsExecutionAddressHigh                       ; } point to execution address  $^$ 0xf324
    LDA #4                                              ; Tube service call 4  $^$ 0xf326
    JMP .secondProcessorCall                            ; and issue to Tube to run file  $^$ 0xf328

; ***************************************************************************************
.starCatEntryPoint
    LDA #%00001000                                      ; A=8 (set catalogue state)  $^$ 0xf32b
    JSR .setTapeStatusBits                              ; set ('OR' in) status bits  $^$ 0xf32d
    JSR .claimSerialSystemForLoadSave                   ; claim serial system for cassette  $^$ 0xf330
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0 (don't match filename and block number)  $^$ 0xf333
    JSR .searchForBlockCheckFilingSystem                ; read data from tape/ROMFS  $^$ 0xf335
    JSR .cancelTapeOperation                            ;  $^$ 0xf338

.clearCatalogueStatus
    LDA #%11110111                                      ; clear bit 3 of file system status  $^$ 0xf33b
                                                        ; bit (catalogue status)
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Clear tape status bits
;
; On Entry:
;       A has the bits set that are to be cleared from the tape status byte
;
; On Exit:
;       X and Y preserved
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.clearTapeStatusBits
    AND .fsStatusByte                                   ;  $^$ 0xf33d
.storeTapeStatusByte
    STA .fsStatusByte                                   ;  $^$ 0xf33f
.exit29
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf341

; ***************************************************************************************
.setTapeEOFStatus
    LDA #%01000000                                      ; set bit 6 of cassette status (EOF)  $^$ 0xf342
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Set tape status bits
;
; On Entry:
;       A has the bits set that are to be set on the tape status byte
;
; On Exit:
;       X and Y preserved
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.setTapeStatusBits
    ORA .fsStatusByte                                   ;  $^$ 0xf344
    BNE .storeTapeStatusByte                            ; ALWAYS branch (store status byte)  $^$ 0xf346

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Search for the next block, checking for Tape or ROM
;
; Used when loading a file or cataloguing a directory.
;
; On Entry:
;       A = $FF - must match the current filename and block number
;       A = $00 - match anything (e.g. for catalogue)
;
; On Exit:
;       V clear if final block
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.searchForBlockCheckFilingSystem
    PHA                                                 ; save A on stack  $^$ 0xf348
    LDA .tapeOrROMSwitch                                ; filing system flag 0=Tape; 2=ROMFS  $^$ 0xf349
    BEQ .searchForBlockReadHeaderAndCompare             ; if (tape filing system active) then branch  $^$ 0xf34c

    ; deal with search on ROM FS
    JSR .setInitialSpeechPHROMNumber                    ; set current Filing System ROM/PHROM  $^$ 0xf34e
    JSR .readByteFromROMOrPHROM                         ; get byte from data ROM check type  $^$ 0xf351
    BCC .searchForBlockReadHeaderAndCompare             ; if (carry clear) then branch  $^$ 0xf354
    CLV                                                 ; clear overflow flag  $^$ 0xf356
    BVC .pullAAndReturn                                 ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xf357

; ***************************************************************************************
.searchForBlockReadHeaderAndCompare
    JSR .readBlockHeader                                ; read block header  $^$ 0xf359
    LDA .fsBlockNumberLow                               ; block number  $^$ 0xf35c
    STA .currentBlockNumberLow                          ; current block number low  $^$ 0xf35f
    LDA .fsBlockNumberHigh                              ; block number high  $^$ 0xf361
    STA .currentBlockNumberHigh                         ; current block number high  $^$ 0xf364
    LDX #$FF                                            ; X=$FF  $^$ 0xf366
    STX .fsLastBlockReadFlagsCopy                       ; copy of last read block flag  $^$ 0xf368
    INX                                                 ; X=0  $^$ 0xf36b
    STX .currentBlockHasDataErrorFlag                   ; reset data error flag to zero  $^$ 0xf36c
    BEQ +                                               ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xf36e

.searchForBlockLoop
    JSR .incrementBlockNumbers                          ; increment current block number  $^$ 0xf370
    JSR .readBlockHeader                                ; read block header  $^$ 0xf373

+
    LDA .tapeOrROMSwitch                                ; get filing system flag 0=tape; 2=ROMFS  $^$ 0xf376
    BEQ +                                               ; if (tape filing system is active) then branch  $^$ 0xf379
    BVC .pullAAndReturn                                 ; if (final block, on ROMFS) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xf37b

+
    PLA                                                 ; get back A (match flag)  $^$ 0xf37d
    PHA                                                 ; save A on stack  $^$ 0xf37e
    BEQ .finishReadingBlockAndContinue                  ; if (A == 0, i.e. match anything) then branch  $^$ 0xf37f
    JSR .compareFilenames                               ; check filename header block matches searched Fn  $^$ 0xf381
    BNE .messageAndFinishBlock                          ; if (filenames don't match) then branch  $^$ 0xf384
    LDA #%00110000                                      ;  $^$ 0xf386
    AND .tapeCurrentOptionsByte                         ; check bits 4/5 of current options,  $^$ 0xf388
                                                        ; checking for 'ignore errors'
    BEQ .pullAAndReturn                                 ; if (ignore errors) then branch  $^$ 0xf38a
    LDA .fsBlockNumberLow                               ; block number  $^$ 0xf38c
    CMP .nextBlockNumberLow                             ; next block number low  $^$ 0xf38f
    BNE .messageAndFinishBlock                          ;  $^$ 0xf391
    LDA .fsBlockNumberHigh                              ; block number high  $^$ 0xf393
    CMP .nextBlockNumberHigh                            ; next block number high  $^$ 0xf396
    BNE .messageAndFinishBlock                          ;  $^$ 0xf398

.pullAAndReturn
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xf39a
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf39b

.messageAndFinishBlock
    LDA .tapeOrROMSwitch                                ; filing system flag 0=tape; 2=ROMFS  $^$ 0xf39c
    BEQ .finishReadingBlockAndContinue                  ; if (tape filing system active) then branch  $^$ 0xf39f

.skipMessaging
    JSR .setROMOrPHROMAddress                           ; set ROM address  $^$ 0xf3a1

.resetBlockNumberAndContinue
    LDA #$FF                                            ; A=$FF to reset block number  $^$ 0xf3a4
    STA .fsBlockNumberLow                               ; block number low  $^$ 0xf3a6
    STA .fsBlockNumberHigh                              ; block number high  $^$ 0xf3a9
    BNE .searchForBlockLoop                             ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xf3ac

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Finish reading block and continue
;
; On Entry:
;       V set means reset file system state (occurs when reading the last block of a ROMFS file)
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.finishReadingBlockAndContinue
    BVC +                                               ; if (V clear) then branch  $^$ 0xf3ae
    LDA #$FF                                            ; A=$FF (searching)  $^$ 0xf3b0
    JSR .setCharAThenProgressState4OrReset              ; update to progress state 4 (if block length > 0)  $^$ 0xf3b2
+
    LDX #0                                              ; X=0  $^$ 0xf3b5
    JSR .checkForChecksumError                          ; report 'Data?' if necessary  $^$ 0xf3b7
    LDA .tapeOrROMSwitch                                ; get current filing system  $^$ 0xf3ba
    BEQ +                                               ; if (tape filing system) then branch  $^$ 0xf3bd
    BIT .tapeCurrentOptionsByte                         ; check current options (bit 6)  $^$ 0xf3bf
    BVC .skipMessaging                                  ; if (no long messages) then branch (back)  $^$ 0xf3c1
+
    BIT .fsBlockFlagByte                                ; block flag  $^$ 0xf3c3
    BMI .resetBlockNumberAndContinue                    ; if (-ve) then branch  $^$ 0xf3c6
    BPL .searchForBlockLoop                             ; ALWAYS branch (loop back and do it again)  $^$ 0xf3c8


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSFIND - Open or close a file
;
; When opening a file, this returns a file handle ('channel') number:
;
;   1 = input file on tape
;   2 = output file on tape
;   3 = input file from ROMFS
;
; On Entry:
;       A determines action
;       Y may contain file handle (channel number)
;       or XY is the address of the filename terminated by $0D
;
;       A=0    closes file in channel Y; if Y = 0 closes all files
;       A=$40  open a file for input  (reading) XY points to filename
;       A=$80  open a file for output (writing) XY points to filename
;       A=$C0  open a file for both input and output (random Access)
;              (not supported by TAPE and ROM filing systems)
;
; On Exit:
;       A = file handle of opened file or zero on error
;       X,Y are preserved
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osfindEntryPoint
    STA .fsTempStorage                                  ; save action in temporary store  $^$ 0xf3ca
    TXA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf3cc
    PHA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf3cd
    TYA                                                 ; } save X and Y on the stack  $^$ 0xf3ce
    PHA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf3cf
    LDA .fsTempStorage                                  ; recall action  $^$ 0xf3d0
    BNE .openAFile                                      ; if (A is non zero) then branch (open a specific file)  $^$ 0xf3d2

.closeOneFile
    TYA                                                 ; A=Y  $^$ 0xf3d4
    BNE +                                               ; if (A is not zero) then branch (close specified file)  $^$ 0xf3d5
    JSR .osbyte119EntryPoint                            ; close all SPOOL/EXEC files using OSBYTE 119  $^$ 0xf3d7
    JSR .closeFileThatsOpenForOutput                    ; close file open for output  $^$ 0xf3da
-
    LSR .fsStatusByte                                   ; shift right (bit zero into carry)  $^$ 0xf3dd
    ASL .fsStatusByte                                   ; shift left (clear bit zero)  $^$ 0xf3df
    BCC .finishWithError                                ; if (carry clear, i.e. no input file open) then branch  $^$ 0xf3e1
+
    LSR                                                 ; A contains file handle so shift bit 0 into carry  $^$ 0xf3e3
    BCS -                                               ; if (carry set) then branch (close input file)  $^$ 0xf3e4
    LSR                                                 ; shift bit 1 into carry  $^$ 0xf3e6
    BCS .closeOutputFile                                ; if (carry set) then branch (close output file)  $^$ 0xf3e7
    JMP .channelError                                   ; report 'Channel error'  $^$ 0xf3e9
                                                        ; as tape filing system can only support one input and one output file

.closeOutputFile
    JSR .closeFileThatsOpenForOutput                    ; close file open for output  $^$ 0xf3ec
.finishWithError
    JMP .restoreRegistersAndExit                        ; and exit  $^$ 0xf3ef

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Open a file
;
; A file is opened for input or output. The file handle ('channel') is returned in A.
;
; File handles returned:
;   1 = input file on tape
;   2 = output file on tape
;   3 = input file from ROMFS
;
; On Entry:
;       XY = address of zero terminated filename
;       .fsTempStorage - action from .OSFIND (See .osfindEntryPoint)
;           bit 6 set to open for input
;           bit 7 set to open for output
;           (opening both for input and output is not supported on either tape or ROMFS)
;
; On Exit:
;       A = file handle ('channel')
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.openAFile
    JSR .getFilenameFromXY                              ; get filename from buffer at XY  $^$ 0xf3f2
    BIT .fsTempStorage                                  ; get action (OSFIND value of A on entry)  $^$ 0xf3f5
    BVC .openAFileForOutputOnly                         ; if (bit 6 not set, i.e. it's to be an output only file) then branch  $^$ 0xf3f7

    ; open a file for input
    LDA #0                                              ; it's an input file  $^$ 0xf3f9
    STA .bgetBufferOffset                               ; BGET buffer offset for next byte  $^$ 0xf3fb
    STA .nextBGETBlockLow                               ; Expected BGET file block number low  $^$ 0xf3fe
    STA .nextBGETBlockHigh                              ; expected BGET file block number high  $^$ 0xf401
    LDA #%00111110                                      ; }  $^$ 0xf404
    JSR .clearTapeStatusBits                            ; } clear 'input file open' bit; clear 'EOF reached'; clear 'EOF warning given'  $^$ 0xf406
    JSR .claimSerialSystemForSequentialAccess           ; claim serial system and set OPTions  $^$ 0xf409
    PHP                                                 ; save flags on stack  $^$ 0xf40c
    JSR .searchForFile                                  ; search for file  $^$ 0xf40d
    JSR .checkLockedFlag                                ; check protection bit of block status and respond  $^$ 0xf410
    PLP                                                 ; get back flags  $^$ 0xf413
    LDX #$FF                                            ; X=loop counter  $^$ 0xf414

-
    INX                                                 ; X=X+1  $^$ 0xf416
    LDA .fsFilename,X                                   ; copy file name character  $^$ 0xf417
    STA .bgetFilename,X                                 ; and store as BGET filename  $^$ 0xf41a
    BNE -                                               ; until end of filename (zero terminator)  $^$ 0xf41d

    LDA #%00000001                                      ; A=1 to set bit for 'input file open'  $^$ 0xf41f
    JSR .setTapeStatusBits                              ; set status bit  $^$ 0xf421
    LDA .tapeInputCurrentBlockSizeLow                   ; tape filing system currently resident file block length low  $^$ 0xf424
    ORA .tapeInputCurrentBlockSizeHigh                  ; tape filing system currently resident file block length high  $^$ 0xf427
    BNE +                                               ; if (block length is no zero) then branch  $^$ 0xf42a
    JSR .setTapeEOFStatus                               ; set tape filing system status bit 6 (EOF reached)  $^$ 0xf42c
+
    LDA #1                                              ; }  $^$ 0xf42f
    ORA .tapeOrROMSwitch                                ; } get input file handle, 1 = tape; 3=ROMFS  $^$ 0xf431
    BNE .returnAWithXYRestoredFromStack                 ; ALWAYS branch (restore registers and exit)  $^$ 0xf434

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Open a file for output
;
; On Entry:
;       X is length of filename
; ***************************************************************************************
.openAFileForOutputOnly
    TXA                                                 ; A=X  $^$ 0xf436
    BNE +                                               ; if (filename length is non-zero) then branch  $^$ 0xf437
    JMP .brkBadString                                   ; output 'Bad String' error  $^$ 0xf439

+
    LDX #$FF                                            ; X=$FF  $^$ 0xf43c
.copyFilenameLoop
    INX                                                 ; X=X+1  $^$ 0xf43e
    LDA .filenameToSearchFor,X                          ; sought filename  $^$ 0xf43f
    STA .tapeBlockHeaderStart,X                         ; write it to BPUT file header block  $^$ 0xf442
    BNE .copyFilenameLoop                               ; until A=0 (zero terminator at end of filename)  $^$ 0xf445

    LDA #$FF                                            ; A=$FF  $^$ 0xf447
    LDX #8                                              ; X=8  $^$ 0xf449
-
    STA .tapeBlockLoadAddressLow-1,X                    ; set load and exec address to $FF  $^$ 0xf44b
    DEX                                                 ; X=X-1  $^$ 0xf44e
    BNE -                                               ;  $^$ 0xf44f

    TXA                                                 ; A=0  $^$ 0xf451
    LDX #.tapeBlockNumberLow - .tapeBlockHeaderStart    ; X=loop counter from $14 to $1E  $^$ 0xf452
-
    STA .tapeBlockHeaderStart,X                         ; BPUT file header block  $^$ 0xf454
    INX                                                 ; X=X+1  $^$ 0xf457
    CPX #.bgetBufferOffset - .tapeBlockHeaderStart      ; this zeros BPUT block  $^$ 0xf458
    BNE -                                               ;  $^$ 0xf45a

    ROL .tapeBlockLengthHigh                            ;  $^$ 0xf45c
    JSR .claimSerialSystemForLoadSave                   ; claim serial system for cassette load/save  $^$ 0xf45f
    JSR .promptToRecordOnTape                           ; prompt to start recording  $^$ 0xf462
    JSR .cancelTapeOperationAndMotor                    ;  $^$ 0xf465
    LDA #%00000010                                      ; } set the tape status bit  $^$ 0xf468
    JSR .setTapeStatusBits                              ; } for 'output file open'  $^$ 0xf46a
    LDA #2                                              ; A=2=file handle of (tape) file open for output  $^$ 0xf46d

.returnAWithXYRestoredFromStack
    STA .fsTempStorage                                  ; store value of A temporarily  $^$ 0xf46f

.restoreRegistersAndExit
    PLA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf471
    TAY                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf472
    PLA                                                 ; } Restore X and Y registers  $^$ 0xf473
    TAX                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf474
    LDA .fsTempStorage                                  ; recall temporary store into A  $^$ 0xf475
.exit30
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf477

; ***************************************************************************************
.closeFileThatsOpenForOutput
    LDA #%00000010                                      ; }  $^$ 0xf478
    AND .fsStatusByte                                   ; } clear all of tape status byte except bit 1  $^$ 0xf47a
    BEQ .exit30                                         ; if (output file not open) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xf47c

    ; an output file is open
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0  $^$ 0xf47e
    STA .tapeBlockLengthHigh                            ; setting block length to current value of BPUT offset  $^$ 0xf480
    LDA #$80                                            ; A=$80 (last block)  $^$ 0xf483
    LDX .bputBufferOffset                               ; get BPUT buffer offset  $^$ 0xf485
    STX .tapeBlockLengthLow                             ; setting block length to current value of BPUT offset  $^$ 0xf488
    STA .tapeBlockFlagByte                              ; mark current block as last  $^$ 0xf48b
    JSR .saveSequentialAccessBlockToTape                ; save block to tape  $^$ 0xf48e
    LDA #%11111101                                      ; }  $^$ 0xf491
    JMP .clearTapeStatusBits                            ; } clear bit 1 of the tape status (no file is open for output) and return  $^$ 0xf493

; ***************************************************************************************
; Sequential access writes bytes instead of files. (As used by BGET and BPUT in BASIC).
.saveSequentialAccessBlockToTape
    JSR .claimSerialSystemForSequentialAccess           ; claim serial system and set OPTions  $^$ 0xf496

    LDX #17                                             ; loop counter  $^$ 0xf499
-
    LDA .tapeBlockLoadAddressLow,X                      ; }  $^$ 0xf49b
    STA .fsLoadAddressLow,X                             ; } copy header block  $^$ 0xf49e
    DEX                                                 ; X=X-1  $^$ 0xf4a1
    BPL -                                               ; loop back until X=255  $^$ 0xf4a2

    ; set load address to "FFFF0900"
    STX .tapeSaveStartAddressMid2                       ; store $FF  $^$ 0xf4a4
    STX .tapeSaveStartAddressHigh                       ; store $FF  $^$ 0xf4a6
    INX                                                 ; increment X (to zero)  $^$ 0xf4a8
    STX .tapeSaveStartAddressLow                        ; store $00  $^$ 0xf4a9
    LDA #$09                                            ;  $^$ 0xf4ab
    STA .tapeSaveStartAddressMid1                       ; store $09  $^$ 0xf4ad

    ; Copy
    LDX #(.tapeBlockFilename-1) - .vduVariablesStart    ;  $^$ 0xf4af
    JSR .copyToSoughtFilename                           ; copy filename from .tapeBlockFilename to .filenameToSearchFor  $^$ 0xf4b1
    STA .fsLastBlockReadFlagsCopy                       ; set copy of last read block flag to zero  $^$ 0xf4b4
    JSR .zeroFileHandleAndMotorOn                       ; switch Motor On  $^$ 0xf4b7
    JSR .setupForCassetteWrite                          ; set up tape filing system for write operation  $^$ 0xf4ba
    JSR .saveABlockToTape                               ; write block to tape  $^$ 0xf4bd

    ; increment block number
    INC .tapeBlockNumberLow                             ; block number low  $^$ 0xf4c0
    BNE +                                               ;  $^$ 0xf4c3
    INC .tapeBlockNumberHigh                            ; block number high  $^$ 0xf4c5
+
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf4c8

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBGET - get byte from file
;
; On Entry:
;       Y contains channel number (file handle)
; On Exit:
;       X and Y are preserved
;       C=0 indicates valid character
;       A contains character (or error) A=$FE End Of File
;
; See LoadFromTape.pdf
; See LoadFromROM.pdf
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbgetEntryPoint
    TXA                                                 ; A=X  $^$ 0xf4c9
    PHA                                                 ; save A on stack  $^$ 0xf4ca
    TYA                                                 ; A=Y  $^$ 0xf4cb
    PHA                                                 ; save A on stack  $^$ 0xf4cc
    LDA #1                                              ; A=1 (check file is open for reading)  $^$ 0xf4cd
    JSR .checkFileIsOpen                                ; check conditions for OSBGET are OK  $^$ 0xf4cf
    LDA .fsStatusByte                                   ; tape/ROM FS status byte  $^$ 0xf4d2
    ASL                                                 ; shift bit 7 into carry (EOF warning given)  $^$ 0xf4d4
    BCS .eofErrorMessage                                ; if (carry set) then branch  $^$ 0xf4d5
    ASL                                                 ; shift bit 6 into carry  $^$ 0xf4d7
    BCC .notEOF                                         ; if (carry clear, i.e. EOF not reached) then branch  $^$ 0xf4d8
    LDA #%10000000                                      ; }  $^$ 0xf4da
    JSR .setTapeStatusBits                              ; } set bit 7 of status byte ('EOF warning given')  $^$ 0xf4dc
    LDA #$FE                                            ; A = return value = $FE (end of file)  $^$ 0xf4df
    BCS .storeFileStatus                                ; if (carry set) then branch  $^$ 0xf4e1

.notEOF
    LDX .bgetBufferOffset                               ; BGET buffer offset for next byte  $^$ 0xf4e3
    INX                                                 ; X=X+1  $^$ 0xf4e6
    CPX .tapeInputCurrentBlockSizeLow                   ; tape filing system currently resident file block length low  $^$ 0xf4e7
    BNE .readFromFSBufferAndContinue                    ; if (not end of block) then branch (read a byte from buffer)  $^$ 0xf4ea

    BIT .blockFlagOfCurrentlyResidentBlock              ; block flag of currently resident block  $^$ 0xf4ec
    BMI .setEOF                                         ; if (this is the last block) then branch  $^$ 0xf4ef
    LDA .lastCharacterOfCurrentlyResidentBlock          ; last character of currently resident block  $^$ 0xf4f1
    PHA                                                 ; save A on stack  $^$ 0xf4f4
    JSR .claimSerialSystemForSequentialAccess           ; claim serial system and set OPTions  $^$ 0xf4f5
    PHP                                                 ; save flags on stack  $^$ 0xf4f8
    JSR .bgetReadBlockAndHeader                         ; read in a new block  $^$ 0xf4f9
    PLP                                                 ; get back flags  $^$ 0xf4fc
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xf4fd
    STA .fsTempStorage                                  ; store return value: last byte of current block  $^$ 0xf4fe
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry flag  $^$ 0xf500
    BIT .blockFlagOfCurrentlyResidentBlock              ; block flag of currently resident block  $^$ 0xf501
    BPL .incrementAndFinish                             ; if (not last block) then branch  $^$ 0xf504
    LDA .tapeInputCurrentBlockSizeLow                   ; get block length  $^$ 0xf506
    ORA .tapeInputCurrentBlockSizeHigh                  ; OR with high byte  $^$ 0xf509
    BNE .incrementAndFinish                             ; if (block size not zero) then branch  $^$ 0xf50c
    JSR .setTapeEOFStatus                               ; set tape filing system status bit 6 (EOF reached)  $^$ 0xf50e
    BNE .incrementAndFinish                             ; if (not EOF) then branch  $^$ 0xf511

.setEOF
    JSR .setTapeEOFStatus                               ; set tape filing system status bit 6 (EOF reached)  $^$ 0xf513

.readFromFSBufferAndContinue
    DEX                                                 ; X=X-1  $^$ 0xf516
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry flag  $^$ 0xf517
    LDA .tapeOrRS423InputBuffer,X                       ; read byte from cassette buffer  $^$ 0xf518

.storeFileStatus
    STA .fsTempStorage                                  ; store return value temporarily  $^$ 0xf51b
.incrementAndFinish
    INC .bgetBufferOffset                               ; BGET buffer offset for next byte  $^$ 0xf51d
    JMP .restoreRegistersAndExit                        ; exit via .restoreRegistersAndExit  $^$ 0xf520

; ***************************************************************************************
.eofErrorMessage
    BRK                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf523
    !byte $DF                                           ; error number
    !text "EOF",0                                       ; string and zero terminator

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; OSBPUT - Write a byte to file
;
; This is for the TAPE filing system only. The OS supplies filing system code for TAPE and
; ROM filing systems, and obviously you can't write into the ROM filing system.
;
; On Entry:
;       Y contains channel number (file handle)
;       A contains byte to be written
;
; See .saveFileToTape for PDF showing the code path and how bytes are written to tape.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.osbputEntryPoint
    STA .tapeLastBputValue                              ; store A in temporary store  $^$ 0xf529
    TXA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf52b
    PHA                                                 ; } save XY on the stack  $^$ 0xf52c
    TYA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf52d
    PHA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf52e
    LDA #2                                              ; A=2 (meaning check file is open for writing)  $^$ 0xf52f
    JSR .checkFileIsOpen                                ; check conditions necessary for OSBPUT are OK  $^$ 0xf531
    LDX .bputBufferOffset                               ; BPUT buffer offset for next byte  $^$ 0xf534
    LDA .tapeLastBputValue                              ; get back original value of A  $^$ 0xf537
    STA .tapeOrRS423OutputBuffer,X                      ; Write into cassette or RS-423 buffer  $^$ 0xf539
    INX                                                 ; X=X+1  $^$ 0xf53c
    BNE +                                               ; if (not zero, buffer is not full) then branch  $^$ 0xf53d
    JSR .saveSequentialAccessBlockToTape                ; buffer is full so save block to tape  $^$ 0xf53f
    JSR .cancelTapeOperationAndMotor                    ;  $^$ 0xf542
+
    INC .bputBufferOffset                               ; BPUT buffer offset for next byte  $^$ 0xf545
    LDA .tapeLastBputValue                              ; get back A  $^$ 0xf548
    JMP .returnAWithXYRestoredFromStack                 ; and exit  $^$ 0xf54a

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; *OPT X,Y
;
; On Entry:
;
;        X,Y
;   *OPT 0,0  restore *OPT default message values
;   *OPT 1,0  turn off filing system messages
;   *OPT 1,1  turn on filing system messages (normal)
;   *OPT 1,2  turn on filing system messages (extended)
;   *OPT 2,0  ignore errors, though messages may be displayed
;   *OPT 2,1  on error prompt for retry
;   *OPT 2,2  on error, abort
;   *OPT 3,n  set interblock gaps to n/10 seconds (for tape SAVE operations)
;             if n>127 then set default value
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.starOptEntryPoint
    TXA                                                 ; A=X  $^$ 0xf54d
    BEQ .restoreDefaultOPTs                             ; if (*OPT 0) then branch (set defaults)  $^$ 0xf54e
    CPX #3                                              ;  $^$ 0xf550
    BEQ .tapeSetInterblockGap                           ; if (*OPT 3) then branch (to set interblock gap)  $^$ 0xf552
    CPY #3                                              ;  $^$ 0xf554
    BCS .issueBadCommand                                ; if (Y > 2) then branch ('Bad command' error)  $^$ 0xf556
    DEX                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf558
    BEQ .opt1                                           ; if (*OPT 1) then branch (set filing system message level)  $^$ 0xf559
    DEX                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf55b
    BEQ .opt2                                           ; if (*OPT 2) then branch (response level to errors)  $^$ 0xf55c
.issueBadCommand
    JMP .badCommandError                                ; issue 'Bad command' error  $^$ 0xf55e


; ***************************************************************************************
; Set filing system message level
.opt1
    LDA #%00110011                                      ; set lower two bits of each nybble as a MASK  $^$ 0xf561
                                                        ; this allows us to set the top two bits of each nybble (message type) and
                                                        ; still keep the existing values for the bottom two bits
                                                        ; of each nybble (ignore/retry/abort)
    INY                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf563
    INY                                                 ; } Y=Y+3 (offset into .tapeOptByteTable)  $^$ 0xf564
    INY                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf565
    BNE .setOptWithMask                                 ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xf566

; ***************************************************************************************
; Set error levels
.opt2
    LDA #%11001100                                      ; setting top two bits of each nybble as a MASK  $^$ 0xf568
                                                        ; allows us to set the bottom two bits of each nybble (ignore/retry/abort) and
                                                        ; still keep the existing values for the top two bits
                                                        ; of each nybble (message type)
.setOptWithMask
    INY                                                 ; Y=Y+1 (offset into .tapeOptByteTable)  $^$ 0xf56a
    AND .tapeOptionsByte                                ; keep bits set in MASK for keeping current tape options  $^$ 0xf56b
.setOPTValueY
    ORA .tapeOptByteTable,Y                             ; OR with table value to set new options  $^$ 0xf56d
    STA .tapeOptionsByte                                ; store it  $^$ 0xf570
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf572

; ***************************************************************************************
.tapeSetInterblockGap
    TYA                                                 ; A=Y (interblock gap)  $^$ 0xf573
    BMI +                                               ; if (A > 127) use default value  $^$ 0xf574
    BNE .useGapDontUseDefaultValue                      ; if (A != 0) then branch (don't use default value)  $^$ 0xf576
+
    LDA #25                                             ; A=25 (2.5 seconds by default)  $^$ 0xf578
.useGapDontUseDefaultValue
    STA .tapeSequentialAccessInterBlockGap              ; sequential block gap  $^$ 0xf57a
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf57d

; ***************************************************************************************
.restoreDefaultOPTs
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A=0  $^$ 0xf57e
    BEQ .setOPTValueY                                   ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xf57f


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Tape opt byte table
;
; Options are stored in top four bits (LOAD/SAVE) and bottom four bits (sequential access)
; See .tapeCurrentOptionsByte.
;
;   bit 0/4 = Abort bit
;   bit 1/5 = Retry bit
;   bit 2/6 } Message type: 00 = no messages
;   bit 3/7 }             : 10 = short messages
;           }             : 11 = long messages
;
; 0000     Ignore errors         no messages
; 0001     Abort if error        no messages
; 0010     Retry after error     no messages
; 1000     Ignore error          short messages
; 1001     Abort if error        short messages
; 1010     Retry after error     short messages
; 1100     Ignore error          long messages
; 1101     Abort if error        long messages
; 1110     Retry after error     long messages
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.tapeOptByteTable
    !byte %10100001                                     ; default value:
                                                        ; LOAD/SAVE: Retry; short messages
                                                        ; SEQUENTIAL: Abort; no messages
    !byte %00000000                                     ; ignore error
    !byte %00100010                                     ; retry if error
    !byte %00010001                                     ; abort if error
    !byte %00000000                                     ; no messages
    !byte %10001000                                     ; short messages
    !byte %11001100                                     ; long messages

; ***************************************************************************************
; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Chapter 19: Low Level Tape Operations
;
; ***************************************************************************************
; ***************************************************************************************

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Update ACIA
;
; If necessary, read or write a byte to cassette, or read a byte from ROMFS.
; Can either be called from interrupt routine, or when loading from cassette.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.updateACIA
    DEC .fsGotACharacterToReadOrWriteFlag               ; Used when writing to tape,  $^$ 0xf588
                                                        ; to decrement the value from zero to
                                                        ; 255 indicating the byte has been
                                                        ; written (which happens below)

    LDA .tapeOrROMSwitch                                ; filing system flag 0=tape; 2=ROMFS  $^$ 0xf58a
    BEQ .updateACIATape                                 ; if (tape filing system active) then branch  $^$ 0xf58d

    ; deal with reading a byte from ROM / PHROM
    JSR .readByteFromROMFSorPHROM                       ; read ROMFS data ROM or PHROM  $^$ 0xf58f
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A  $^$ 0xf592
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry flag  $^$ 0xf593
    BCC .postReadByte                                   ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xf594

.updateACIATape
    ; deal with reading or writing to tape
    LDA .acia6850StatusRegister                         ; ACIA status register  $^$ 0xf596
    PHA                                                 ; save A on stack  $^$ 0xf599
    AND #2                                              ; clear all but bit 1  $^$ 0xf59a
    BEQ .readByteFromTape                               ; if (transmit data register full,  $^$ 0xf59c
                                                        ; i.e. not ready to send) then branch
                                                        ; (read from tape)
    LDY .tapeSendingFlag                                ; check we are sending to tape  $^$ 0xf59e
    BEQ .readByteFromTape                               ; if (not sending to tape) then  $^$ 0xf5a0
                                                        ; branch (read from tape)

    ; send a byte to tape
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xf5a2
    LDA .fsCharacterJustReadOrCharToWrite               ; get character to send  $^$ 0xf5a3
    STA .acia6850DataRegister                           ; ACIA transmit data register  $^$ 0xf5a5
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf5a8

    ; read a byte from tape
.readByteFromTape
    LDY .acia6850DataRegister                           ; read ACIA receive data register  $^$ 0xf5a9
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xf5ac
    LSR                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf5ad
    LSR                                                 ; } shift bit 2 to carry  $^$ 0xf5ae
    LSR                                                 ; } (data carrier detect)  $^$ 0xf5af
    ; fall through

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Process byte after being read from tape or ROMFS
;
; This is called from the 100Hz interrupt routine. It updates the read progress state as
; needed, and stores the byte for later processing in .readBlockHeader and
; .readTapeBlockHeader.
; See .readBlockHeader.
; See .readTapeBlockHeader.
;
; The progress in reading a block is tracked by a progress byte (0-5):
;
; See .fsReadProgressState
;
;     0 - exit
;     1 - looking for carrier tone
;     2 - found carrier tone, waiting for sync byte $2A
;     3 - found sync byte $2A, now reading header
;     4 - have read the header with non-zero block data length, now reading actual block data
;     5 - finished reading data in block
;
; On Entry:
;       Y = byte just read
;       Carry set if it's the tape filing system and 'data carrier detect' bit is set
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.postReadByte
    LDX .fsReadProgressState                            ; read progress state  $^$ 0xf5b0
    BEQ .exit31                                         ; if (.fsReadProgressState = 0) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xf5b2
    DEX                                                 ; X=X-1  $^$ 0xf5b4
    BNE .fsReadProgress2FoundCarrierTone                ; if (.fsReadProgressState > 1) then branch  $^$ 0xf5b5

    ; deal with progress state = 1 (looking for carrier tone)
    BCC .exit31                                         ; if (reading from ROM OR carrier  $^$ 0xf5b7
                                                        ; tone from cassette not detected)
                                                        ; then branch (exit)
    LDY #2                                              ; Y=2  $^$ 0xf5b9
    BNE .storeTapeProgress                              ; ALWAYS branch (store progress and  $^$ 0xf5bb
                                                        ; return)

; ***************************************************************************************
.fsReadProgress2FoundCarrierTone
    DEX                                                 ; X=X-1  $^$ 0xf5bd
    BNE .fsReadProgress3FoundSyncByte                   ; if (.fsReadProgressState > 2) then branch  $^$ 0xf5be

    ; deal with progress state = 2 (found carrier tone, waiting for it to finish)
    BCS .exit31                                         ; if (carrier tone from cassette  $^$ 0xf5c0
                                                        ; still detected) then branch (exit)

    TYA                                                 ; A=Y=byte read  $^$ 0xf5c2
    JSR .zeroChecksumAndFSFlag                          ; initialise CRC checksum to zero  $^$ 0xf5c3
    LDY #3                                              ; Y=3  $^$ 0xf5c6
    CMP #.fsSynchronisationByte                         ; check for the sync byte $2A  $^$ 0xf5c8
    BEQ .storeTapeProgress                              ; if (found sync byte) then branch  $^$ 0xf5ca
                                                        ; (store state and return)

    ; sync byte not found, revert back to progress state 1
    JSR .flipRelayOffAndOnThenSetToReadFromTape         ; control cassette system  $^$ 0xf5cc
    LDY #1                                              ; Y=1  $^$ 0xf5cf
    BNE .storeTapeProgress                              ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xf5d1

; ***************************************************************************************
.fsReadProgress3FoundSyncByte
    DEX                                                 ; X=X-1  $^$ 0xf5d3
    BNE .fsReadProgress4FoundBlockData                  ; if (.fsReadProgressState > 3) then branch  $^$ 0xf5d4

    ; deal with progress state = 3 (found sync byte $2A, reading block header)
    BCS +                                               ; if (carrier detected) then branch  $^$ 0xf5d6
    STY .fsCharacterJustReadOrCharToWrite               ; store byte just read  $^$ 0xf5d8
    BEQ .exit31                                         ; if (zero) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xf5da
+
    LDA #$80                                            ; A=$80  $^$ 0xf5dc
    STA .fsGotACharacterToReadOrWriteFlag               ; note that we have just read a byte  $^$ 0xf5de
    BNE .exit31                                         ; ALWAYS branch (exit)  $^$ 0xf5e0

; ***************************************************************************************
.fsReadProgress4FoundBlockData
    DEX                                                 ; X=X-1  $^$ 0xf5e2
    BNE .fsReadProgress5FinishedReadingBlockData        ; if (.fsReadProgressState > 4) then branch  $^$ 0xf5e3

    ; deal with progress state = 4 (found non-zero length block, reading block data)

    ; if carrier detected then reset progress to zero
    BCS .resetACIAAndResetProgress                      ; if (carry set) then branch (reset and return)  $^$ 0xf5e5

    TYA                                                 ; A=Y=byte just read  $^$ 0xf5e7
    JSR .updateCRC                                      ; perform CRC  $^$ 0xf5e8
    LDY .fsTempStorage                                  ; get length of block read  $^$ 0xf5eb
    INC .fsTempStorage                                  ; increment length of block read  $^$ 0xf5ed
    BIT .fsCharacterJustReadOrCharToWrite               ; check if bit 7 set (meaning  $^$ 0xf5ef
                                                        ; searching, not loading)
    BMI .checkForEndOfBlock                             ; if (searching) then branch  $^$ 0xf5f1

    ; send byte to second processor if needed, or store byte in regular memory
    JSR .checkLoadAddressIsForSecondProcessor           ; check load address is ok  $^$ 0xf5f3
                                                        ; also puts value of A (the byte
                                                        ; just read) into X
    BEQ +                                               ; if (load address is not for second  $^$ 0xf5f6
                                                        ; processor) then branch
    STX .tubeULADataRegister3                           ; Write byte to Tube. This triggers  $^$ 0xf5f8
                                                        ; an NMI on the co-processor.
    BNE .checkForEndOfBlock                             ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xf5fb

+
    TXA                                                 ; A=X restore value  $^$ 0xf5fd
    STA (.loadAddressLow),Y                             ; store byte at current load address  $^$ 0xf5fe

.checkForEndOfBlock
    INY                                                 ; Y=Y+1  $^$ 0xf600
    CPY .fsBlockLengthLow                               ; block length  $^$ 0xf601
    BNE .exit31                                         ; if (not equal) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xf604

    ; reached end of block data
    LDA #1                                              ; A=1  $^$ 0xf606
    STA .fsTempStorage                                  ; loop counter  $^$ 0xf608
    LDY #5                                              ; Y=5  $^$ 0xf60a
    BNE .storeTapeProgress                              ; ALWAYS branch (store progress and return)  $^$ 0xf60c

; ***************************************************************************************
.fsReadProgress5FinishedReadingBlockData
    ; this first section reads two more bytes (one byte at a time) by using .fsTempStorage
    ; (which was initialised to 1 on the previous progress state above) as a loop counter.
    TYA                                                 ; A=Y=byte read  $^$ 0xf60e
    JSR .updateCRC                                      ; update CRC  $^$ 0xf60f
    DEC .fsTempStorage                                  ; decrement loop counter (1,0)  $^$ 0xf612
    BPL .exit31                                         ; exit if loop is not done  $^$ 0xf614

.resetACIAAndResetProgress
    JSR .resetACIA                                      ; reset ACIA  $^$ 0xf616
    LDY #0                                              ; Y=0  $^$ 0xf619
.storeTapeProgress
    STY .fsReadProgressState                            ; progress state  $^$ 0xf61b
.exit31
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf61d


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Check for EOF on an open file
;
; On Entry:
;       X = file handle
; On Exit:
;       Preserves A,Y
;       X is 0 if EOF reached
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.checkEOFEntryPoint
    PHA                                                 ; save A on stack  $^$ 0xf61e
    TYA                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf61f
    PHA                                                 ; save Y on stack  $^$ 0xf620
    TXA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf621
    TAY                                                 ; } Y=X=file handle  $^$ 0xf622
    LDA #3                                              ; A=3 (meaning check for file being  $^$ 0xf623
                                                        ; open for read or write)
    JSR .checkFileIsOpen                                ; confirm file is open (otherwise  $^$ 0xf625
                                                        ; BRK with 'Channel' error)
    LDA .fsStatusByte                                   ; tape / ROM FS status byte  $^$ 0xf628
    AND #%01000000                                      ; mask for just the EOF flag  $^$ 0xf62a
    TAX                                                 ; X=A  $^$ 0xf62c
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xf62d
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A  $^$ 0xf62e
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xf62f
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf630

; ***************************************************************************************
.searchForFile
    LDA #0                                              ; }  $^$ 0xf631
    STA .currentBlockNumberLow                          ; } reset current block number  $^$ 0xf633
    STA .currentBlockNumberHigh                         ; }  $^$ 0xf635

.searchForSpecifiedBlock
    LDA .currentBlockNumberLow                          ; current block number (low byte)  $^$ 0xf637
    PHA                                                 ; save A on stack  $^$ 0xf639
    STA .nextBlockNumberLow                             ; save as next block number (low byte)  $^$ 0xf63a
    LDA .currentBlockNumberHigh                         ; current block number (high byte)  $^$ 0xf63c
    PHA                                                 ; save A on stack  $^$ 0xf63e
    STA .nextBlockNumberHigh                            ; save as next block number (high byte)  $^$ 0xf63f

    JSR .safePrintFollowingMessage                      ; print message following call  $^$ 0xf641
    !text "Searching"                                   ;
    !text .charRETURN,0                                 ;

    LDA #$FF                                            ; A=$FF (Meaning 'Must match filename  $^$ 0xf64f
                                                        ; and block number')
    JSR .searchForBlockCheckFilingSystem                ; read data from tape filing system/ROMFS  $^$ 0xf651
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xf654
    STA .currentBlockNumberHigh                         ; current block number high  $^$ 0xf655
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xf657
    STA .currentBlockNumberLow                          ; current block number low  $^$ 0xf658
    LDA .nextBlockNumberLow                             ; next block number low  $^$ 0xf65a
    ORA .nextBlockNumberHigh                            ; next block number high  $^$ 0xf65c
