    BNE +                                               ;  $^$ 0xf65e
    STA .currentBlockNumberLow                          ; zero current block number low  $^$ 0xf660
    STA .currentBlockNumberHigh                         ; zero current block number high  $^$ 0xf662
    LDA .checksumIsValidFlag                            ; checksum result  $^$ 0xf664
    BNE +                                               ;  $^$ 0xf666
    LDX #(.fsFilename-1) - .vduVariablesStart           ;  $^$ 0xf668
    JSR .copyToSoughtFilename                           ; copy filename from .fsFilename to .filenameToSearchFor  $^$ 0xf66a
+
    LDA .tapeOrROMSwitch                                ; filing system flag 0=tape filing system; 2=ROMFS  $^$ 0xf66d
    BEQ .setBlockFlagsAndExit                           ; if (tape filing system active) then branch  $^$ 0xf670
    BVS .setBlockFlagsAndExit                           ; if (V set) then branch  $^$ 0xf672

.fileNotFoundError
    BRK                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf674
    !byte $D6                                           ; Error number
    !text "File not found",0                            ;

; ***************************************************************************************
.setBlockFlagsAndExit
    LDY #$FF                                            ; Y=$FF  $^$ 0xf685
    STY .fsLastBlockReadFlagsCopy                       ; copy of last read block flag  $^$ 0xf687
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf68a


; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Close a SPOOL / EXEC file
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.closeSpoolOrExecFile
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0, Z=0  $^$ 0xf68b
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Close EXEC file and optionally open a new EXEC file
;
; On Entry:
;       A = 0
;       Z = 0 means close any open EXEC file.
;       Z = 1 means open the exec file whose filename is in address XY.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.closeAndOptionallyOpenANewEXECFile
    PHP                                                 ; save flags on stack  $^$ 0xf68d
    STY .tempWorkspaceE6                                ; .tempWorkspaceE6 = Y  $^$ 0xf68e
    LDY .execFileHandle                                 ; file handle of EXEC file to be closed  $^$ 0xf690
    STA .execFileHandle                                 ; record EXEC file closed (A=0)  $^$ 0xf693
    BEQ +                                               ; if (closing an exec file) then branch  $^$ 0xf696
    JSR .OSFIND                                         ; close EXEC file (A=0; Y=file handle)  $^$ 0xf698
+
    LDY .tempWorkspaceE6                                ; Y = original Y  $^$ 0xf69b
    PLP                                                 ; get back flags  $^$ 0xf69d
    BEQ +                                               ; if (zero flag set on entry) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xf69e
    LDA #$40                                            ; A is value for opening an input file  $^$ 0xf6a0
    JSR .OSFIND                                         ; open an EXEC file  $^$ 0xf6a2
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A  $^$ 0xf6a5
    BEQ .fileNotFoundError                              ; If (Y ===0) then branch ('File not found')  $^$ 0xf6a6
    STA .execFileHandle                                 ; store EXEC file handle  $^$ 0xf6a8
+
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf6ab

; ***************************************************************************************
.bgetReadBlockAndHeader
    LDX #(.bgetFilename-1) - .vduVariablesStart         ;  $^$ 0xf6ac
    JSR .copyToSoughtFilename                           ; copy filename from .bgetFilename to .filenameToSearchFor  $^$ 0xf6ae
    JSR .readBlockHeader                                ; read block header. On exit V is clear for last block of ROMFS.  $^$ 0xf6b1
.checkLockedFlag
    LDA .fsBlockFlagByte                                ; block flag  $^$ 0xf6b4
    LSR                                                 ; move bit 0 into carry to check for a 'locked' file  $^$ 0xf6b7
    BCC .setLoadAddressAndLoadBlock                     ; if (not locked) then branch (skip next instruction)  $^$ 0xf6b8
    JMP .fileLocked                                     ; 'locked' file routine  $^$ 0xf6ba

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Set Load Address and Load Block
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.setLoadAddressAndLoadBlock
    LDA .nextBGETBlockLow                               ; Expected BGET file block number low  $^$ 0xf6bd
    STA .currentBlockNumberLow                          ; current block number low  $^$ 0xf6c0
    LDA .nextBGETBlockHigh                              ; expected BGET file block number high  $^$ 0xf6c2
    STA .currentBlockNumberHigh                         ; current block number high  $^$ 0xf6c5
    LDA #<.tapeOrRS423InputBuffer                       ; }  $^$ 0xf6c7
    STA .loadAddressLow                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf6c9
    LDA #>.tapeOrRS423InputBuffer                       ; }  $^$ 0xf6cb
    STA .loadAddressMid1                                ; } set load address to $FFFF0A00  $^$ 0xf6cd
    LDA #$FF                                            ; } (i.e. .tapeOrRS423InputBuffer)  $^$ 0xf6cf
    STA .loadAddressMid2                                ; }  $^$ 0xf6d1
    STA .loadAddressHigh                                ; }  $^$ 0xf6d3
    JSR .setStateForLoadingBlockDataOrReset             ; set progress to read block data  $^$ 0xf6d5
    JSR .loadBlock                                      ; load block from tape  $^$ 0xf6d8
    BNE .searchForBlock                                 ; if (non zero) then branch  $^$ 0xf6db
    LDA .tapeOrRS423InputBuffer + $FF                   ; get last character from input buffer  $^$ 0xf6dd
    STA .lastCharacterOfCurrentlyResidentBlock          ; last character currently resident block  $^$ 0xf6e0
    JSR .incrementBlockNumbers                          ; inc. current block number  $^$ 0xf6e3
    STX .nextBGETBlockLow                               ; expected BGET file block number low  $^$ 0xf6e6
    STY .nextBGETBlockHigh                              ; expected BGET file block number high  $^$ 0xf6e9

    LDX #2                                              ; X = loop counter  $^$ 0xf6ec
-
    LDA .fsBlockLengthLow,X                             ; read bytes from block flag/block length  $^$ 0xf6ee
    STA .tapeInputCurrentBlockSizeLow,X                 ; store into current values of above  $^$ 0xf6f1
    DEX                                                 ; X=X-1  $^$ 0xf6f4
    BPL -                                               ; until X=-1 ($FF)  $^$ 0xf6f5

    BIT .blockFlagOfCurrentlyResidentBlock              ; block flag of currently resident block  $^$ 0xf6f7
    BPL +                                               ; if (not last block) then branch (don't print newline)  $^$ 0xf6fa
    JSR .printReturnSafely                              ; print newline if needed  $^$ 0xf6fc
+
    JMP .cancelTapeOperationAndMotor                    ;  $^$ 0xf6ff

; ***************************************************************************************
.searchForBlock
    JSR .searchForSpecifiedBlock                        ; search for a specified block  $^$ 0xf702
    BNE .checkLockedFlag                                ; ALWAYS branch (check for locked condition)  $^$ 0xf705

; ***************************************************************************************
.checkForROMBlockMarker
    CMP #.fsSynchronisationByte                         ; check for synchronising byte $2A (at start of first block)  $^$ 0xf707
    BEQ .startOfBlock                                   ; if (found synchronising byte for first block) then branch  $^$ 0xf709
    CMP #.romFSMiddleBlockHeaderByte                    ; check for header byte for a middle block  $^$ 0xf70b
    BNE .clearCatalogueStatusBadROM                     ; if (middle block header not found) then branch (error 'Bad ROM')  $^$ 0xf70d

    INC .fsBlockNumberLow                               ; block number  $^$ 0xf70f
    BNE +                                               ;  $^$ 0xf712
    INC .fsBlockNumberHigh                              ; block number high  $^$ 0xf714
+
    LDX #$FF                                            ; X=$FF  $^$ 0xf717
    BIT .allBitsSet                                     ; set N and V flags  $^$ 0xf719
    BNE .clearChecksumTapeProgress                      ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xf71c

; ***************************************************************************************
.clearCatalogueStatusBadROM
    LDA #%11110111                                      ; }  $^$ 0xf71e
    JSR .clearTapeStatusBits                            ; } clear current catalogue status  $^$ 0xf720
                                                        ; [this could just call
                                                        ;  JSR .clearCatalogueStatus
                                                        ;  instead of the LDA/JSR instructions
                                                        ;  above, for a 2 byte saving]

.badROMError
    BRK                                                 ; cause error  $^$ 0xf723
    !byte $D7                                           ; error number
    !text "Bad ROM"                                     ; message
    !byte 0                                             ; terminator

; ***************************************************************************************
.readTapeBlockHeader
    LDY #$FF                                            ;  $^$ 0xf72d
    JSR .storeFileHandleAndMotorOn                      ; switch Motor on  $^$ 0xf72f
    LDA #1                                              ; A=1  $^$ 0xf732
    STA .fsReadProgressState                            ; start the read progress state  $^$ 0xf734
    JSR .flipRelayOffAndOnThenSetToReadFromTape         ; control serial system  $^$ 0xf736

-
    JSR .checkForEscapeDuringCassetteOperation          ; confirm ESC not set and tape filing system not executing  $^$ 0xf739
    LDA #3                                              ; A=3  $^$ 0xf73c
    CMP .fsReadProgressState                            ; progress state  $^$ 0xf73e
    BNE -                                               ; back until .fsReadProgressState=3  $^$ 0xf740

.startOfBlock
    LDY #0                                              ; Y=0  $^$ 0xf742
    JSR .setChecksumBytesToY                            ; zero checksum bytes  $^$ 0xf744

    ; read filename
-
    JSR .readByteFromTapeOrROM                          ; get character from file and do CRC  $^$ 0xf747
    BVC .reachedEndOfHeader                             ; if (V clear) then branch  $^$ 0xf74a
    STA .fsFilename,Y                                   ; store  $^$ 0xf74c
    BEQ +                                               ; or if A=0 then branch  $^$ 0xf74f
    INY                                                 ; Y=Y+1  $^$ 0xf751
    CPY #11                                             ; check Y against 11  $^$ 0xf752
    BNE -                                               ; if (Y != 11) then branch (go back for next character)  $^$ 0xf754
    DEY                                                 ; Y=10  $^$ 0xf756

+
    ; read rest of header
    LDX #12                                             ; X=loop counter (from 12 to 31) to read rest of header  $^$ 0xf757
-
    JSR .readByteFromTapeOrROM                          ; get character from file and do CRC  $^$ 0xf759
    BVC .reachedEndOfHeader                             ; if (V clear) then branch  $^$ 0xf75c
    STA .fsFilename,X                                   ; store byte  $^$ 0xf75e
    INX                                                 ; X=X+1  $^$ 0xf761
    CPX #$1F                                            ; check X for 31  $^$ 0xf762
    BNE -                                               ; if (X is not 31) then loop back  $^$ 0xf764

.reachedEndOfHeader
    TYA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf766
    TAX                                                 ; } X=Y=length of filename  $^$ 0xf767
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0  $^$ 0xf768
    STA .fsFilename,Y                                   ; store terminator  $^$ 0xf76a
    LDA .tapeChecksumLow                                ; }  $^$ 0xf76d
    ORA .tapeChecksumHigh                               ; } Check if the CRC value is zero  $^$ 0xf76f
    STA .checksumIsValidFlag                            ; Checksum result is zero if valid  $^$ 0xf771

.clearChecksumTapeProgress
    JSR .zeroChecksumAndFSFlag                          ; reset checksum etc  $^$ 0xf773
    STY .fsReadProgressState                            ; reset progress (Y=0)  $^$ 0xf776
    TXA                                                 ; A=X=length of filename  $^$ 0xf778
    BNE .exit32                                         ; The tape filename is always non-zero  $^$ 0xf779
                                                        ; in length so:
                                                        ; ALWAYS branch (exit)
                                                        ; [In which case, RTS would be shorter]

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Read block header
;
; On Exit:
;       V = clear if final block
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.readBlockHeader
    LDA .tapeOrROMSwitch                                ; filing system flag 0=tape; 2=ROMFS  $^$ 0xf77b
    BEQ .readTapeBlockHeader                            ; if (tape filing system active) then branch  $^$ 0xf77e

    ; Read ROM file header
    ; See NAUG Section 17.5.6, Page 317 for ROM data format
-
    JSR .readByteFromROMFSorPHROM                       ; read ROMFS data ROM or PHROM  $^$ 0xf780
    CMP #.romFSFinalBlockHeaderByte                     ; check for ROM file terminator  $^$ 0xf783
    BNE .checkForROMBlockMarker                         ; if (not terminator) then branch  $^$ 0xf785

    ; ROM file terminator found
    LDA #%00001000                                      ; A=isolating bit 3 (catalogue status)  $^$ 0xf787
    AND .fsStatusByte                                   ; check catalogue status  $^$ 0xf789
    BEQ +                                               ; if (clear) then branch (skip next instruction)  $^$ 0xf78b
    JSR .saveFlagsPrintCR                               ; print CR safely  $^$ 0xf78d
+
    JSR .readByteFromROMOrPHROM                         ; get byte from data ROM  $^$ 0xf790
    BCC -                                               ; if (carry clear) then branch (loop back and try again)  $^$ 0xf793
    CLV                                                 ; clear overflow flag  $^$ 0xf795
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf796

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Read byte from tape or ROM
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.readByteFromTapeOrROM
    LDA .tapeOrROMSwitch                                ; filing system flag 0=tape; 2=ROMFS  $^$ 0xf797
    BEQ +                                               ; if (tape filing system active) then branch  $^$ 0xf79a

    ; deal with ROMFS read byte
    TXA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf79c
    PHA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf79d
    TYA                                                 ; } save X and Y  $^$ 0xf79e
    PHA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf79f
    JSR .readByteFromROMFSorPHROM                       ; read ROMFS data ROM or PHROM  $^$ 0xf7a0
    STA .fsCharacterJustReadOrCharToWrite               ; store character just read  $^$ 0xf7a3
    LDA #$FF                                            ; Top bit set  $^$ 0xf7a5
    STA .fsGotACharacterToReadOrWriteFlag               ; note that we have just read a byte  $^$ 0xf7a7
                                                        ; set 'flag' to $FF to avoid waiting for
                                                        ; byte to be read (c.f. from tape)
    PLA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf7a9
    TAY                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf7aa
    PLA                                                 ; } restore X and Y  $^$ 0xf7ab
    TAX                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf7ac
+
    JSR .waitForByteToReadOrWrite                       ; check for Escape and loop till bit 7 of FS buffer flag=1  $^$ 0xf7ad
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Update CRC
;
; A cyclic redundancy check is updated one byte at a time.
;
; Pseudo-code is as follows. HL = high and low bytes of the CRC. A = byte on input.
;
;   H = A EOR H
;   FOR X = 1 TO 8
;       Carry=bit 7 of H
;       IF (Carry = 1) THEN HL=HL EOR $0810
;       HL=(HL*2 + Carry) AND $FFFF
;   NEXT X
;
; On Entry:
;       A = byte just written or read
;       Preserves A, X and Y
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.updateCRC
    PHP                                                 ; save flags on stack  $^$ 0xf7b0
    PHA                                                 ; save A on stack  $^$ 0xf7b1
    SEC                                                 ; } Set top bit of CRC bit counter  $^$ 0xf7b2
    ROR .tapeCRCBitCounter                              ; } This acts as a loop counter  $^$ 0xf7b3

    EOR .tapeChecksumHigh                               ; }  $^$ 0xf7b5
    STA .tapeChecksumHigh                               ; } H = A EOR H  $^$ 0xf7b7
-
    LDA .tapeChecksumHigh                               ;  $^$ 0xf7b9
    ROL                                                 ; Carry = bit 7 (A = A * 2)  $^$ 0xf7bb
    BCC +                                               ;  $^$ 0xf7bc
    ROR                                                 ; A = A / 2 = H  $^$ 0xf7be

    EOR #$08                                            ; }  $^$ 0xf7bf
    STA .tapeChecksumHigh                               ; }  $^$ 0xf7c1
    LDA .tapeChecksumLow                                ; } HL=HL EOR $0810  $^$ 0xf7c3
    EOR #$10                                            ; }  $^$ 0xf7c5
    STA .tapeChecksumLow                                ; }  $^$ 0xf7c7
    SEC                                                 ; set carry flag  $^$ 0xf7c9

+
    ROL .tapeChecksumLow                                ; }  $^$ 0xf7ca
    ROL .tapeChecksumHigh                               ; } HL=(HL*2 + Carry) AND &FFFF  $^$ 0xf7cc

    LSR .tapeCRCBitCounter                              ; shift loop counter right  $^$ 0xf7ce
    BNE -                                               ; if (eight bits not processed) then branch  $^$ 0xf7d0

    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xf7d2
    PLP                                                 ; get back flags  $^$ 0xf7d3
.exit32
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf7d4

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Set state ready for loading block data (or reset)
;
; Set the character just read to zero, and the progress state to 4.
; Together this signifies we are ready to load block data.
; If V is clear, then we instead reset to progress state zero.
;
; On Entry:
;       If V clear, then reset to state zero
;       otherwise set to state 4, ready to read the block data bytes
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.setStateForLoadingBlockDataOrReset
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0  $^$ 0xf7d5
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Set state ready for loading block data or searching (or reset state)
;
; Store the character just read. If all is well (V set and non-zero block length), then
; progress state is set to 4. Otherwise we revert back to progress state zero.
;
; On Entry:
;       A is $FF when searching, $00 when loading
;       V clear means reset progress state to zero
;       .fsBlockLengthLow/High holds the block length
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.setCharAThenProgressState4OrReset
    STA .fsCharacterJustReadOrCharToWrite               ; store character just read  $^$ 0xf7d7
    LDX #0                                              ; X=0  $^$ 0xf7d9
    STX .fsTempStorage                                  ;  $^$ 0xf7db
    BVC +                                               ;  $^$ 0xf7dd
    LDA .fsBlockLengthLow                               ; block length  $^$ 0xf7df
    ORA .fsBlockLengthHigh                              ; block length high  $^$ 0xf7e2
    BEQ +                                               ; if (block length is zero) then branch  $^$ 0xf7e5
    LDX #4                                              ; X=4 (block length not zero)  $^$ 0xf7e7
+
    STX .fsReadProgressState                            ; save progress state  $^$ 0xf7e9
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf7eb

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Save a block to tape
;
; When saving to tape, we record a five second delay before the first block, then a delay
; specified by the interblock gap for all subsequent blocks. After all blocks are recorded
; there is a further five second delay.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.saveABlockToTape
    PHP                                                 ; save flags on stack  $^$ 0xf7ec
    LDX #3                                              ; X=loop counter  $^$ 0xf7ed
    LDA #0                                              ; A=value to store  $^$ 0xf7ef
-
    STA .fsSpareByteA,X                                 ; clear the four spare bytes of file system block  $^$ 0xf7f1
    DEX                                                 ; X=X-1  $^$ 0xf7f4
    BPL -                                               ;  $^$ 0xf7f5

    LDA .fsBlockNumberLow                               ; block number  $^$ 0xf7f7
    ORA .fsBlockNumberHigh                              ; block number high  $^$ 0xf7fa
    BNE .waitForInterblockGap                           ; if (block number is not zero) then branch  $^$ 0xf7fd
    JSR .waitFiveSeconds                                ; generate a 5 second delay  $^$ 0xf7ff
    BEQ +                                               ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xf802

.waitForInterblockGap
    JSR .generateInterBlockGapDelay                     ; generate delay set by interblock gap  $^$ 0xf804

    ; initialise and save value $2A to tape
+
    LDA #.fsSynchronisationByte                         ; A=synchronisation byte (byte to save to tape)  $^$ 0xf807
    STA .fsCharacterJustReadOrCharToWrite               ; store character to write  $^$ 0xf809
    JSR .zeroChecksumAndFSFlag                          ; initialise checksum and file system buffer flag  $^$ 0xf80b
    JSR .activateRequestToSend                          ; request send to tape  $^$ 0xf80e
    JSR .waitForByteToReadOrWrite                       ; wait for byte to be saved to tape  $^$ 0xf811
    DEY                                                 ; Y=Y-1  $^$ 0xf814

    ; save filename
-
    INY                                                 ; Y=Y+1  $^$ 0xf815
    LDA .filenameToSearchFor,Y                          ; move sought filename  $^$ 0xf816
    STA .fsFilename,Y                                   ; into filename block  $^$ 0xf819
    JSR .saveByteAToTapeAndUpdateCRC                    ; transfer byte to tape filing system and do CRC  $^$ 0xf81c
    BNE -                                               ; if (filename not yet complete) then branch (do it again)  $^$ 0xf81f

    ; save rest of header:
    ;   load address      (4 bytes)
    ;   execution address (4 bytes)
    ;   block number      (2 bytes)
    ;   block length      (2 bytes)
    ;   block flag byte   (1 byte)
    ;   spare bytes       (4 bytes)
    LDX #.fsLoadAddressLow - .fsFilename                ; X=offset to load address  $^$ 0xf821
-
    LDA .fsFilename,X                                   ; get filename byte  $^$ 0xf823
    JSR .saveByteAToTapeAndUpdateCRC                    ; transfer byte to tape filing system and do CRC  $^$ 0xf826
    INX                                                 ; X=X+1  $^$ 0xf829
    CPX #.fsChecksumLow - .fsFilename                   ; until X reaches the end of the header block (just before the start of the two checksum bytes)  $^$ 0xf82a
    BNE -                                               ;  $^$ 0xf82c

    JSR .saveChecksumToTape                             ; save checksum to TAPE reset buffer flag  $^$ 0xf82e
    LDA .fsBlockLengthLow                               ; block length  $^$ 0xf831
    ORA .fsBlockLengthHigh                              ; block length high  $^$ 0xf834
    BEQ .saveFinalTwoBytes                              ; if (block length is zero) then branch  $^$ 0xf837

    LDY #0                                              ; Y=0  $^$ 0xf839
    JSR .setChecksumBytesToY                            ; zero checksum bytes  $^$ 0xf83b

-
    LDA (.tapeSaveStartAddressLow),Y                    ; get a data byte to save  $^$ 0xf83e
    JSR .checkLoadAddressIsForSecondProcessor           ; check if load address is from second processor  $^$ 0xf840
    BEQ +                                               ; if (not from second processor) then branch  $^$ 0xf843
    LDX .tubeULADataRegister3                           ; read byte from second processor  $^$ 0xf845
+
    TXA                                                 ; A=X  $^$ 0xf848
    JSR .saveByteAToTapeAndUpdateCRC                    ; transfer byte to tape filing system and do CRC  $^$ 0xf849
    INY                                                 ; Y=Y+1  $^$ 0xf84c
    CPY .fsBlockLengthLow                               ; check block length  $^$ 0xf84d
    BNE -                                               ; if (block not done yet) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xf850

    JSR .saveChecksumToTape                             ; save checksum to TAPE  $^$ 0xf852

.saveFinalTwoBytes
    JSR .waitForByteToReadOrWrite                       ; save byte  $^$ 0xf855
    JSR .waitForByteToReadOrWrite                       ; save byte  $^$ 0xf858
    JSR .resetACIA                                      ; reset ACIA  $^$ 0xf85b

    LDA #1                                              ; A=1  $^$ 0xf85e
    JSR .generateDelay                                  ; generate 0.1 second delay  $^$ 0xf860
    PLP                                                 ; get back flags  $^$ 0xf863
    JSR .updateBlockFlagAndDisplayProgress              ; update block flag, PRINT filename (and address if reqd)  $^$ 0xf864
    BIT .fsBlockFlagByte                                ; block flag  $^$ 0xf867
    BPL +                                               ; if (this is NOT last block) then branch  $^$ 0xf86a
    PHP                                                 ; save flags on stack  $^$ 0xf86c
    JSR .waitFiveSeconds                                ; generate a 5 second delay  $^$ 0xf86d
    JSR .beepCancelAndPrintReturn                       ; sound bell and cancel  $^$ 0xf870
    PLP                                                 ; get back flags  $^$ 0xf873
+
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf874

; ***************************************************************************************
.saveByteAToTapeAndUpdateCRC
    JSR .saveByteAToTape                                ; save byte  $^$ 0xf875
    JMP .updateCRC                                      ; update CRC  $^$ 0xf878

; ***************************************************************************************
.saveChecksumToTape
    LDA .tapeChecksumHigh                               ;  $^$ 0xf87b
    JSR .saveByteAToTape                                ; save byte to buffer, transfer to  $^$ 0xf87d
                                                        ; tape filing system and reset flag
    LDA .tapeChecksumLow                                ;  $^$ 0xf880
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Save a byte to tape
;
; On Entry:
;       A = character to write
; On Exit:
;       A is preserved
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.saveByteAToTape
    STA .fsCharacterJustReadOrCharToWrite               ; store character to write  $^$ 0xf882

.waitForByteToReadOrWrite
    JSR .checkForEscapeDuringCassetteOperation          ; confirm ESC not set and tape filing  $^$ 0xf884
                                                        ; system not executing
    BIT .fsGotACharacterToReadOrWriteFlag               ; check if we have read / written a byte  $^$ 0xf887
    BPL .waitForByteToReadOrWrite                       ; loop back until we have read / written a byte  $^$ 0xf889

    ; byte is now read / written
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0  $^$ 0xf88b
    STA .fsGotACharacterToReadOrWriteFlag               ; clear flag, we no longer have a byte  $^$ 0xf88d
    LDA .fsCharacterJustReadOrCharToWrite               ; get character just read  $^$ 0xf88f
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf891

; ***************************************************************************************
.waitFiveSeconds
    LDA #50                                             ; Set A for 50 tenths of a second  $^$ 0xf892
                                                        ; delay
    BNE .generateDelay                                  ; ALWAYS branch. generate delay  $^$ 0xf894
                                                        ; 100ms * A (= 5 seconds)

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Delay for the (temporary) interblock gap time
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.generateInterBlockGapDelay
    LDA .tapeInterBlockGap                              ; get current interblock flag  $^$ 0xf896
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Wait for A/10 seconds, or until ESCAPE is pressed
;
; On Entry:
;       A = amount of delay in 10ths of a second
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.generateDelay
    LDX #5                                              ; X=loop counter  $^$ 0xf898

.delayLoop
    STA .verticalSyncCounter                            ; set vsync counter  $^$ 0xf89a
-
    JSR .checkForEscapeDuringCassetteOperation          ; check for ESCAPE  $^$ 0xf89d
    BIT .verticalSyncCounter                            ; check vsync counter (decremented 50 times a second)  $^$ 0xf8a0
    BPL -                                               ; if (not negative) then branch back  $^$ 0xf8a3
    DEX                                                 ; X--  $^$ 0xf8a5
    BNE .delayLoop                                      ;  $^$ 0xf8a6
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf8a8

; ***************************************************************************************
; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Chapter 20: Filing System Messaging and Error Reporting
;
; ***************************************************************************************
; ***************************************************************************************

; ***************************************************************************************
.generateScreenReports
    LDA .fsBlockNumberLow                               ; block number low  $^$ 0xf8a9
    ORA .fsBlockNumberHigh                              ; block number high  $^$ 0xf8ac
    BEQ .newlineAndContinue                             ; if (block number is zero) then branch (print newline and continue)  $^$ 0xf8af
    BIT .fsLastBlockReadFlagsCopy                       ; copy of last read block flags  $^$ 0xf8b1
    BPL .updateBlockFlagAndDisplayProgress              ; update block flag, PRINT filename (and address if required)  $^$ 0xf8b4

.newlineAndContinue
    JSR .printReturnSafely                              ; print newline if needed  $^$ 0xf8b6
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Display progress
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.updateBlockFlagAndDisplayProgress
    LDY #0                                              ; Y=0  $^$ 0xf8b9
    STY .currentBlockHasDataErrorFlag                   ; reset data error flag to zero  $^$ 0xf8bb
    LDA .fsBlockFlagByte                                ; get block flag byte  $^$ 0xf8bd
    STA .fsLastBlockReadFlagsCopy                       ; store as copy of last read block flag  $^$ 0xf8c0
    JSR .shouldPrintMessage                             ; check if free to print message  $^$ 0xf8c3
    BEQ .exit33                                         ; if (not safe to print messages) then branch (return)  $^$ 0xf8c6

    ; print just a carriage return, to return text cursor to the start of the current line
    ; (without emitting a linefeed to go down to the next line)
    LDA #.charRETURN                                    ; carriage return  $^$ 0xf8c8
    JSR .OSWRCH                                         ; print it (note no linefeed; so text will overwrite any previous block's message)  $^$ 0xf8ca

    ; display filename as printable characters, or '?' otherwise
.filenameLoop
    LDA .fsFilename,Y                                   ; get byte from filename (zero terminated)  $^$ 0xf8cd
    BEQ .filenameDone                                   ; if (filename is ended) then branch  $^$ 0xf8d0
    CMP #.charSPACE                                     ; }  $^$ 0xf8d2
    BCC .displayQuestionMark                            ; } if (control code found) then branch (show '?')  $^$ 0xf8d4
    CMP #.charDELETE                                    ; check for being less than DELETE  $^$ 0xf8d6
    BCC .displayPrintableCharacter                      ; if (it's a printable character) then branch  $^$ 0xf8d8
.displayQuestionMark
    LDA #.charQUESTIONMARK                              ; A='?'  $^$ 0xf8da
.displayPrintableCharacter
    JSR .OSWRCH                                         ; and print it  $^$ 0xf8dc
    INY                                                 ; Y=Y+1  $^$ 0xf8df
    BNE .filenameLoop                                   ; ALWAYS branch (back to get rest of filename)  $^$ 0xf8e0
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Display Progress (post-filename)
;
; John Kortink found a couple of bugs in the filing systems. See .reachedFinalBlock.
;
; The first is that in the ROM filing system, .tapeFileLengthLow / High only get set here
; if long messages are enabled, otherwise we early out of this routine. This means OSFILE
; can return an invalid size.
;
; See .reachedFinalBlock for more information
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.filenameDone
    LDA .tapeOrROMSwitch                                ; filing system switch (0=cassette, 2=ROM filing system)  $^$ 0xf8e2
    BEQ +                                               ; if (tape filing system active) then branch  $^$ 0xf8e5
    BIT .tapeCurrentOptionsByte                         ; check bit 6 of current options  $^$ 0xf8e7
    BVC .exit33                                         ; if (long messages not needed) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xf8e9

    ; print spaces after filename up to 11 characters total
+
    JSR .printSpace                                     ; print a space  $^$ 0xf8eb
    INY                                                 ; Y=Y+1  $^$ 0xf8ee
    CPY #11                                             ;  $^$ 0xf8ef
    BCC .filenameDone                                   ; if (Y<11) then branch (loop again to fill out filename with spaces)  $^$ 0xf8f1

    ; print block number
    LDA .fsBlockNumberLow                               ; block number  $^$ 0xf8f3
    TAX                                                 ; remember block number in X  $^$ 0xf8f6
    JSR .printHexByte                                   ; print hex byte as ASCII  $^$ 0xf8f7
    BIT .fsBlockFlagByte                                ; block flag byte (bit 7 is 'last block' flag)  $^$ 0xf8fa
    BPL .exit33                                         ; if (not end of file) then branch (return)  $^$ 0xf8fd

    ; at this point we are on the last block of the file
    ; print the file length in hex
    TXA                                                 ; recall block number from X  $^$ 0xf8ff
    CLC                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf900
    ADC .fsBlockLengthHigh                              ; add block length high byte (to get total file length high)  $^$ 0xf901
    STA .tapeFileLengthHigh                             ; store as file length (high byte)  $^$ 0xf904
    JSR .printSpaceThenHexByte                          ; print space then hex byte as ASCII  $^$ 0xf906
    LDA .fsBlockLengthLow                               ; get block length (low byte)  $^$ 0xf909
    STA .tapeFileLengthLow                              ; store as file length (low byte)  $^$ 0xf90c
    JSR .printHexByte                                   ; print hex byte as ASCII  $^$ 0xf90e
    BIT .tapeCurrentOptionsByte                         ; current options  $^$ 0xf911
    BVC .exit33                                         ; if (long messages not required) then branch (return)  $^$ 0xf913

    ; print four spaces
    LDX #4                                              ; X=loop counter  $^$ 0xf915
-
    JSR .printSpace                                     ; print a space  $^$ 0xf917
    DEX                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf91a
    BNE -                                               ; loop to print 4 spaces  $^$ 0xf91b

    ; display load address, a space, then executable address
    LDX #.fsLoadAddressHigh - .fsFilename               ; X = offset to load address (high byte)  $^$ 0xf91d
    JSR .printFourByteAddress                           ; print 4 bytes from tape filing system block header  $^$ 0xf91f
    JSR .printSpace                                     ; print a space  $^$ 0xf922
    LDX #.fsExecutionAddressHigh - .fsFilename          ; X = offset to execution address (high byte)  $^$ 0xf925
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Print four bytes from tape filing system block header
;
; On Entry:
;       X is offset to high byte of address from .fsFilename
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.printFourByteAddress
    LDY #4                                              ; loop counter  $^$ 0xf927
-
    LDA .fsFilename,X                                   ; block header  $^$ 0xf929
    JSR .printHexByte                                   ; print ASCII equivalent of hex byte  $^$ 0xf92c
    DEX                                                 ; X=X-1  $^$ 0xf92f
    DEY                                                 ; Y=Y-1  $^$ 0xf930
    BNE -                                               ;  $^$ 0xf931
.exit33
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf933

; ***************************************************************************************
.promptToRecordOnTape
    LDA .tapeOrROMSwitch                                ; filing system flag 0=tape; 2=ROMFS  $^$ 0xf934
    BEQ +                                               ; if (tape filing system active) then branch  $^$ 0xf937
    JMP .badCommandError                                ; 'Bad command error message'  $^$ 0xf939
+
    JSR .zeroFileHandleAndMotorOn                       ; switch motor on  $^$ 0xf93c
    JSR .setupForCassetteWrite                          ; set up tape filing system for write operation  $^$ 0xf93f
    JSR .shouldPrintMessage                             ; check if free to print message  $^$ 0xf942
    BEQ .exit33                                         ; if (not free to print message) exit  $^$ 0xf945
    JSR .safePrintFollowingMessage                      ; print message following call  $^$ 0xf947
    !text "RECORD then RETURN"                          ; message
    !byte 0                                             ; terminator

-
    JSR .checkForEscapeDuringCassetteOperation          ; check for ESCAPE  $^$ 0xf950
    JSR .OSRDCH                                         ; wait for keypress  $^$ 0xf955
    CMP #.charRETURN                                    ; check for the RETURN key  $^$ 0xf963
    BNE -                                               ; if (not RETURN key) then branch (loop back to test again)  $^$ 0xf965
    JMP .OSNEWL                                         ; output Carriage RETURN and LINE FEED then return  $^$ 0xf967

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Increment load or save address (by one page)
;
; Add a page onto the load address (.loadAddress) when loading,
; or save start address (.tapeSaveStartAddress) when saving.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.incrementLoadOrSaveAddress
    INC .loadAddressMid1                                ; increment page  $^$ 0xf96a
    BNE +                                               ;  $^$ 0xf96c
    INC .loadAddressMid2                                ; increment higher bytes as needed  $^$ 0xf96e
    BNE +                                               ;  $^$ 0xf970
    INC .loadAddressHigh                                ; increment higher bytes as needed  $^$ 0xf972
+
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf974

; ***************************************************************************************
.printSpaceThenHexByte
    PHA                                                 ; save A on stack  $^$ 0xf975
    JSR .printSpace                                     ; print a space  $^$ 0xf976
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xf979
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Print ASCII version of a hex value
;
; On Entry:
;       A = value to print
;       Preserves X and Y
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.printHexByte
    PHA                                                 ; save A on stack  $^$ 0xf97a
    LSR                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf97b
    LSR                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf97c
    LSR                                                 ; } divide by 16 to put high nybble in low  $^$ 0xf97d
    LSR                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf97e
    JSR .printHexDigit                                  ; print its ASCII equivalent  $^$ 0xf97f
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xf982
.printHexDigit
    CLC                                                 ; clear carry flag  $^$ 0xf983
    AND #%00001111                                      ; clear high nybble. A=0-15  $^$ 0xf984
    ADC #.charZERO                                      ; A = $30 to $3F  $^$ 0xf986
    CMP #.charNINE + 1                                  ; }  $^$ 0xf988
    BCC .writeCharJumper                                ; } if A <= ASC('9') then print  $^$ 0xf98a
    ADC #.charA - (.charNINE + 1) - 1                   ; Convert $3A-$3F to A=$41-$46 ('A' to 'F')  $^$ 0xf98c

.writeCharJumper
    JMP .OSWRCH                                         ; print character and return  $^$ 0xf98e

;[ This routine could be three bytes smaller...
;.printHexByte
;    PHA                                                 ; save A on stack
;    LSR                                                 ; }
;    LSR                                                 ; }
;    LSR                                                 ; } divide by 16 to put high nybble in low
;    LSR                                                 ; }
;    JSR .printHexDigit                                  ; print its ASCII equivalent
;    PLA                                                 ; get back A
;    AND #%00001111                                      ; just the lower nybble
;.printHexDigit
;    SED                                                 ; set decimal mode
;    CMP #10                                             ; }
;    ADC #.charZERO                                      ; } decimal mode arithmetic trick
;    CLD                                                 ; clear decimal mode
;    JMP .OSWRCH                                         ; print character and return
;]

; ***************************************************************************************
.printSpace
    LDA #.charSPACE                                     ; A=' '  $^$ 0xf991
    BNE .writeCharJumper                                ; ALWAYS branch (to print it)  $^$ 0xf993

; ***************************************************************************************
.checkForEscapeDuringCassetteOperation
    PHP                                                 ; save flags on stack  $^$ 0xf995
    BIT .tapeCritical                                   ; first read tape critical flag  $^$ 0xf996
    BMI .skipESCAPECheck                                ; if (tape critical) then branch  $^$ 0xf998
    BIT .escapeFlag                                     ; }  $^$ 0xf99a
    BMI .foundEscapeCondition                           ; } if (ESCAPE condition found) then branch  $^$ 0xf99c
.skipESCAPECheck
    PLP                                                 ; get back flags  $^$ 0xf99e
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xf99f

; ***************************************************************************************
.foundEscapeCondition
    JSR .clearCatalogueStatus                           ; clear catalogue status  $^$ 0xf9a0
    JSR .cancelTapeOperationAndMotor                    ;  $^$ 0xf9a3
    LDA #126                                            ; }  $^$ 0xf9a6
    JSR .OSBYTE                                         ; } Acknowledge ESCAPE condition  $^$ 0xf9a8
.escapeError
    BRK                                                 ; cause error  $^$ 0xf9ab
    !byte $11                                           ; error 17
    !text "Escape"                                      ; message
    !byte 0                                             ; terminator

; ***************************************************************************************
; On Entry:
;       Y = 0 for no messages
;       otherwise show messages
.loadBlock
    TYA                                                 ; A=Y  $^$ 0xf9b4
    BEQ +                                               ;  $^$ 0xf9b5
    JSR .safePrintFollowingMessage                      ; print message following call  $^$ 0xf9b7

    !text .charRETURN,"Loading",.charRETURN             ; message text
    !byte 0                                             ; terminator

+
    STA .currentBlockHasDataErrorFlag                   ; data error = zero  $^$ 0xf9c4
    LDX #$FF                                            ; X=$FF  $^$ 0xf9c6
    LDA .checksumIsValidFlag                            ; Checksum result  $^$ 0xf9c8
    BNE .checkForChecksumError                          ; if (checksum failed) then branch  $^$ 0xf9ca

    ; check if we have the right filename
    JSR .compareFilenames                               ; check filename header block matches searched filename.  $^$ 0xf9cc
    PHP                                                 ; save flags on stack  $^$ 0xf9cf
    LDX #$FF                                            ; X=$FF  $^$ 0xf9d0
    LDY #<.fileError                                    ; }  $^$ 0xf9d2
    LDA #>.fileError                                    ; } YA is set to point to 'File?' error  $^$ 0xf9d4
    PLP                                                 ; get back flags  $^$ 0xf9d6
    BNE .printNewlineThenReportError                    ; if (filenames don't match) then branch (report a query unexpected file name)  $^$ 0xf9d7

.checkForChecksumError
    LDY #<.dataError                                    ; making Y/A point to 'Data' for CRC error  $^$ 0xf9d9
    LDA .checksumIsValidFlag                            ; Checksum result  $^$ 0xf9db
    BEQ .checksumOK                                     ; if (no checksum error) then branch  $^$ 0xf9dd
    LDA #>.dataError                                    ; point to dataError  $^$ 0xf9df
    BNE .printNewlineThenReportError                    ; ALWAYS branch (to report issue)  $^$ 0xf9e1

; ***************************************************************************************
.checksumOK
    LDA .fsBlockNumberLow                               ; block number  $^$ 0xf9e3
    CMP .currentBlockNumberLow                          ; current block number low  $^$ 0xf9e6
    BNE .reportBlockError                               ; if (block numbers low byte dont match) then branch  $^$ 0xf9e8
    LDA .fsBlockNumberHigh                              ; block number high  $^$ 0xf9ea
    CMP .currentBlockNumberHigh                         ; current block number high  $^$ 0xf9ed
    BEQ .blockNumbersMatch                              ; if (block numbers high byte matches) then branch  $^$ 0xf9ef

.reportBlockError
    LDY #<.blockError                                   ; } an error has occurred  $^$ 0xf9f1
    LDA #>.blockError                                   ; } point AY to 'Block?' error (unexpected block number)  $^$ 0xf9f3
                                                        ;
.printNewlineThenReportError
    PHA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf9f5
    TYA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf9f6
    PHA                                                 ; } save registers AYX on stack  $^$ 0xf9f7
    TXA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf9f8
    PHA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf9f9
    JSR .newlineAndContinue                             ; print CR if indicated by current block flag  $^$ 0xf9fa
    PLA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf9fd
    TAX                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xf9fe
    PLA                                                 ; } restore XYA from stack  $^$ 0xf9ff
    TAY                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xfa00
    PLA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xfa01
    BNE .checkIfWeShouldShowError                       ; ALWAYS branch (since the high byte of the error message address in A is never zero)  $^$ 0xfa02

; ***************************************************************************************
.blockNumbersMatch
    TXA                                                 ; A=X  $^$ 0xfa04
    PHA                                                 ; save A on stack  $^$ 0xfa05
    JSR .generateScreenReports                          ; report  $^$ 0xfa06
    JSR .waitForBlockToFinish                           ; wait for block to finish  $^$ 0xfa09
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xfa0c
    TAX                                                 ; X=A  $^$ 0xfa0d
    LDA .tapeChecksumLow                                ;  $^$ 0xfa0e
    ORA .tapeChecksumHigh                               ;  $^$ 0xfa10
    BEQ .exit34                                         ; if (checksum succeeded) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xfa12

    ; checksum error
    LDY #<.dataError                                    ; }  $^$ 0xfa14
    LDA #>.dataError                                    ; } AY points to 'Data?'  $^$ 0xfa16

.checkIfWeShouldShowError
    DEC .currentBlockHasDataErrorFlag                   ; set current block flag to $FF  $^$ 0xfa18
    PHA                                                 ; save A on stack  $^$ 0xfa1a
    BIT .tapeCritical                                   ; read tape critical flag  $^$ 0xfa1b
    BMI .tidyUpAndDisplayError                          ; if (tape critical) then branch  $^$ 0xfa1d
    TXA                                                 ; A=X  $^$ 0xfa1f
    AND .tapeOrROMSwitch                                ; filing system flag 0=tape; 2=ROMFS  $^$ 0xfa20
    BNE .tidyUpAndDisplayError                          ; if (ROMFS) then branch  $^$ 0xfa23
    TXA                                                 ; A=X  $^$ 0xfa25
    AND #%00010001                                      ;  $^$ 0xfa26
    AND .tapeCurrentOptionsByte                         ; current options (check for abort)  $^$ 0xfa28
    BEQ .dontAbortOnError                               ; if (not abort on error) then branch  $^$ 0xfa2a

.tidyUpAndDisplayError
    PLA                                                 ; get back A  $^$ 0xfa2c
    STA .printMessageAddressHigh                        ; store A  $^$ 0xfa2d
    STY .printMessageAddressLow                         ; store Y  $^$ 0xfa2f
    JSR .closeSpoolOrExecFile                           ; do *EXEC 0 to tidy up  $^$ 0xfa31
    LSR .tapeCritical                                   ; clear tape critical flag  $^$ 0xfa34
    JSR .beepAndCancelTapeOperation                     ; bell, reset ACIA and motor  $^$ 0xfa36
    JMP (.printMessageAddressLow)                       ; display selected error report  $^$ 0xfa39

; ***************************************************************************************
.dontAbortOnError
    PLA                                                 ; get A from stack  $^$ 0xfa3c
    INY                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xfa3d
    BNE +                                               ; } increment AY  $^$ 0xfa3e
    CLC                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xfa40
    ADC #1                                              ; }  $^$ 0xfa41
+
    PHA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xfa43
    TYA                                                 ; } save AY on stack. This is the  $^$ 0xfa44
    PHA                                                 ; } (byte before) the error message  $^$ 0xfa45
                                                        ; } which will be printed by
                                                        ; } .printFollowingMessage below
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.safePrintFollowingMessage
    JSR .shouldPrintMessage                             ; check if free to print message  $^$ 0xfa46
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A  $^$ 0xfa49
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Print the following message
;
; Prints the message at the address on the top of the stack (this is usually the
; return address, so represents the data that follows a JSR to this function).
; The alternative route here is that we fall through from .dontAbortOnError above, which
; has put the appropriate address on the stack.
;
; On returning from this routine, execution continues from the byte directly after the
; message.
;
; On Entry:
;       The top two bytes on the stack hold the address of the message - 1
;       Y = zero means don't actually output the message
;       otherwise print each character of the message using .OSASCI
; On Exit:
;       A = 0
;       Z is clear (not equal to zero)
; ***************************************************************************************
.printFollowingMessage
    PLA                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xfa4a
    STA .printMessageAddressLow                         ; } get calling address  $^$ 0xfa4b
    PLA                                                 ; } and store it in .printMessageAddressLow/High  $^$ 0xfa4d
    STA .printMessageAddressHigh                        ; }  $^$ 0xfa4e
    TYA                                                 ; A=Y (used to set Z flag if Y=0)  $^$ 0xfa50
    PHP                                                 ; save Z flag on stack  $^$ 0xfa51
-
    INC .printMessageAddressLow                         ;  $^$ 0xfa52
    BNE +                                               ;  $^$ 0xfa54
    INC .printMessageAddressHigh                        ;  $^$ 0xfa56
+
    LDY #0                                              ; Y=0  $^$ 0xfa58
    LDA (.printMessageAddressLow),Y                     ; get byte of message to print  $^$ 0xfa5a
    BEQ .printingFinished                               ; if (terminator found) then branch  $^$ 0xfa5c
                                                        ; (jump back to calling function after
                                                        ; message)
    PLP                                                 ; restore flags from stack  $^$ 0xfa5e
    PHP                                                 ; save flags on stack again  $^$ 0xfa5f
    BEQ -                                               ; if (Z=1, i.e. don't output message)  $^$ 0xfa60
                                                        ; then branch (loop back to get next
                                                        ; character)
    JSR .OSASCI                                         ; print character  $^$ 0xfa62
    JMP -                                               ; jump back to get next character  $^$ 0xfa65

.printingFinished
    PLP                                                 ; get back flags  $^$ 0xfa68
    INC .printMessageAddressLow                         ; increment pointers  $^$ 0xfa69
    BNE +                                               ;  $^$ 0xfa6b
    INC .printMessageAddressHigh                        ;  $^$ 0xfa6d
+
    JMP (.printMessageAddressLow)                       ; return control to just after the error message  $^$ 0xfa6f


; ***************************************************************************************
.compareFilenames
    LDX #$FF                                            ; loop counter  $^$ 0xfa72
.checkNextCharacter
    INX                                                 ; X=X+1  $^$ 0xfa74
    LDA .filenameToSearchFor,X                          ; get sought filename byte  $^$ 0xfa75
    BNE .checkCharacter                                 ; if (non zero) then branch (check this character)  $^$ 0xfa78
    TXA                                                 ; A = filename length  $^$ 0xfa7a
    BEQ +                                               ; if (zero length) then branch (exit)  $^$ 0xfa7b
    LDA .fsFilename,X                                   ; A = filename byte  $^$ 0xfa7d
+
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xfa80

.checkCharacter
    JSR .isLetter                                       ; set carry if byte in A is NOT a letter  $^$ 0xfa81
    EOR .fsFilename,X                                   ; compare with filename character  $^$ 0xfa84
    BCS +                                               ; if (carry set, i.e. not a letter) then branch  $^$ 0xfa87
    AND #$DF                                            ; convert to upper case  $^$ 0xfa89
+
    BEQ .checkNextCharacter                             ; if (zero, i.e. filename characters match) then branch (check the next character)  $^$ 0xfa8b
.exit34
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xfa8d

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Filing System Data Errors
;
; Note that these error routines are called if the abort flag is set in the current options.
; If the abort flag is not set, then the routine is not called, but by manipulating the
; address of the routine, the message contained within is printed and execution continues
; after the message. See .blockNumbersMatch for an example which executes .dontAbortOnError
; See .dontAbortOnError.
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.dataError
    BRK                                                 ;  $^$ 0xfa8e
    !byte $D8                                           ; error number
    !text .charRETURN, "Data?"                          ; message
    !byte 0                                             ; terminator
    BNE .postFileError                                  ; ALWAYs branch  $^$ 0xfa97

.fileError
    BRK                                                 ;  $^$ 0xfa99
    !byte $DB                                           ; error number
    !text .charRETURN, "File?"                          ; message
    !byte 0                                             ; terminator
    BNE .postFileError                                  ; ALWAYs branch  $^$ 0xfaa2

.blockError
    BRK                                                 ;  $^$ 0xfaa4
    !byte $DA                                           ; error number
    !text .charRETURN, "Block?"                         ; message
    !byte 0                                             ; terminator
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.postFileError
    LDA .currentBlockHasDataErrorFlag                   ; get current block flag  $^$ 0xfaae
    BEQ .skipRewindTapeMessage                          ; if (zero) then branch  $^$ 0xfab0
    TXA                                                 ; A=X  $^$ 0xfab2
    BEQ .skipRewindTapeMessage                          ; if (X == 0) then branch (no retry)  $^$ 0xfab3
    LDA #%00100010                                      ; A=$22  $^$ 0xfab5
    BIT .tapeCurrentOptionsByte                         ; check current options  $^$ 0xfab7
    BEQ .skipRewindTapeMessage                          ; if (not retry) then branch (no retry)  $^$ 0xfab9

    ; rewind tape
    JSR .resetACIA                                      ; reset ACIA  $^$ 0xfabb
    TAY                                                 ; Y=A  $^$ 0xfabe
    JSR .printFollowingMessage                          ; print following message  $^$ 0xfabf
    !byte .charRETURN                                   ; Carriage Return
    !byte .charBELL                                     ; Beep
    !text "Rewind tape"                                 ; Message
    !byte .charRETURN, .charRETURN                      ; Carriage Return, Carriage Return
    !byte 0                                             ; terminator
.exit35
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xfad2

.skipRewindTapeMessage
    JSR .saveFlagsPrintCR                               ; print CR if tape filing system not critical  $^$ 0xfad3
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.waitForBlockToFinish
    LDA .fsReadProgressState                            ; get progress state  $^$ 0xfad6
    BEQ .exit35                                         ; if (zero) then branch (return)  $^$ 0xfad8
    JSR .checkForEscapeDuringCassetteOperation          ; check for ESCAPE  $^$ 0xfada
    LDA .tapeOrROMSwitch                                ; filing system flag 0=tape; 2=ROMFS  $^$ 0xfadd
    BEQ .waitForBlockToFinish                           ; if (tape filing system active) then branch (loop back)  $^$ 0xfae0
    JSR .updateACIA                                     ; set up ACIA etc  $^$ 0xfae2
    JMP .waitForBlockToFinish                           ; loop back again  $^$ 0xfae5

; ***************************************************************************************
; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Chapter 21: More Low Level Tape Operations
;
; ***************************************************************************************
; ***************************************************************************************

; ***************************************************************************************
.beepAndCancelTapeOperation
    JSR .shouldPrintMessage                             ; check if free to print message  $^$ 0xfae8
    BEQ .cancelTapeOperationAndMotor                    ;  $^$ 0xfaeb
    LDA #.charBELL                                      ; beep  $^$ 0xfaed
    JSR .OSWRCH                                         ;  $^$ 0xfaef
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
; Cancel the tape operation:
;       relinquish the Tube
;       switch off the cassette motor
;       reset ACIA
.cancelTapeOperationAndMotor
    LDA #$80                                            ;  $^$ 0xfaf2
    JSR .secondProcessorTransfer                        ; relinquish the Tube (NAUG Section 18.8, Page 339)  $^$ 0xfaf4
    LDX #0                                              ;  $^$ 0xfaf7
    JSR .controlMotor                                   ; switch off motor  $^$ 0xfaf9
.cancelTapeOperation
    PHP                                                 ; save flags on stack  $^$ 0xfafc
    SEI                                                 ; prevent IRQ interrupts  $^$ 0xfafd
    LDA .serialULARegisterCopy                          ; get serial ULA control register setting  $^$ 0xfafe
    STA .serialULAControlRegister                       ; write to serial ULA control register setting  $^$ 0xfb01
    LDA #0                                              ; A=0  $^$ 0xfb04
    STA .rs423TimeoutCounter                            ; zero RS-423 timeout counter  $^$ 0xfb06
    BEQ +                                               ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xfb08

; ***************************************************************************************
.setupACIA
    PHP                                                 ; save flags on stacksave flags  $^$ 0xfb0a
+
    JSR .resetACIA                                      ; reset the ACIA  $^$ 0xfb0b
    LDA .rs423ControlRegisterCopy                       ; get last setting of ACIA  $^$ 0xfb0e
    JMP .storeACIAAndPull                               ; set ACIA and OS Copy from A before exit  $^$ 0xfb11


; ***************************************************************************************
.checkForEscapeFlag
    PLP                                                 ; get back flags  $^$ 0xfb14
    BIT .escapeFlag                                     ; check bit 7 of ESCAPE flag  $^$ 0xfb15
    BPL .waitForRS423ToTimeout                          ; if (ESCAPE flag not set) then branch  $^$ 0xfb17
    RTS                                                 ; return (ESCAPE is pending)  $^$ 0xfb19

; ***************************************************************************************
.claimSerialSystemForSequentialAccess
    LDA .tapeOptionsByte                                ; get cassette filing system options byte  $^$ 0xfb1a
                                                        ; high nybble used for LOAD and SAVE operations
                                                        ; low nybble used for sequential access
                                                        ; See .tapeOptByteTable

    ASL                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xfb1c
    ASL                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xfb1d
    ASL                                                 ; } move low nybble into high nybble  $^$ 0xfb1e
    ASL                                                 ; }  $^$ 0xfb1f
    STA .tapeCurrentOptionsByte                         ; save current OPTions  $^$ 0xfb20
    LDA .tapeSequentialAccessInterBlockGap              ; get sequential block gap (>0)  $^$ 0xfb22
    BNE .claimSerialSystem                              ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xfb25

; ***************************************************************************************
.claimSerialSystemForLoadSave
    LDA .tapeOptionsByte                                ; get cassette filing system options byte  $^$ 0xfb27
                                                        ; high nybble used for LOAD and SAVE operations
                                                        ; low nybble used for sequential access
                                                        ; See .tapeOptByteTable

    AND #%11110000                                      ; clear low nybble  $^$ 0xfb29
    STA .tapeCurrentOptionsByte                         ; store as current OPTions  $^$ 0xfb2b
    LDA #6                                              ; set current interblock gap to 6/10ths of a second  $^$ 0xfb2d

.claimSerialSystem
    STA .tapeInterBlockGap                              ; set current interblock gap  $^$ 0xfb2f

    ; wait for the RS-423 system to timeout, so that the cassette system can take over
.waitForRS423ToTimeout
    CLI                                                 ; allow interrupts briefly  $^$ 0xfb31
    PHP                                                 ; save flags on stack (with interrupts enabled)  $^$ 0xfb32
    SEI                                                 ; disable interrupts  $^$ 0xfb33
    BIT .rs423ReadyFlag                                 ;  $^$ 0xfb34
    BPL .checkForEscapeFlag                             ; if (RS-423 is busy) then branch  $^$ 0xfb37
                                                        ; (check escape flag and try again)
    LDA .rs423TimeoutCounter                            ;  $^$ 0xfb39
    BMI .checkForEscapeFlag                             ; if (RS-423 has NOT timed out) then  $^$ 0xfb3b
                                                        ; branch (check for escape flag and try again)

    LDA #1                                              ; } store RS-423 timeout counter with  $^$ 0xfb3d
    STA .rs423TimeoutCounter                            ; } one to indicate that cassette has  $^$ 0xfb3f
                                                        ; } control of the ACIA 6850

    JSR .resetACIA                                      ; reset ACIA  $^$ 0xfb41
    PLP                                                 ; get back flags (enabling interrupts)  $^$ 0xfb44
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xfb45

; ***************************************************************************************
.resetACIA
    LDA #%00000011                                      ; A=3 (bits CR0 and CR1 set means  $^$ 0xfb46
                                                        ;      'master reset')
    BNE .storeAToACIARegister                           ; ALWAYS branch (to reset ACIA)  $^$ 0xfb48

; ***************************************************************************************
.activateRequestToSend
    LDA #%00110000                                      ; set current ACIA control register  $^$ 0xfb4a
                                                        ; 8 bit word, 2 stop bits, RTS low
                                                        ; (this is the active state), transmit
                                                        ; interrupt enabled
    STA .tapeSendingFlag                                ; set non-zero value to indicate  $^$ 0xfb4c
                                                        ; sending to tape
    BNE .setACIA6850ControlRegister                     ; ALWAYS branch  $^$ 0xfb4e

; ***************************************************************************************
.flipRelayOffAndOnThenSetToReadFromTape
    LDA #%00000101                                      ; set .serialULAControlRegister  $^$ 0xfb50
    STA .serialULAControlRegister                       ; which sets transmit to 300 baud  $^$ 0xfb52
                                                        ;           receive to 19200 baud
                                                        ;              tape system in use
                                                        ;                       motor off
    LDX #$FF                                            ; loop counter  $^$ 0xfb55
-
    DEX                                                 ; } delay loop  $^$ 0xfb57
    BNE -                                               ; }  $^$ 0xfb58
    STX .tapeSendingFlag                                ; .tapeSendingFlag = 0  $^$ 0xfb5a
    LDA #%10000101                                      ;     transmit baud rate 300 baud  $^$ 0xfb5c
                                                        ;           receive to 19200 baud
                                                        ;              tape system in use
                                                        ;                        motor on
    STA .serialULAControlRegister                       ;  $^$ 0xfb5e

    LDA #%11010000                                      ; A=%11010000  $^$ 0xfb61
                                                        ; bit 7     - enable interrupts
                                                        ; bit 6/5   - RTS high, transmit
                                                        ;             interrupt disabled
                                                        ; bit 4/3/2 - 8 bit word, 2 stop bits
                                                        ; bit 1/0   - divide counter by 1
.setACIA6850ControlRegister
    ORA .tapeBaudRate                                   ; set bits for baud rate:  $^$ 0xfb63
                                                        ; 5 = %101 means 1200 baud
                                                        ; (divide by 16; 1 stop bit)
                                                        ; 6 = %110 means  300 baud
                                                        ; (divide by 64; 1 stop bit)
.storeAToACIARegister
    STA .acia6850ControlRegister                        ; set up ACIA control register  $^$ 0xfb65
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xfb68

; ***************************************************************************************
.incrementBlockNumbers
    LDX .fsBlockNumberLow                               ; block number  $^$ 0xfb69
    LDY .fsBlockNumberHigh                              ; block number high  $^$ 0xfb6c
    INX                                                 ; X=X+1  $^$ 0xfb6f
    STX .currentBlockNumberLow                          ; current block number low  $^$ 0xfb70
    BNE +                                               ;  $^$ 0xfb72
    INY                                                 ; Y=Y+1  $^$ 0xfb74
+
    STY .currentBlockNumberHigh                         ; current block number high  $^$ 0xfb75
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xfb77

; ***************************************************************************************
.zeroChecksumAndFSFlag
    LDY #0                                              ;  $^$ 0xfb78
    STY .fsGotACharacterToReadOrWriteFlag               ; clear 'just read character' flag  $^$ 0xfb7a
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Set (zero) checksum bytes
;
; On Entry:
;       Y = value to store (always zero in practice)
.setChecksumBytesToY
    STY .tapeChecksumLow                                ;  $^$ 0xfb7c
    STY .tapeChecksumHigh                               ;  $^$ 0xfb7e
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xfb80

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Copy zero terminated string to .filenameToSearchFor
;
; On Entry:
;       X is offset from $301 for source string
; ***************************************************************************************
.copyToSoughtFilename
    LDY #$FF                                            ; Y=$FF  $^$ 0xfb81
-
    INY                                                 ; Y=Y+1  $^$ 0xfb83
    INX                                                 ; X=X+1  $^$ 0xfb84
    LDA .vduVariablesStart,X                            ;  $^$ 0xfb85
    STA .filenameToSearchFor,Y                          ; sought filename  $^$ 0xfb88
    BNE -                                               ; until end of filename (0)  $^$ 0xfb8b
    RTS                                                 ;  $^$ 0xfb8d

; ***************************************************************************************
.zeroFileHandleAndMotorOn
    LDY #0                                              ; Y=0  $^$ 0xfb8e
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
.storeFileHandleAndMotorOn
    CLI                                                 ; enable interrupts  $^$ 0xfb90
    LDX #1                                              ; X=1 (relay on)  $^$ 0xfb91
    STY .tapeCurrentFileHandle                          ; store Y as current file handle  $^$ 0xfb93
    ; fall through...

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Control Tape Relay (On / Off)
;
; On Entry:
;       X = 0 for relay off
;       X = 1 for relay on
.controlMotor
    LDA #137                                            ; do OSBYTE 137  $^$ 0xfb95
    LDY .tapeCurrentFileHandle                          ; get back file handle (preserved through OSBYTE)  $^$ 0xfb97
    JMP .OSBYTE                                         ; turn on motor  $^$ 0xfb99

; ***************************************************************************************
;
; Check file is open
;
; On Entry:
;       A = 1 means check file is open for reading (check bit 0 of tape status byte)
;       A = 2 means check file is open for writing (check bit 1 of tape status byte)
;       A = 3 means check file is open for reading or writing
;       Y = file handle ('channel')
;
; On Exit:
;       If file is not open then a 'Channel' error occurs
;
; ***************************************************************************************
.checkFileIsOpen
    STA .fsTempStorage                                  ; remember action type (1-3)  $^$ 0xfb9c
    TYA                                                 ; A=Y=channel:  $^$ 0xfb9e
                                                        ;   1 = input file on tape
                                                        ;   2 = output file on tape
                                                        ;   3 = input file from ROMFS

    EOR .tapeOrROMSwitch                                ; EOR with filing system flag  $^$ 0xfb9f
